name: Systematic fund investment and financial planning adjustments.
description: On June 10, Yu Xiaowen made systematic investments in two balanced funds through the banking app as planned, totaling 2,000 yuan. At the same time, following the advice of financial advisor Wang Mingyuan, she transferred 5,000 yuan of demand deposits originally intended for daily consumption into a short-term wealth management product with a seven-day annualized return of 3.2% to improve returns on idle funds. After the operations, she reorganized that month's asset allocation in her notebook.

subevent.name: Execute the scheduled fund investment.
subevent.description: In the recurring investment section of her banking app, Yu Xiaowen invested 1,000 yuan in each of two mixed funds, for a total of 2,000 yuan, and completed the investment after confirming her payment password. These two funds were the mid-to-long-term allocation targets she had chosen earlier based on Wang Mingyuan's advice.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City - Home Study Room

subevent.name: Transfer demand deposit to short-term wealth management
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen transferred 5,000 yuan originally in her current account to a short-term wealth management product with a seven-day annualized yield of 3.2% in the bank app. After the operation succeeded, the system showed the interest start date as the next day, with a 30-day lock-up period for the funds.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City - Home Study Room

name: Attended the hospital's young physician clinical skills training.
description: On the Monday afternoons of March 10, 17, and 24, Yu Xiaowen attended the hospital's series of clinical skills training sessions for young physicians. The training covered emergency skills (CPR, defibrillator use), simulated deep venous catheterization, and doctor-patient communication skills. After the training on March 24, an assessment was held, and she passed with a good score. These sessions laid the foundation for the upcoming emergency skills competition and also boosted her daily clinical confidence.

subevent.name: First clinical skills training for young physicians
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Monday, March 10, 2025, Yu Xiaowen attended the first session of the hospital's clinical skills training series for young physicians at the Clinical Skills Training Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The training covered emergency skills, including theoretical explanations and simulated operations of cardiopulmonary resuscitation and defibrillator use. She and the other young physicians in her group took turns practicing under the guidance of the instructors and became familiar with the emergency procedures and equipment operation.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Clinical Skills Training Center

subevent.name: Second clinical skills training session for young physicians
subevent.description: On Monday afternoon, March 17, 2025, Yu Xiaowen attended the second session of the series of trainings at the Clinical Skills Training Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The training topic was simulation of deep venous puncture. She practiced internal jugular vein and subclavian vein puncture and catheterization on a high-fidelity mannequin and mastered the procedure steps and precautions. After the training, she exchanged insights with colleagues.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Clinical Skills Training Center

subevent.name: Third Session of Clinical Skills Training and Assessment for Young Physicians
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Monday, March 24, 2025, Yu Xiaowen attended the final session of a training series at the Clinical Skills Training Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The training included theory and case simulations of doctor-patient communication skills, as well as a comprehensive practical skills assessment. She completed four assessments in turn: cardiopulmonary resuscitation, defibrillator use, deep venous puncture, and doctor-patient communication scenario simulation, and passed with a good grade. This training laid a solid foundation for the first aid skills competition and also boosted her clinical confidence.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Clinical Skills Training Center

name: Trying meditation before bedtime to improve sleep quality.
description: On the evening of April 18, after three consecutive nights of insomnia due to work pressure and family matters, Yu Xiaowen downloaded the Tide app on her phone and followed the guide for a 15-minute pre-bedtime meditation. After finishing, she felt calm and fell asleep noticeably faster. She resolved to make meditation a regular part of every evening to cope with anxiety during high-pressure periods.

subevent.name: Download the Tide app and learn about its meditation features
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen felt anxious before bed because she had been unable to sleep for three consecutive days, so she decided to try meditation to help her sleep. She searched and downloaded the Tide App in her phone's app store, spent a few minutes browsing the interface and guided courses, and chose a 15-minute meditation exercise suitable for relaxing before sleep.
subevent.location: No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Do a 15-minute bedtime meditation practice
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen put on her earphones, lay in bed, and followed the guidance of the Tide app for a 15-minute meditation practice. She did deep breathing and a body scan as prompted, focusing on the rhythm of her breathing and gradually relaxing her body and mind. After finishing the meditation, she felt calm and fell asleep much faster.
subevent.location: No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Record meditation experience and develop a plan to stick with it
subevent.description: After the meditation ended, Yu Xiaowen briefly recorded the effects and feelings of this meditation in the notes app on her phone, writing, 'It felt great, and I fell asleep faster.' She resolved to make meditation a fixed part of her nightly routine and set a daily bedtime alarm to remind herself, so as to cope with anxiety during high-pressure periods.
subevent.location: No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - bedroom at home

name: Badminton friend Lin Wei arranged to meet and have a long chat, deepening their friendship through the sport.
description: On April 25, badminton friend Lin Wei sent a message to meet up. The two talked for a long time on a bench outside the gym. Although they couldn't play due to time constraints, they exchanged updates on their lives and stress. Lin Wei's listening and understanding made Yu Xiaowen feel relaxed, and their friendship deepened, also setting the stage for resuming exercise later.

subevent.name: Lin Wei sent a message to arrange a meeting.
subevent.description: On the morning of April 25, 2025, badminton friend Lin Wei sent Yu Xiaowen a message via WeChat, saying she wanted to meet up and chat that day and share recent updates.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – Yu Xiaowen's home (via mobile phone)

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowen responded and headed to the gym.
subevent.description: After receiving the message, Yu Xiaowen replied agreeing, and after work that afternoon she walked or drove to her usual badminton hall, waiting for Lin Wei in the bench area outside the hall.
subevent.location: Near the badminton hall in Zhengzhou

subevent.name: The two talked at length on a bench outside the sports hall
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen and Lin Wei sat down on a bench outside the badminton hall and talked about their recent work, life, and stress. Lin Wei listened patiently and showed understanding. Yu Xiaowen felt relaxed and warm, and their friendship deepened. Because it was already late, they didn't get to play.
subevent.location: A bench outside a badminton hall in Zhengzhou

name: Celebrating the new home: a warm family dinner
description: On Saturday evening, March 22, after her parents moved into their new home in Jinshui District, Yu Xiaowen personally made the braised noodles and sweet and sour pork ribs her parents loved, and also specially prepared a fruit salad. At the dinner table, the family of three chatted while eating. Her parents sighed at how hard their daughter worked, while Yu Xiaowen reassured them to enjoy a peaceful retirement. This dinner marked a new beginning of family reunion, and the warmth of family love dissolved the fatigue of the past days.

subevent.name: Buy ingredients for dinner
subevent.description: On the morning of March 22, Yu Xiaowen went to the vegetable market or supermarket near her home to buy mutton, flour, and vegetables for making stewed noodles, as well as pork tenderloin, sugar, vinegar, and other seasonings for sweet and sour pork. She also picked up fresh fruit to make fruit salad, preparing for the family dinner that evening.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - food market/supermarket

subevent.name: Cooked a family dinner.
subevent.description: From the afternoon to the evening of March 22, Yu Xiaowen personally made her father's favorite braised noodles and her mother's favorite sweet and sour pork tenderloin in the kitchen of her parents' new home in Jinshui District, and carefully prepared a fruit salad. Using the existing kitchen tools and the purchased ingredients, she cooked carefully according to home-style methods to ensure a hearty and delicious dinner.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou – kitchen at parents’ new home

subevent.name: The whole family enjoyed a warm dinner together.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 22, Yu Xiaowen had dinner with her father Yu Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying in the dining room of her parents' new home. The three sat around the table, eating and chatting. Yu Xiaowen enjoyed her own cooking, and her parents praised her for being a filial daughter. Her father remarked that her work was hard, while her mother asked about her life in Zhengzhou. Yu Xiaowen reassured her parents to settle into retirement with peace of mind. The family was filled with warmth and joy, and this dinner marked a new beginning of family reunion.
subevent.location: Dining room at parents' new home, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City

name: Complete the finishing work on a complex case report
description: From January 13 to 14, Yu Xiaowen organized the complex case analysis she had taken over since January 6 into a complete first draft of a clinical report and submitted it to her supervising attending physician, Li Wei, for review. Dr. Li carefully annotated it, noting that the differential diagnosis reasoning was clear, and suggested revising it before submission. That afternoon, Yu Xiaowen revised and polished it according to the annotations, marked the content that needed to be checked, and planned to complete the paper submission preparation later.

subevent.name: Prepared the first draft of the case report.
subevent.description: In the on-duty room at Zhengzhou Central Hospital or at home, Yu Xiaowen systematically organized the complex case analyses she had taken over since January 6, and wrote a complete first draft of the clinical report, including medical history, diagnosis, treatment process, and differential diagnosis.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Submit the report and ask Teacher Li Wei to review it.
subevent.description: On the morning of January 14, Yu Xiaowen submitted the compiled case report to her supervising teacher, attending physician Li Wei. After carefully reviewing it, Teacher Li Wei gave detailed comments, particularly pointing out that Yu Xiaowen's differential diagnosis thinking was clear, and suggested that she could further revise it for paper submission.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Revise the report based on the review comments
subevent.description: Based on Teacher Li Wei's annotations and submission suggestions, Yu Xiaowen revised and improved the case report on the department computer that afternoon, marked content that needed further verification, and planned to complete the paper submission preparations later.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: On the eve of Qingming Festival, held a remote memorial for her grandparents and prayed for her father's recovery.
description: On the evening of April 3, on the eve of Qingming Festival, Yu Xiaowen paid distant tribute to her grandparents in Luoyang from the balcony of her rented apartment in Jinshui District. She lit a small ceramic lamp she had made herself, silently praying in the flickering light for her father's early recovery. This ritual-filled act was both a remembrance of deceased relatives and an emotional sustenance under family pressure.

subevent.name: Making a pottery lamp for sacrificial use.
subevent.description: At home, Yu Xiaowen used pottery tools and materials to make a small clay lamp for a distant memorial ceremony during the Qingming Festival. She carefully shaped the lamp base and lamp bowl by hand, carved the abbreviated names of her grandparents on it, and left a wick hole. After finishing, she set it aside to dry.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City - Home Study Room

subevent.name: Prepare items for remote ancestor worship.
subevent.description: On the evening of April 3, Yu Xiaowen prepared items for a distant ritual in the living room of her rented apartment: she filled a small handmade clay lamp with vegetable oil and a wick, took out a piece of white paper and wrote a prayer for her father's recovery, and prepared a lighter and a small tray to place the clay lamp on the balcony.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City - living room at home

subevent.name: Perform a remote memorial ceremony on the balcony
subevent.description: Carrying a tray with a lit small ceramic lamp on it, Yu Xiaowen walked to the south balcony of her rented apartment, facing the direction of Luoyang. She placed the ceramic lamp on the balcony railing. As the flame flickered, she closed her eyes and silently mourned her deceased grandparents, and softly prayed that her father, who was recuperating at home in Luoyang, would recover soon. The whole process lasted about 15 minutes and was full of ritual and emotional significance.
subevent.location: Rented apartment balcony, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

name: Leave care instructions for mother.
description: On the morning of February 24, before returning to Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen left a detailed note on her father's nightstand, listing medication times, rehabilitation training reminders, and the follow-up appointment date for the next week, and urged her mother to rest well, showing her attentive guardian qualities.

subevent.name: Writing a caregiving reminder note
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen sat beside her father's nightstand and wrote detailed reminders on an A4 sheet of paper with a pen: listing the mother's three daily medication times (8:00, 14:00, 20:00), rehabilitation exercise reminders (one set each of leg lifts and breathing exercises in the morning and afternoon), and the specific time and materials to bring for next Wednesday's follow-up visit. Her handwriting was neat, and she marked the key points.
subevent.location: Home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Small ceremony for International Women's Day
description: On Saturday afternoon, March 8, after finishing half a day of outpatient work, Yu Xiaowen stopped by a flower shop near the hospital and picked a bouquet of elegant carnations, and made an exception to buy a slice of strawberry cake. Back at her place, she took a photo and sent it to her mother and the close-friends group chat, celebrating the occasion with a little floral fragrance and sweetness, reminding herself that she too deserves to be seen amid the busyness.

subevent.name: Completed half a day of outpatient work.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen completed her half-day outpatient clinic at Zhengzhou Central Hospital in the afternoon, seeing various patients, issuing prescriptions and examination orders, and handling routine work such as medical records.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhongyuan District - Outpatient Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Went to the flower shop to choose and buy carnations.
subevent.description: After finishing her outpatient clinic, Yu Xiaowen dropped by a flower shop near the hospital on her way, carefully chose a bouquet of elegant carnations—pink-white and light purple flowers with green leaves—paid, and took it with her.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhongyuan District - flower shop near the hospital

subevent.name: Go to the cake shop to buy a strawberry cake
subevent.description: After leaving the flower shop, Yu Xiaowen walked into a nearby bakery and, as an exception, bought a freshly made strawberry cake, packaged in an exquisite paper box, as a small treat for herself for the holiday.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhongyuan District - bakery near the hospital

subevent.name: Returned to the accommodation, took photos, and shared them.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen returned to her residence at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, put the carnations into a vase and the strawberry cake on the table, carefully arranged them, took photos with her phone, and sent the photos to her mother Yu Xiaowen's WeChat and the close-friend group (Zhang Jing, Wang Lina, Sun Yue, etc.), along with festive greetings.
subevent.location: Living room, Jingsan Road residence, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Enjoying a personal celebration
subevent.description: In the living room, Yu Xiaowen celebrated International Women's Day with a small ritualistic touch—admiring fresh flowers, tasting strawberry cake, and listening to European classical music—while reminding herself that even amid busy work, she deserved to be seen and treated kindly.
subevent.location: Living room, Jingsan Road residence, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

name: Had dinner with university classmate Sun Yue and caught up.
description: On the evening of Friday, July 25, Yu Xiaowen met up with her college classmate and close friend Sun Yue for dinner at a Hunan restaurant in Erqi District. As they enjoyed the food, they shared interesting stories and pressures from their recent work. Sun Yue also joked about the bizarre cases she had encountered at the hospital. After dinner, they strolled around a nearby mall and bought some small accessories. This gathering let Yu Xiaowen temporarily forget her worries and feel the support of friendship.

subevent.name: After work, headed to the dinner venue.
subevent.description: After work on the evening of July 25, Yu Xiaowen set out from Zhengzhou Central Hospital, drove her family car to the agreed Hunan cuisine restaurant in Erqi District, and on the way confirmed arrival times with Sun Yue via WeChat.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Erqi District - a Hunan restaurant

subevent.name: Had dinner and caught up with Sun Yue at a Hunan restaurant
subevent.description: On the evening of July 25, Yu Xiaowen had dinner with her college friend Sun Yue at a Hunan restaurant in Erqi District. As they enjoyed the Hunan cuisine, they shared fun stories and stress from their recent work. Sun Yue also teased her about the bizarre cases she had encountered at the hospital. The dinner was relaxed and pleasant, lasting about 1.5 hours.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Erqi District - a Hunan restaurant

subevent.name: Went shopping at the mall after a meal
subevent.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue strolled around the mall near the Hunan restaurant. They chatted as they walked, picked out a few small accessories at an accessories shop, and Sun Yue also helped Yu Xiaowen choose a pair of earrings. The two continued sharing snippets of their lives, and ended shopping about an hour later.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Erqi District - a shopping mall

subevent.name: Ended the gathering and returned home.
subevent.description: Before the mall closed, Yu Xiaowen said goodbye to Sun Yue and drove alone back to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District. After arriving home, she washed up and rested. That evening she felt happy and supported by friendship.
subevent.location: Home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Discovered middle school diary and revisited old times.
description: On the afternoon of February 22, while sorting through old belongings at her home in Luoyang, Yu Xiaowen unexpectedly found her middle school diary. As she flipped through it, she recalled the friendships and dreams of her middle school years, reflected on how hard it is to grow up, and became even more determined to take good care of her family.

subevent.name: Tidy up old belongings at home in Luoyang.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen took advantage of her vacation time at her parents' home in Luoyang (No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City) and began sorting through old boxes stored in the study cabinet in her hometown, including cleaning out childhood toys, exercise books, picture albums, and other personal items.
subevent.location: Parents' Home Study, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Discovered and flipped through my middle school diary
subevent.description: While sorting through an old belongings box, Yu Xiaowen unexpectedly found her middle school diary. She put down her current work, sat on the sofa in the study, and carefully read through the diary page by page, recalling her middle school friends, dreams, and interesting moments from campus life.
subevent.location: Parents' Home Study, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Review insights and put everything back in place.
subevent.description: After flipping through the diary, Yu Xiaowen was filled with emotion. Thinking about her growth from middle school to becoming a doctor, she became even more determined to take good care of her family and cherish the present. She carefully put the diary back into the box of old belongings and continued sorting the remaining items.
subevent.location: Parents' Home Study, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Sunday: browsed a bookstore alone, bought books, and rested.
description: On the afternoon of Sunday, January 5, 2025, Yu Xiaowen went alone to the Zhengzhou Book Center. In the literature section, she picked The Miracles of the Namiya General Store by Keigo Higashino as leisure reading, then read the first two chapters while drinking a latte in the bookstore's café area, enjoying a rare moment of tranquility.

subevent.name: Go to the Book Center.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen drove her own family car from home to Zhengzhou Book Center, passing city roads such as Jinshui Road and Wenhua Road along the way. The drive took about 15 minutes, and she arrived around 2 p.m.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Book Center (along the way and parking lot)

subevent.name: Selecting and reading at the bookstore
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen entered the Zhengzhou Book Center, went straight to the literature section, and browsed carefully in front of the bestseller shelf. She finally chose The Miracles of the Namiya General Store by Keigo Higashino as leisure reading. Then she went to the cafe area inside the bookstore, ordered a latte, sat in a window seat, and quietly read the first two chapters of the book, enjoying about an hour of peaceful time.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou Book Center (Coffee Area)

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: At around 4:30 in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen finished her bookstore visit. After paying, she left the book center with the copy of The Miracles of the Namiya General Store she had bought, and drove back along the same route to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District. After arriving home, she tidied up her things and put the new book on her bedside table.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Wang Fang shared her engagement news, planting the seed for a bridesmaid role.
description: On January 2, 2025, the first day back to work after the holiday, colleague Wang Fang shared the amusing story of being proposed to during New Year's Eve in the department break area. At noon, she privately told Yu Xiaowen about her engagement and invited her to be a bridesmaid. That evening, Yu Xiaowen told her close friends the good news, planting a clue for the later twists and reconciliation in their friendship.

subevent.name: Wang Fang shared her New Year's Eve marriage proposal experience in the department
subevent.description: On the morning of January 2, 2025, the first day back after the holiday, in the department lounge of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, colleague Wang Fang excitedly told Yu Xiaowen, Liu Qiang, Wu Min, and other department colleagues the detailed story of her boyfriend's New Year's Eve proposal, including the proposal scene, the ring display, and how she felt at the time. Everyone gave their congratulations, and the atmosphere was lively.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Department rest area, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Wang Fang privately revealed her engagement and hinted at the bridesmaid choice
subevent.description: During the noon break that day, Wang Fang took Yu Xiaowen aside and privately confided in her in a quiet corner of the department corridor that she and her boyfriend had set their engagement date. She warmly said she hoped Yu Xiaowen would serve as her bridesmaid, saying she considered Yu Xiaowen one of her most trusted friends. Surprised and delighted, Yu Xiaowen congratulated her and happily agreed to consider it. The two had a very pleasant chat.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - department corridor, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowen shared the good news of Wang Fang's engagement with her best friend
subevent.description: Back home that evening, Yu Xiaowen used a WeChat video call to share the good news with her best friend Zhang Jing that Wang Fang had told her about her engagement and the bridesmaid invitation. The two discussed wedding-related topics. Zhang Jing was happy for Yu Xiaowen and suggested she prepare the bridesmaid gift in advance.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - home

name: Completed annual comprehensive physical examination.
description: On August 14, Yu Xiaowen made an appointment through the hospital's official WeChat account for the annual physical examination on the morning of August 16. On August 16, after taking a compensatory day off, she went to the hospital's physical examination center and completed items including a complete blood count, biochemical tests, electrocardiogram, and abdominal ultrasound. The whole process took about 1.5 hours, and she was told that the results would be issued on the afternoon of August 18. On August 17, she rested at home and kept an eye on hospital notifications. On the afternoon of August 18, she checked the electronic report. Apart from mild loss of cervical lordosis, there were no abnormalities. As recommended, she began doing cervical spine exercises every day starting that evening.

subevent.name: Book annual physical exam.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen booked an annual comprehensive physical examination online for the morning of August 16, 2025, through the Zhengzhou Central Hospital WeChat official account, confirmed the physical examination package and fasting requirements, and set a phone reminder.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Home

subevent.name: Undergo the annual physical examination.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 16, 2025, after taking a compensatory day off, Yu Xiaowen went to the Physical Examination Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital for her annual comprehensive checkup. She completed blood routine, biochemistry, electrocardiogram, abdominal ultrasound, and other items in sequence, which took about 1.5 hours in total. Finally, she received breakfast and was told that the results would be available on the afternoon of August 18.
subevent.location: Henan Province-Zhengzhou City-Zhongyuan District-Zhengzhou Central Hospital Physical Examination Center

subevent.name: Waiting for physical examination results
subevent.description: The day after the physical examination, Yu Xiaowen rested at home. She took no special action, only checked the hospital's official account reminders on her phone and waited for the results to be released the next day.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Home

subevent.name: Review the physical examination report and interpretation
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 18, 2025, Yu Xiaowen viewed her electronic physical examination report through the WeChat official account of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. She confirmed that all indicators were normal but saw a prompt indicating mild straightening of the cervical spine's natural curvature. She carefully read the suggestions in the notes from the physical examination department and decided to follow the guidance by doing daily cervical spine exercises.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Home

subevent.name: Start performing the cervical spine exercise routine
subevent.description: On the evening of August 18, 2025, based on the suggestions in her physical examination report and standard movements she found online, Yu Xiaowen performed the complete set of cervical spine health exercises for the first time in her living room, including neck flexion and extension, left and right rotation, and shoulder shrugs to relax. It took about 10 minutes, and she decided to make it a fixed nightly habit.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Home

name: Participated in the online discussion of the Women's Power reading list co-reading program
description: Yu Xiaowen logged into Tencent Meeting from her study at home in Zhengzhou at 8 PM every Tuesday in March (4th, 11th, 18th, 25th) to participate in the online discussion of the Women's Power Book List Co-reading Program, sharing her thoughts on Becoming, exchanging views with fellow readers on women's growth topics, and drawing spiritual strength from it.

subevent.name: Participated in the first online discussion of the joint reading program.
subevent.description: At 8 p.m. on Tuesday, March 4, 2025, Yu Xiaowen logged into Tencent Meeting on time at her home in Zhengzhou to join the first online discussion of the Women's Power Reading List co-reading plan. She sincerely shared her reflections on self-awareness and growth from Chapter 1 of 'Becoming' and interacted with other readers.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Participated in the second online discussion of the co-reading plan
subevent.description: On Tuesday, March 11, 2025, at 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen logged into Tencent Meeting at her home in Zhengzhou to participate in the second online discussion of the shared reading plan. Based on her reading reflections on the later chapters of "Becoming," she had an in-depth discussion with book friends on the topic of women's growth and drew spiritual strength from it.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Participate in the third online discussion of the co-reading plan
subevent.description: On Tuesday evening, March 18, 2025, at 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen logged into Tencent Meeting at her home in Zhengzhou to participate in the third online discussion of the shared-reading program. She continued sharing her reflections on "Becoming" and exchanged ideas with fellow readers about balancing personal growth and career development, opening up intellectual space amid a high-pressure life.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Participated in the fourth online discussion of the group reading plan.
subevent.description: On Tuesday, March 25, 2025, at 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen logged into Tencent Meeting at her home in Zhengzhou to participate in the fourth and final online discussion of the shared reading plan. She and her fellow readers summarized their reflections on the whole book, shared their growth and changes from reading, and successfully concluded the reading activity.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: Reuniting at home on New Year's Eve and staying up late.
description: On January 28, Chinese New Year's Eve, Yu Xiaowen, her mother Li Xiuying, and her brother Yu Xiaofeng prepared the New Year's Eve dinner at their home in Xigong District, Luoyang. They cooked yam porridge for her father Yu Jianguo and made huimian noodles, which she loved. At six in the evening, the family gathered in the living room for the New Year's Eve dinner, including dishes such as pork rib soup. After dinner, they sat around watching the Spring Festival Gala. When the bell rang at midnight, they stayed up to greet each other with New Year wishes, used their phones to capture the moment of reunion, and spent a simple, family-centered New Year.

subevent.name: Returning home for family reunion and preparing the New Year's Eve dinner.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen, her mother Li Xiuying, and her older brother Yu Xiaofeng prepared ingredients for the Chinese New Year's Eve dinner in advance at their home in Xigong District, Luoyang. Yu Xiaowen cooked yam porridge for her father and made the stewed noodles (huimian) she loved. Her mother and brother were responsible for washing vegetables, cutting vegetables, and simmering other dishes. The family divided the work and prepared the meal together.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Xigong District, home kitchen.

subevent.name: The family enjoyed New Year's Eve dinner together
subevent.description: Around six in the evening, Yu Xiaowen, her parents, and her elder brother gathered at the dining table in the living room and enjoyed the Chinese New Year's Eve dinner they had prepared themselves, including yam porridge, braised noodles, and the pork rib soup stewed by her mother. During the meal, the family chatted about everyday matters and shared funny stories about work and life over the past year, creating a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Xigong District, Luoyang

subevent.name: The whole family watches the Spring Festival Gala.
subevent.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen, her parents, and her older brother sat together on the living room sofa watching the CCTV Spring Festival Gala. During the show, they chatted while eating sunflower seeds and candy, occasionally commenting on the performances, enjoying their time together as a family.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Xigong District, Luoyang

subevent.name: Chinese New Year's Eve vigil and exchanging blessings of safety
subevent.description: When the bell struck midnight, Yu Xiaowen stayed up with her parents and older brother to celebrate the arrival of the New Year. The family hugged and blessed each other, exchanged wishes for safety and health, and used their phones to capture the reunion. Then they each went back to their rooms to rest, ending a simple and complete New Year's Eve.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Xigong District, Luoyang

name: A typo in a night-shift medical order triggered deep reflection, and the idea of a career transition and changing departments began to emerge
description: During the late-night shift on June 12, Yu Xiaowen, severely sleep-deprived from consecutive days of family caregiving, made a dosage error when prescribing a common medication. Fortunately, the charge nurse on duty, Wu Min, caught it during verification and quietly reminded her. After the handover the next day, Wu Min deliberately pulled her aside and, in the break room, shared a story from when she first started working and a family crisis nearly led to a medical error, warmly encouraging her with 'Don't let yourself snap.' That evening, Yu Xiaowen went through 'Better', which she had been reading intermittently for months, and finally finished the last chapter on June 14. In her notes she wrote, 'Mastery lies not only in technique, but in every choice made in daily life,' directly pointing to the lesson from the prescription error. Late at night on June 15, she sent a WeChat message to her best friend Wang Lina: 'Am I not suitable to be a doctor?' Wang Lina instantly replied, 'A good doctor is first of all someone who survives.' This resonated strongly with her. Before the morning ward rounds on June 16, she for the first time seriously considered applying for a transfer to the rehabilitation department, which has relatively lower clinical pressure, to match the current pace of family life.

subevent.name: Night-shift medical order typo incident
subevent.description: Late on the night of June 12, while on night duty at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen, severely sleep-deprived after days of caring for her family, wrote the wrong dosage for a commonly used medication. Wu Min, the nurse manager on duty, caught the error while checking the medication order and quietly reminded her to correct it, avoiding a potential medical risk.
subevent.location: Ward at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Had a heart-to-heart talk with Wu Min and received encouragement.
subevent.description: After the morning handover on June 13, Wu Min deliberately pulled Yu Xiaowen into the department break room and shared how, when she had just started working, she had nearly made a medical error because of family difficulties, and warmly encouraged her: 'Don't stretch yourself until you break.' This conversation made Yu Xiaowen feel understood and comforted, and also prompted her to reflect on her own working state.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Rest room at Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Finished reading Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance and wrote reflection notes
subevent.description: On the evening of June 14, Yu Xiaowen was at home leafing through "Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance", which she had been reading intermittently for months, and finally finished the last chapter. In her notes, she wrote: 'Excellence lies not only in skill, but in every daily choice.' This recorded her deep reflection on the night-shift clerical error incident, emphasizing the importance of professionalism and everyday details.
subevent.location: No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home study

subevent.name: Sharing career confusion with her best friend late at night
subevent.description: Late on the night of June 15, Yu Xiaowen, at her home in Zhengzhou, sent a message via WeChat to her best friend Wang Lina, who was far away in Shenzhen: ‘Am I not suited to be a doctor?’ Wang Lina instantly replied: ‘A good doctor is first of all someone who survives.’ This sentence resonated strongly with Yu Xiaowen, temporarily easing her self-doubt and prompting her to begin seriously thinking about future career adjustment.
subevent.location: No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - bedroom at home

subevent.name: First time considering applying for a transfer to the Rehabilitation Department
subevent.description: On the morning of June 16, before her morning ward rounds, Yu Xiaowen thought alone in the corridor of Zhengzhou Central Hospital and, for the first time, seriously considered submitting a department transfer request to her department, with the goal of moving to the rehabilitation department, which has relatively lower clinical pressure, in order to better match her current family life rhythm and personal energy levels.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - corridor in the department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Wang Fang delivered an invitation card and suggested forming a team to participate in the first aid skills competition.
description: On March 20, Wang Fang made a special trip to the department to deliver her wedding invitation and formally invited Yu Xiaowen to be her bridesmaid. On March 22, the hospital issued a notice for the annual emergency skills competition. Wang Fang immediately suggested the two team up to compete. After hesitating, Yu Xiaowen ultimately agreed, and their friendship became stronger through a shared goal.

Facing this happy news, despite her busy schedule and financial pressure at home recently, Yu Xiaowen gladly accepted. The two had a warm exchange in the department lounge, and their relationship warmed further.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Weekend pottery class, shopping, and dinner with close friends
description: On the morning of January 11, Yu Xiaowen attended her fourth pottery class and tried making small cups on the potter's wheel. In the afternoon, she went shopping with her close friend Zhang Jing at Zhengzhou David City and enjoyed her favorite sweet and sour pork tenderloin. Zhang Jing asked whether her recent work had been too busy, and the two agreed to meet again before the Spring Festival.

subevent.description: From 9:30 to 11:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen attended her fourth pottery class at the 'Between the Clay' pottery studio. Under the guidance of pottery teacher Zheng Guodong, she tried making a small cup on a potter's wheel. She focused on practicing the throwing technique, repeatedly adjusting the shape of the clay blank, and finally completed the initial shaping of the cup. After class, she left the semi-finished piece in the studio to dry, waiting for subsequent trimming and glazing.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - Guancheng Hui District - Between the Clay Pottery Studio

subevent.name: After the pottery class, tidying up and departing for David City
subevent.description: Around 12 noon, after finishing her pottery class, Yu Xiaowen cleaned her hands and workbench, and briefly discussed the arrangement for the next class with Teacher Zheng. She then drove about 15 minutes to David City Mall in Zhengzhou to meet her best friend Zhang Jing.

The two strolled through the mall's fashion clothing section and daily necessities section, chatting about what was going on in each other's lives as they walked. Zhang Jing asked whether Yu Xiaowen had been too busy at work lately; Yu Xiaowen shared the pressures and some amusing stories from hospital work. They also tried on new clothes, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.

subevent.name: Savoring sweet and sour pork at a David City restaurant.

During the meal, Zhang Jing asked about Yu Xiaowen's plans before the Spring Festival, and they agreed to meet again before the festival and planned to visit the New Year market together.

subevent.name: Returning home after shopping and dining out
subevent.description: Around 5 p.m., Yu Xiaowen and Zhang Jing finished shopping and dining, and the two said goodbye at the entrance to Daweicheng. Yu Xiaowen drove about 15 minutes back to her home on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District, organized the notes from the day's pottery class, and called her parents to share the pleasant weekend experience.

name: Adjust the fund fixed-investment plan
description: On the evening of February 20, Yu Xiaowen had an online discussion with financial advisor Wang Mingyuan. They analyzed recent market fluctuations and her personal income situation, and decided to increase the monthly auto-investment amount for two mixed funds from 2,000 yuan to 2,500 yuan, and add a new debt-biased fund with a monthly investment of 500 yuan to balance risk. Wang Mingyuan advised her to stick with long-term investing, and she completed the settings in the China Merchants Bank app that day.

subevent.name: Online discussion with financial advisor about adjusting the regular investment plan
subevent.description: On the evening of February 20, Yu Xiaowen communicated online with her financial advisor Wang Mingyuan via WeChat at home. The two analyzed recent fluctuations in the fund market and Yu Xiaowen's personal income. Wang Mingyuan suggested adjusting the monthly automatic investment from 2,000 yuan to 2,500 yuan and adding a bond-biased fund to balance risk. Yu Xiaowen agreed to the plan and decided to complete the setup that same day.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Yu Xiaowen's home

subevent.name: Completed setting up an automatic investment plan in the China Merchants Bank app.
subevent.description: After finishing the communication with Wang Mingyuan, Yu Xiaowen immediately logged into the China Merchants Bank mobile app and, according to the communication plan, adjusted the monthly auto-investment amount for the two existing hybrid funds from 2,000 yuan to 2,500 yuan, and added a new bond-biased fund with a monthly auto-investment of 500 yuan, confirming that the setup was successful.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Yu Xiaowen's home

name: Dinner with Sun Yue, confiding career anxieties
description: On Sunday, June 8, Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue had braised noodles at a noodle shop near Jingsan Road. Yu Xiaowen confided in her about her self-doubt after a night-shift clerical error and her emerging thought of transferring to another department. Sun Yue, drawing on her own high-pressure pediatric work as an example, counseled her, encouraged her to take care of her physical and mental health first, and introduced her to a rehabilitation physician she knew well for consultation. The two agreed to attend a book club event together the following month. This heart-to-heart talk made Yu Xiaowen feel understood, and her anxiety eased somewhat.

subevent.name: Going to the noodle shop on Jingsan Road
subevent.description: After work on the evening of June 8, Yu Xiaowen walked or drove from Zhengzhou Central Hospital to the stewed noodle restaurant near Jingsan Road where she had agreed to meet Sun Yue. On the way, she thought about recent work stress and looked forward to the conversation with her friend.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - from the hospital to Jingsan Road

subevent.name: Having a meal with Sun Yue at a noodle shop and confiding career anxieties.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 8, Yu Xiaowen met Sun Yue at a noodle shop near Jingsan Road. The two ordered two bowls of braised noodles and some side dishes. During the meal, Yu Xiaowen confided to Sun Yue about the self-doubt caused by a clerical error on the night shift and her emerging thought of transferring departments. Sun Yue, drawing on her own high-pressure work experience in pediatrics, advised her to focus on her physical and mental health first and introduced a rehabilitation doctor she knew well for her to consult. They also agreed to attend a book club event together next month. This in-depth conversation lasted about two hours. Yu Xiaowen felt understood and her anxiety was somewhat relieved.
subevent.location: Braised noodle restaurant near Jingsan Road, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Returned to residence after the meal gathering.
subevent.description: After the dinner gathering ended on the evening of June 8, Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue said goodbye at the entrance of the noodle shop. Yu Xiaowen then drove or walked back to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, feeling lighter than before.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - from Jingsan Road to home in Jinshui District

name: Pay for father's rehabilitation treatment costs for July
description: On July 9, Yu Xiaowen contacted her father to confirm the rehabilitation expense details and learned that the total was 5,000 yuan. On July 10, she transferred 5,000 yuan to the hospital account via mobile banking. Seeing the balance decrease strengthened her determination to budget carefully.

subevent.name: Confirmed the rehabilitation cost breakdown
subevent.description: On July 9, Yu Xiaowen contacted her father Yu Jianguo via WeChat to confirm the detailed treatment costs at the rehabilitation hospital for July, including rehabilitation training, physical therapy, and some self-paid medicines, totaling 5,000 yuan, and asked whether any additional expenses were needed. Her father replied to confirm there were no other costs. Yu Xiaowen recorded the amount.
subevent.location: Home living room, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Pay the rehabilitation fee by transferring money via mobile banking.
subevent.description: On July 10, 2025, Yu Xiaowen used the China Merchants Bank mobile banking app at home to transfer 5,000 yuan to the rehabilitation hospital account designated by her father Yu Jianguo, to pay for this month's rehabilitation training, physical therapy, and part of the out-of-pocket medication costs. After the transfer succeeded, she checked her account balance, realized that her savings had decreased, and strengthened her determination to budget carefully.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home bedroom

name: Wrote and submitted a department transfer application, had an in-depth conversation with Director Zhang Lei, and handled the subsequent filing.
description: On the evening of August 5, Yu Xiaowen wrote a written application for transfer to the rehabilitation department in the study at her home on Jingsan Road, Zhengzhou, detailing her family caregiving pressure and professional interests. On the morning of August 6, after the department handover, she handed the application in person to Director Zhang Lei at the department director's office of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The two had an in-depth exchange about the transfer for about twenty minutes. Director Zhang expressed understanding and pointed out the interdisciplinary direction of "clinical + research." That afternoon, Yu Xiaowen sorted out a copy of the application letter, talking points, and personal documents in the department lounge, placed them in a file folder, and asked someone to pass them to the HR department. At the same time, she recorded this career turning point and follow-up plans in her personal work log.

subevent.name: Writing a written application for department transfer.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 5, in her home study on Jingsan Road, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen carefully wrote a formal written application for transfer to the rehabilitation department, taking into account the family caregiving pressure brought by her father's condition, her own interest in rehabilitation medicine, and her career development plans. In the letter, she explained in detail the reasons for the application, her thoughts on professional transition, and her future work plans.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Submit the application and have an in-depth talk with Director Zhang Lei
subevent.description: On the morning of August 6, after the department handover, Yu Xiaowen hand-delivered the written application to Director Zhang Lei in the department director's office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Director Zhang was silent for a few seconds, then read the application carefully and said he understood her choice, and advised her, 'Clinical competence is the foundation; after transferring to the rehabilitation department, you can explore the intersection of clinical practice and research.' The two then talked for about twenty minutes about the work plan after the transfer, department arrangements, and Yu Xiaowen's family situation.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City – Office of the Department Director, Zhengzhou Central Hospital.

subevent.name: Organize and archive application-related documents and materials.
subevent.description: Before leaving work that afternoon, Yu Xiaowen organized a copy of her application letter, notes on her conversation with Director Zhang Lei, and copies of relevant personal identification documents in the department break room, placed them in the department personnel file envelope, and asked someone to forward them to the hospital's human resources department. At the same time, she recorded this key career turning point and the follow-up plan in her personal work log.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department rest area, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Play badminton with Lin Wei every Saturday evening.

After exercising, she felt relaxed in mind and body, her physical strength gradually recovered, and sweating relieved the accumulated stress of caring for her family. Lin Wei also taught her several stretching moves to help ease shoulder and neck soreness.

During the exercise, Yu Xiaowen felt relaxed in both body and mind; after sweating, the stress accumulated from caring for her family was relieved. Lin Wei also taught her a few stretching moves to ease shoulder and neck soreness.

subevent.name: Played badminton with Lin Wei on the evening of June 14
subevent.description: On the evening of Saturday, June 14, Yu Xiaowen went to Jinyu Badminton Hall to meet Lin Wei for this week's badminton session. The two practiced against each other for about an hour, and her physical strength gradually recovered. After exercising, Yu Xiaowen felt relaxed in both body and mind. Lin Wei again guided her through stretching movements to help relieve shoulder and neck soreness. Sweating through exercise effectively alleviated the accumulated stress of caring for the family.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinyu Badminton Hall

subevent.name: Played badminton with Lin Wei on the evening of June 21.
subevent.description: On Saturday evening, June 21, Yu Xiaowen arrived at the Jinyu Badminton Hall as promised to play with Lin Wei. The two practiced doubles for about an hour. Yu Xiaowen's physical fitness had further recovered compared to the previous two weeks, and she felt refreshed after sweating from exercise. Lin Wei shared some new stretching techniques to help relieve shoulder and neck discomfort. After exercising, the two briefly caught up on their daily lives.

The two played about an hour of doubles match play, and Yu Xiaowen's physical fitness had basically returned to its pre-interruption level. The sweating after exercise relieved the accumulated pressure of caring for the family. Lin Wei continued to guide her through stretching exercises, and the two agreed to keep exercising regularly next month.

name: Video call with my cousin Li Yaqin.

They also talked about her cousin's current work at Alibaba and recalled happy childhood memories together. The call lasted nearly an hour. Afterwards, Yu Xiaowen recorded her cousin's suggestions and encouraging words in her phone memo, feeling fulfilled and at ease.

subevent.description: On Sunday evening, February 18, Yu Xiaowen had a video call with her cousin Li Yaqin, who was far away in Hangzhou, at her home in Luoyang. Her cousin asked in detail about the condition and recovery of her uncle (Yu Xiaowen's father, Yu Jianguo), shared her own experience of caring for an ill elderly relative years ago, and encouraged Yu Xiaowen to take care of herself. The two also talked about her cousin's recent work at Alibaba and recalled interesting childhood memories together. The call lasted nearly an hour, making Yu Xiaowen feel the warmth and support of family.

She then put her phone back on charge, sat by the bed, and savored the family support she had felt from the call, feeling fulfilled and at ease.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Luoyang City, Xigong District - home (No. 42, Kaixuan Road)

name: The mentor reminded her to prepare for the attending physician exam, so she started review preparation.
description: During a break in her shift on April 8, 2025, her supervising teacher Li Wei reminded Yu Xiaowen that she needed to start preparing for the attending physician qualification examination half a year in advance. Feeling a sense of urgency, she ordered a complete set of exam books online that same day and officially began preparing.

subevent.name: The supervising teacher reminded her to prepare for the attending physician exam
subevent.description: During a duty break on April 11, 2025, supervising teacher Li Wei, in the inpatient department duty room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, reminded Yu Xiaowen that the attending physician qualification exam requires preparation half a year in advance and advised her to start systematic review as early as possible. Yu Xiaowen seriously listened to the advice and felt the urgency of time.
subevent.location: Duty room, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Buy books for the attending physician exam online.
subevent.description: After being reminded by her supervising teacher, Yu Xiaowen used the gaps between shifts that day to search on an e-commerce platform with her phone and order a complete set of books for the attending physician exam, including the textbook “Internal Medicine (Attending Physician)”, past exam papers, and mock test papers, choosing next-day delivery to her home.

Then at about 8:40 p.m., she wrote an initial draft of her father's rehabilitation notes in English, about 500 words, recording the training methods, progress, and reflections.

subevent.name: Reviewing her father's rehabilitation records and medical English materials.
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen, in her home study in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, first went through her father Yu Jianguo's detailed rehabilitation training records (including physical therapy, speech training, etc.), while quickly reviewing the vocabulary and sentence patterns related to rehabilitation medicine from her recent medical English course, in preparation for writing English notes. She marked the key terms and frameworks in her notebook.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Wrote the first draft of father's rehabilitation notes in English
subevent.description: At around 8:40 p.m., Yu Xiaowen sat at the desk in her study. She opened her laptop, created a new Word document, and began writing a brief note in English about her father's rehabilitation case. Following the framework of training methods, progress, and reflections, she recorded each item, paying attention to using professional expressions learned in her medical English course. The first draft was about 500 words and took about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Mother expresses unease about city life, and daughter offers support and plans
description: On the evening of May 15 after dinner, at home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, her mother Li Xiuying told Yu Xiaowen about feeling lonely in city life and lacking communication with people she knew. Yu Xiaowen realized that her mother's social isolation was more serious than expected. She moved closer, put her arm around her mother's shoulder to comfort her, and promised to take her to the nearby park and vegetable market on the weekend to help her get familiar with the area. The next morning, Yu Xiaowen used her phone in the home study to look up information about Zijingshan Park, Jingsan Road Farmers' Market, and other places, planned the weekend route and activities, and officially added helping her mother adapt to city life to the family rehabilitation extension plan.

subevent.name: Mother expressed that she is not adapting well to city life
subevent.description: On the evening of May 15 after dinner, in the living room of the home at No. 89, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, her mother Li Xiuying sat on the sofa in silence for a long time before quietly confiding to Yu Xiaowen: 'The buildings here are too tall. When I go out, there isn't even an acquaintance to talk to. I feel suffocated.' Yu Xiaowen realized that her mother's sense of social isolation in Zhengzhou was heavier than she had thought.
subevent.location: Living room at home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowen comforted her mother and promised to accompany her on the weekend.
subevent.description: At Yu Xiaowen's home in Zhengzhou, after listening to her mother's worries, Yu Xiaowen sat close and gently put her arm around her mother's shoulder, comforting her softly, and promised to take her to the nearby park and vegetable market that weekend to help her get familiar with the area and adjust to city life.
subevent.location: Living room at home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City

subevent.name: Plan the weekend outing schedule

The two set out from the gate of Zijingshan Park, chatting about recent events as they walked, bought ice cream on the way to share, enjoyed the summer breeze, and finally returned home separately, spending a relaxed and pleasant leisure time.

subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 27, 2025, Yu Xiaowen contacted her best friend Zhang Jing via WeChat to confirm the meeting time and gathering place for the evening city walk along the Jinshui River. The two agreed to meet at the gate of Zijingshan Park on the banks of the Jinshui River in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, at 6:30 that evening.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home in Jinshui District

subevent.name: Walked and chatted along the Jinshui River
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the evening, Yu Xiaowen met her best friend Zhang Jing at the entrance of Zijingshan Park, and the two walked side by side along the footpath by the Jinshui River. With the summer evening breeze gently blowing, they enjoyed the riverside scenery while sharing recent updates on work and life. Zhang Jing talked about fun things in her class, and Yu Xiaowen shared what she had seen and heard during hospital duty. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
subevent.location: Jinshui Riverfront Trail, Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: Buying ice cream and sharing it.
subevent.description: During the walk, they passed a cold drink stall near the Jinshui River. Yu Xiaowen suggested buying ice cream to cool off, and they each chose a cone (Yu Xiaowen picked mango flavor, Zhang Jing picked matcha flavor). They continued walking while eating, then sat for a while on a riverside bench, enjoying the pleasant summer evening.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - cold drink stand and bench by the Jinshui River

subevent.name: Ended the walk and returned separately.
subevent.description: At around 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen and Zhang Jing walked along the Jinshui River to the agreed turnaround point (near the Jinshui Road Overpass). After saying goodbye, they each walked home. On her way back to her residence on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District, Yu Xiaowen stopped at the convenience store near the community entrance to buy breakfast for the next day. After arriving home, she washed up and rested, ending a pleasant evening.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui Riverbank, Jinshui District to home

name: Organizing and consolidating cardiovascular system exam notes
description: On the evening of February 16, after finishing the weekend caregiving and returning to Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen forced herself to stay energized. Sitting at her desk, she organized her cardiovascular system notes for the attending physician exam and completed a set of mock questions. She found that she was still weak in the arrhythmia section, and planned to focus on breaking through it next week.

subevent.name: Returned from Luoyang to home in Zhengzhou.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen finished the weekend of caring for her parents in Luoyang and drove her family car back in the afternoon from Luoyang to her residence on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, to prepare for the evening's exam study.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Luoyang City to Zhengzhou City - Expressway

subevent.name: Organizing cardiovascular system notes
subevent.description: On the evening of February 16, at her desk in the study of her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen organized her review notes for the cardiovascular system chapter of the attending physician qualification exam, summarizing key points, drawing a mind map, and reinforcing key knowledge.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Completed the cardiovascular system practice questions.
subevent.description: After organizing her notes, Yu Xiaowen completed a set of cardiovascular system practice questions within the allotted time, 50 questions in total, to test her mastery of the knowledge points.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Analyze weak areas and formulate a review plan
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen graded the mock questions and found that her accuracy was relatively low in the arrhythmia section. She analyzed the reasons for the mistakes, recorded the weak knowledge points in her notebook, and made a review plan to focus on the arrhythmia topic in the coming week.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Taking a walk with my father and talking heart-to-heart to encourage his confidence in recovery
description: After dinner on April 11, Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to invite her father to take a walk in the neighborhood garden. The father and daughter walked slowly along the tree-lined path. She softly asked how he felt about the physical therapy, and her father finally said what was on his mind: 'I don't want to be a burden to you.' Xiaowen held his hand and said firmly, 'Dad, you are never a burden. We'll work through this together.' Under the moonlight, her father's eyes became moist, and their relationship grew closer through the heart-to-heart talk.

subevent.name: Invite father for a walk after dinner
subevent.description: On the evening of April 11, 2025, after dinner, at her father's home in Luoyang, Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to invite her father Yu Jianguo for a walk in the community garden. After her father agreed, the two left the house together and headed to the tree-lined path in the community at No. 42 Kaixuan Road.
subevent.location: Kaixuan Road Community Garden, Xigong District, Luoyang

subevent.name: Taking a walk and having a heart-to-heart talk with my father
subevent.description: On the evening of April 11, 2025, Yu Xiaowen walked slowly with her father Yu Jianguo along the tree-lined path in the community garden. Yu Xiaowen softly asked her father how he felt about physical therapy. After a silence, her father finally revealed his true feelings, saying he did not want to be a burden to them. Yu Xiaowen held his hand and said firmly, Dad, you have never been a burden; let us work hard together. The father and daughter had a heart-to-heart talk, tears welled up in her father's eyes, and their relationship grew even closer.
subevent.location: Kaixuan Road Community Garden, Xigong District, Luoyang

subevent.name: After the walk, returned home.
subevent.description: On the evening of April 11, 2025, after their walk and heart-to-heart talk, Yu Xiaowen and her father Yu Jianguo returned together to their home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road. The father and daughter were warm-hearted, and the family atmosphere became more harmonious.
subevent.location: Home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang.

name: Taking over complex cases for in-depth analysis caught the teacher's attention
description: From January 6 to 10, 2025, Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to take on a complex patient with multiple systemic diseases. In her spare time, she consulted a large amount of literature and wrote a detailed case analysis of 2,000 words. Her supervising teacher Li Wei noticed her diligent attitude in clinical work and acknowledged her research potential.

subevent.name: Apply to take over complex cases
subevent.description: On January 6, 2025, while making ward rounds in the inpatient department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen proactively asked her supervising teacher, Li Wei, to allow her to take over a complex patient with multisystem disease, and briefly explained her preliminary thoughts on the case.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: In-depth review of related literature.
subevent.description: From January 6 to 8, 2025, Yu Xiaowen used her after-work spare time every day to systematically search the latest literature related to the patient's multiple diseases through medical databases (such as PubMed) in the hospital library and at home, focusing on the pathological mechanisms and advances in diagnosis and treatment of multisystem diseases.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital library, home study

subevent.name: Submitted case analysis and received feedback from the teacher.
subevent.description: On January 10, 2025, after the department morning meeting, Yu Xiaowen submitted the completed case analysis report to her supervising teacher Li Wei. After reading it on the spot, Li Wei affirmed her meticulous literature research and rigorous clinical thinking, and praised the research potential she had shown.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Gathered briefly with family in the hospital garden on Labor Day; her father encouraged her not to work too hard.
description: On the afternoon of May 1, Labor Day, Yu Xiaowen pushed her father in a wheelchair to the garden of the rehabilitation hospital for a walk. The spring sun was warm, and her mother, Li Xiuying, brought homemade sweet and sour pork in an insulated container. The family of three spent a rare afternoon gathering on a bench. Her father was in good spirits and, after finishing the meal, held her hand and said, "Don't work too hard; you need to take care of yourself too." This admonition made her eyes slightly warm and also somewhat relaxed the tension she felt from the burden of family responsibilities.

subevent.name: Go to the rehabilitation hospital to visit my father.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Labor Day, Yu Xiaowen set out from her home in Jinshui District and drove to the rehabilitation hospital where her father, Yu Jianguo, was staying. On the way, she bought a basket of seasonal fruit at a fruit store to bring to her parents. After arriving at the hospital, she parked in the parking lot, carried the fruit into the inpatient department, and met up with her mother, Li Xiuying.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Rehabilitation Hospital

subevent.name: Hospital garden walk and small family gathering
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen pushed her father Yu Jianguo, who was in a wheelchair, to the garden of the rehabilitation hospital. The spring sun was gentle, and the garden was full of blooming flowers. Her mother Li Xiuying had brought home-cooked dishes in an insulated food container, including sweet and sour pork and fruit salad. The family of three sat down on a bench in the garden, eating and chatting. Her father was in good spirits. After finishing the meal, he held Yu Xiaowen's hand and said with concern, 'Don't be too tired. You need to take care of yourself too.' These words made Yu Xiaowen's eyes slightly red, and she relaxed a little from the strain of shouldering the family burden.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Rehabilitation Hospital Garden

subevent.name: Finished the visit and returned home
subevent.description: After the small gathering, Yu Xiaowen cleaned up the tableware and leftover food, safely escorted her father back to the ward, and reminded her mother to rest. Afterward, she drove alone back to her home in Jinshui District. On the way, she felt relaxed and began planning her rest arrangements for the next few days.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Rehabilitation Hospital

name: Help parents with hospitalization expenses and medical insurance reimbursement
description: From January 18 to 20, 2025, after her father Yu Jianguo's condition stabilized, Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to handle family financial matters. During breaks from caring for him, she used her phone in the ward to check the reimbursement policy for cross-province medical insurance, organized her father's daily expense lists at Luoyang Central Hospital, and contacted the hospital's medical insurance office to ask about the reimbursement process. On January 19, she transferred the hospital prepayment for her father's hospitalization from her own savings card via online banking, and together with her mother sorted out all the bills and documents in preparation for the formal reimbursement later. This eased her mother's financial anxiety and reflected her sense of family responsibility as an adult child.

subevent.name: Ward, nurse station, and doctor's office on the 16th floor of the Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province
subevent.description: On January 18, 2025, in her father Yu Jianguo's ward at Luoyang Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen used gaps between caregiving to check Henan Province's cross-regional medical insurance reimbursement policy on her phone, while also organizing the daily expense lists issued by Luoyang Central Hospital during her father's hospitalization, recording key data and cost items.
subevent.location: Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, Luoyang, Henan Province

subevent.name: Ask about the hospital's medical insurance reimbursement process
subevent.description: On January 18, 2025, after checking the policy, Yu Xiaowen contacted the Medical Insurance Office of Luoyang Central Hospital by phone to inquire about the specific procedures, required materials, and precautions for her father Yu Jianguo's out-of-town medical insurance reimbursement, and noted down the handling instructions provided by the staff.
subevent.location: Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, Luoyang, Henan Province

subevent.name: Transferred the hospitalization advance payment via online banking
subevent.description: On January 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowen used the mobile banking app on her phone to transfer money from her own savings card to pay the hospitalization deposit for her father Yu Jianguo at Luoyang Central Hospital, ensuring that subsequent treatment costs would not be interrupted.
subevent.location: Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, Luoyang, Henan Province

subevent.name: Organize reimbursement receipts and ID documents.
subevent.description: On January 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying sorted through all of her father Yu Jianguo's expense receipts, diagnostic certificates, ID card, social security card, and other documents from his hospitalization in the ward, classified and bagged them according to reimbursement requirements, and verified the completeness and amounts of the receipts.
subevent.location: Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, Luoyang, Henan Province

subevent.name: Verify materials and wait for official reimbursement
subevent.description: On January 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowen checked the sorted receipts and documents list again, confirmed nothing was missing, put them in a document folder for safekeeping, and explained to her mother the subsequent formal reimbursement steps and schedule to ease her mother's financial anxiety.
subevent.location: Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Use fragmented time to advance the methodology section of the thesis
description: Between March 13 and 18, Yu Xiaowen used the compensatory rest after night shifts or spare time after work to follow the "Medical Statistics" video tutorial, clumsily operate SPSS, and attempt preliminary screening and descriptive statistics on case data. Whenever an error occurred, she took a screenshot and recorded it, planning to organize the materials and consult her college classmate Zhou Haoran online. The methods section of the paper was being filled in with difficulty.

subevent.name: Watching a video tutorial on medical statistics
subevent.description: March 13, during her compensatory rest after the night shift, Yu Xiaowen opened the "Medical Statistics" video tutorial at her home in Zhengzhou and focused on studying the descriptive statistics chapter, preparing for subsequent SPSS software operations. While listening, she took notes on key steps.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: First attempt at SPSS data processing
subevent.description: Later that same evening, Yu Xiaowen clumsily opened the SPSS software on her computer, imported case data, and tried to perform preliminary screening and descriptive statistics. After encountering repeated errors, she took screenshots of each one and saved them in a dedicated folder, recording the context of the failed operations.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Tried the SPSS operations several times and took screenshots.
subevent.description: From March 14 to 15, Yu Xiaowen used fragmented time after work to repeatedly operate SPSS while following the Medical Statistics tutorial and performed descriptive statistical analysis on the case data. During the process, she encountered various errors and took screenshots of all of them. She compiled the problems into a document and prepared to ask for guidance later.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Compiled a list of SPSS issues and error screenshots
subevent.description: On March 16, Yu Xiaowen compiled all the SPSS error screenshots and operation questions from the previous days at home, organized them into a clear list by category, and attached snippets of data files, fully preparing to ask Zhou Haoran for help online.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Consulted university classmate Zhou Haoran online
subevent.description: On the evening of March 17, Yu Xiaowen contacted her college classmate Zhou Haoran (a medical researcher at the National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases) via WeChat, sent him organized SPSS error screenshots and a list of questions, and asked online about the specific steps of statistical methods. The two had a video call for about 40 minutes, during which Zhou Haoran answered each question one by one and gave suggestions for optimizing SPSS operations.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Revised the methods section of the paper according to the guidance.
subevent.description: On March 18, following Zhou Haoran's guidance from the previous day, Yu Xiaowen re-ran SPSS at home to complete the correct descriptive statistics, and filled the results and statistical methodology notes into the methods section of the paper. After several hours of effort, the initial draft of the methods section was completed.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Used the lunch break to browse rehabilitation medicine journals
description: Inspired by her father's rehabilitation process, during her lunch break on February 24, Yu Xiaowen browsed the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine in the library of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, focusing on a review of the impact of early rehabilitation intervention on the prognosis of stroke patients, and took photos to save key literature titles. During her lunch break on February 28, she went to the library again, continued to consult related literature, and supplemented and organized the previously saved titles.

subevent.name: During the first lunch break, looked up rehabilitation medicine journals.
