subevent.description: During the lunch break on February 24 (about 30 minutes), inspired by her father's rehabilitation process, Yu Xiaowen went to the library at Zhengzhou Central Hospital and browsed the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine, focusing on several review articles about the impact of early rehabilitation intervention on the prognosis of stroke patients. She photographed and saved the titles of key references with her phone, planning to read them systematically later.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Library

subevent.name: Reviewed rehabilitation medicine journals again during lunch break.
subevent.description: During the lunch break on February 28 (about 30 minutes), Yu Xiaowen continued her previous habit and went again to the library of Zhengzhou Central Hospital to continue reviewing relevant literature on early rehabilitation intervention in the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine, supplementing and organizing the titles she had saved before, and taking photos of newly discovered key literature for archiving.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Library

name: Remotely bought Spring Festival decorations for her hometown in Luoyang.
description: On January 20, while accompanying her father at the hospital in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen placed an order on her phone for Spring Festival decorations such as couplets, fortune characters, and red lanterns. The delivery address was set to her parents' home in Luoyang, and she immediately called her neighbor Zhao Xiulan to ask her to receive the packages and later put up the decorations. On January 22, after receiving the packages, Zhao Xiulan went to Yu Xiaowen's parents' home, put up the couplets and the fortune characters, and hung the red lanterns. When finished, she took photos and sent them to Yu Xiaowen via WeChat so that her parents in the hospital ward could see the festive decoration of the old house and continue the Spring Festival ritual.

subevent.name: Ordered Spring Festival decorations online
subevent.description: During a break in caring for her father, Yu Xiaowen browsed and ordered traditional Spring Festival decorations such as Spring Festival couplets, blessing characters, and red lanterns through Taobao on her phone, setting the delivery address to her hometown in Luoyang (No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province), hoping these festive decorations would add a festive New Year atmosphere to her parents' ward.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Zhongyuan District - No. 1 Jianshe West Road (Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital)

subevent.name: Called the neighbor to receive the posted decorations
subevent.description: After placing the order, Yu Xiaowen immediately called Aunt Zhao Xiulan, her mother's close friend who lives at the same address, explaining that she had bought Spring Festival decorations for her hometown. The delivery would arrive in 2-3 days, and she asked Aunt Zhao to help receive the package and, after receiving it, put up the decorations on the front door and in the living room of the old house to create a festive atmosphere.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Zhongyuan District - No. 1 Jianshe West Road (Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital)

subevent.name: Neighbor received the package and put up decorations
subevent.description: Aunt Zhao Xiulan received the package on January 22. That afternoon, she took out the Spring Festival couplets, the 'Fu' character, and the red lantern, and went to Yu Xiaowen's parents' home (No. 42 Kaixuan Road). She carefully pasted the couplets on both sides of the front door, stuck the 'Fu' character upside down in the center of the door, and hung the red lantern under the eaves. After finishing, she took photos and sent them to Yu Xiaowen via WeChat, so that Yu Xiaowen and her parents in the hospital could see that the old house had been given a completely new look.
subevent.location: No. 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province (Yu Xiaowen's parents' home)

name: Subscribe to and enable a high-resolution classical music channel.
description: On the afternoon of February 9, 2025, Yu Xiaowen used her iPad in her father's hospital ward to browse Apple Music. After discovering the high-resolution classical music channel, she immediately subscribed to the annual membership (198 yuan) and downloaded selected playlists. The next evening (February 10), she imported the playlists into the car audio system in the parking lot of her residence in Zhengzhou, and thereafter used the high-definition music throughout her travels, providing spiritual comfort during her busy commutes.

subevent.name: Browsed and discovered a high-resolution classical music channel and subscribed.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 9, 2025, while at Luoyang Central Hospital (in her father's inpatient ward), Yu Xiaowen browsed Apple Music on her iPad during a break in visiting and happened to discover a dedicated high-resolution classical music channel. She immediately decided to subscribe to the annual membership. She paid an annual fee of 198 yuan with Alipay and successfully subscribed. She then selected several classical works from the channel (e.g., HD versions of Mozart and Beethoven symphonies) and downloaded them to the iPad as an offline playlist. The whole process took about 15 minutes. During this time, Chen Siyu had just left, and Yu Xiaowen was the only one accompanying her father in the ward.
subevent.location: Luoyang - Central Hospital ward

subevent.name: Importing high-definition classical music into the car audio system
subevent.description: Subscription: On the evening of the next day (February 10), after getting off work, Yu Xiaowen returned to the parking lot of her residence on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. In the car, she used a data cable to transfer the downloaded high-resolution classical music playlist from her iPad to a USB drive in the car's multimedia system. Once finished, she started the car to listen, confirmed that the sound quality had clearly improved, and switched all car music sources to the high-definition versions. From then on, every time she drove to work or went out, she listened to this curated playlist, which provided higher-quality spiritual comfort during her busy journeys.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - inside the car in the Jingsan Road parking lot

name: In-department new technology learning: observing rehabilitation robot-assisted training.
description: On the morning of May 21, at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, the department invited a rehabilitation engineer to demonstrate the operation of a lower-limb rehabilitation robot. Yu Xiaowen observed the entire demonstration in the rehabilitation treatment room and recorded key parameter settings. Afterwards, she discussed with Dr. Li Wei in the department rest area the possibility of applying this technology to her father's rehabilitation, gaining intuitive knowledge for the future direction of 'rehabilitation + technology'.

subevent.name: Observed the operation demonstration of the lower-limb rehabilitation robot
subevent.description: In the rehabilitation therapy room, a rehabilitation engineer invited by the department gave a live demonstration of the complete operating workflow of the lower-limb rehabilitation robot, including device startup, patient donning, gait parameter setting, and real-time adjustment. Yu Xiaowen stood beside the equipment throughout, carefully watching every step the engineer took and recording key parameter-setting points in her notebook, such as stride length, assist mode, and safety thresholds, while observing the entire process of the robot assisting the patient with simulated training.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Rehabilitation Treatment Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Discussed with Dr. Li Wei the possibility of applying the technology
subevent.description: After the observation, Yu Xiaowen found her supervising teacher Li Wei in the department rest area, and the two had about a 20-minute exchange about the lower-limb rehabilitation robot technology just demonstrated. Yu Xiaowen proactively raised the feasibility of applying this technology to the rehabilitation training that her father (Yu Jianguo) might need due to aging. Teacher Li Wei analyzed the advantages, applicable conditions, and potential risks of robot-assisted training from a clinical perspective. Yu Xiaowen listened carefully to the advice and summarized the inspiration this learning brought to her subsequent exploration of the 'rehabilitation + technology' direction.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department rest area, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: City walk in Luoyang Old Town with high school classmates.
description: On the morning of February 22, Yu Xiaowen met her high school classmate Chen Siyu near Lijing Gate in Luoyang's old town. The two strolled along Cross Street, tasted authentic hulatang and peony cakes, and chatted about each other's recent lives and youthful memories while walking, enjoying a rare relaxing time.

subevent.name: Set off for Lijing Gate
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen set out from her parents' home in Xigong District, Luoyang, and walked or took the bus to Lijing Gate in Laocheng District, planning to meet her high school classmate Chen Siyu near Lijing Gate to start a City Walk.
subevent.location: Luoyang - on the way from home in Xigong District to Lijing Gate in Laocheng District

subevent.name: Met Chen Siyu at Lijing Gate
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen met up with high school classmate Chen Siyu near Lijing Gate in the old town of Luoyang. After greeting each other warmly, they began strolling along Cross Street, chatting about recent news while enjoying the old town's scenery.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Lijing Gate, Laocheng District

subevent.name: Tasting authentic hulatang
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen and Chen Siyu sat down at a long-established hulatang shop near Cross Street, each ordering a bowl of steaming hot hulatang. They chatted about their work and household trivialities while sipping the soup, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
subevent.location: Luoyang - Cross Street Spicy Soup Shop, Laocheng District

subevent.name: Tasting Luoyang peony cakes
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen and Chen Siyu stopped in front of a pastry shop on Cross Street, bought a few freshly baked Luoyang peony cakes, and shared them. The peony cakes were sweet and crispy, and they reminisced about fun times buying snacks together in high school.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Laocheng District Cross Street pastry shop

subevent.name: Continue strolling and chatting, and end the activity
subevent.description: After tasting the snacks, Yu Xiaowen and Chen Siyu continued their walk along Cross Street, passing through the ordinary alleys, chatting about the recent news of their high school classmates and their own youthful memories, in a warm and pleasant atmosphere. Around noon, the two said goodbye at the intersection and each headed home.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Laocheng District, Shizi Street to the area around Lijing Gate

name: Older brother Yu Xiaofeng rushed back to Luoyang to visit his father.
description: On January 19, her brother Yu Xiaofeng took the earliest flight from Shenzhen back to Luoyang and went directly to the ward at Luoyang Central Hospital. Seeing their father weak but conscious, the siblings clasped each other's hands. He told his sister to go home and rest that night, and he stayed on for the night shift.

subevent.name: Accompanying father at the hospital.
subevent.description: From the early morning to the morning of January 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowen watched over her father Yu Jianguo, who had been hospitalized due to his illness, in the ward of Luoyang Central Hospital. Her mother Li Xiuying was also present. The three chatted and waited for her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng to arrive.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Luoyang Central Hospital Ward

subevent.name: The brother and sister met at the hospital.
subevent.description: At about 10 a.m. on January 19, 2025, Yu Xiaofeng rushed to the ward at Luoyang Central Hospital and saw his father, Yu Jianguo, weak but clear-minded. He and his younger sister, Yu Xiaowen, held each other's hands tightly, with their mother, Li Xiuying, also there. The family had a brief reunion and talked together.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Luoyang Central Hospital Ward

subevent.name: Hand over caregiving duties and go home to rest
subevent.description: On the evening of January 19, 2025, her brother Yu Xiaofeng told Yu Xiaowen to go home and rest first, while he stayed overnight to accompany their father. Yu Xiaowen left the ward with her mother Li Xiuying, gave her brother some instructions, and returned to the home in Luoyang (her parents' home), planning to come back to the hospital the next day.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - ward of Luoyang Central Hospital, and home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City

subevent.name: Her elder brother took the night shift to accompany and care for her father.
subevent.description: On the evening of January 19, 2025, Yu Xiaofeng stayed alone in the ward at Luoyang Central Hospital to take care of his father, Yu Jianguo, closely monitoring his condition, communicating with the nurses about nighttime care, and planning to discuss the treatment plan with the doctor the next day.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Luoyang Central Hospital Ward

name: Home pottery hand-shaping attempt
description: On the afternoon of February 23, Yu Xiaowen used leftover clay from her pre-New Year pottery class to try shaping a small teacup at her home in Luoyang. Although the finished cup was crooked, the process helped her temporarily forget her stress and rediscover the peace and joy of handcrafting.

subevent.name: Preparing pottery tools and materials
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen found about 500 grams of gray clay left over from the pottery class before the New Year, as well as a wooden trimming knife, a turntable, a water basin, and damp cloths she had bought before, in the storage cabinet at her parents' home in Luoyang (No. 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District). She spread old newspapers on the dining table in the living room, arranged the tools and clay in order to form a temporary work area, and filled a basin with clean water and placed it nearby.
subevent.location: Luoyang - home (parents' home)

subevent.name: Kneading clay and removing air bubbles
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen placed the clay on the wheel, kneading and pressing with both hands, and repeated the 'ram's-head kneading method' for about ten minutes to ensure air bubbles were completely removed from the clay, making it even in softness and hardness and highly plastic. The kneaded clay ball was covered with a damp cloth and left to rest for five minutes to keep it moist.
subevent.location: Luoyang - home (parents' home)

subevent.name: Shape the teacup body.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen took a fist-sized piece of clay, first rolled it into a ball with her palm, then pressed a dent in the center with her thumb. Then she turned the turntable with one hand while using the other hand and fingers to evenly pinch the cup wall thinner from the inside out. She tried to pinch the cup wall to a uniform thickness and keep the rim round, but due to her unfamiliar technique, the wall thickness was inconsistent and the cup body was slightly crooked.
subevent.location: Luoyang - home (parents' home)

subevent.name: Trim the cup rim and base
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen used a trimming knife to carefully shave off the uneven excess clay from the cup rim, then used a sponge dipped in water to smooth the rim. She turned the cup upside down on the turntable, scraped off excess clay from the bottom with a blade to make it flat, and carved the character “Yu” as her personal mark. The body of the cup still retains the natural texture of hand-shaping; although the shape is lopsided, it has a simple, rustic charm.
subevent.location: Luoyang - home (parents' home)

subevent.name: Clean up the work area and admire the finished pieces
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen placed the shaped teacup in a ventilated, cool place to air-dry naturally, then cleaned up her tools, washing the trimming knife, sponge, and turntable, wrapped the remaining clay and put it back in the storage cabinet, and wiped down the dining table. She stood at the table examining the finished piece. Though it was crooked and imperfect, the process of shaping it with her own hands made her feel calm and happy, temporarily forgetting work stress.
subevent.location: Luoyang - home (parents' home)

name: Setting up a simple home rehabilitation corner for her father.
description: On February 9, Yu Xiaowen went to Zhengzhou Central Hospital to borrow rehabilitation elastic bands and grip balls. On February 10, at home in Luoyang, she cleaned the living room corner with her mother, laid non-slip mats, set up equipment, put up motivational posters, and placed a rest chair. Finally, she invited her father to inspect the rehab corner, and he approved it.

subevent.name: Go to the hospital to borrow rehabilitation equipment.
subevent.description: On February 9, after work, Yu Xiaowen went to the Rehabilitation and Physical Therapy Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, where she works. Through her colleagues, she borrowed one set of resistance bands and one set of grip balls, signed the borrowing registration form, and prepared to take them back to her home in Luoyang to set up a rehabilitation corner for her father.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Clean the corner of the living room.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 10, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying moved the clutter out of an unused corner by the window in the living room at the Luoyang home, thoroughly cleaned the floor with a broom and mop to ensure the area was clean and flat, in preparation for setting up a rehabilitation corner.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - home living room

subevent.name: Laying non-slip mats and arranging rehabilitation equipment.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 10, Yu Xiaowen laid anti-slip mats bought from a pharmacy in the cleaned corner of the living room, and neatly placed the rehabilitation resistance bands and grip balls borrowed from the hospital on one side of the mats, ensuring safety and convenience for her father when he used them.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - home living room

subevent.name: Put up motivational posters and set up resting chairs.
subevent.description: At noon on February 10, Yu Xiaowen used removable tape to stick her father's favorite calligraphy piece (with the words 'Heaven rewards the diligent') on the wall opposite the rehab corner as a visual motivator. Then she brought a comfortable chair with a backrest from the bedroom and placed it beside the corner so her father could rest after completing training.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - home living room

subevent.name: Father accepted and approved the rehabilitation corner
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 10, Yu Xiaowen invited her father Yu Jianguo to the living room to look at the newly arranged rehabilitation corner. Seeing the tidy corner, professional rehabilitation equipment, and his beloved calligraphy copybooks, Yu Jianguo was deeply moved and repeatedly praised his daughter for being thoughtful. He immediately sat in the chair to try it and said he would be willing to exercise here every day.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - home living room

name: Brother called to arrange a monthly transfer of rehabilitation fees; Yu Xiaowen updated the income forecast in her expense-tracking app.
description: On the evening of Saturday, June 7, Yu Xiaowen received a call from her older brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen while at home in Zhengzhou, to discuss their father's rehabilitation costs. Her brother initially offered to transfer money every month. Yu Xiaowen, understanding his mortgage pressure, suggested transferring 2,000 yuan, but her brother insisted that since he had been promoted he could transfer 5,000 yuan each month. They finally agreed on 5,000 yuan per month. After hanging up, Yu Xiaowen sat at her desk at home and opened the bookkeeping app, raised the expected monthly income to reflect the extra income, and carefully checked the current income and expense data and savings goals to ensure the records were accurate.

subevent.name: Brother called to discuss father's rehabilitation costs.
subevent.description: On Saturday evening, June 7, Yu Xiaowen received a call at her home in Zhengzhou from her brother Yu Xiaofeng, who was in Shenzhen. After asking about their father's rehabilitation progress, her brother offered to transfer the rehabilitation expenses every month. Yu Xiaowen, understanding her brother's mortgage pressure, suggested transferring 2,000 yuan per month. But her brother insisted that he had been promoted and could transfer 5,000 yuan a month, although the high monthly mortgage payment on his Shenzhen apartment meant he couldn't send more. The two eventually agreed that her brother would transfer 5,000 yuan per month for their father's rehabilitation.
subevent.location: Home living room, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Modify the income forecast in the bookkeeping app
subevent.description: After the phone call with her brother ended, Yu Xiaowen sat down at her desk at home, opened the bookkeeping app on her phone, and adjusted the expected monthly income upward to reflect the extra income from her brother's monthly transfer of 5,000 yuan. She carefully checked the current income and expenditure data and savings goals to ensure the ledger was accurate.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: New Year's Day dinner, New Year countdown, and start of pottery class enrollment
description: In the early hours of January 1, 2025, Yu Xiaowen, together with her friends Zhang Jing and Sun Yue, made spicy soup and braised noodles at her rental apartment at No. 89 Jingsan Road, gathering to celebrate New Year's Eve and sharing New Year goals. She announced her annual plan to devote herself to pottery. The next day (January 2), she went to the community and signed up for the 'Between the Clay' pottery class, with classes scheduled for Thursday evenings and Saturday mornings.

subevent.name: New Year celebration dinner
subevent.description: In the early morning of January 1, 2025, Yu Xiaowen made hulatang and braised noodles with her friends Zhang Jing and Sun Yue at her rental apartment at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and had a New Year's Eve dinner together. The three chatted while eating, sharing their New Year's goals and plans. At the table, Yu Xiaowen announced her annual plan to systematically learn pottery this year, and received encouragement and support from her friends.
subevent.location: Rental apartment, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City

subevent.name: Signed up for a pottery class
subevent.description: On January 2, 2025, based on information she had previously learned about community interest classes, Yu Xiaowen went to the registration point for the "Between the Clay" pottery studio at the Jinshui District Community Cultural Center in Zhengzhou. She consulted on site and completed the registration procedures for the pottery interest class, paid the tuition, confirmed that the classes were scheduled for Thursday evenings and Saturday mornings, and received the class schedule and a list of pottery tools.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – Jinshui District Community Cultural Center

name: Family weekend walk in the park, first look at the surroundings of the new home
description: On Sunday afternoon, April 6, Yu Xiaowen saw that her father was in good spirits, so she suggested the whole family take a walk in Dongfengqu Riverside Park near the new home in Jinshui District. Her mother supported her father as they walked slowly, while Xiaowen pushed the wheelchair as backup. Along the way, the three identified the nearby supermarket, pharmacy, and bus stops. When her father rested on a bench, he remarked that the community environment was more peaceful than the old house in Luoyang, and her mother noted down the walking route, planning to accompany her father for a walk every day when the weather was good. This walk let the family find a common rhythm in the new environment and also eased the tense atmosphere of the past few days.

subevent.name: Proposed and prepared for a family park walk.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 6, Yu Xiaowen noticed that her father, Yu Jianguo, was in good spirits at home, so she suggested the family go for a walk in Dongfengqu Riverside Park near their new home in Jinshui District. She and her mother, Li Xiuying, prepared the wheelchair, drinking water, and necessary belongings, and made sure her father was dressed comfortably. Then the three of them set out from the new home together.
subevent.location: Entrance to Dongfeng Canal Riverside Park, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Walk in the park and identify surrounding facilities
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 6, the whole family arrived at Dongfengqu Riverside Park. Mother Li Xiuying helped Father Yu Jianguo walk slowly, while Yu Xiaowen pushed a wheelchair as backup. The three strolled along the park path, identifying nearby supermarkets, pharmacies, bus stops and other daily facilities as they walked, familiarizing themselves with the surroundings of their new home. During the walk, Father was in stable condition, walking slowly but in good spirits.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province - Dongfeng Canal Riverside Park Trail

subevent.name: Resting and chatting on a park bench.
subevent.description: Midway through the walk, the family sat down on a bench in the park to rest. Her father, Yu Jianguo, sat on the bench and remarked that the environment of the new community was more peaceful than the old house in Luoyang, with good greenery and fresh air. Yu Xiaowen and her mother, Li Xiuying, also shared their feelings about arriving in the new environment. The three chatted about everyday matters in a relaxed and warm atmosphere, easing the tension from the days of moving.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province - Dongfeng Canal Riverside Park Rest Area

subevent.name: Record walking route and plan for the future
subevent.description: After returning to the new home from the park, mother Li Xiuying wrote down from memory the day's walking route and the landmark buildings along the way, and planned to take a walk with father every day when the weather was good, helping him gradually adapt to the environment and regain strength. Yu Xiaowen also expressed support. The family gained an initial understanding of the living environment around the new home and gained more confidence in their future life in the new community.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City, Jinshui District - living room of the new residence

name: Keep up Saturday evening badminton practice.
description: On the afternoon of July 26, Yu Xiaowen prepared her badminton gear at home, and in the evening went to a badminton hall near Zhengzhou Central Hospital to meet up with Lin Wei and other badminton friends. From 8 to 10 p.m., she and Lin Wei and the others played two hours of doubles matches. Although she was a little tired from accompanying her father's rehabilitation during the day, she still finished the workout, and Lin Wei praised her for being in good shape. Afterward, the two stretched and agreed to continue next week.

subevent.name: Prepared badminton equipment and workout clothes.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 26, Yu Xiaowen organized her badminton bag at home, checked equipment such as rackets, shuttlecocks, sports shoes, wrist guards, towels, and a water bottle, and changed into sportswear, fully preparing for the evening workout.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Heading to the badminton gym
subevent.description: On the evening of July 26, Yu Xiaowen walked or drove to the badminton hall near Zhengzhou Central Hospital with her badminton equipment, and confirmed the meeting time with her badminton partner Lin Wei via WeChat on the way.
subevent.location: Badminton hall near Zhengzhou Central Hospital.

subevent.name: Warm up and play doubles against fellow players.
subevent.description: On Saturday evening, July 26, from 8 to 10 p.m., Yu Xiaowen and her badminton friends, including Lin Wei, played a two-hour doubles match at the badminton gym. Yu Xiaowen performed steadily during warm-up and the match. Despite being a bit tired from the day, she kept going, and Lin Wei praised her for being in good shape.
subevent.location: Badminton hall near Zhengzhou Central Hospital.

subevent.name: Agreed to play ball again next week
subevent.description: On the evening of July 26, while stretching and resting, Yu Xiaowen and Lin Wei agreed to play ball again at the same time next Saturday. Lin Wei expressed willingness to continue as partners, and together they set the time for next week's exercise plan.
subevent.location: Badminton hall near Zhengzhou Central Hospital.

name: Communicated with Su Ya on WeChat about collaborative pottery ideas
description: On the evening of April 21, Yu Xiaowen photographed the vessel sketches she had drawn on April 19 and sent them to Su Ya. The two had an animated discussion over WeChat about the creative possibilities for a zodiac commemorative coin themed series. Su Ya suggested using different clay materials to represent the changing seasons. Yu Xiaowen was deeply inspired, and they agreed to go to the pottery studio together after the May Day holiday to make prototypes.

subevent.name: Drawing sketches of the zodiac commemorative coin vessel form
subevent.description: At home, Yu Xiaowen used a pottery design notebook and pencil, combined with the patterns from her collection of zodiac commemorative coins, and drew a series of vessel type sketches, including round, fan-shaped, and antique coin-shaped forms, to prepare for the upcoming exchange with Su Ya.
subevent.location: No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home study

subevent.name: Take a photo of the sketch and send it to Su Ya.
subevent.description: On the evening of April 21, Yu Xiaowen used her phone at her home in Zhengzhou to take clear photos of the vessel sketch she had drawn on April 19, and sent them to her pottery classmate Su Ya via WeChat, with a message asking for advice.
subevent.location: Home living room, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Discussed the zodiac commemorative coin pottery series with Su Ya via WeChat
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya had a lively discussion via WeChat voice messages and text. Su Ya proposed the idea of using different clay bodies—such as purple clay, white porcelain, and coarse pottery—to represent the changing seasons. Yu Xiaowen was deeply inspired, and the two exchanged ideas on vessel shape combinations and glaze color design. The discussion lasted about an hour.
subevent.location: No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home study

subevent.name: Agreed to go to the pottery studio after the May Day holiday to make prototypes.
subevent.description: At the end of the discussion, Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya agreed on WeChat that after the May Day holiday, the two would go together to Master Zheng's 'Between the Clay' pottery studio to turn the sketches into test samples, and they discussed the specific schedule (initially planned for the afternoon of May 6). Yu Xiaowen recorded the appointment in her phone calendar.
subevent.location: No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home study

name: Took her mother to People's Park to ease her loneliness
description: On the morning of Sunday, May 25, Yu Xiaowen kept her promise and walked hand in hand with her mother to the nearby People's Park for a stroll. She taught her mother to identify flowers and plants, helped her use scan-to-pay at the park kiosk to buy two bottles of water, and took her to the nearby vegetable market to learn the way. Along the way, her mother gradually talked more, and a relaxed smile appeared on her face that she had not shown for a long time. This outing effectively relieved her mother's loneliness and also made a good start for the family to integrate into city life.

subevent.name: Getting ready to go out in the morning
subevent.description: On the morning of Sunday, May 25, Yu Xiaowen washed up and made simple preparations at home (the apartment she rented at No. 89, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou). She changed into comfortable casual clothes and confirmed that her phone and wallet were with her. Then she discussed the day's outing plan with her mother, Li Xiuying, telling her that she would take her to People's Park for a walk and to learn the route. She asked her mother to change into shoes suitable for walking and reminded her to bring her phone.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Walk to People's Park
subevent.description: At around 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowen took her mother Li Xiuying's hand and set out on foot from their residence on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District, walking along the street toward the nearby People's Park. Along the way, Yu Xiaowen introduced the shops and community facilities along the route to her mother and reminded her to be careful. After about 15 minutes of walking, they arrived at the south gate of People's Park.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - People's Park

subevent.name: Teaching Mom to identify flowers and plants in the park
subevent.description: After entering People's Park, Yu Xiaowen took her mother for a walk along the shaded path, pointing out common plants in the park such as roses, osmanthus, and ginkgo, and taught her mother to use her phone to take photos as records. Her mother, Li Xiuying, showed interest in the flowers and plants. Yu Xiaowen patiently answered her questions. The two chatted as they walked, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere, staying for about 30 minutes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - People's Park

subevent.name: Take mother to the vegetable market to learn the route
subevent.description: Around 10:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowen walked with her mother out of the park and walked to the nearby Renmin Road vegetable market. She introduced her mother to the market's layout and her usual stalls, taught her how to judge the freshness of vegetables, and encouraged her to come shopping by herself in the future. Her mother observed carefully, took the initiative to ask about prices, and showed a willingness to integrate into city life.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Renmin Road Vegetable Market

name: Yu Xiaowen learned of her father's walking breakthrough and celebrated with her family over video.
description: On the morning of June 10, father Yu Jianguo achieved short-distance walking with the aid of a four-legged walker and the assistance of a rehabilitation therapist. Mother Li Xiuying filmed the walking process and sent the video to Yu Xiaowen via WeChat. After work in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen watched the video at home in Zhengzhou and was deeply moved by her father's progress. That evening, Yu Xiaowen video-called her parents in Luoyang to celebrate this rehabilitation breakthrough together. The whole family was greatly encouraged.

subevent.name: Mother recorded and sent a rehabilitation video.
subevent.description: After the walking training session, her mother Li Xiuying sent Yu Xiaowen the video of her father's entire walking process taken on her phone via WeChat, and shared the good news of his recovery in the family group. In the video, his steps were slow but his posture was steady, and her mother encouraged him from the side.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - corridor of a hospital's rehabilitation department ward

subevent.name: After getting off work, Yu Xiaowen checked her phone and saw the received video.
subevent.description: After work on the afternoon of June 10, 2025, Yu Xiaowen took out her phone at her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, to check WeChat. Seeing the video of her father's rehabilitation walking sent by her mother, she was deeply moved by his progress and excitedly watched the video over and over.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home in Jinshui District

subevent.name: The family celebrated the recovery breakthrough together.
subevent.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen video-called her parents in Luoyang, directly expressing congratulations and encouragement to her father and mother. The family together reflected on the milestone achievements of the rehabilitation training, felt the rewards of their hard care, and were greatly encouraged.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home in Jinshui District (video call); Luoyang - rehabilitation ward of a hospital

name: Organize father's medical insurance reimbursement materials, handle it online, and confirm the payment arrives.
description: During the lunch break on February 7, Yu Xiaowen organized her father's hospitalization invoices, expense lists, and diagnosis certificates in her Zhengzhou office, took photos, and sent them via WeChat to her brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen. The two siblings collaborated online; Yu Xiaofeng logged into the Luoyang medical insurance platform on her behalf and submitted the reimbursement application. On February 14, Yu Xiaowen confirmed that the reimbursement of about 8,000 yuan had arrived, easing the family's financial pressure.

subevent.name: Organize reimbursement materials for Father's hospitalization
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen, in her office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, used her lunch break to take out all the reimbursement materials for her father Yu Jianguo's hospitalization—invoices, cost lists, and diagnostic certificates—from her bag. She carefully checked them, sorted them by category, and prepared to take photos and send them to her older brother.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Took photos and sent the reimbursement materials to her older brother.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen used her phone to photograph the prepared reimbursement materials page by page, and sent all the photos to her brother Yu Xiaofeng, who is far away in Shenzhen, via WeChat. At the same time, she left a message in WeChat explaining the reimbursement notes and the total expenses, and asked her brother to help log in to the Luoyang medical insurance platform and submit the application.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Elder brother logged into the Luoyang medical insurance platform to submit a reimbursement application.
subevent.description: After receiving the photos of the reimbursement materials sent by his younger sister Yu Xiaowen in Shenzhen, Yu Xiaofeng logged on to the Luoyang Medical Insurance Online Service Platform using his computer, uploaded the photos one by one as required, filled in the reimbursement information, and submitted the hospitalization expense reimbursement application for his father Yu Jianguo. The system showed that the review and payment would be completed within 5 working days, and this reimbursement was expected to cover 60% of the expenses, about 8000 yuan.
subevent.location: Shenzhen City - Yu Xiaofeng's home

subevent.name: Confirm the reimbursement amount has arrived in the account
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen checked via bank SMS notifications or the Luoyang medical insurance platform and confirmed that the reimbursement for her father's hospitalization expenses had been credited. After checking, the amount credited was about 8,000 yuan, consistent with expectations. She informed her father and older brother of this news, easing the family's financial pressure.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Career transition research in rehabilitation medicine
description: On Sunday, March 9, Yu Xiaowen used her day off to open her iPad mini in her old residence, systematically visited the official website of the Chinese Association of Rehabilitation Medicine, recruitment announcements of rehabilitation departments in major hospitals, and further training brochures, and selected research directions of interest from the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine. In the Notes app, she organized an initial transition roadmap and questions to ask in the note “[Transition Research - March]”.

subevent.name: Preparing research tools
subevent.description: On Sunday morning, in the living room of her residence on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen took her iPad mini out of her bag, turned on the screen, opened the built-in Notes app, and created or located a note named [Transition Research - March] to prepare for systematically conducting information research on a career transition into rehabilitation medicine.
subevent.location: Living room at home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City

subevent.name: Visited the official website and recruitment and training information.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen sat at the desk in her home study, used the browser on her iPad mini to visit in turn the official website of the Chinese Association of Rehabilitation Medicine, the official recruitment announcement pages of rehabilitation departments in major Grade-A tertiary hospitals, and the summary pages of further training brochures, browsing one by one and recording the organizations, job requirements, and training program information she was interested in.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District, home study

subevent.name: Review academic journals and select a research direction.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen opened the latest electronic issues of the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine through the hospital intranet or academic databases, quickly browsed the tables of contents and abstracts, and excerpted into her memo the keywords, article titles, and author information for research directions she was interested in, such as neurological rehabilitation, bone and joint rehabilitation, and cardiopulmonary rehabilitation, for later in-depth reading.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District, home study

subevent.name: Organize the transition roadmap and questions to ask.
subevent.description: In the memo note [Career Change Research - March], Yu Xiaowen organized the official website information, recruitment notices, training brochures, and journal directions she had previously collected, used a mind map to draw a preliminary roadmap for transitioning to rehabilitation medicine, and listed questions to ask her supervising teacher or peers (such as the duration of specialty training, certification requirements, and the department's development prospects). Finally, she saved and backed up the note.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District, home study

name: Reading English literature sparked an inspiration for a “ceramics + cultural memory” rehabilitation intervention.
description: On the evening of August 25, while reading English literature, Yu Xiaowen encountered research on art therapy intervention for post-stroke depression. She thought of combining the zodiac commemorative coins her father collected in his early years (cultural memory elements) with tactile ceramic creation, which might have a positive effect on her father and similar patients. She then recorded this idea in detail in her notes under the theme 'Rehabilitation + Technology + Humanities' as a resource for future research.

subevent.name: Look up English literature on art therapy
subevent.description: On the evening of August 25, in her study at home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen turned on her computer, searched for, and carefully read a recent English-language paper on the effects of art therapy on post-stroke depression, gaining a deeper understanding of its research methods and clinical data.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Came up with and recorded the idea of combining pottery with zodiac commemorative coins.
subevent.description: While reading the literature, Yu Xiaowen thought of the cultural memory elements carried by the zodiac commemorative coins her father had collected in earlier years, and had an inspiration to combine tactile pottery creation with zodiac cultural memory to form a rehabilitation intervention plan. She immediately took out her notebook and recorded this idea in detail in the 'Rehabilitation + Technology + Humanities' themed notes, as a reserve for future research.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: After organizing the data charts and searching the literature, write the first draft of the paper's introduction.
description: Yu Xiaowen used her rest time after the two night shifts on June 24 and 25 to successively organize data, search the literature, and draft the introduction of her paper in the office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. On the 24th, she systematically organized the data charts from the interim report of the earlier univariate analysis, and searched and downloaded more than 10 core journal articles through the hospital's internal database. On the 25th, following Director Zhang Lei's suggestion, she completed the first draft of the paper's introduction based on the organized charts and literature, and plans to continue with the methods section next month.

subevent.name: Organized data charts and searched for literature.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen used her rest time after the night shift on June 24, alone in her office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, to systematically organize the interim report data from the preliminary univariate analysis and produce standard charts. At the same time, she searched and downloaded more than 10 recent core journal articles through the hospital's internal database, focusing on statistical methods and clinical significance related to her research topic, in preparation for writing the introduction of her paper.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Write the first draft of the paper's introduction
subevent.description: Using her rest time after the night shift on June 25, Yu Xiaowen began writing the introduction of her paper in her office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, following Director Zhang Lei's suggestions on the direction of the introduction and incorporating the figures and tables she had organized the previous day and the literature she had retrieved. She analyzed paragraph by paragraph the research background, existing controversies, and the purpose of this study. After multiple revisions, she finally completed the first draft of the introduction and planned to continue with the methods section next month.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

name: Watched a healing movie with Zhang Jing to relax.
description: On the evening of Friday, June 20, Yu Xiaowen invited her best friend Zhang Jing to see a newly released Japanese healing film at the Jingsan Road Cinema. They bought popcorn and milk tea, spending two hours laughing and being moved. After the movie, they walked home, and Zhang Jing encouraged her not to be too hard on herself; Xiaowen felt much of her stress released.

subevent.name: Invite Zhang Jing to see a movie
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 20, after finishing work, Yu Xiaowen contacted her best friend Zhang Jing via WeChat and suggested going to the Jingsan Road Cinema in the evening to watch a newly released Japanese healing film. The two agreed to meet at the cinema entrance at 7 PM that evening.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - Home

subevent.name: Go to the cinema and buy snacks.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 20, Yu Xiaowen walked to the cinema on Jingsan Road and met up with Zhang Jing, who was waiting at the entrance. The two bought a large popcorn and two cups of milk tea at the counter, then passed through the ticket check and found their seats to watch the movie.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - Jingsan Road Cinema

subevent.name: Watch a healing movie.
subevent.description: From 7 to 9 p.m. on June 20, Yu Xiaowen and Zhang Jing watched the entire newly released Japanese healing film in a screening room at Jingsan Road Cinema. During the movie, the two ate snacks and were immersed in the plot, laughing and being moved by turns, enjoying a pleasant two hours together.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - Jingsan Road Cinema

subevent.name: Took a walk and had a heart-to-heart talk after the event.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 20, after the movie ended, Yu Xiaowen and Zhang Jing walked home together along Jingsan Road. On the way, Zhang Jing noticed that Xiaowen had been under a lot of work pressure recently, so she actively comforted her and encouraged her not to be too hard on herself and to relax appropriately. Yu Xiaowen felt relieved by her friend's comfort and much of her stress was released. The two said goodbye downstairs at Xiaowen's home.
subevent.location: Street near Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

name: Shared old clothes recycling on Moments and received encouragement.
description: On the afternoon of April 12, after tidying her wardrobe, she posted on WeChat Moments to share her old-clothes recycling and Ant Forest energy. Her close friend Zhang Jing liked the post and commented 'green expert', and her colleague Wang Fang also left a comment praising her. This made her feel the warmth brought by small good deeds during the high-pressure caregiving period, and reinforced her attitude of maintaining rational consumption alongside environmental protection.

subevent.name: Organize the wardrobe and take inventory of old clothes.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 12, Yu Xiaowen was in her rented apartment at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. She opened the wardrobe, picked out clothes that were rarely worn, outdated, or the wrong size, folded and sorted them, and sorted out about 10 old garments in total, preparing to recycle them.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home bedroom

subevent.name: Edit and post on Moments
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen opened WeChat Moments, wrote a post sharing her experience of organizing the wardrobe and recycling old clothes, attached a screenshot of Ant Forest energy and photos of the old clothes, and expressed her relaxed mindset with the caption "Tidying the room while being eco-friendly, Ant Forest energy +1." She set it to public and clicked publish.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Check comments and reply to interactions.
subevent.description: Shortly after posting on Moments, Yu Xiaowen received a like and a comment from her close friend Zhang Jing calling her a “green living expert,” and her colleague Wang Fang also left a praising comment. Yu Xiaowen replied to each with grateful emojis and words, saying she would keep it up, and felt the warm encouragement from her friends.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Attended the Under the Wutong Tree Book Club and had a lively conversation with Zhao Min about the humanities
description: On Sunday afternoon, May 25, Yu Xiaowen attended the monthly "Under the Wutong Tree Book Club" event. This session centered on a discussion of "Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance." She shared her clinical insights and had an in-depth exchange with book editor Zhao Min about reading lists spanning medicine and the humanities. Zhao Min recommended "When Breath Becomes Air," and the two agreed to exchange reading notes next time. Sustained humanistic reading has broadened her horizons and also preserved a private plot of intellectual space for her high-pressure life.

subevent.name: Participated in the book club discussion and shared clinical insights.
subevent.description: At the Wutong Tree Book Club, Yu Xiaowen shared her real experiences from clinical work at Zhengzhou Central Hospital around this month's featured book, Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance, including her decision-making thoughts when facing complex cases and insights into doctor-patient communication, and had an interactive discussion with more than ten fellow readers present.
subevent.location: Second-floor activity area, Under the Plane Tree Bookstore, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Talked with book editor Zhao Min about a medical popular science book list.
subevent.description: After the book club ended, Yu Xiaowen had an in-depth exchange with Zhao Min, a book editor she met there, in the bookstore's café area. Zhao Min recommended medical humanities books such as When Breath Becomes Air. The two discussed the value of reading at the intersection of medicine and humanities, added each other on WeChat, and agreed to exchange reading notes after one month.
subevent.location: Cafe area of Under the Plane Trees Bookstore, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Complete process for career transition intention communication
description: On March 25, Yu Xiaowen systematically prepared rehabilitation medicine research materials and an interview outline at home. The following afternoon, after the department's regular meeting ended, she spoke face-to-face with department director Zhang Lei, officially raised her intention to make a career transition, and received specific suggestions. After the interview, she immediately returned to her desk to summarize the key points and developed a short-term action plan that included literature review, topic selection, and other steps, laying a foundation for her subsequent transition.

subevent.name: Preparing materials before the interview
subevent.description: On March 25, Yu Xiaowen used her spare time to systematically organize research materials on rehabilitation medicine in her home study, including the current development status of rehabilitation medicine, employment prospects, and points of fit with her existing clinical skills. She also listed her personal strengths (such as being meticulous and having strong communication skills) and reasons for transitioning. She recorded the key points in a notebook, forming a clear interview outline, and prepared for the formal communication with Director Zhang Lei the next day.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Discussing transition intentions with Director Zhang Lei in person
subevent.description: After the department's regular meeting on the afternoon of March 26, Yu Xiaowen went to Director Zhang Lei's office on her own initiative to request a one-on-one talk. She formally raised to Director Zhang her wish to transition from her current position as a resident physician in general internal medicine to the direction of rehabilitation medicine, and briefly reported on the development prospects of rehabilitation medicine she had researched, her own strengths, and the feasibility of the transition. Director Zhang Lei listened attentively, expressed understanding, and gave constructive advice: first, solidly accumulate current clinical experience and strive to publish 1-2 academic papers related to rehabilitation medicine; at the same time, he promised to help connect her with the hospital's rehabilitation department or external experts for further guidance. The conversation lasted about 20 minutes, and Yu Xiaowen gained a clear understanding of the next key steps on her transition path.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Zhengzhou Central Hospital - Director's Office.

subevent.name: Summary and action plan after the interview
subevent.description: After the meeting with Director Zhang Lei ended, Yu Xiaowen returned to her desk and immediately recorded the key points of the conversation and Director Zhang's suggestions in her personal work notes. She focused on sorting out the two core suggestions Director Zhang made: first, continue accumulating clinical experience in her current position and pay attention to rehabilitation-related cases; second, start selecting a research topic and reviewing literature to prepare for writing a paper in the field of rehabilitation medicine. Based on this, she listed a short-term action plan: search core rehabilitation medicine journals this week, schedule an exchange with the supervising teacher for rehabilitation-related cases in the department next week, and set a goal of completing the initial screening of the paper topic within one month. These notes became the basic framework for her career transition actions over the next three months.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Zhengzhou Central Hospital - Doctor's Office

name: Bought a rehabilitation exercise bike for her father and used it for the first time.
description: On the morning of Saturday, June 28, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying went to a medical device store on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. After comparing and testing, they purchased a magnetic-resistance home rehabilitation exercise bike for 3,500 yuan. That afternoon, the two transported the equipment home to No. 89 Jingsan Road. After Yu Xiaowen assembled it, she guided her father, Yu Jianguo, through his first lower-limb strength training session (low resistance, 15 minutes), monitored his heart rate and fatigue, and recorded them in the rehabilitation log. This expense strained the month's budget, but she believed it was crucial to her father's recovery.

subevent.name: Go to the medical equipment store to buy a rehabilitation exercise bike
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, June 28, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying went to a medical device store on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. After careful comparison and trial, they selected a magnetic-resistance home rehabilitation exercise bike, paid 3,500 yuan by card, and the store assistant helped pack it and carry it to the car.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jingsan Road Medical Device Specialty Store

subevent.name: Installed the pedal exerciser and guided her father through his first training session.
subevent.description: That afternoon, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying transported the purchased home rehabilitation exercise bike back to their home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. Yu Xiaowen assembled it according to the instructions. Then she guided her father Yu Jianguo through his first lower-limb strength training session on the bike, setting the resistance to low for 15 minutes. During the session, she monitored her father's heart rate and subjective fatigue level and recorded them in his rehabilitation log.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Home (No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District)

name: Went to the nursing home for volunteer service.
description: On the afternoon of July 20, Yu Xiaowen went to a nursing home in Jinshui District to measure blood pressure for the elderly, chat with them, and lead simple finger exercise activities. She found that many elderly people were lonely because their children were busy, which resonated with her experience of caring for her father. This service let her revisit the power of humanistic care beyond medicine.

subevent.name: Drive to the nursing home.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen drove her family car from her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, to a nursing home in Jinshui District, a drive of about 20 minutes. After arriving, she coordinated with the nursing home staff, registered the information, and learned about the basic conditions of the elderly residents.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - a nursing home in Jinshui District.

subevent.name: Measuring blood pressure for the elderly.
subevent.description: In the nursing home activity room, Yu Xiaowen used her own blood pressure monitor to measure blood pressure for more than ten elderly people present one by one, recorded the data, reminded those with high blood pressure to watch their diet and take medication on time, gave simple advice for abnormal values, and suggested that staff pay attention.

participant.name: Elderly residents of the nursing home

subevent.location: Activity room of a nursing home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Accompany the elderly and chat with them
subevent.description: After measuring blood pressure, Yu Xiaowen sat among the elderly and chatted cordially with several of them, listening to their past stories and family situations. She noticed that many elderly people were lonely because their children were busy. Reflecting on her own experience caring for her father, she was deeply touched and comforted them with warm words.

participant.name: Elderly residents of the nursing home

subevent.location: Rest area of a nursing home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Leading finger exercise activities
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen organized the elderly patients to do simple finger exercises. She stood in front and demonstrated the movements, using easy-to-understand verbal instructions to lead them through fist clenching, stretching, finger opposition, and other movements, encouraging them to persist in practice to promote blood circulation in the hands. The activity lasted about 15 minutes, and the elderly patients participated actively.

participant.name: Elderly residents of the nursing home

subevent.location: Activity room of a nursing home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Saying goodbye and returning home
subevent.description: The volunteer service activity ended around 4 p.m. Yu Xiaowen said goodbye to the nursing home staff and the elderly, collected feedback, handed the blood pressure record data to the staff, then drove back to her home in Jinshui District. On the way, she recalled the service process and felt fulfilled and warm.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province: from a nursing home in Jinshui District to home.

subevent.name: Record volunteer service reflections
subevent.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowen recorded her feelings about today's nursing home service in her diary or phone memo, writing about her empathy for the loneliness of the elderly and her thoughts on medical humanistic care, and she planned to regularly participate in such volunteer activities in the future.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province – home study

name: Completed the statistical analysis of the cerebral infarction database and reported it to the supervising physician.
description: On the evenings of May 26 and 27, Yu Xiaowen conducted SPSS statistical analysis on the rehabilitation database of 150 cerebral infarction patients in her home study, including univariate analysis and multivariate logistic regression. During the day on May 28, she organized the results into a PPT in her hospital office. On May 29, she reported to her supervising teacher Li Wei in the department office, received affirmation, and was advised to write a case series abstract and submit it to the hospital's youth forum.

subevent.name: Perform univariate analysis on the database
subevent.description: In her study at home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen used the evening time to conduct SPSS univariate statistical analysis on the established rehabilitation database of 150 cerebral infarction patients, including data cleaning, descriptive statistics, and preliminary univariate association analysis, to screen out possible influencing factors.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Perform multivariable logistic regression analysis.
subevent.description: In her study at home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen continued multivariate logistic regression analysis in the evening. She incorporated the potential influencing factors screened in univariate analysis into the model, adjusted for covariates, and evaluated the independent effects of each factor on the rehabilitation outcomes of patients with cerebral infarction.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Complete statistical analysis and review the results.
subevent.description: At her home study in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen used the evening to complete all the remaining statistical analyses, including model fitting and result verification, exporting key statistics (p-values, odds ratios, confidence intervals, etc.) and organizing them into statistical tables.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Organized the results and made the report PPT
subevent.description: At her office in Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen compiled the statistical analysis results into a PPT during the day, including research background, methods, charts for univariate and multivariate analysis results, and preliminary conclusions, preparing to report to her mentor Li Wei.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Report the statistical results to the supervising instructor.
subevent.description: At the department office of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen used a PowerPoint presentation to report in detail the statistical analysis results and clinical significance to her supervising teacher Li Wei. Li Wei affirmed the reliability of the results and the analytical approach, and suggested that Yu Xiaowen organize the relevant findings into a case series abstract and submit it to the upcoming hospital-wide youth forum.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Visited the special exhibition “Ancient Traditional Chinese Medicine” and was inspired to revise the discussion section of the paper.
description: On Sunday, July 13, Yu Xiaowen visited the special exhibition 'Ancient Traditional Chinese Medicine' at the Henan Provincial Museum with her close friend Zhang Jing. The ancient ceramic medicine grinders and mortar and pestle sets on display deeply moved her. She took photos and sent them to her pottery teacher Zheng Guodong, remarking, 'It turns out pottery and medicine have intersected since ancient times.' Zheng Guodong replied, 'Objects carry healing, and so do the ceramic bowls you make.' The exhibition's emphasis on the holistic view of traditional Chinese medicine inspired her. That same evening, she revised the discussion section of her paper, incorporating thoughts on holistic rehabilitation of disease.

subevent.name: Go to the Henan Provincial Museum
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen and her close friend Zhang Jing agreed to meet at the entrance of the Henan Provincial Museum. Yu Xiaowen drove from home to the museum, and after arriving, she met up with Zhang Jing and entered the museum together.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Henan Provincial Museum

subevent.name: Visit the 'Ancient Traditional Chinese Medicine' special exhibition
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen and Zhang Jing visited the 'Ancient Traditional Chinese Medicine' special exhibition at the Henan Provincial Museum, carefully viewing ancient ceramic medicine grinders, pestle-and-mortar jars, and other artifacts, reading the display descriptions, and were deeply moved by the holistic concept of traditional Chinese medicine.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Henan Provincial Museum

subevent.name: Taking photos and sharing reflections with the pottery teacher
subevent.description: During the visit, Yu Xiaowen used her phone to take photos of an ancient ceramic medicine grinder and a medicine mortar, sent them to her pottery teacher Zheng Guodong via WeChat, and commented with emotion, "So pottery and medicine have intersected since ancient times." Zheng Guodong replied, "Objects carry healing, and the clay bowl you made does too."
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Henan Provincial Museum

subevent.name: In the evening, revise the discussion section of the paper.
subevent.description: After returning home from the museum and finishing dinner, Yu Xiaowen opened her laptop in the study. Inspired by the daytime exhibition, she began revising the discussion section of a medical paper, especially incorporating thoughts on the overall rehabilitation of the disease.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: Organized and handed over the neurology department work documents.
description: From August 22 to 26, Yu Xiaowen used her free time during night shifts to systematically organize the neurology-related medical records and work notes, and wrote a detailed handover memorandum. She sent the electronic document to the doctor taking over, Liu Qiang, and communicated with him in person about the precautions for key patients, ensuring a smooth transition.

subevent.name: Organize medical record materials.
subevent.description: On August 22, during her night shift in the Neurology Department at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen used her spare time to systematically organize the medical records of the neurology patients she was responsible for, including discharge records, archived records, and current inpatient records. She checked key information, categorized and filed them, to prepare for the handover.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Neurology Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Write a handover memo
subevent.description: On August 25, after completing all the material organization, Yu Xiaowen wrote a detailed handover memorandum, including the patient list, key patient precautions, unfinished matters, personalized medication tips, and department workflow reminders, to ensure the successor doctor could take over seamlessly.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Neurology Doctor's Duty Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Sent electronic document and arranged face-to-face communication.
subevent.description: On August 26, Yu Xiaowen packaged and sent the organized electronic documents—medical records, summaries of ongoing cases, medication experience notes, and handover memos—to the relieving doctor Liu Qiang through the hospital's internal system, and proactively arranged a face-to-face meeting time with Liu Qiang.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Neurology Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Discussed key patient precautions in person
subevent.description: On August 26, Yu Xiaowen had a face-to-face conversation with her replacement doctor Liu Qiang in the neurology department office. She explained item by item the key patients' conditions, special medication regimens, and potential risks listed in the handover memo, and answered Liu Qiang's questions, ensuring a smooth transition of work.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Neurology Doctor's Duty Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Father suffered a sudden cerebral infarction; urgently returned hometown to accompany and care for him
description: At noon on January 15, 2025, while on duty at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen received an urgent call from her mother, Li Xiuying, and learned that her father, Yu Jianguo, had suddenly suffered a cerebral infarction at home in Luoyang. She immediately asked for leave from the department director, Zhang Lei, and took a high-speed train back to Luoyang that afternoon, heading straight to the neurology ward of Luoyang Central Hospital. Seeing her father lying in bed with a clouded consciousness, she held back tears and discussed treatment options with her mother, and immediately notified her brother, Yu Xiaofeng, who worked in Shenzhen, in the family WeChat group. This emergency completely disrupted her original work, pottery, and social plans, and family responsibility became the focus of the rest of the month.

subevent.name: Received an urgent call that her father had a cerebral infarction.
subevent.description: At noon on January 15, 2025, Yu Xiaowen was on duty in the inpatient department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital when she received an urgent call from her mother, Li Xiuying, at their home in Luoyang. Her mother anxiously told her that her father, Yu Jianguo, had suffered a sudden cerebral infarction and had been taken to Luoyang Central Hospital for emergency treatment with the help of a neighbor. Yu Xiaowen's heart raced, and she immediately decided to set aside her current work and rush back to Luoyang.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Ask the department director for leave and hand over work.
subevent.description: After hanging up, Yu Xiaowen immediately went to Director Zhang Lei's office, explained the family emergency, and verbally requested leave. Director Zhang Lei expressed understanding, approved her emergency leave, and arranged for Wang Fang, a resident physician on the same team, to temporarily take over the patients under Yu Xiaowen's care. Yu Xiaowen quickly finished the day's medical records on the computer, verbally passed along the important notes to Wang Fang, then packed her belongings and prepared to leave.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Doctors' Office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Took the high-speed rail from Zhengzhou back to Luoyang
subevent.description: At the hospital entrance, Yu Xiaowen used a mobile app to buy a ticket for the next high-speed train from Zhengzhou East Station to Luoyang Longmen Station, then drove toward Zhengzhou East Station (because time was tight, she parked her car in the hospital parking lot and took a taxi to the station). While waiting for the train and riding it, she kept in touch with her mother via WeChat to get the latest news about her father, and also searched for knowledge on emergency treatment and nursing care for cerebral infarction. The high-speed train ride took about 40 minutes, and she arrived at Luoyang Longmen Station around 2 p.m.
subevent.location: High-speed rail route in Henan Province from Zhengzhou East Railway Station to Luoyang Longmen Railway Station.

subevent.name: Arrived at the hospital to check on father's condition
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen took a taxi from Luoyang Longmen Station directly to the neurology ward of Luoyang Central Hospital. Outside the ward, she saw her mother Li Xiuying waiting anxiously. Through the attending doctor, she learned about her father's condition: her father, Yu Jianguo, had suffered a sudden cerebral infarction, causing left-sided limb weakness and slurred speech. He had already received thrombolytic therapy, and his vital signs were stable but he still required close observation. When Yu Xiaowen entered the ward and saw her father lying on the hospital bed semiconscious, she held back tears and comforted her mother.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Luoyang City - Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital

subevent.name: Discussed the treatment plan with her mother and notified her elder brother.
subevent.description: In the corridor outside the ward, Yu Xiaowen discussed the follow-up treatment plan in detail with her mother Li Xiuying, including whether to transfer her father to a major hospital in Zhengzhou and the rehabilitation plan. At the same time, in the family WeChat group, she informed her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng, who works in Shenzhen, of their father's onset of illness and current treatment, and attached the attending physician's contact information. Yu Xiaofeng said he would arrange leave as soon as possible and rush back to Luoyang. The siblings agreed to stay in real-time communication.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Luoyang City - corridor of the Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital

name: Listening to classical music before bed to relax the body and mind
description: On the evening of April 7, after her father fell asleep, Yu Xiaowen put on earphones and sat alone on the balcony, listening to the first movement of Mozart's Symphony No. 40 in G Minor. In the familiar melody, she temporarily forgot the pressures of family and work and felt a long-lost inner peace. She decided to set aside at least two evenings a week from then on to enjoy classical music as a small ritual of self-care.

subevent.name: Getting ready to listen to classical music.
subevent.description: After her father fell asleep in the evening, Yu Xiaowen took out her wireless earphones and opened the music app on her phone, selected and played the first movement of Mozart's Symphony No. 40 in G minor from her classical music collection, adjusted the volume to a comfortable level, then carried a cup of water to the balcony, arranged the cushion, and got ready to listen.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - balcony at home

subevent.name: Listening to classical music on the balcony and making a self-care decision
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen sat alone on the balcony of her home in Zhengzhou, put on headphones, and listened intently in the night to the first movement of Mozart's Symphony No. 40 in G minor. The familiar melody let her temporarily forget the dual pressure of recent family trivialities and hospital work, and her mind gradually calmed, bringing her a long-missed sense of relaxation and peace. When the piece ended, she decided to set aside at least two evenings every week to focus on enjoying classical music, making it a fixed little self-care ritual.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - balcony at home

name: Mother complained that Father was passive about exercising. Xiaowen, feeling emotionally drained, confided in Zhang Jing.
description: On the evening of April 10, her mother complained that her father was not proactive in physical therapy, while her father remained silent, and the family atmosphere was heavy. Yu Xiaowen tried to mediate, but felt emotionally drained under pressure from both sides, so she hid in her room and sent a voice message to her good friend Zhang Jing: 'Sometimes I feel like a sandwich cookie. I have to comfort both sides, but who comforts me?' Zhang Jing quickly replied with a string of hug emojis, giving her immediate emotional support. This venting eased her loneliness.

subevent.name: Father is receiving physical therapy
subevent.description: On National Day, my father performed the prescribed physical therapy rehabilitation exercises at home in Xigong District, Luoyang City. However, due to incorrect movements or a negative attitude, the treatment effect was poor, setting the stage for my mother's later complaints.
subevent.location: Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province - home

subevent.name: Mother complained that Father was passive about exercise, and Xiaowen tried to comfort her
subevent.description: In the evening, in the living room of the home in Xigong District, Luoyang, mother Li Xiuying complained to the family that father Yu Jianguo was not proactive in physical therapy, with a displeased tone. Father remained silent, and the family atmosphere was tense. Yu Xiaowen saw this and tried to mediate between them, hoping her mother would understand the difficulty of her father's recovery, while encouraging her father to face it positively, but the mediation was ineffective, and she herself felt exhausted.
