subevent.location: Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province - home living room

subevent.name: Xiaowen hid in her room and poured her heart out to Zhang Jing
subevent.description: After her attempt to mediate failed, Yu Xiaowen returned to her bedroom, closed the door, and poured out her pent-up feelings and exhaustion to her friend Zhang Jing via WeChat voice message, saying, ‘Sometimes I feel like a sandwich cookie—I have to soothe both sides, but who soothes me?’ She also described in detail the course of her parents' quarrel and her own helplessness.
subevent.location: Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province - home bedroom.

subevent.name: Zhang Jing provided emotional support
subevent.description: Zhang Jing replied within minutes after Yu Xiaowen sent the voice message with a series of hugging emojis and comforting words, providing immediate emotional support via WeChat, expressing understanding of Xiaowen's situation and encouraging her to relax a little. After seeing the reply, Xiaowen felt her loneliness ease and gradually calmed down.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home (Zhang Jing)

name: Getting started in research practice: SPSS exercises and database construction, with guidance from a mentor.
description: On May 7, Yu Xiaowen began using previous case data to practice SPSS operations, attempting to complete univariate analysis independently. After morning ward rounds on May 8, her supervising teacher, Li Wei, took the initiative to ask about her progress and gave her half an hour of guidance on focusing the research topic and selecting key variables, suggesting that she 'first build a clean, small database that can answer one specific clinical question.' On May 9, following his guidance, she spent the whole afternoon initially establishing a small research database with rehabilitation indicators from 150 patients with cerebral infarction, and her confidence in hands-on research greatly increased.

subevent.name: Practiced SPSS univariate analysis.
subevent.description: On May 7, at her office in Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen practiced using SPSS with previous stroke case data, trying to independently complete univariate analysis to prepare for her subsequent research projects.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Received directional guidance from supervising teacher Li Wei
subevent.description: After morning rounds on May 8, Yu Xiaowen discussed her research progress with her mentor Li Wei in the doctor's office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Li Wei proactively asked and spent half an hour giving her guidance, suggesting that she first build a clean, small database, focus on specific clinical questions, and offering advice on topic selection and key variable screening.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Preliminarily established a research database for cerebral infarction patients
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 9, Yu Xiaowen, following the guidance of her supervisor Li Wei, spent about half a day in her office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital initially building a small research database containing rehabilitation-phase indicators from 150 cerebral infarction patients. Through data cleaning and entry, she gained more confidence in hands-on research.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

name: Had a heart-to-heart WeChat chat with Zhang Jing about responsibility and self-balance
description: Around 9 p.m. on July 22, Zhang Jing sent a greeting message via WeChat asking how Yu Xiaowen was doing. Yu Xiaowen honestly said that she was physically and mentally exhausted because of her father's rehabilitation, the pressure of hospital work, and her personal pursuits (such as pottery and exercise), and she did not know how to find a balance between responsibility and herself. Zhang Jing listened patiently and then responded warmly: 'You don't need to be perfect; you just need to remember that you're human too.' This sentence deeply touched Yu Xiaowen and brought her relief late at night.

subevent.name: Had a heart-to-heart WeChat chat with Zhang Jing about responsibility and self-balance
subevent.description: At around nine in the evening, Zhang Jing sent a greeting message via WeChat, asking Yu Xiaowen about her recent work and life. Yu Xiaowen honestly said that she felt physically and mentally exhausted due to her father's rehabilitation, the pressure of hospital work, and her personal pursuits (such as pottery and exercise), and she did not know how to find a balance between responsibility and herself. After listening patiently, Zhang Jing responded warmly: 'You don't need to be perfect; you just need to remember that you are human too.' These words deeply touched Yu Xiaowen, making her feel relieved and understood late at night.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City – home in Jinshui District (online chat)

name: Yu Xiaowen changed her hairstyle to symbolize a fresh start.
description: On June 14, her mother Li Xiuying suggested that Yu Xiaowen change her hairstyle to start fresh, which resonated with her. She then searched for hairstyle inspiration on the 16th, discussed it with her best friend Zhang Jing on the 17th, booked a hair salon on the 18th, and went in for a consultation on the 20th. She finally completed her new hairstyle transformation on June 29 and felt satisfied, sharing it with others.

subevent.name: Mother suggested a new hairstyle.
subevent.description: At the home at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, her mother Li Xiuying, during a video call with Yu Xiaowen, noticed that her daughter looked tired from work and casually suggested she change her hairstyle to symbolize a fresh start. Yu Xiaowen heard this in the living room and began to seriously consider the suggestion.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Searching online for hairstyle inspiration.
subevent.description: At her home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen used her phone and computer to browse social platforms such as Xiaohongshu and Weibo, looked at various hairstyle pictures including short hair, curly hair, and dyed hair, saved the styles she liked, and preliminarily determined the hairstyle direction she wanted to try.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Discussed ideas about changing her hairstyle with her best friend
subevent.description: During her lunch break at the hospital in downtown Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen used WeChat to share her idea of changing her hairstyle with her best friend Zhang Jing, a primary school Chinese language teacher in Zhengzhou, sent pictures of hairstyles she liked, and asked for advice. Zhang Jing encouraged her to try a change and recommended several hair salons she knew about.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Compare hair salons and book an appointment
subevent.description: At her home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen browses highly rated hair salons in Zhengzhou through the Dianping app, compares stylists' portfolios and user reviews, and finally selects a well-known chain salon in Zhongyuan District, booking an appointment online for the weekend.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Went to the salon to consult a hairstylist.
subevent.description: On her day off, Yu Xiaowen went to the hair salon she had booked (located near Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City), and discussed her face shape, hair texture, and desired style with the stylist. Based on her profession and temperament, the stylist recommended a fresh shoulder-length bob and suggested a light perm. Yu Xiaowen decided to accept the plan and set a time for the actual appointment.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - a chain hair salon

subevent.name: Carried out the new hairstyle makeover
subevent.description: At the agreed time, Yu Xiaowen went to the hair salon again (near Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou). The stylist provided her with a full set of services including a haircut, light perm, and coloring, and finally completed her new hairstyle. After the makeover, Yu Xiaowen examined the effect in front of the mirror, felt satisfied, and took photos to share with her mother and close friends.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - a chain hair salon

name: Father was discharged from the hospital and taken back to the old house to recuperate.
description: On January 27, after evaluation by the attending physician, her father Yu Jianguo's indicators were stable, and he could be discharged to go home for the Spring Festival. Yu Xiaowen and her brother completed the discharge procedures and brought him back to the old house at 42 Kaixuan Road in a wheelchair. Seeing the Spring Festival couplets that neighbors had helped put up, her father showed his first smile since being admitted to the hospital.

subevent.name: The doctor evaluated and confirmed discharge.
subevent.description: On the morning of January 27, 2025, after making ward rounds, the attending physician for Yu Xiaowen's father Yu Jianguo at Zhengzhou Central Hospital conducted a comprehensive assessment of his vital signs and rehabilitation indicators, confirmed that his condition was stable and met the criteria for discharge, and immediately notified Yu Xiaowen and her older brother Yu Xiaofeng that they could complete the discharge procedures. He also explained the post-discharge home care and medication precautions.
subevent.location: Ward at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Handling discharge procedures and packing belongings.
subevent.description: Around 10 a.m., Yu Xiaowen and her older brother Yu Xiaofeng went to the inpatient billing window at the hospital to settle the hospitalization costs, get the deposit back, and pick up the discharge medications prescribed by the doctor from the pharmacy. At the same time, the two returned to the ward to help their father pack personal items such as clothes and toiletries, and confirmed that nothing was left in the ward. Yu Xiaofeng was in charge of carrying the items, while Yu Xiaowen carefully checked the discharge summary and doctor's orders.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Escorting father back to the old house in a wheelchair
subevent.description: At noon, Yu Xiaowen and Yu Xiaofeng pushed their father Yu Jianguo to the hospital entrance in a wheelchair provided by the hospital, and took a ride-hailing car that had been booked in advance back to Luoyang. Along the way, Yu Xiaowen took careful care of her father to ensure he was comfortable and free from bumps. About an hour later, the car arrived at the downstairs of the old residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City. The two worked together to help their father out of the car carefully and used the wheelchair to take him inside.
subevent.location: Old residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City.

subevent.name: Settling into the old house and moments of surprise
subevent.description: After arriving at the old family home in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen and Yu Xiaofeng helped their father to the bedroom and got him settled on the bed to rest. They then unpacked the luggage and boiled water to prepare lunch. Yu Xiaowen noticed that a neighbor had already helped put up brand-new Spring Festival couplets and a 'Fu' character on the front door, so she helped her father walk over to take a look. Looking at the festive couplets, her father showed the first smile since his hospital admission. Yu Xiaowen took a photo of her father's smile and the couplets with her phone and shared it in the family WeChat group.
subevent.location: In front of the old house at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang

name: Intensive training for the attending physician exam — cardiovascular system drug review
description: From June 25 to 30, Yu Xiaowen, based on the weak areas identified in the mock exam, used the fragmented time after work and between night shifts to focus on reviewing the cardiovascular system drug chapter. Through textbooks, internal handouts, and online question banks, she tackled difficult points such as the classification of antiarrhythmic drugs and the management of digitalis toxicity, and compiled five pages of handwritten notes. This round of intensive training significantly improved her mastery of the module, laying a solid foundation for the final sprint before the exam.

subevent.name: Formulating a review plan and making an initial outline
subevent.description: After work on June 25, in her home study at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen made a 6-day intensive review plan for the cardiovascular system drugs chapter based on the weak points identified in the mock exam. She first quickly flipped through the textbook's table of contents, sorted out two key difficulties: the classification of antiarrhythmic drugs and the management of digitalis toxicity, and marked the content that needed focused effort, planning for subsequent review.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - home study

subevent.name: Systematic study of the classification of antiarrhythmic drugs
subevent.description: On June 26, Yu Xiaowen was in the resident on-call room at Zhengzhou Central Hospital and used fragments of time during the night shift to systematically study the classification of antiarrhythmic drugs. Comparing the internal handouts and textbooks, she read in detail the mechanisms of action, indications, and adverse reactions of drugs in each category, and drew a classification tree diagram in her notebook to deepen her memory. She focused on memorizing the representative drugs and clinical application points of the four major categories (Classes I, II, III, and IV).
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - hospital duty room

subevent.name: Special topic breakthrough: digitalis toxicity management
subevent.description: On the evening of June 27, Yu Xiaowen focused on studying the management of digitalis poisoning at her desk at home. Combining the textbook and case analyses collected online, she worked to understand the clinical manifestations of poisoning (gastrointestinal, cardiac, and neurological) and the treatment principles (discontinuing the drug, potassium supplementation, phenytoin sodium, etc.). She recorded the key points in a question-and-answer format in her handwritten notes and recited them aloud to reinforce memory.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - home desk

subevent.name: Practice exercises with an online question bank
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 28, Yu Xiaowen used the medical exam online question bank on her phone in the rest room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital to do targeted practice on the cardiovascular system drugs chapter. She completed 50 multiple-choice questions, covering subtopics such as classification of antiarrhythmic drugs, management of digitalis toxicity, and commonly used antihypertensive drugs. After answering, she carefully reviewed the explanations, marked the weak knowledge points involved in the wrong questions, and added the relevant explanation points to her notes.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Hospital lounge

subevent.name: Organizing and systematizing handwritten notes.
subevent.description: After work on June 29, Yu Xiaowen systematically organized the scattered notes she had accumulated during the previous four days of review at her home on Jingsan Road. Using different colored pens, she sorted key content by chapter, including antiarrhythmic drug classifications, digoxin toxicity management, and antihypertensive drug mechanisms, producing 5 pages of clearly organized handwritten notes with tables, flowcharts, and memory mnemonics as core materials for the final sprint review.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - home

subevent.name: Overall review and further reinforcement of weak points
subevent.description: On the evening of June 30, Yu Xiaowen did a final round of review in the living room at home. She first quickly reviewed the framework of cardiovascular system drugs through self-questioning and self-answering, then focused on the wrong questions and difficult points marked in previous rounds (such as the differential diagnosis of digitalis toxicity and the principles for selecting antiarrhythmic drugs). Finally, she orally summarized the key scoring points of the module, confirmed that the classification of antiarrhythmic drugs and the management of digitalis toxicity had been basically mastered, and laid the foundation for the subsequent exam sprint.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Home Living Room

name: Had an in-depth exchange with the director of the rehabilitation medicine department about the transition plan.
description: On July 23, Yu Xiaowen organized her career planning thoughts, paper outline, and takeaways from the online forum at home, and prepared consultation questions and a personal resume. On July 24, she had a one-on-one consultation with Director Li Yan in the office of the director of the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, learning in detail about the training track, staffing needs, and department transfer process, and received affirmation of her interdisciplinary strengths. After the exchange, she organized the key information and began preparing her application materials for advanced study, strengthening her resolve to make the career transition.

subevent.name: Preparing content for career transition discussion
subevent.description: In her home study, Yu Xiaowen organized her career planning thoughts, her conceptual ideas about holistic rehabilitation in her paper, and what she had learned from an online forum. She listed specific questions to ask Director Li Yan, and printed her resume and a statement of her intention to pursue further training.
subevent.location: Home study room, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Had an in-depth discussion with Director Li Yan about career transition
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen had a one-on-one career consultation with Director Li Yan in the office of the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine's director. Director Li Yan gave a detailed introduction to the training path in rehabilitation medicine, the department's staffing needs, and the department transfer process, and affirmed her advantage in combining her neurology experience with rehabilitation. Yu Xiaowen reported her idea of incorporating a holistic rehabilitation concept into her paper and what she had gained from attending an online forum. The exchange lasted about an hour and further strengthened her determination to make the transition.

participant.name: Li Yan
participant.relation: Director of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department

subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Office of the Director, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Sorted communication records and key points.
subevent.description: After the discussion, Yu Xiaowen returned to the department office and organized the key information provided by Director Li Yan—such as the department transfer process, training paths, and staffing needs—into electronic notes, and marked the application materials that needed to be prepared first and the next action steps.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – Resident Physician Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Department transfer application approved and congratulations from cousin Li Yaqin.
description: On the afternoon of August 12, the HR department notified Yu Xiaowen that her application to transfer departments had been approved, and she was scheduled to report to the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine on September 1. The same day the news spread, her cousin Li Yaqin sent a WeChat congratulations: "Congrats, Xiaowen! When you come to Hangzhou in the future, remember to take a look at your brother-in-law's lumbar muscle strain!" Yu Xiaowen smiled and replied with a tip on rehabilitation exercises.

subevent.name: Received notice of approved department transfer
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 12, 2025, Yu Xiaowen received formal notice from the Human Resources Department in its office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital that her department transfer application had been approved, and she was told to report to the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine on September 1. Yu Xiaowen confirmed the information on the spot and expressed her gratitude.
subevent.location: Human Resources Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Replied to cousin's congratulations and rehabilitation advice.
subevent.description: That afternoon, Yu Xiaowen received a congratulatory WeChat message from her cousin Li Yaqin in Hangzhou. Her cousin asked about rehabilitation exercises and mentioned her husband's lumbar muscle strain. Yu Xiaowen replied via WeChat from the doctors' lounge at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, sharing detailed tips on rehabilitation exercises for lumbar muscle strain, and they agreed to talk more when she visits Hangzhou in the future.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Doctors' Lounge, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Prepare for and visit the rehabilitation department director to discuss the department transfer
description: On the morning of August 13, after reviewing rehabilitation department materials in the resident doctors' office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen walked to the rehabilitation medicine department office to discuss her rotation arrangement with Director Wang Zhenhua. Director Wang introduced the department's ongoing "Community Rehabilitation for Stroke" project and suggested that she use the time before reporting to familiarize herself with the rehabilitation assessment process.

subevent.name: Look up rehabilitation department materials
subevent.description: On the morning of August 13, at the resident physicians' office of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen used the hospital information system and internal materials to review learning materials including the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine profile, the community stroke rehabilitation program, and the rehabilitation assessment process, preparing herself for the discussion with Director Wang Zhenhua.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – Resident Physician Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Go to the rehabilitation medicine department office
subevent.description: On the morning of August 13, Yu Xiaowen walked from the residents' office to the rehabilitation medicine department office in the same hospital, preparing to meet with Director Wang Zhenhua.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Communicated with Director Wang Zhenhua about the transfer to another department.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen visited Wang Zhenhua, director of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department, in his office, and explained that she would report for the department transfer on September 1 as notified by the personnel office. Director Wang introduced the department's ongoing 'Community Stroke Rehabilitation' project and suggested that Yu Xiaowen use the time before reporting to become familiar with the rehabilitation assessment process. The two had a full exchange about the work handover after the transfer.

participant.name: Wang Zhenhua
participant.relation: Director of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department

subevent.location: Rehabilitation Medicine Department office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou

name: Attended a pottery class and chatted with Su Ya after class
description: On Saturday afternoon, January 4, Yu Xiaowen left home and went to the 'Between the Clay' pottery studio in Guancheng District to attend a pottery interest class. Under the guidance of teacher Zheng Guodong, she practiced wheel throwing and hand shaping. After class, she went to a nearby café with Su Ya, a classmate she had just met in the pottery class, to exchange ideas, share photos of their works, and agreed to make tea sets together.

subevent.name: Attend a pottery class
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Saturday, January 4, 2025, Yu Xiaowen set out from her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and went to the "Between Clay" Pottery Studio in the Artists' Park on Shangcheng Road, Guancheng District, to attend the week's pottery hobby class. The class was instructed by pottery teacher Zheng Guodong. Yu Xiaowen practiced wheel-throwing and hand-building techniques, accumulating material for her later exchange with Su Ya after class.
subevent.location: Guancheng District, Zhengzhou - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

subevent.name: After class, had a conversation with Su Ya at the café.
subevent.description: After the pottery class, Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya, a classmate she had just met, went to a café near the studio to sit for a while. The two exchanged their pottery learning insights. Su Ya shared photos of her previous pottery works, including tea sets and flower vessels, and Yu Xiaowen also showed her practice pieces from that day's class. The conversation was relaxed and pleasant, and they came to know each other better.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou Guancheng District - cafe near the studio

name: Activated the electronic medical insurance certificate and taught her mother how to use it.
description: At noon on April 2, Yu Xiaowen responded to the Zhengzhou Medical Insurance Bureau's promotion by activating her electronic medical insurance voucher on Alipay and teaching her mother how to use it. Her mother marveled at the convenience of scanning codes, and Yu Xiaowen took the opportunity to encourage her mother to try more smartphone functions to ease the sense of isolation after moving to Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: Activate my electronic medical insurance certificate.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen, at her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, opened the Alipay app and, following the promotional guidelines of the Zhengzhou Healthcare Security Bureau, completed facial recognition and identity verification, successfully activating her electronic medical insurance voucher. She carefully read the instructions and saved a screenshot of the voucher QR code for future medical visits.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Home

subevent.name: Teaching mother to use the electronic medical insurance voucher
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen demonstrated on her own phone how to open Alipay and show the electronic medical insurance credential, then guided her mother Li Xiuying through activation and first use on her own phone. She patiently explained how to display the QR code for scenarios such as hospital registration and buying medicine. Her mother Li Xiuying remarked that scanning codes was much more convenient than carrying a physical card. Yu Xiaowen seized this opportunity to encourage her mother to try more smartphone features, in order to ease her mother's sense of alienation from modern life after coming to Zhengzhou.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Home

name: Attended a hypertension lecture and organized study notes
description: On the afternoon of January 9, Yu Xiaowen attended a lecture in the 15th-floor meeting room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital organized by her department to interpret the new edition of the Chinese Guidelines for the Prevention and Treatment of Hypertension. The speaker, Dr. Liu Qiang, analyzed the key points of combination therapy with case studies, and Yu Xiaowen took careful notes. That evening, she organized the lecture notes in her study, made electronic study cards, and looked up two systematic reviews recommended by Liu Qiang.

subevent.name: Attending a professional learning lecture
subevent.description: On January 9, from 3:00 to 4:30 PM, Yu Xiaowen attended a professional learning lecture organized by her department in the 15th-floor conference room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The speaker, Dr. Liu Qiang, gave a detailed analysis of the indications, contraindications, and dose adjustment points for ACEI/ARB and CCB combination therapy, based on the new Chinese Guidelines for the Prevention and Treatment of Hypertension and combined with clinical cases. Yu Xiaowen listened attentively throughout and recorded key data, flowcharts, and points of confusion in her notebook.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 15th floor conference room

subevent.name: Organize lecture notes and review literature
subevent.description: That evening, Yu Xiaowen opened her computer and notebook in her home study, organized and summarized the key points she had recorded during the lecture, and made digital study cards. At the same time, she searched the hospital's digital library for two systematic reviews on combination antihypertensive therapy recommended by Liu Qiang, quickly skimmed the abstracts, and marked the key conclusions. The organization process took about 1 hour.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: Formally reported to the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine and completed first-day onboarding
description: On September 1, Yu Xiaowen officially reported to the Rehabilitation Medicine Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The department director, Fang Mingyuan, arranged for senior therapist Li Zhigang to mentor her. In the morning, she followed Li Zhigang to learn the rehabilitation assessment process; during the lunch break, she organized her workstation, placing her father's rehabilitation notes alongside professional books, marking a new starting point of 'clinical + research'; in the afternoon, she sat in on a case discussion meeting and accompanied attending physician Wang Min on ward rounds to familiarize herself with the department's daily operations; before leaving work, she completed a daily summary and communicated with her mentor about the next day's study arrangements.

subevent.name: Report to the Rehabilitation Medicine Department and meet the department director.
subevent.description: At 8 a.m., Yu Xiaowen, as notified by the personnel department, went to the doctor's office of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department at Zhengzhou Central Hospital to report in. The department director, Chief Physician Fang Mingyuan, received her, had a brief onboarding conversation, introduced the department's basic situation and team division of work, and assigned senior therapist Li Zhigang as her mentor, responsible for helping her become familiar with the rehabilitation assessment process.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Rehabilitation Medicine Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Shadow a senior therapist to learn the rehabilitation assessment process
subevent.description: From 9:00 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., led by therapist Li Zhigang, Yu Xiaowen visited the rehabilitation assessment room, physical therapy area, and occupational therapy area in turn, observed procedures such as limb motor function assessment and activities of daily living assessment, and learned the key points of writing assessment reports. During the visit, Li Zhigang explained evaluation approaches for several typical cases, and Yu Xiaowen took careful notes and asked several key questions.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - treatment areas of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department at Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: During lunch break, tidied up the workstation and arranged documents.
subevent.description: From 12:00 to 13:00, Yu Xiaowen used her lunch break to return to her assigned workstation (in the corner of the doctors' office in the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine). She placed the rehabilitation notes of her father Yu Jianguo that she had brought, along with several professional rehabilitation medicine books, side by side on the bookshelf. She also organized her computer and stationery, put a small green plant on the desk, and created a comfortable working environment. She flipped through her father's notes and gained insight into some rehabilitation concepts.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - doctor's workstation at the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: In the afternoon, continued familiarizing herself with the department's daily work and triage procedures
subevent.description: From 13:30 to 17:00, under the arrangement of her supervising teacher Li Zhigang, Yu Xiaowen sat in on the afternoon case discussion meeting of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department and learned about the rehabilitation goals and plans for several newly admitted patients. Afterward, she accompanied Wang Min, the department’s attending physician, on ward rounds, gaining an initial grasp of patient distribution and shift handover procedures. She also briefly communicated with and greeted patients, feeling the humanistic care atmosphere of rehabilitation medicine.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Ward and conference room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital.

subevent.name: Before leaving work, complete the day's summary and plan the next day's study
subevent.description: From 5:00 PM to 5:30 PM, Yu Xiaowen reviewed the first day’s learning gains at her workstation, compiled the assessment points and case discussion content she had observed into electronic notes, and archived them in the department’s shared folder. She also briefly communicated with her supervising teacher Li Zhigang about the next day’s arrangements, confirming that she would continue observing various assessment practices in depth the next morning and begin learning to operate the rehabilitation treatment record system in the afternoon. After completing these tasks, she packed her belongings and left the hospital at 5:30 PM to go home.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - doctor's workstation at the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Met with the financial advisor and made the decision to redeem some funds and suspend the automatic investment plan
description: On July 9, Yu Xiaowen made an appointment with financial advisor Wang Mingyuan via WeChat, agreeing to meet on the afternoon of Saturday, July 12 at the café downstairs from the bank. On July 12, she met with Wang Mingyuan, who offered three options: redeem part of the fund, apply for a consumer loan, or suspend the regular investment plan. Yu Xiaowen repeatedly calculated the gap between household expenses and rehabilitation costs, and ultimately chose to redeem part of the fund and suspend the regular investment, declining the consumer loan. After leaving the café, she checked her account balance, sighed softly, and felt that the financial pressure had eased for the moment but the future remained uncertain.

subevent.name: Schedule a meeting with a financial advisor
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen contacted financial advisor Wang Mingyuan through WeChat and arranged to meet on Saturday afternoon, July 12, at the cafe downstairs from China Merchants Bank in Zhengzhou to discuss fund redemption and regular fixed-amount investments.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - at home / WeChat online

subevent.name: Heading to the agreed café
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 12, Yu Xiaowen drove from her residence on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou to the café downstairs from China Merchants Bank on Shangwu Waihuan Road, Zhengdong New District, to meet with financial advisor Wang Mingyuan.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jingsan Road to Zhengdong New District

subevent.name: Discussing the plan with the financial advisor
subevent.description: At the café, Yu Xiaowen met with financial advisor Wang Mingyuan. Wang Mingyuan explained three options in detail: redeem part of the fund for cash but risk missing potential gains, apply for a consumer loan with an annual interest rate of 4.5% and increase the monthly payment by 800 yuan, or suspend the regular fund investment and keep existing funds. Yu Xiaowen listened carefully and asked about the details.
subevent.location: Café downstairs of China Merchants Bank, Zhengdong New District, Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: Calculate the expense gap and make a decision
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen took out her phone in the café, repeatedly calculated the gap between family expenses and rehabilitation costs, and after weighing the options, finally decided to redeem part of her funds for cash, suspend the fund regular investment plan, and refuse to apply for a consumer loan. She informed Wang Mingyuan of the decision.
subevent.location: Café downstairs of China Merchants Bank, Zhengdong New District, Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: After leaving, check the account balance.
subevent.description: After walking out of the café, Yu Xiaowen stopped at the door, took out her phone, opened the banking app, and checked her account balance to confirm her financial situation after the redemption and suspension of the automatic investment plan. She sighed softly, feeling that the financial pressure had eased for the moment but the future remained uncertain.
subevent.location: Entrance of the café downstairs from China Merchants Bank, Zhengdong New District, Zhengzhou

name: Medical English course is more than halfway through; I applied English literature to my father's home rehabilitation training.
description: At her father's home, Yu Xiaowen used gaps between caregiving tasks in the morning to study a medical English course via a mobile app, reviewing rehabilitation vocabulary and phrases. Then, in the study, she searched for and read an English paper on family-involved rehabilitation training, focusing on mirror training and task-oriented exercises. In the afternoon, she integrated the methods from the paper into her father's daily rehabilitation, guiding him to try new exercises, and her father actively cooperated. In the evening, she organized her study notes and rehabilitation insights, marked the course as more than half complete, and felt the value of clinical English learning.

subevent.name: Study the medical English course in the morning.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen used the morning care break at her father's home at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, to complete the day's medical English course on her phone app, reviewing rehabilitation-related vocabulary and short phrases and consolidating what she had learned before.
subevent.location: Luoyang - father's home

subevent.name: Search for and study English-language rehabilitation literature.
subevent.description: In the study at her father's home, Yu Xiaowen searched through the English rehabilitation medicine literature she had brought and found an English paper titled 'The Impact of Family-Involved Rehabilitation Training on Functional Recovery in Stroke Patients.' She carefully read the abstract and parts of the methods section, focusing on the specific procedures of mirror therapy and task-oriented training, and highlighted key points with a marker.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - father's home study

subevent.name: Applied literature-based methods to guide father's rehabilitation training
subevent.description: During her father's regular afternoon rehabilitation session, Yu Xiaowen, combining the content of the literature she had just learned, explained the principle of mirror training to her father Yu Jianguo, and guided him to try integrating task-oriented exercises into the original training. Her father found it fresh and actively cooperated, which increased his training motivation. During the process, Yu Xiaowen used her phone to record the operational details, preparing for a follow-up optimization plan.
subevent.location: Luoyang - living room at father's home

subevent.name: Organized study notes and rehabilitation reflections.
subevent.description: Before resting at night, Yu Xiaowen recorded the day's key medical English vocabulary, core findings from the paper, and the effects of the adjusted rehabilitation training in her personal study notes, and marked the milestone that the course was more than halfway through, feeling the practical value of learning clinical English.
subevent.location: Luoyang - bedroom at father's home

name: The financial advisor suggested increasing equity positions, but Yu Xiaowen insisted on a conservative strategy and redeemed the short-term wealth management product.
description: On the morning of May 22, financial advisor Wang Mingyuan called, saying that market volatility offered an opportunity and suggested converting part of her fund allocation into equity-biased funds to chase gains. After hanging up, Yu Xiaowen carefully calculated her father's rehabilitation costs and rent, then called back to decline the adjustment and redeemed a 50,000-yuan short-term wealth management product in advance, depositing it into her current account to ensure she could pay medical expenses at any time. Financial prudence had become instinct.

subevent.name: Answered a financial advisor's recommendation call
subevent.description: In the morning in the doctors' office of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen received a call from her financial advisor, Wang Mingyuan. Wang Mingyuan analyzed that current market volatility was creating opportunities and suggested shifting part of her fund allocation to equity-oriented funds to seek higher returns. Yu Xiaowen said she needed to think it over carefully and then hung up.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Calculate expenses such as father's rehabilitation costs and rent.
subevent.description: After hanging up the phone, Yu Xiaowen carefully calculated her father's recent rehabilitation treatment costs, monthly rent, and daily living expenses in the office, assessed the liquidity of her existing demand savings and short-term wealth management products, and concluded that capital safety should be the primary principle.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Returned the call to decline the adjustment suggestion and inform them of the redemption decision
subevent.description: After calculating, Yu Xiaowen believed that liquidity and safety should be the primary considerations for the current situation. She called back financial advisor Wang Mingyuan and clearly stated that she would stick to a conservative strategy and not increase equity positions, and told him she would redeem a 50,000-yuan short-term wealth management product in advance to ensure funds could be used at any time.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Redeem short-term wealth management products and transfer the funds into a current account.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen redeemed a 50,000-yuan short-term wealth management product in advance through mobile banking and immediately transferred the redeemed funds to her current account, ensuring flexible access to the funds for possible medical expenses such as her father's rehabilitation treatment.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Formulate a first-month review plan for the attending physician qualification.
description: During the lunch break on April 14, after receiving the exam preparation books, Yu Xiaowen combined her clinical instructor's advice and her weak points, and made a detailed monthly review plan in her notebook, splitting subjects such as internal medicine and surgery into the fragmented daily time slots of commuting, lunch breaks, and caregiving. She felt that although the path to exam preparation was arduous, she now had a clear route.

subevent.name: Receive the attending physician qualification exam books
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen signed for the express delivery of exam books in the department at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, took out the attending physician qualification exam textbooks for subjects such as internal medicine and surgery, and flipped through them to confirm the contents were complete.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital - Department

subevent.name: Review the mentor's suggestions and identify weak points
subevent.description: During the time before her lunch break, Yu Xiaowen sat in the department rest area and recalled the recent suggestions from her supervising teacher, Li Wei, about her weak clinical subjects. She cross-referenced the textbook table of contents, identified chapters that needed focused review, such as cardiovascular medicine and respiratory diseases, and briefly noted difficult key terms in her notebook.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital - Rest Area

subevent.name: Make a monthly review plan in the notebook
subevent.description: During her lunch break, Yu Xiaowen used a pen in the on-duty room to draw up a detailed monthly review plan from April 14 to May 14 in her notebook. She divided the major subjects such as internal medicine and surgery by week and by day, specified the learning content and target chapters for the fragmented time during daily commuting, lunch breaks, and night-shift patient accompaniment, and wrote down the staged test arrangements for each weekend.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital - Duty Room

subevent.name: Organize and digitize the review plan
subevent.description: Before leaving work in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen took a photo of her handwritten monthly review plan and saved it to her phone's photo album as a backup. She also entered key daily study time points (such as reviewing internal medicine from 21:00-22:00 every night) into her phone calendar as reminders to ensure she could follow the plan later.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital - Department

name: Independently handled acute stroke patients during the shift.
description: On the night shift on July 22, Yu Xiaowen independently received an acute stroke patient. She quickly completed the NIHSS assessment, coordinated the emergency CT, and initiated the thrombolysis process, while also calming the patient’s family. The patient recovered from the critical condition. Dr. Li Wei later praised her for decisive and standard handling. This experience strengthened her clinical confidence and reinforced her determination to transfer to the rehabilitation department—she realized the key role early rehabilitation intervention plays in stroke prognosis.

subevent.name: Attended to an acute stroke patient.
subevent.description: During her night shift on July 22, 2025, Yu Xiaowen received an emergency notice and quickly went to the emergency department. She treated an elderly patient with sudden disturbance of consciousness and suspected acute stroke. She briefly took the medical history and performed a preliminary physical examination, determined that it was likely a stroke, and immediately activated the stroke green channel. The patient's family members looked anxious and kept asking about the condition.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Emergency Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Completed NIHSS score assessment
subevent.description: According to the acute stroke diagnosis and treatment guidelines, Yu Xiaowen independently assessed the patient using the NIHSS (National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale). She examined the patient item by item for neurological deficits in consciousness, language, motor function, and sensation, recorded a score of 12 (moderate stroke), and quickly determined that the time of onset was within the 4.5-hour thrombolysis window.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Stroke Clinic, Emergency Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Coordinated emergency CT and accompanied the examination
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen urgently contacted the CT room to activate the green channel, issued an emergency head CT examination order, and personally escorted the patient to the CT room to complete the scan. She communicated with the technician to prioritize the examination while monitoring the patient's vital signs to ensure safety along the way. The CT results ruled out hemorrhagic stroke and confirmed acute ischemic stroke.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - CT Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Initiate the intravenous thrombolysis process.
subevent.description: Based on the CT results and NIHSS score, Yu Xiaowen determined that the patient met the indications for intravenous thrombolysis with no contraindications. She quickly calculated the thrombolytic drug dosage, wrote the order for alteplase, and instructed the nurse to administer the intravenous infusion. During thrombolysis, she continuously monitored the patient's blood pressure, heart rate, and neurological function changes, and recorded the start time of thrombolysis.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Emergency Resuscitation Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Comfort the patient's family members and communicate the condition
subevent.description: While thrombolytic therapy was underway, Yu Xiaowen took the time to talk with the patient's family members (the patient's son and daughter-in-law) in the waiting area about the condition. She explained the cause of acute stroke, the necessity of thrombolytic therapy, and its possible risks in plain language, and also stressed the importance of subsequent rehabilitation. The family gradually calmed down, expressed understanding, and agreed to cooperate with the treatment.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Family waiting area of the Emergency Department at Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Liu Qiang conveyed Wang Fang's true thoughts, and the rift in their friendship remained hard to heal.
description: After work on September 5, Yu Xiaowen ran into Liu Qiang in the staff cafeteria. Liu Qiang privately revealed, 'Fangfang isn't blaming you; she just hates to see you leave and feels that you are leaving her circle.' Yu Xiaowen fell silent, remembering the ceramic gift she had prepared after the August conflict but had not yet sent, and her conflicting feelings deepened. Still, she decided to finish the gift before the wedding.

subevent.name: Ran into Liu Qiang at the cafeteria after work
subevent.description: At about 17:30 on September 5, Yu Xiaowen finished her work as a resident physician at Zhengzhou Central Hospital and went to the hospital staff cafeteria after work. At the food pickup area, she ran into Liu Qiang, a resident physician from the same department. Because their shifts were similar, they often met in the cafeteria. This time they nodded and smiled at each other, and Liu Qiang carried his tray to sit opposite Yu Xiaowen, striking up a conversation.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Staff Canteen of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Liu Qiang leaked Wang Fang's true thoughts.
subevent.description: While eating in the staff cafeteria, Liu Qiang lowered his voice and revealed to Yu Xiaowen Wang Fang's real feelings. Wang Fang was another resident physician close to Yu Xiaowen. Liu Qiang said Wang Fang had privately confided in him earlier, saying she wasn't truly blaming Yu Xiaowen, but rather felt reluctant and lost because Yu Xiaowen was about to 'leave' their current social circle due to life changes, which led to her emotional reaction. Liu Qiang relayed this with a sincere tone, trying to resolve the misunderstanding between the two. After hearing these words, Yu Xiaowen fell into deep thought and did not respond immediately.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Staff Canteen of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Inner conflict deepened, decided to give the gift
subevent.description: After listening to Liu Qiang's account, Yu Xiaowen sat in silence for a long time at the cafeteria table, emotions churning inside. She immediately recalled that after the heated conflict with Wang Fang in August, she had deliberately spent two weeks at the pottery studio hand-shaping and firing a ceramic cup as a reconciliation gift, but later, out of stubbornness and hesitation, had kept putting off giving it. Now that she knew Wang Fang's true feeling was fear of losing the friendship rather than resentment, Yu Xiaowen felt deep conflict and guilt. After several minutes of inner struggle, she finally made up her mind to personally give the gift to Wang Fang before her upcoming wedding, in order to bridge the rift between them, and silently planned the exact time to deliver it.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Staff Canteen of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Helped Wang Fang finalize wedding details, and their relationship quickly warmed up
description: On Saturday, July 19, Yu Xiaowen accompanied Wang Fang to a wedding planning company in Zhengzhou to finalize the wedding process details, confirming everything from floral arrangements to ceremony music. During the process, Wang Fang confided her anxiety and stress about pre-wedding preparations and sincerely said, "You are the only one who understands my pressure." The relationship between the two quickly warmed, and most of the estrangement caused by earlier conflicts such as the bridesmaid date clash dissipated.

subevent.name: Meet Wang Fang as arranged and go to the wedding planning company.
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, July 19, Yu Xiaowen confirmed the meeting time with Wang Fang in advance via WeChat, and they agreed to meet at 10 a.m. at the entrance of the wedding company in Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou. Yu Xiaowen walked there from home. The two met punctually at the entrance of the wedding company and then entered the company lobby together.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - a wedding planning company

subevent.name: Confirm the wedding floral arrangement plan.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen accompanied Wang Fang and the wedding planner in the discussion area to discuss the wedding floral arrangements, confirming one by one the flower types, color schemes, and placement details for the main stage flower wall, table flowers, bridal bouquet, and corsages. Wang Fang asked Yu Xiaowen for her opinion, and Yu Xiaowen made suggestions based on her own aesthetic. They finally settled on a plan featuring white roses and pale purple hydrangeas.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - a wedding company's consultation area

subevent.name: Confirm the details of the wedding ceremony music.
subevent.description: After the floral design plan was confirmed, Yu Xiaowen continued accompanying Wang Fang to confirm the wedding ceremony music with the planner, including the groom's entrance music, the bride's entrance music, the ring exchange music, and the recessional. Wang Fang played several candidate tracks and repeatedly asked Yu Xiaowen for her impressions. In the end, they selected a soothing piano piece as background music.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - a wedding company's consultation area

subevent.name: Wang Fang confided her pre-wedding anxiety and the relationship warming up
subevent.description: After confirming all the wedding details, the two chatted on the sofa in the wedding planning company's lounge area. Wang Fang took the initiative to confide her anxiety and stress about the wedding preparations, including troubles such as coordinating family opinions and arranging guest seating, sincerely saying, "You are the only person who can understand my stress." Yu Xiaowen listened patiently and comforted her, sharing her own experience coping with stress at work. After their in-depth conversation, most of the estrangement caused by the bridesmaid schedule conflict dissipated, and their relationship quickly warmed up.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - rest area at a wedding planning company

name: Complete the medical English course’s all-English case presentation simulation exercise
description: On September 24, Yu Xiaowen systematically reviewed English terminology for stroke rehabilitation cases at home and prepared her presentation script. On September 25, she conducted a one-on-one full English case report simulation with a foreign teacher through an online platform and was rated "clear logic, accurate terminology." She then saved the simulation video and recorded a learning log, viewing the exercise as an important milestone in the course and a foundation for future international exchange.

subevent.name: Reviewing case files and preparing an English presentation
subevent.description: In her home study in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen used her laptop and medical English course materials to systematically review English terminology, pathological mechanisms, and rehabilitation plans for stroke rehabilitation cases. She prepared a speech of about 15 minutes and repeatedly practiced pronunciation and logical transitions to ensure accurate terminology and fluent delivery. Meanwhile, she tested the microphone and camera of the online meeting software (such as Zoom) and confirmed that the network was stable.
subevent.location: Home study, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Conduct a full-English simulated case presentation with the foreign teacher
subevent.description: On September 25 at 8:00 p.m. (the scheduled time slot), Yu Xiaowen conducted a one-on-one, all-English case presentation simulation at home via an online video conferencing platform with the course's foreign teacher (a native-English-speaking medical English instructor). She used the screen-sharing function to present a PPT (including CT images, rehabilitation rating scales, etc.) and described in English the medical history, diagnosis, rehabilitation treatment process, and prognosis assessment of a stroke patient. After the presentation, the teacher gave immediate feedback, praising her for 'clear logic and accurate terminology', and suggested improvements on a few pronunciation and grammar details. The entire simulation lasted about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Home, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (online)

subevent.name: Saved the simulation video and recorded the learning milestone
subevent.description: After the mock presentation, Yu Xiaowen immediately downloaded the video file (MP4 format) automatically recorded by the software and saved it to the dedicated Medical English Learning folder on her computer, naming it 2025-09-25 Stroke Case Final Mock. She then wrote a brief reflection in her personal e-learning journal, recording the foreign teacher's suggestions and what she gained from the session. She regarded this mock as an important milestone in the 8-month course, which built her confidence for reading English rehabilitation literature and participating in international medical exchanges in the future.
subevent.location: At the computer at home, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading and commemorative coins during caregiving breaks evoke warm memories.
description: From January 16 to 18, 2025, her father's condition gradually stabilized. During breaks in bedside care in the ward, Yu Xiaowen began reading The Doctor's Progress, sent by her close friend Wang Lina, and wrote her first reading notes. On the 18th, her mother Li Xiuying brought from home the collection box of her childhood zodiac commemorative coins. The familiar old objects triggered warm memories of family time in the past.

subevent.name: Started reading 'Better'
subevent.description: On January 16, 2025, Yu Xiaowen was accompanying her father Yu Jianguo, whose condition was gradually stabilizing, in the ward of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. During a break in caregiving, she took out "Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance" that her close friend Wang Lina had sent earlier, began to read it carefully, and noted her initial impressions in her mind.
subevent.location: Ward at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Continue reading and taking notes.
subevent.description: On January 17, 2025, Yu Xiaowen continued to accompany her father in the ward, using spare moments to read deeply into 'Better', and made notes with a pen in the margins, recording key viewpoints and personal reflections, accumulating material for writing her first reading notes.
subevent.location: Ward at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Complete the first note and memory box memories
subevent.description: On January 18, 2025, while accompanying her father in the ward, Yu Xiaowen completed her first reading note, writing her reflections on the opening chapter of Better. That same morning, her mother Li Xiuying brought from her home in Luoyang the zodiac commemorative coin collection box that Xiaowen had collected as a child. Xiaowen opened the box, saw the familiar coins, recalled the warm childhood moments of collecting and exchanging commemorative coins with her family, and felt warm inside.
subevent.location: Ward at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou

name: Handle residence permit renewal.
description: On Monday, September 8, after receiving a reminder text message from the neighborhood committee, Yu Xiaowen left half an hour early. With her ID card and rental contract, she went to the Jinshui District police station to renew her residence permit. The process went smoothly and was done in fifteen minutes, with the new validity extending to September 2026. Looking at the date, she felt a more solid sense of belonging in this city, then hurried back to the hospital without delaying her normal work.

subevent.name: Received the endorsement reminder and prepared the materials.
subevent.description: On Monday morning, September 8, 2025, as Yu Xiaowen was preparing to leave for work at her home in Zhengzhou, she received a text message from the Jinshui District Neighborhood Committee reminding her that her residence permit was about to expire. After checking that her rental contract, ID card, and other materials were in order, she immediately decided to go to the police station to handle it during the morning and left half an hour early.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home

subevent.name: Go to Jinshui District Police Station
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen took her ID card and rental contract and walked or took transportation from home to Jinshui District Police Station. Along the way, she kept her normal commuting pace to ensure she wouldn't delay her subsequent work schedule.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province - on the way to the police station.

subevent.name: Handle residence permit renewal.
subevent.description: After Yu Xiaowen arrived at the Jinshui District police station, she took a number and waited in line in the lobby, then submitted her ID card and rental contract to the window staff to apply for a residence permit endorsement. After reviewing the materials, the staff printed and updated the endorsement information on the spot. The process went smoothly and took only fifteen minutes. With the new endorsement valid until September 2026, she felt a more solid sense of belonging in the city.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Jinshui District Police Station

subevent.name: Return to the hospital and continue working
subevent.description: After completing the residence permit endorsement, Yu Xiaowen rushed back to Zhengzhou Central Hospital from the police station. She did not let the endorsement procedure delay her normal work, arriving at her department on time and devoting herself to routine clinical duties.
subevent.location: Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: The warmth of the pepper soup in the ward
description: On the afternoon of February 3, 2025, her mother Li Xiuying carefully prepared hulatang (spicy soup) and braised noodles in the kitchen of their Luoyang home, putting them in a thermos and lunchbox. In the evening, she brought the food to the ward at Luoyang Central Hospital, where she shared dinner around a small table with Yu Xiaowen, who was accompanying her father, and Yu Jianguo and Yu Xiaofeng. As they ate, they chatted about family matters. Her mother told Xiaowen to take care of herself, her father showed a smile he hadn't for a long time, and her brother shared funny work stories. In the evening, the family cleaned up the dishes. Her mother reminded her again, and her father and brother said goodbye and left, leaving Xiaowen with warm support.

subevent.name: Mother is at home preparing spicy soup and braised noodles.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 3, 2025, Yu Xiaowen's mother, Li Xiuying, carefully prepared hulatang soup and huimian noodles, Yu Xiaowen's favorites, in the kitchen of her home in Luoyang using ingredients at hand. She poured the hulatang into a thermos and packed the huimian in a lunchbox, planning to take them to the ward of Luoyang Central Hospital so that Yu Xiaowen, who was accompanying the patient, and the family members who had come to visit could enjoy a warm dinner together.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Xigong District, home kitchen.

subevent.name: The family of four shared dinner in the ward
subevent.description: On the evening of February 3, 2025, Yu Xiaowen, her mother Li Xiuying, her father Yu Jianguo, and her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng sat around a small table in the hospital room at Luoyang Central Hospital. Li Xiuying poured spicy soup from the thermos into bowls, Yu Jianguo opened the packaging of the braised noodles, and the family ate and chatted about everyday things. Mother told Xiaowen to take care of herself and not to tire herself out; Father looked at his daughter with a smile he had not shown for a long time; Brother Yu Xiaofeng shared funny stories about work in Shenzhen. This simple but warm dinner gave the busy and hard-working Yu Xiaowen a taste of home.
subevent.location: Luoyang - Central Hospital ward

subevent.name: After-meal cleanup and a warm farewell.
subevent.description: On the evening of February 3, 2025, after dinner with her family, Yu Xiaowen helped clear the table and washed and put away the thermos, bowls, chopsticks, and lunch boxes. Her mother, Li Xiuying, told Yu Xiaowen to rest well while accompanying her father in the hospital. Her father, Yu Jianguo, and her older brother, Yu Xiaofeng, said goodbye to Xiaowen and urged her to take care of herself, then the two left the ward and returned home. The ward became quiet for a while, and Xiaowen felt warmth and the support of her family in her heart.
subevent.location: Luoyang - Central Hospital ward

name: Xu Tao came to Zhengzhou on a business trip, invited her to play ball, and brought about a change in her attitude toward exercise.
description: On the evening of August 21, her old friend Xu Tao, on a business trip from Shenzhen to Zhengzhou, invited Yu Xiaowen to play badminton at a sports hall. During a break, Xu Tao said bluntly that she used to play to relax, but now she played as if completing a task. Yu Xiaowen was startled and remembered that in Better, the hardest thing for doctors is learning to take care of themselves. That night she reset her fitness band to focus on heart rate zones rather than time and distance. After that, she paid more attention to how her body felt during badminton and morning runs.

subevent.name: Heading to the badminton gym
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen left Zhengzhou Central Hospital and drove her family car to Flying Badminton Hall in Zhongyuan District, a trip of about 15 minutes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Feixiang Badminton Hall

subevent.name: Playing badminton with Xu Tao
subevent.description: At 6 p.m., Yu Xiaowen met Xu Tao at Feixiang Badminton Hall, and the two practiced badminton singles for an hour. During the session, Yu Xiaowen, as usual, focused on high-intensity movement and smashes, keeping a fast pace.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Feixiang Badminton Hall

subevent.name: During the break, Xu Tao pointed out a problem with the exercise mindset.
subevent.description: During a break in the game, Xu Tao said bluntly that Yu Xiaowen now played ball like she was completing a task and lacked enjoyment. Yu Xiaowen was stunned when she heard this, and recalling the line 'The hardest thing for a doctor is to learn to take care of oneself' from the book Better she had read recently, she began to reflect on her mindset of treating exercise as a check-in task.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Feixiang Badminton Hall rest area

subevent.name: Going home to adjust fitness tracker settings
subevent.description: At 9 p.m., Yu Xiaowen returned to her home in Jinshui District and reset her fitness band: she changed the goal from 'daily exercise duration and distance' to 'heart-rate-zone oriented', and planned to pay more attention to bodily sensations and heart rate changes when running and playing ball in the future, rather than mechanically completing metrics.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Stayed home over the Spring Festival to study for the attending physician exam, including reading and mock tests.
description: From January 30 to 31, at her home in Luoyang, Yu Xiaowen focused in the mornings on reviewing the respiratory and cardiovascular system chapters of internal medicine, and in the afternoons read Better and organized her reading notes; on the 31st she completed two sets of attending physician practice tests and summarized weak knowledge points. Her brother Yu Xiaofeng provided daytime care to ensure study efficiency, building momentum for returning to work after the holiday and the exam.

subevent.name: January 30: Review respiratory system and reading
subevent.description: At home in Luoyang, Yu Xiaowen spent the quiet morning focused on reviewing the respiratory system chapter of internal medicine for the attending physician exam, using notes and textbooks to tackle key points and difficult areas. In the afternoon, she continued reading the remaining chapters of *Better*, taking reading notes as she went, recording clinical insights and key cases. Her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng handled most of the daytime caregiving to ensure her study time was undisturbed.
subevent.location: Luoyang - Home

subevent.name: January 31: Review the cardiovascular system, reading, and practice questions.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen was at home in Luoyang. In the morning, she focused on reviewing the cardiovascular system chapter of internal medicine and reinforced core knowledge with practice questions. In the afternoon, she finished reading the rest of Better and compiled complete reading notes, then took time to complete two sets of mock exam papers for the attending physician examination, summarized weak knowledge points, and recorded them in an error notebook, building momentum for returning to work after the holiday and the official exam. Her brother Yu Xiaofeng continued to handle daytime care, ensuring study efficiency.
subevent.location: Luoyang - Home

name: Played badminton with Lin Wei on Wednesday evening
description: On the afternoon of April 23, during a break at work, Yu Xiaowen used WeChat to arrange with her badminton partner Lin Wei to play at a badminton hall near her workplace at 7:30 that evening. From 7:30 to 8:30 p.m., the two practiced doubles for an hour. Amid the swings and smashes, she felt a long-missed exhilaration and sore arm muscles. Lin Wei praised her improved smashes.

subevent.name: Arranged with Lin Wei to play ball on Wednesday.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 23, during a break at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen contacted her badminton friend Lin Wei via WeChat to confirm that they would play badminton together at the badminton hall near the hospital after work that evening, and agreed to meet at the hall at 7:30.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Played a badminton match with Lin Wei
subevent.description: From 7:30 to 8:30 p.m. on April 23, Yu Xiaowen had an hour of doubles practice with Lin Wei at the badminton hall near her workplace. During the session they did multi-shot rallies and smash drills. As she swung the racket, she felt a long-missed sense of relief; her arm muscles ached when smashing, but after sweating she felt refreshed in both body and mind. Lin Wei praised her for improving her smashes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - badminton hall near the work unit

name: Try bedtime meditation to improve sleep quality
description: Due to long-term sleep deprivation from night shifts and caring for her father, Yu Xiaowen paid more attention to sleep management after the medication order mistake on June 12. Starting June 14, she used a mobile app for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation every night before bed, focusing on breathing and body scanning. At first she was easily distracted, but after a week she found that she fell asleep faster and woke up less at night. By the end of the month, she had incorporated meditation into her daily routine and recommended it to her mother to relieve anxiety.

subevent.name: Bedtime mindfulness meditation practice
subevent.description: From June 14 to 20, Yu Xiaowen turned off her phone 30 minutes before bedtime each night, lay in bed, and used a mobile app for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on breathing and body scanning. In the first few days, her mind often wandered, and she had to repeatedly bring her attention back to her breath. Later, she gradually adapted and was able to complete the meditation quietly, initially experiencing a relaxing effect.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Bedtime mindfulness meditation practice
subevent.description: For seven consecutive days starting June 14, Yu Xiaowen turned off her phone 30 minutes before bed every night and lay in bed using a mobile app to do 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on breathing and body scanning. In the first few days (14–16), she often got distracted and had to repeatedly bring her attention back to her breath; in the following days (17–20), she gradually adapted and was able to complete the meditation relatively calmly, with her attention focusing more easily. Throughout the process, she persisted in practicing every night and initially experienced the relaxing effects of meditation.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Meditation effects become apparent and adjustments are made
subevent.description: In the second week, Yu Xiaowen was already able to enter a meditative state relatively easily, and the number of times her mind wandered decreased significantly. She found that she fell asleep faster, and the number of nighttime awakenings also dropped from 2-3 times per night to 0-1 times. She began to incorporate body-scan details into her meditation, focusing on relaxing the shoulder, neck, and waist areas, further relieving the muscle tension caused by long periods of standing at work. She adjusted her meditation time to one hour before bed and added 5 minutes of gratitude journal writing, forming a pre-bedtime ritual.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Routine meditation practice and observation of its effects
subevent.description: Each night from June 21 to June 23, 2025, before going to bed, Yu Xiaowen sat cross-legged on her bed in the bedroom at her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City. She turned off the lights, played soft meditation background music, and did 20 minutes of mindful breathing meditation. She found that she could enter a meditative state relatively easily; the number of times her mind wandered decreased from multiple times in the first week to 2-3 times per night. She fell asleep noticeably faster, usually within 10-15 minutes of lying down, and the number of nighttime awakenings decreased from the previous 2-3 times to 0-1 times. After each meditation session, she briefly recorded the day's sleep quality and mental state in her phone memo.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Try incorporating body scan meditation.
subevent.description: At 10 p.m. on June 24, 2025, while meditating in her bedroom, Yu Xiaowen tried the body scan technique for the first time. She followed the steps she had learned online in advance, starting from her toes and scanning up through each part of the body in turn, lingering especially on the shoulders, neck, and lower back that were sore from long hours of standing work. She stayed on each area for about 2 minutes, using her breath to guide the muscles to relax. The whole process lasted 25 minutes, slightly longer than her usual meditation. When it was over, she felt her shoulders and neck were noticeably looser and the fatigue in her body had eased. She wrote down her feelings about this attempt in her diary and planned to continue practicing it later.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Deepened the body scan and focused on relaxing the shoulders and neck
subevent.description: Before bed on June 25, 2025, Yu Xiaowen continued practicing body scan meditation, focusing entirely on the shoulder, neck, and lower back areas. She first did 5 minutes of breathing adjustment, then concentrated on her shoulders, imagining her breath bringing warmth and relaxation to the tense trapezius muscles; next, she moved to the back of her neck and both sides of her lumbar spine, scanning each area carefully for about 3 minutes. She also incorporated gentle neck rotations to enhance the relaxation effect. The meditation lasted 30 minutes, and afterward she felt the muscle tension in her upper body had noticeably eased. She wrote in her gratitude journal: "The body scan helps me understand my stress points better. I can do this before night shifts in the future."
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Adjusted meditation time and wrote a gratitude journal for the first time.
subevent.description: At 10:30 p.m. on June 26, 2025, Yu Xiaowen began her adjusted bedtime routine in the bedroom. She moved her meditation time from half an hour before bed to one hour before bed, that is, starting meditation at 22:30. Before meditating, she spent five minutes at her desk writing a gratitude journal, recording three small things she felt grateful for that day, for example, 'A patient's family member said thank you today,' 'The braised noodles at lunch tasted great,' and 'I saw beautiful evening glow while taking a walk at night.' Then she did a 15-minute body scan meditation, still focusing on her shoulders and neck. The whole routine took about 20 minutes. After finishing, she felt calm and satisfied, and fell asleep with almost no tossing and turning.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tried bedtime meditation to relieve stress
description: From March 25 to 29, to ease the difficulty falling asleep caused by work stress, Yu Xiaowen persisted in doing 5 minutes of meditation every night before bed. Using the Tide app, she tried various guided courses in turn, including body scan, breathing meditation, relaxing-music meditation, deep relaxation, and natural-sound meditation, gradually relaxing her body and mind.
