After five consecutive days of practice, she fell asleep noticeably faster, felt less anxious, and her sleep quality improved.

subevent.name: First attempt at bedtime meditation
subevent.description: In her bedroom at home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen tried bedtime meditation for the first time to relieve difficulty falling asleep caused by work stress. Lying in bed, she opened the Tide app on her phone, selected the 5-minute body scan meditation guide, and followed the audio instructions to do deep breathing and relax her body. After the meditation, she felt her nerves gradually relax, and her sleep onset improved.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - bedroom at home

subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen continued her bedtime meditation plan, using the relaxation music meditation module in the Tide app. With soft music in the background, she did a body scan, relaxing muscle groups one by one from her toes to the top of her head, effectively relieving the day's shoulder and neck tension.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Fourth bedtime meditation
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen stuck with her meditation practice for the fourth day. That evening, she chose the 'Deep Relaxation' course on the Tide app, using progressive muscle relaxation combined with breathing guidance to bring her body and mind into a calmer state, which clearly helped relieve her anxiety.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - bedroom at home

That evening, in her study, she copied the easily confused exam points one by one onto white cards and grouped them by subject for later use. During dinner on May 14, her mother Li Xiuying told her that she had reclassified the scattered cards by subject—internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics, neurology, etc.—and secured them with small clips. In particular, she had sorted out the neurology cards separately and arranged them neatly, leaving Yu Xiaowen both surprised and moved.

After the courier called, Yu Xiaowen went downstairs, signed for it, and brought it back to her apartment.

subevent.name: Copied out error-prone exam point flashcards for the first time.
subevent.description: On the evening of May 9, 2025, Yu Xiaowen, under the desk lamp in the study, used the previously compiled mistake notebook and key points from textbooks to transcribe the easily confused pharmacology and pathology knowledge points one by one onto plain white cards purchased in advance with a black pen, transcribing about 15 cards in total. Afterwards, she grouped the cards by subject and placed them in a pen holder, preparing to post them later.

subevent.name: Mother sorted the classification cards and told her warmly at dinner.

Thinking of the help her father had received during his illness and her strong sense of social responsibility as an ISFJ personality, she resolutely signed up.

She read the notice carefully, recalled the social assistance her family had received during her father's illness, was deeply moved, and felt the urge to sign up.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Social Work Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen decided to sign up for volunteer service at a nursing home. subevent.description: After receiving Yu Xiaowen's application form, the social work department staff confirmed her registration information on the spot, told her that pre-service training and service times would be arranged uniformly later, and asked her to join the volunteer WeChat group to receive notifications. After completing the registration process, Yu Xiaowen returned to her work post.

She took detailed notes in class and exchanged review strategies with colleagues, further consolidating her exam preparation pace.

She briefly handed over the afternoon ward work to ensure patient management was unaffected.

Yu Xiaowen listened attentively throughout and carefully took notes on key knowledge points and exam essentials.

Then she further organized and consolidated her notes, reinforcing her exam preparation rhythm.

name: Midterm report on univariate analysis praised by Zhang Lei
description: Continuing from the database established last month, Yu Xiaowen completed all univariate analysis using SPSS in early June and organized the preliminary results into tables. At the department's mid-term report meeting on June 3, she presented the analysis results with slides. Because the data were clear and the clinical entry point was appropriate, she received immediate praise from Zhang Lei, the deputy director of the department. Zhang Lei said, “This direction is valuable; organize it into a paper as soon as possible,” and encouraged her to submit it to a core journal. After the meeting, Yu Xiaowen listed an outline for the paper in her notebook, and her confidence in research noticeably increased.

name: Mother arrived in Zhengzhou and they had dinner together
description: On the evening of September 28, her mother, Li Xiuying, arrived in Zhengzhou from Luoyang by high-speed rail. Yu Xiaowen picked her up at the station after work. The mother and daughter made a simple dinner at home and chatted while eating. Her mother brought local specialties from Luoyang and conveyed her father's concern for his daughter. Yu Xiaowen also updated her mother on her recent work and life. The family atmosphere was warm.

subevent.name: After work, Yu Xiaowen went to Zhengzhou High-Speed Railway Station to pick someone up.

subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou East Railway Station

subevent.name: Mother and daughter meet and return home
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen met her mother Li Xiuying at the exit of Zhengzhou East Railway Station. After a brief exchange upon reunion, they drove back to Yu Xiaowen's residence at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou East Station to Jingsan Road, Jinshui District

subevent.name: Preparing dinner at home
subevent.description: After the mother and daughter returned home, they prepared dinner together in the kitchen. The mother brought out the Luoyang specialties she had brought and showed the pastries her father had made by hand. Yu Xiaowen washed and cut vegetables, her mother did the cooking, and together they cooked simple home-style dishes.
subevent.location: Kitchen at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Had dinner together and caught up on each other's news
subevent.description: The mother and daughter had dinner together at the table, chatting while they ate. The mother conveyed the concern of her father Yu Jianguo and asked about her daughter's work and health. Yu Xiaowen reported her recent work progress, life arrangements, and future career plans (such as taking the attending physician exam). The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home dining room, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District

name: Warm family dinner
description: On August 20, Yu Xiaowen returned to Luoyang from out of town. She first went to the Kaixuan Road market in Xigong District to buy sea bass, her father's favorite, and seasonal vegetables, her mother's favorite, then returned to her parents' home and cooked herself: steamed sea bass, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and prepared rice and cucumber salad. At dinner, she sat around the table with her father Yu Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying, eating and chatting. Her father talked about teaching at Luoyang No. 1 Senior High School in his youth, and her mother shared anecdotes from the community choir. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious. This was the first time since her father fell ill that the whole family could sit together and enjoy a relaxed, happy meal. Yu Xiaowen felt a long-lost sense of family peace. After dinner, she cleaned up and washed the dishes, chatted with her parents until 9:30, and then they all rested.

subevent.name: Went to the vegetable market to buy ingredients.
subevent.description: After arriving in Luoyang, Yu Xiaowen went to the Kaixuan Road vegetable market in Xigong District, near her home. She bought sea bass, which her father loves; seasonal vegetables her mother likes (such as greens and tomatoes); and seasonings such as scallions, ginger, and garlic, in preparation for dinner.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Xigong District Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Cooking dinner in the home kitchen
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen cooked by herself in the kitchen at her parents' home. She prepared sea bass for steaming, washed and cut seasonal vegetables for stir-frying, cooked rice, and made side dishes such as cucumber salad, completing the whole cooking process independently.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - home kitchen

subevent.name: Had dinner with parents and chatted
subevent.description: At dinnertime, Yu Xiaowen, her father Yu Jianguo, and her mother Li Xiuying sat around the dining table at home, enjoying home-cooked dishes such as steamed sea bass and seasonal vegetables made by Yu Xiaowen, while chatting warmly. Her father spontaneously talked about stories from his youth teaching at Luoyang No. 1 Senior High School, and her mother shared amusing anecdotes about joining a community choir after retirement. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious. It was the first time the whole family had sat together so easily and enjoyed a meal since her father fell ill, and Yu Xiaowen felt a long-missed sense of family peace.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Home dining room

subevent.name: After-meal cleanup and rest.
subevent.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen got up to clear the dishes, wash the tableware, and properly refrigerate the leftovers. Then she went to the living room and sat with her parents for a while, continuing to chat about everyday things. Around 9:30 p.m., they each returned to their own rooms to rest.
subevent.location: Luoyang - Home

name: College classmate Zhao Ming shared cutting-edge developments in rehabilitation technology, inspiring the idea of 'rehabilitation + technology + humanities'
description: On the evening of May 20, university classmate Zhao Ming, on a business trip in Zhengzhou, took the initiative to invite Yu Xiaowen to a simple meal at a small restaurant near the hospital. He enthusiastically talked about advances in rehabilitation medicine in Shenzhen, such as rehabilitation robots and AI gait assessment systems. Yu Xiaowen immediately thought of the outdated rehabilitation equipment in her hometown of Luoyang and her own pottery experience. After returning home, she wrote the phrase 'rehabilitation + technology + humanities' in her diary, and a vague career direction of incorporating art into rehabilitation began to take shape in her mind.

subevent.name: Zhao Ming invited her via WeChat to a dinner gathering
subevent.description: During the day on May 20, college classmate Zhao Ming came to Zhengzhou on a business trip and proactively contacted Yu Xiaowen via WeChat, inviting her to a simple dinner at a small restaurant near the hospital that evening. Yu Xiaowen gladly agreed.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Online (WeChat)

subevent.name: Had dinner with Zhao Ming and exchanged views on the frontiers of rehabilitation technology.

As they ate and chatted, Zhao Ming enthusiastically shared advances in rehabilitation medicine in Shenzhen, including technologies like rehabilitation robots and AI gait assessment systems. Yu Xiaowen listened carefully, thinking of the outdated rehabilitation equipment in her hometown of Luoyang and her own experience learning pottery.

subevent.name: Going home to record inspiration
subevent.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen returned to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, and wrote the phrase "rehabilitation + technology + humanities" in her diary, recording the inspiration she received tonight.

subevent.name: A future career direction takes shape
subevent.description: Lying in bed, Yu Xiaowen carefully thought about the rehabilitation technology Zhao Ming had mentioned and her own ceramic art hobby. Gradually, a vague career vision sprouted in her mind: bringing art into rehabilitation and, in the future, pursuing an integrated direction of "rehabilitation + technology + humanities."

name: Video call with Wang Fang to discuss bridesmaid dresses and pre-wedding preparations
description: On Saturday evening, April 26, after work, Yu Xiaowen returned to the living room of her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and had a video call with Wang Fang. Wang Fang shared the wedding preparation progress, and the two browsed bridesmaid dress styles together. Yu Xiaowen gave suggestions based on Wang Fang's wedding theme, and they finally chose a champagne-colored long dress, confirming the size and delivery time. Wang Fang was grateful for her company, and Yu Xiaowen also felt excited about the upcoming wedding.

subevent.name: Started a video call and exchanged updates on the wedding progress.
subevent.description: On the evening of Saturday, April 26, 2025, after finishing work at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen returned to the living room of her home. At around 8 p.m., she had a video call on WeChat with Wang Fang, her best friend and fellow department colleague. They greeted each other, and Wang Fang excitedly shared the latest progress in her wedding preparations, including details such as venue decoration and the finalized list of bridesmaids and groomsmen. Yu Xiaowen listened attentively and offered encouragement; the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City - living room at home

subevent.name: Browsing and discussing bridesmaid dress styles
subevent.description: During the video call, Wang Fang suggested browsing online for bridesmaid dress styles together. The two shared a screen or each opened a shopping app, and Yu Xiaowen carefully screened multiple long dresses based on the champagne color theme and outdoor venue style of Wang Fang's wedding, and gave matching suggestions based on her own figure and temperament as a bridesmaid. They discussed the pros and cons of different styles, Wang Fang also shared the preferences of the other bridesmaids, and the whole process lasted about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City - living room at home

subevent.name: Selected the dress and confirmed the order details.
subevent.description: After repeated comparisons, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang finally chose a champagne satin long dress as the bridesmaid gown; the style was simple and elegant and matched the wedding theme. Yu Xiaowen provided her exact measurements (height 163 cm, weight 50 kg), and Wang Fang placed the order online and confirmed the estimated arrival time (within about a week). They also discussed the return and exchange process if the size was not suitable. Yu Xiaowen said she was looking forward to wearing the gown at the wedding. The call ended with contentment and joy, and Yu Xiaowen reminded Wang Fang to rest early.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City - living room at home

name: Discuss with a financial advisor about adjusting the regular fund investment and setting up an emergency reserve fund.
description: On March 25, 2025, Yu Xiaowen contacted her financial advisor Wang Mingyuan via WeChat voice call from her home in Zhengzhou, explaining the financial pressure caused by her parents' move that doubled her rent. Wang Mingyuan suggested reducing her monthly fund investment plan from 3,000 yuan to 2,000 yuan and putting the saved 1,000 yuan into a money market fund as an emergency reserve. Yu Xiaowen immediately modified the investment plan in the China Merchants Bank app and transferred 1,000 yuan to the money market fund account, feeling that her financial planning was more stable.

subevent.name: Discussed financial stress with a financial advisor.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen, at her home in Zhengzhou, contacted financial advisor Wang Mingyuan via WeChat voice call, explaining in detail the financial pressure caused by doubled rent after her parents moved, and asked for an adjustment plan. After understanding the situation during the call, Wang Mingyuan suggested lowering the monthly fund investment plan from 3,000 yuan to 2,000 yuan and putting the reduced 1,000 yuan into a money market fund as emergency reserves.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Yu Xiaowen's residence

subevent.description: After listening to Wang Mingyuan's advice, Yu Xiaowen immediately operated in the China Merchants Bank app to temporarily reduce her monthly fund investment amount from 3,000 yuan to 2,000 yuan, and confirmed that the modification was successful.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Yu Xiaowen's residence

subevent.name: Set up an emergency reserve fund and transfer it into a money market fund
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen transferred the 1,000 yuan she saved each month from her current account to a money market fund account at China Merchants Bank as an emergency reserve to strengthen financial stability. After completing the transfer, she confirmed the balance change and felt that her financial planning had become more robust.

As soon as her father's morning rehabilitation session ended, Yu Xiaowen hurried to the bridal shop. The two picked out five or six dresses together, and Wang Fang ran out to show each one. Yu Xiaowen took photos with her phone and gave sincere advice. For three hours, laughter never stopped, and their friendship regained its former ease and closeness among the romantic piles of wedding dresses, finally putting an end to the earlier bridesmaid dispute.

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowen left home and headed to the bridal gown shop
subevent.description: That morning, after accompanying her father through rehabilitation treatment at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen drove her own car from her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, to a bridal shop in Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, as agreed with Wang Fang, to accompany Wang Fang in trying on wedding dresses.

subevent.name: Pick out and try on wedding dresses with Wang Fang.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen arrived at the bridal salon and met up with Wang Fang. The two picked out five or six wedding dresses of different styles. Every time Wang Fang changed into a dress, she would run out to show Yu Xiaowen, who took photos with her phone and gave sincere, specific styling advice. The two laughed constantly throughout, and the atmosphere was relaxed and cheerful. It lasted about three hours and deepened their friendship.

subevent.name: Returning after the wedding dress fitting.
subevent.description: After the wedding dress fitting, Yu Xiaowen said goodbye to Wang Fang at the entrance of the bridal salon, then drove her private car back to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, ending that afternoon's companionship activity.

name: The annual check-up served as a health warning, and I began planning to integrate exercise and rehabilitation.
description: At the annual physical exam on October 15, Yu Xiaowen stood on the body fat scale and saw the report showing her body fat percentage had risen from 21% last year to 24%, and the numbers stung her eyes. That night, she opened her diary and wrote, 'I can't just make do with walking anymore; I must find a way to stick with it,' and she began searching online for how to integrate exercise anatomy into rehabilitation training to design a progressive plan for her father.

subevent.name: Annual physical exam in progress
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen took part in the annual physical examination organized by her employer at the Health Examination Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. subevent.name: Write a diary entry to record determination
subevent.description: That evening, Yu Xiaowen opened her diary in her home study and wrote, 'I can't keep making do with walking; I have to find a way I can stick to,' recording her reflections from the physical examination and her determination to improve her health.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

She registered online on April 3, then bought the book online on April 6, received it on April 7, and read the preface and first chapter, fully preparing for the book club discussion.

subevent.description: During a break at work, Yu Xiaowen used the Douban City app on her phone to browse local offline events in Zhengzhou and found a notice by the 'Under the Plane Tree Book Club' for a medical humanities discussion on Being Mortal. The theme was highly relevant to her career as a doctor and aroused her interest.

name: Paying attention to dietary nutrition during hospital caregiving
description: While accompanying her father, Yu Xiaowen paid attention to dietary nutrition. On February 9 (Sunday), she returned to her home in Luoyang and cooked a nutritious soup for her father and herself. On February 10, she went to a supermarket near Zhengzhou Central Hospital to buy fresh fruit, yogurt, and whole wheat bread, replacing takeout and instant noodles. On February 15, she went back to Luoyang to make soup again, and also focused on protein intake to maintain her strength.

subevent.name: Realized dietary problems and purchased nutritious food
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen realized that while caring for her father, her diet had become irregular due to all the rushing around, so she decided to adjust it right away. That afternoon, she went to a supermarket near Zhengzhou Central Hospital, carefully picked fresh fruit, yogurt, and whole-wheat bread to replace the takeout and instant noodles she had often been eating, and began to pay attention to daily nutrition.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City – supermarket near the hospital

subevent.name: First weekend returning home to cook nutritious soup
subevent.description: On Sunday (February 9), Yu Xiaowen returned to her home in Luoyang. Using the kitchen utensils, she cooked nutritious soup (such as chicken soup or pork rib soup) for her hospitalized father, packed it in an insulated container, and brought it to the hospital to supplement his nutrition. During that time, she also drank some of the soup herself to take in protein and maintain her strength.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - home kitchen

subevent.name: Second weekend trip home to cook nourishing soup
subevent.description: On the following Saturday (February 15), Yu Xiaowen went back to her home in Luoyang again, cooked nutritious soup for her father, and brought it to the hospital. She also made sure to consume enough protein, such as eggs and milk, to maintain the physical strength needed for ongoing care.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - home kitchen

name: In the late-night ward, listening to Debussy's Clair de Lune to ease anxiety
description: Late in the night of January 17, 2025, Yu Xiaowen put on headphones in the ward of Zhengzhou Central Hospital and played Debussy's "Clair de Lune." The music flowed gently, soothing the anxiety and exhaustion of the past days, giving her the first moment of peace and comfort in the ward.

subevent.name: Listening to Moonlight, finding peace
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen put on her earphones and gently pressed play. The melody of Debussy's 'Clair de Lune' slowly flowed out. She closed her eyes, leaned back in the chair beside the hospital bed, and let the music soothe her inner anxiety and exhaustion. In the quiet ward, she felt a long-lost sense of peace and comfort for the first time. The music accompanied her through the late-night hours.

name: Frankly discuss the intention to switch rotations with the supervising physician and start the rotation transfer application.

Late that night while on duty, she had a candid conversation with her supervising teacher Li Wei and formally expressed her intention to transfer departments, receiving understanding and support. On July 12, following Li Wei's advice, she wrote a transfer application at home; after Li Wei reviewed and made minor adjustments, it was ready to be submitted, marking the career transition officially entering the application stage.

She reviewed why she was inclined toward the rehabilitation department because of family caregiving pressure and her personal career interests, and thought about how to communicate with her supervising teacher Li Wei, preparing herself mentally and verbally for the late-night formal conversation.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital duty rest room

subevent.name: During the late-night shift, she candidly shared with Li Wei her thoughts about transferring departments.
subevent.description: Late on the night of July 10, 2025, Yu Xiaowen had an in-depth conversation with her supervising teacher, Li Wei, in the rest room during a break in her shift. She honestly expressed her desire to transfer from her current position to the department of rehabilitation medicine, driven by the pressure of family care (her aging parents need care) and her strong interest in rehabilitation medicine. Li Wei listened carefully, expressed understanding, and promised to convey her wishes to the department director, Zhang Lei, in an appropriate manner. This conversation marked the shift in Yu Xiaowen's career change from inner struggle to concrete action.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital duty rest room

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowen writes a department transfer application
subevent.description: On July 12, 2025, based on feedback from Teacher Li Wei, Yu Xiaowen carefully wrote a formal application at home to transfer to the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, elaborating on her personal family care needs, career interests, and understanding of rehabilitation medicine, and attached a future study plan. After completing it, she sent the electronic version to Teacher Li Wei for review, made minor adjustments based on his suggestions, and prepared to submit it to the department later.
subevent.location: Home study room, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

name: Annual career development interview with clinical instructor Li Wei
description: On June 19, Yu Xiaowen contacted her supervising physician, Li Wei, through the hospital's internal WeChat to schedule a talk for the next day, and prepared the key points for discussion. At 16:00 on June 20, the two had a career development talk lasting about 40 minutes in the department's teaching room. Yu Xiaowen candidly expressed her recent career confusion caused by family pressure and mistakes made on night shifts, as well as her intention to transfer to the rehabilitation department. Li Wei, drawing on personal experience, suggested that she first handle the current exam preparation and family matters, wait until her father's recovery is stable before making a decision, and promised to support her reasonable choice. After the talk, Yu Xiaowen sorted out the key suggestions, called her father, told her mother that she had decided to focus on her work for now, adjusted her review plan, and resolved to face the challenges positively.

subevent.name: Schedule a time for a face-to-face meeting and prepare talking points
subevent.description: During a break in her department duty, Yu Xiaowen contacted her supervising teacher Li Wei via the hospital's internal WeChat, saying she wanted to have a talk about career development. Li Wei agreed to meet her at 16:00 the next afternoon in the teaching room. Yu Xiaowen then compiled a list of recent work confusions on her phone, including night shift mistakes, career uncertainty, and family pressure, to prepare for the conversation.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Career development talk with supervising teacher Li Wei
subevent.description: At 16:00 on June 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowen had about a 40-minute career development talk with her supervising teacher Li Wei in the department demonstration room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. She candidly expressed the family pressure caused by her father's illness and the mistakes she had made while on duty, which made her feel lost about her work as a resident physician, and she revealed that she was considering applying to transfer to the rehabilitation department. Drawing on his own experience of coping with difficulties when he was young, Li Wei suggested that she first handle the current preparation for the attending physician exam and her father's rehabilitation, and not rush to transfer departments, and he promised to support her reasonable choice. The atmosphere of the conversation was sincere and warm, and Yu Xiaowen felt understood and supported.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital - department teaching room

subevent.name: After the face-to-face meeting, sort out my thoughts and plan next steps
subevent.description: After the face-to-face meeting, Yu Xiaowen returned to the doctors' office and jotted down the key points of Li Wei's suggestions in her notebook: focus on exam preparation, maintain her current position, and communicate with her parents about family arrangements. After work, she went home, called her father in Luoyang to ask about his recovery, and told her mother that she had decided to focus on her work for now. She then adjusted her upcoming study plan and resolved to face the challenges with a positive attitude.
subevent.location: Home, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

name: Received the journal revision feedback and supplemented the statistical charts with remote assistance.
description: On September 3, Yu Xiaowen received a revision request email from the editorial office of Henan Medical Research, asking her to add a forest plot for the multivariate regression analysis and correct the description of the statistical methods. She contacted Zhou Haoran and Teacher Wang from the hospital's statistics office overnight, made revisions item by item through online screen sharing, and submitted the revised manuscript in the early morning of September 5, receiving remote collaborative support throughout the process.

subevent.name: Received and read the journal's revision request email
subevent.description: On September 3, 2025, Yu Xiaowen received a revision-request email from the editorial office of "Henan Medical Research" in her office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The email required adding a forest plot for the multivariate regression analysis and correcting the description of statistical methods. She carefully read the reviewer comments and revision requirements and marked the key parts that needed to be revised.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Contact collaboration staff to arrange remote modifications.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 3, 2025, Yu Xiaowen returned to her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and contacted her university classmate Zhou Haoran (currently engaged in medical research at the National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases) and her colleague Wang Jianguo from the hospital statistics office separately via WeChat calls, explaining the revision requirements and requesting remote assistance. The three agreed to work on the revisions together the next day through Tencent Meeting with screen sharing; Zhou Haoran would provide guidance on statistical methods, and Wang Jianguo would assist in creating the forest plot.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Remote collaboration to supplement statistical charts and revise methods.
subevent.description: On September 4, 2025, Yu Xiaowen was at home all day, connecting remotely with Zhou Haoran and Wang Jianguo via Tencent Meeting and sharing her screen to address the revision comments one by one. Zhou Haoran guided her in correcting the description of the statistical methods for the multivariate regression analysis, and Wang Jianguo used SPSS to create a standard forest plot and export it as a high-definition image. Yu Xiaowen concurrently integrated the changes into the Word document of the paper, repeatedly verifying the data and formatting.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Submit the revised manuscript of the paper
subevent.description: In the early morning of September 5, 2025, Yu Xiaowen completed the full-text review of the final revised manuscript at her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, confirmed that all revision points corresponded to the reviewers' comments, and generated a revision-marked version as required by the journal. She uploaded the revised manuscript, the forest plot attachment, and the point-by-point response document to the reviewers' comments through the online submission system of Henan Medical Research, completing the submission.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: Attending the Annual Meeting of Henan Provincial Rehabilitation Medicine Association
description: Yu Xiaowen made full preparations for the annual meeting of the Henan Provincial Rehabilitation Medicine Association. On August 27, she organized her poster and materials at home. From August 28 to 30, she attended the meeting at the Zhengzhou International Convention and Exhibition Center, including the opening ceremony, frontier reports, poster presentations, sub-forum discussions, equipment exhibitions, and closing exchanges. On August 31, she organized materials and contacts at home. Through this meeting, she strengthened her commitment to rehabilitation medicine and built connections for a department transfer.

subevent.name: Prepare meeting materials
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen organized and printed the poster at home in Zhengzhou, reviewed the data from the stroke home rehabilitation case analysis she was going to present, prepared the notebook and business cards needed for the conference, and confirmed the conference schedule and transportation routes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Attended the annual meeting opening ceremony and frontier reports on neurorehabilitation
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen arrived at Zhengzhou International Convention and Exhibition Center in the morning, completed check-in and registration, attended the opening ceremony of the Henan Provincial Rehabilitation Medicine Association annual meeting, and then listened to two special lectures in the field of neurological rehabilitation, recording key academic progress.

participant.name: Staff member of the Henan Provincial Rehabilitation Medicine Association

subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou International Convention and Exhibition Center

subevent.name: Poster presentation and peer exchange
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen put up her case analysis poster in the poster area, shared her experience in home-based rehabilitation for stroke with visiting colleagues, answered questions, exchanged contact information with physicians from other hospitals, and discussed difficulties in clinical practice.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Wall Poster Area, Zhengzhou International Convention and Exhibition Center

subevent.name: Attended the sub-forum and thematic seminar
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen attended the community rehabilitation sub-forum in the morning and the stroke rehabilitation thematic seminar in the afternoon, where she exchanged in-depth views with experts on optimizing home rehabilitation plans and recorded valuable suggestions.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou International Convention and Exhibition Center sub-venue

subevent.name: Visited the rehabilitation equipment exhibition and attended the midday social
subevent.description: During her lunch break, Yu Xiaowen visited the rehabilitation equipment exhibition accompanying the conference, learned about the latest rehabilitation devices, and had lunch with several colleagues, exchanging insights on career development and plans for transferring departments.

subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen attended the closing ceremony in the morning, listened to the conference summary, and after the meeting had a small gathering with her supervising physician Li Wei and a few newly acquainted colleagues. They shared their thoughts on the conference, and she further confirmed her intention to transfer to the rehabilitation medicine department.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou International Convention and Exhibition Center

subevent.name: Organize meeting materials and contacts
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen, at her home in Zhengzhou, sorted out the notes and the photos of slides taken during the meeting, entered the contact information of the colleagues she had just met into her address book, and wrote a short reflection on attending the conference to send to the department group.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Father's positive rehabilitation progress: first time sitting up independently from a lying position
description: During the morning rehabilitation training on May 10, under the therapist's supervision, her father finally, after more than a month of daily training, sat up steadily from a lying position without external support for the first time, showing significantly improved back strength. Yu Xiaowen stood nearby and recorded this brief moment on her phone. Her mother, deeply moved, turned away to wipe away tears. The whole family felt the tangible hope of recovery.

subevent.name: Going to the rehabilitation center
subevent.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowen prepared at her parents' home in Luoyang together with her parents, then drove the family car carrying her father Yu Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying to the rehabilitation center in Xigong District, Luoyang, to make preliminary preparations for her father's morning rehabilitation training.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - on the way from home to the rehabilitation center

subevent.name: Morning rehabilitation training in progress
subevent.description: In the treatment room of the rehabilitation center, under the supervision of rehabilitation therapist Dr. Zhang, Yu Jianguo began his daily sitting-up training, with Yu Xiaowen and Li Xiuying accompanying and encouraging him. After more than a month of continuous training, Yu Jianguo's lower back strength had improved significantly. During this session, he tried hard to sit up independently.
subevent.location: Luoyang - Rehabilitation Center Treatment Room

subevent.name: Father sat up independently for the first time, and it was recorded.
subevent.description: Under the watchful eyes of the therapist and family, Yu Jianguo, after several attempts, finally sat up steadily from a lying position for the first time without any external assistance, with his waist and back strength providing ample support. Yu Xiaowen recorded the brief but crucial moment in full on her phone. Li Xiuying was so moved that she turned away to wipe away tears. The whole family truly felt the real hope of recovery.
subevent.location: Luoyang - Rehabilitation Center Treatment Room

subevent.name: End of rehabilitation training and a brief family celebration.
subevent.description: After the morning rehabilitation training, Yu Xiaowen accompanied her father Yu Jianguo to rest, briefly discussed the follow-up rehabilitation plan with her mother Li Xiuying and therapist Dr. Zhang, and confirmed that his progress was obvious. The family drove back to their home in Luoyang with joy. Yu Xiaowen shared the recorded video in the family WeChat group and encouraged her father to continue training.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Rehabilitation Center and return home

name: Deepened the emotional bond between father and daughter through psychological counseling and having dinner together.
description: On the afternoon of July 8, 2025, at home, Yu Xiaowen used empathetic listening and open-ended questions to guide her father, Yu Jianguo, in recalling the sense of achievement he felt as a math teacher in his youth, easing the low mood caused by his slow recovery. In the evening, the father and daughter prepared and enjoyed dinner together and continued to discuss the rehabilitation plan and amusing life events. Her father's mood fully recovered, and the father-daughter relationship deepened through the warm interactions.

subevent.name: Listened empathetically and guided father to recall his sense of accomplishment at work
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 8, 2025, Yu Xiaowen sat down face to face with her father at home in Luoyang. First, with an empathetic attitude, she patiently listened to her father's anxiety about slow recovery and the grievance behind his silence. Then, through open-ended questions, she guided her father to recall the sense of achievement he gained when he worked as a math teacher at Luoyang No. 1 Senior High School in his youth (such as improvements in students' grades and receiving teaching honors). Her father's mood gradually shifted from low to calm, and he began to actively share past memories.
subevent.location: Home in Xigong District, Luoyang

subevent.name: Father and daughter had dinner together, deepening their emotional bond.
subevent.description: On the evening of July 8, 2025, after Yu Xiaowen finished providing psychological counseling, she prepared dinner at home in Luoyang with her father Yu Jianguo. While eating, they continued chatting about the rehabilitation plan and funny anecdotes from daily life. Her father's mood had fully recovered, and he actively asked about his daughter's recent work. The father-daughter relationship was further deepened through this warm interaction.
subevent.location: Home in Xigong District, Luoyang

name: A heartwarming Mother's Day gift conveying a daughter's deep love
description: On May 11, Mother's Day, although she had to accompany Wang Fang to try on wedding dresses during the day, Yu Xiaowen still ordered a carnation bouquet and a L'Occitane hand cream gift set through the Huajia platform early in the morning, and told the courier to deliver them to her parents' home at noon. Her mother Li Xiuying received them and sent a voice message feigning complaint but unable to hide her joy. After returning home that evening, Yu Xiaowen had a video call with her mother. She saw the flowers placed in the most prominent spot in the living room and her mother's rough hands coated with hand cream. The care and understanding between mother and daughter flowed silently through ordinary days.

subevent.name: Order a Mother's Day gift in the morning
subevent.description: Early in the morning, from her home on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen ordered a bouquet of carnations and an L'Occitane hand cream gift set through the Huajia platform, and specified that the delivery rider arrive at her parents' home on Kaixuan Road in Xigong District, Luoyang at 12 noon. She wrote a blessing in the order notes in advance, hoping to give her mother a surprise.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Accompanied Wang Fang to try on wedding dresses during the day.
subevent.description: From 10 a.m. to 3 p.m., Yu Xiaowen accompanied her best friend Wang Fang at a bridal shop in Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, to try on several wedding dresses and pick suitable styles for her wedding. They chatted while trying on dresses; Yu Xiaowen gave her friend styling suggestions and helped take photos. During the session, Yu Xiaowen received a voice message from her mother and replied in between fittings.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Bridal Shop

subevent.name: Mother received the gift and interacted via voice messages.
subevent.description: At around noon, her mother, Li Xiuying, received a bouquet of carnations and a hand cream gift box delivered by a rider at her home in Luoyang. She immediately sent Yu Xiaowen a voice message on WeChat. Her tone was fondly reproachful but could not hide her joy: “You’re spending money again. The flowers are beautiful, and the hand cream is just what I need.” Yu Xiaowen heard it during a break from trying on wedding dresses, smiled, and replied with a voice message expressing her love for her mother.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Bridal Shop (Yu Xiaowen's location)

subevent.name: Video call with Mom in the evening
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen returned to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and had a video call with her mother on WeChat. In the video, she saw that her mother had put the carnation bouquet in the most conspicuous vase in the living room, and her mother's rough hands had been smeared with hand cream. The two chatted about family matters for half an hour. Her mother told her to take care of herself, and Yu Xiaowen felt the ordinary but warm concern.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Preparing for and attending the book club event, meeting new friends from other industries.
description: On April 9, Yu Xiaowen searched social media for the weekend reading club activity at "Zhijian Book House" in Jinshui District and signed up online. The same day, at her home in Zhengzhou, she organized her notes on end-of-life experiences and planned key points for sharing. On the morning of April 13, she went to the bookstore to attend the reading club, shared the relevant experiences, which sparked lively discussion, and met new friends including book editor Zhao Min and software engineer Chen Chen. She was accepted as a regular member, expanding her social circle.

subevent.name: Look up book club information and sign up
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen found information about the weekend reading club event at an independent bookstore in Jinshui District named 'Between Pages Bookstore' through social media and local cultural public accounts. After learning the event's theme and process, she submitted an online registration.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - Home

subevent.name: Preparing content for sharing
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen sorted through her notes and reflections from her clinical work on end-of-life patients, thought about the key points and stories to share at the book club, and wrote a speaking outline in her notebook.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - Home

subevent.name: Going to the bookstore to attend the reading club
subevent.description: On the morning of Sunday, April 13, 2025, Yu Xiaowen drove from her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou to the independent bookstore Zhijian Bookstore near Jingsan Road in Jinshui District. After arriving, she signed in, took a seat, and exchanged pleasantries with the other participants.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City - Between the Pages Bookstore

description: On the morning of September 24, Yu Xiaowen attended the hospital's Basic Life Support (BLS) refresher training and assessment at the Clinical Skills Training Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. After carefully reviewing the latest guidelines, she completed CPR practice on a manikin and passed the assessment with a perfect score.

subevent.name: Mannequin CPR practice.
subevent.description: Under the guidance of her training instructor, Yu Xiaowen practiced cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) multiple times on a manikin, including single-rescuer and two-rescuer procedures, practicing compression depth and recoil techniques.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Clinical Skills Training Center

subevent.name: Participated in the official BLS assessment and passed with a perfect score.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen completed the full Basic Life Support (BLS) assessment process in front of the examiner, including checking consciousness, calling for help, chest compressions, opening the airway, and rescue breathing. The assessment was standardized and smooth, and she passed with a perfect score.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Clinical Skills Training Center

name: Received and read a thank-you letter from a discharged patient
description: After the physical examination on the morning of October 15, she returned to the department, and Head Nurse Wu Min handed her a thank-you letter from a discharged patient, Grandma Li. Yu Xiaowen read the letter carefully. In it, Grandma Li recalled the warmth of the handshake during ward rounds and expressed her joy at recovery. Yu Xiaowen was deeply moved, and her eyes turned slightly red.

subevent.name: In the morning, had the annual employee physical examination.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen completed her annual employee health checkup at the Physical Examination Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, including routine examination items.

subevent.description: After the physical examination, Yu Xiaowen returned to the department. Head Nurse Wu Min handed her a thank-you letter from discharged patient Grandma Li and briefly explained the source of the letter.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Reading a thank-you letter
subevent.description: In the department office, Yu Xiaowen carefully read Grandma Li's handwritten thank-you letter. After reading it, Yu Xiaowen's eyes turned slightly red, deeply moved.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Restarting pottery: wheel-throwing small bowls and cups and giving them to Wang Fang
description: On the morning of July 20, Yu Xiaowen went to the 'Nitu Zhijian' pottery studio and resumed her pottery practice after a six-month hiatus. At the potter's wheel, she focused intently and produced a small bowl with a neat shape. She then tried making a cup; although the cup wall was slightly crooked, she insisted on finishing it and chose a warm matte white glaze. The studio owner, Zheng Guodong, commented, 'Your technique has stabilized, and with more on your mind, you have actually been able to settle down.' Yu Xiaowen decided to give this cup, full of handcrafted warmth, to Wang Fang, who was about to get married, as a practice piece. The next evening after work, she gave the gift-boxed cup to Wang Fang in the departmental lounge of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Wang Fang was pleasantly surprised, and they took a photo together.

subevent.name: Heading to the pottery studio
subevent.description: On the morning of July 20, Yu Xiaowen set out from her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and drove to the "Between the Clay" pottery studio in the Artists' Park on Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, ready to resume her pottery practice.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - "Between Earth and Clay" Pottery Studio at the Artists' Park

subevent.name: Throwing a small bowl on the potter's wheel.
subevent.description: At the potter's wheel in the 'Between the Clay' pottery studio, Yu Xiaowen was fully focused on wedging the clay, centering it, opening it, and pulling it up, producing a well-proportioned small bowl body. After initially trimming the piece, she set it aside to dry. Zheng Guodong, the studio manager, observed each stage from the side.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Throwing a cup on the pottery wheel
subevent.description: After finishing the small bowl, Yu Xiaowen continued making a cup at the potter’s wheel. During the process, an experimental technique left the cup wall slightly lopsided, but she persisted and refined it until the clay body finally took shape. She chose a warm matte white glaze, giving the piece a plain, rustic texture.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Talked with Zheng Guodong and received feedback
subevent.description: While Yu Xiaowen was organizing her tools, Zheng Guodong walked over to look at the two new pieces and commented, "Your technique is steadier, and with more on your mind, you can actually settle down more." The two had a brief exchange of about 10 minutes on the feel of throwing clay, glaze selection, and creative mindset.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Gave the cup to Wang Fang.
subevent.description: After work on the evening of July 21, Yu Xiaowen gave Wang Fang a gift box containing a handmade cup in the department lounge of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, telling her it was a wedding gift she had made herself by throwing clay on a pottery wheel. Wang Fang was pleasantly surprised, opened the box on the spot to admire it, and expressed her thanks. The two took a group photo together.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - department lounge at the Central Hospital

name: Attend the Toastmasters Speech Club regular meeting
description: On the evening of Monday, August 18, her colleague Liu Qiang invited Yu Xiaowen to attend the regular meeting of the Toastmasters speech club he was in. Yu Xiaowen did not really want to go, but went for the sake of politeness. At the meeting, she was called on impromptu to give a one-minute impromptu speech. Though nervous, she smoothly shared a doctor's daily routine and received applause. She decided not to go a second time, but that experience gave her a bit more confidence in her ability to express herself.

subevent.name: Liu Qiang invited to join the Toastmasters Speech Club
subevent.description: While working at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, her colleague Liu Qiang (a resident physician) invited Yu Xiaowen in person to attend that evening's Toastmasters speech club regular meeting. Liu Qiang introduced the club's activities and warmly invited her. Although Yu Xiaowen was reluctant, she hesitated and then agreed to go because she didn't want to embarrass a colleague.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Central Hospital

subevent.name: Preparing to leave after work
subevent.description: After finishing the day's work, Yu Xiaowen returned home in the evening (No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou). She quickly changed out of her work uniform, tidied herself up briefly, checked the location of and route to the Toastmasters club on her phone, and after confirming the distance, decided to walk there.
subevent.location: Home on Jingsan Road, Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: Go to the Toastmasters club.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen set out on foot from home and followed the navigation to the Toastmasters speech club meeting venue at a community activity center near Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou. Along the way she still felt a bit uneasy, but had decided to go.
subevent.location: Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Attend the club's regular meeting and give an impromptu speech
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen arrived at the club's regular meeting on time, signed in and took a seat under Liu Qiang's guidance. During the meeting, the host called on her to give a 1-minute impromptu speech. Though nervous, Yu Xiaowen walked to the front and spoke smoothly about insights from patient consultations, using her daily work as a doctor as the theme. She received warm applause from the members present when she finished.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhongyuan District - Community Activity Center Meeting Room

subevent.name: Return home after the regular meeting
subevent.description: After the club's regular meeting, Yu Xiaowen briefly exchanged impressions with Liu Qiang, then walked back alone to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District. Along the way, she savored the experience of the impromptu speech. Although she decided not to take part again, she felt a little more recognition of her expressive ability.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jingsan Road - on the way home.

name: Online statistics course assignment postponed, but kept up with fragmented learning
description: From March 1 to 31, affected by her parents' move and household chores, Yu Xiaowen applied for three extensions on her online medical statistics course assignments, her original plan was disrupted, and the hands-on statistical model chapter stalled. She used the compensatory rest after night shifts and fragmented time off work to review video lessons on her iPad, organize key points in her notebook, and try to understand SPSS operation steps. Although she fell behind, she maintained continuity in her studies.

subevent.name: First homework extension request
subevent.description: Because her parents were relocating and needed help with household chores, Yu Xiaowen submitted an extension request for the first medical statistics assignment through the online course platform at home. She filled in the reason for the extension and chose to extend it by one week. After the system approved it, she received a confirmation email.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home in Jinshui District

subevent.name: Second homework extension request
subevent.description: Because household chores were still not finished, Yu Xiaowen logged into the course platform again and submitted a second extension request. This time she asked to extend the deadline to March 20 and briefly explained the situation. After the system approved it, she received the extension notice.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home in Jinshui District

subevent.name: Third Assignment Extension Request
subevent.description: As the second extension deadline approached and the hands-on statistical modeling chapter was still unfinished, Yu Xiaowen used her spare time in the duty room at Zhengzhou Central Hospital to submit a third extension request. The application was ultimately extended to March 31, and she promised to complete it as soon as possible.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - On-call Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Fragmented study during compensatory rest after a night shift.
subevent.description: During compensatory rest after finishing a night shift, Yu Xiaowen used her iPad in her home study to review teaching videos about SPSS operations from the course 'Application of Medical Statistics Software', and organized the key operation steps in her notebook, lasting about 1 hour.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District, home study

subevent.name: Learning in short bursts after work
subevent.description: After getting off work in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen used half an hour of fragmented time in the lounge of Zhengzhou Central Hospital to watch previously bookmarked video course clips on her iPad and supplement her notebook with SPSS operation notes for the t-test.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Rest room at Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Weekend intensive review and note organization
subevent.description: Using her weekend free time, Yu Xiaowen listened to an online course replay in the living room at home while systematically organizing in her notebook the key points of the statistical model chapters she had studied over the past two weeks, and tried to simulate the SPSS operation process in her mind. This lasted about 2 hours.
subevent.location: Living room at home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City

name: Buy home safety supplies for parents.
description: During her lunch break on October 14, Yu Xiaowen carefully selected safety items online, including non-slip mats, hallway handrails, and a shower chair, and placed an order to be shipped to the home in Luoyang. She also called her mother to remind her about the correct installation positions, to ensure that her father would be safer moving around at home after rehabilitation. She felt her sense of responsibility as a daughter growing stronger and that the family's daily support was becoming more comprehensive.

subevent.name: Shopping online for home safety supplies
subevent.description: During her lunch break at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen used her phone to carefully browse, compare, and select items on an e-commerce platform, including non-slip mats, hallway handrails, and shower chairs, making sure the sizes and materials were suitable for the environment at her parents' home in Luoyang.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Rest Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Order and ship to Luoyang.
subevent.description: After confirming the items, Yu Xiaowen added them to the shopping cart on the e-commerce platform and completed the order and payment. She filled in the delivery address as her home in Luoyang (No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City), chose standard express delivery, and expected arrival in a few days.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Rest Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Reminded mother over the phone about the installation location
subevent.description: After placing the order, Yu Xiaowen immediately called her mother Li Xiuying via video call and explained in detail that the non-slip mats should be placed at the bathroom door and on the kitchen floor, the hallway handrails should be installed on the walls on both sides of the corridor that her father often passes through, and the shower chair should be put in the shower area. She emphasized that the installation must be secure and asked her mother to operate according to the instructions after receiving the items.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Rest Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Weekend family rehabilitation walk and mother's community activity.
description: On August 8, under the recommendation of the neighborhood committee, mother Li Xiuying joined the choir group at the community senior activity center, made friends with several peers her age, and after returning home she talked noticeably more and her loneliness was alleviated. From the morning of every weekend starting August 10, Yu Xiaowen took her parents on a walk to Bishagang Park for rehabilitation walks. While explaining key rehabilitation points, she encouraged her father to walk independently with a cane, and her father smiled after finishing the walk. This family routine continued throughout the month, improving her father's physical condition and strengthening family bonds.

subevent.name: Mother participated in the community choir group activity
subevent.description: On August 8, 2025, Yu Xiaowen's mother Li Xiuying, recommended by the neighborhood committee, went to a community senior activity center in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and joined a newly formed choir group. During the activity, she met several retired neighbors of similar age, and together they practiced classic revolutionary songs, chatting and sharing life anecdotes during tea breaks. After returning home, Li Xiuying was noticeably more talkative, telling Yu Xiaowen and Yu Jianguo about the joyful details of the activity. The loneliness she had felt from being alone was clearly relieved.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Community Senior Activity Center

subevent.name: Weekend morning: took parents for a rehabilitation walk at Bishagang Park.
subevent.description: Starting from August 10, 2025 (Saturday), Yu Xiaowen took her parents every Saturday or Sunday morning from their home in Jinshui District to the nearby Bishagang Park. While explaining the key points of walking for her father Yu Jianguo's post-surgery rehabilitation (such as the correct posture for using a cane and a slow walking rhythm), she encouraged him to walk a full loop with the cane along the park's gentle slope (about 30 minutes). Her mother Li Xiuying accompanied them, and the three chatted about family trivialities as they walked. After the walk, her father showed a smile he had not shown for a long time and said his legs felt a bit lighter. This routine lasted throughout August, for a total of four times. It not only improved her father's physical mobility but also strengthened the family's emotional bond.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Bishagang Park

name: Songshan Hiking Challenge and Self-Breakthrough
description: On the afternoon of May 17, Yu Xiaowen sorted out at home the equipment needed for the next day's hike on Mount Song, and confirmed the meeting time and place with her best friend Sun Yue. On May 18, she and Sun Yue joined a one-day Mount Song hike organized by an outdoor club. They set off by bus from Zijingshan Park and climbed along the Songyang Academy trail. Although she was out of breath along the way, with Sun Yue's encouragement she persisted and reached the top of Junji Peak. The expansive view deeply impressed her, and she reflected that she should try more different forms of exercise to broaden the boundaries of her life. After descending the mountain, they took a bus back to Zhengzhou, had a simple meal together, and then went home.

subevent.name: Packing gear and confirming the itinerary before the hike
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 17, Yu Xiaowen sorted out at home the equipment she needed for the next day's hike on Mount Song, including hiking shoes, a sports backpack, a water bottle, sunscreen, a hat, energy bars, and first-aid medicine. She confirmed the meeting time and place with Sun Yue via WeChat. Sun Yue told her that the outdoor club would arrange a coach, with the meeting point at the entrance of Zijingshan Park in Zhengzhou and departure at 7:00 a.m. on May 18. Yu Xiaowen also checked the weather and hiking route for Mount Song, feeling both excited and a little nervous.
subevent.location: At home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Gather and take a bus to Mount Song
subevent.description: At 6:40 a.m. on May 18, Yu Xiaowen arrived as planned at the entrance of Zijingshan Park in Zhengzhou, where she met Sun Yue and other members of the outdoor club. At 7:00 sharp, the coach departed on time, and the drive took about 1.5 hours. On the coach, the tour leader introduced the day's hiking route (starting from Songyang Academy, ascending to the summit of Junji Peak, then returning along the same route), safety precautions, and an estimated hike time of about 6-7 hours. Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue sat in adjacent seats, chatting and snacking along the way in a relaxed atmosphere.
subevent.location: Zijingshan Park, Zhengzhou, Henan Province → Songshan Scenic Area, Dengfeng, Henan Province

subevent.name: The process of hiking up the mountain.
subevent.description: Arrived at the foot of Mount Song around 8:30 a.m. The group took a group photo in front of the Songyang Academy gate and then started hiking. The initial section was a gentle stone staircase, and Yu Xiaowen felt fine. But as the altitude rose and the steps became steeper, she gradually became out of breath and stopped many times to rest. Sun Yue kept encouraging her and shared water and snacks. Along the way, they passed historic sites such as Zhongyue Palace and Laomu Cave, and the team leader interspersed explanations of history and culture. Although physically tired, Yu Xiaowen was attracted by the natural scenery along the way and kept up with the team. At about 11:30, the team stopped for lunch on a flat platform. Yu Xiaowen ate her own sandwich and fruit and recovered some energy.
subevent.location: Dengfeng City, Henan Province - Mount Song Hiking Trail

subevent.name: Summiting Junji Peak and enjoying the view
subevent.description: At around 1 p.m., Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue successfully reached the summit of Junji Peak, the main peak of Mount Song. Standing on the 1,492-meter peak, the view suddenly opened up, with rolling mountains, drifting clouds and mist, and the distant city clearly visible. Yu Xiaowen felt an unprecedented sense of openness and awe, and all her fatigue disappeared. She and Sun Yue took photos of each other as mementos and sat on rocks enjoying the breeze at the summit. Yu Xiaowen was deeply moved: mountaineering brought such a strong sense of achievement that she should try more different forms of exercise to broaden the boundaries of life. After the leader organized a group photo, they began to prepare for the descent.
subevent.location: Summit of Junji Peak, Mount Song, Dengfeng City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Go down the mountain, return, and review the activity
subevent.description: At 1:30 p.m., they started descending the mountain. Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue followed the club group back along the same route. During the descent, Yu Xiaowen felt a slight ache in her knees, but overall it was easier than going up. The two walked and chatted, sharing their thoughts on the hike. Around 4 p.m., they returned to the parking lot at the foot of the mountain and took a coach back to Zhengzhou. On the bus, Yu Xiaowen wrote down today's reflections on her phone, recording the challenges and the sense of accomplishment the climb brought, and decided to participate in at least one outdoor hiking activity every month from then on. At 6 p.m., they returned to Zijingshan Park, had a simple meal together, and then went home separately.
subevent.location: Dengfeng City, Henan Province - Mount Song → Zhengzhou City, Henan Province - restaurant near Zijingshan Park

name: Enrolling in a medical statistics course, falling behind in study, and receiving remote research tools
description: On February 5, encouraged by her best friend Sun Yue, Yu Xiaowen signed up for an online medical statistics course in the study of her home in Zhengzhou and began studying in her free time. However, due to her busy work at the hospital, her study progress lagged severely behind. On February 8, at her home in Xigong District, Luoyang, she received an iPad mini sent from Shenzhen by her best friend Wang Lina, with an encouraging note attached, which facilitated her subsequent study and research.

subevent.name: Consult Sun Yue and sign up for an online medical statistics course.
subevent.description: Encouraged by her close friend Sun Yue, Yu Xiaowen visited the official website of the online medical statistics course through her computer, carefully read the syllabus and reviews, completed the registration and payment, and checked the course schedule and the time of the first live session.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Taking an online medical statistics course
subevent.description: In her spare time after work, Yu Xiaowen logged into the course platform in the evenings to watch recorded videos, take notes, and try to complete after-class exercises. However, due to her busy hospital work and the need to frequently travel between the hospital and her residence, her study progress fell seriously behind.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Received the iPad mini sent by Wang Lina at home in Luoyang
subevent.description: Wang Lina sent an iPad mini from Shenzhen via SF Express, with a note attached that read, 'Don't push yourself too hard, but don't give up either.' Yu Xiaowen signed for the package at her home in Xigong District, Luoyang, unpacked it, activated the device, and downloaded and installed learning and research apps related to medical statistics, making remote research and study more convenient.
subevent.location: Home in Xigong District, Luoyang

name: Accompanied her father to practice walking in the neighborhood.
description: On the evening of September 15, Yu Xiaowen met her father Yu Jianguo, who had come from Luoyang to stay temporarily in Zhengzhou, at the entrance of the residential community. The two went to a flat sidewalk, where Yu Xiaowen helped her father adjust his rehabilitation protective gear and set up the step counter on her phone. Then she stood ahead to guide him while her father walked independently about 50 meters. Yu Xiaowen recorded the steps and kept encouraging him. After he finished, a smile appeared on his face that had been absent for a while. The father and daughter then rested on a bench. Yu Xiaowen showed the step data and affirmed his progress, and her father confidently said he would continue practicing.

subevent.name: Meet with my father and prepare for the practice session
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen walked back to her residence at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District. At the entrance of the residential community, she met her father Yu Jianguo, who had come from Luoyang to stay temporarily in Zhengzhou. The two walked together to a flat pedestrian path in the community. Yu Xiaowen helped her father adjust his rehabilitation protective gear, set up the step-counting function on his phone, and confirmed that the surroundings were safe.
subevent.location: Community near Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Accompanied my father in walking 50 meters independently
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen stood two meters in front of her father, guiding him with encouraging looks and words to walk independently from the starting point. Her father Yu Jianguo took slow but steady steps, while Yu Xiaowen recorded the step count on her phone and kept giving verbal encouragement. After successfully walking about 50 meters, her father showed a smile he had not worn for a long time. The whole walking process took about 8 minutes.
subevent.location: Community near Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Rest and social interaction after practice
subevent.description: After the walk, Yu Xiaowen helped her father sit down on a bench in the community to rest and handed him a water bottle she had brought. The father and daughter chatted while resting. Yu Xiaowen showed her father the recorded step data, affirmed his progress, and discussed the rehabilitation plan for the next few days. Her father was in a good mood and said he was confident to continue practicing.
subevent.location: Community near Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

name: Video-called parents to share recent updates
description: On the evening of October 12, Yu Xiaowen video-called her parents in Luoyang via WeChat. Her father, Yu Jianguo, showed off his new skill of walking independently from the bedroom to the living room. Her mother, Li Xiuying, happily took out the ceramic jewelry dish that Xiaowen had taught her to make a few days earlier; inside it were the earrings she often wore, and she said she was happy to see it every day. Xiaowen shared the news of her successful department transfer and the joy of her paper being accepted. The family of three chatted and laughed across the screen for nearly an hour, and their bond grew deeper through the warm exchange.

subevent.name: Preparations for a video call with her parents.
subevent.description: At home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen scheduled an evening video call with her parents in Luoyang in advance via WeChat, and checked her phone camera angle and network signal to ensure call quality.
subevent.location: At home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Parents share their recent life updates over video call.
subevent.description: After the video call connected in the evening, her father, Yu Jianguo, showed Yu Xiaowen his new skill of walking independently from the bedroom to the living room at their home in Luoyang. Her mother, Li Xiuying, then took out the ceramic jewelry dish that Xiaowen had taught her to make a few days earlier, with the earrings she often wore inside, and said she was happy to see it every day.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - home in Jinshui District (Yu Xiaowen's side) / Henan Province, Luoyang City - home in Xigong District (parents' side)

subevent.name: Sharing personal good news during a video call
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen shared with her parents via video call the news of her successful department transfer and the joy of her paper being accepted. Her parents were very gratified, and the family of three continued chatting in a warm atmosphere for about an hour.
subevent.location: At home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Composing herself after the video call
subevent.description: After hanging up the video call, Yu Xiaowen savored the warm moment of talking with her parents at her home in Zhengzhou. She briefly recorded the exchange in her diary and felt happy about her father's rehabilitation and her mother's interest in pottery.
subevent.location: At home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Completed the first draft of the paper and received guidance from multiple parties
description: Continuing from last month's univariate analysis report and paper outline, Yu Xiaowen focused on writing the first draft of the paper in early July. On July 2, her colleague Liu Qiang gave key guidance on statistical methods, helping her correct the model selection for multivariate analysis; on July 5, her college classmate Zhou Haoran provided remote assistance in improving the literature search strategy and revising the wording of the discussion section. After the draft was completed on July 7, she sent it to Director Zhang Lei for review. In his feedback on July 9, Director Zhang affirmed the value of the topic and suggested strengthening the discussion on rehabilitation prognosis.

subevent.name: Organizing materials and starting to write the first draft of the paper
subevent.description: In the doctor's office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen organized last month's univariate analysis data and the paper outline, and officially began writing the first draft of the paper, mainly working on the introduction and the materials and methods sections.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Liu Qiang provided guidance on the statistical methods.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen asked her colleague Liu Qiang for advice on model selection for the multivariate analysis in her paper. Liu Qiang gave key guidance in the department office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, helping her correct the model selection and providing SPSS operation tips.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Zhou Haoran provided remote assistance to refine the paper.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen contacted her college classmate Zhou Haoran via a WeChat video call and asked for help improving the literature search strategy and the discussion section. Zhou Haoran remotely guided her through PubMed's advanced search functions and helped her revise the logic of the discussion section.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – Yu Xiaowen's home study

subevent.name: Completed the first draft and sent it to Director Zhang for review.
subevent.description: After incorporating the guidance from Liu Qiang and Zhou Haoran, Yu Xiaowen completed the first draft of the paper. In the doctors' office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, she sent the draft to department director Zhang Lei for review, with a message asking for advice.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Received review feedback from Director Zhang
subevent.description: In the department office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen received Director Zhang Lei's feedback on the first draft of her paper. Director Zhang affirmed the value of the topic, suggested strengthening the discussion in the rehabilitation prognosis section, and put forward several specific revision suggestions.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Went to the market with Su Ya, a pottery friend, and talked about booth plans.
description: On the afternoon of October 21, Yu Xiaowen invited Su Ya, a classmate from her pottery class, to visit the handicraft market at Ruiguang Creative Factory in Zhengzhou. As they strolled, they discussed the styles and pricing of the various pottery pieces at the market. Su Ya suggested adding an interactive pottery experience at their November market booth to attract customers, and Xiaowen also shared her design ideas for the custom zodiac rooster piece she had just completed.
