After browsing, they had drinks at the café in the creative park and agreed to practice throwing pottery together next time at Master Zheng's studio. Their friendship was nourished by their shared interest.

subevent.name: Inviting Su Ya to the market
subevent.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowen contacted her ceramics classmate Su Ya via WeChat and invited her to go together that afternoon to the handicraft market at Ruiguang Creative Factory in Zhengzhou. The two agreed on WeChat to meet at 2 pm at the entrance of the Creative Factory, and Su Ya readily agreed.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - at home (WeChat communication)

subevent.name: Set off for Ruiguang Creative Factory.
subevent.description: At 1:40 p.m., Yu Xiaowen left home and drove to the Ruiguang Creative Factory in Zhengzhou. About 20 minutes later, she arrived, parked, and waited for Su Ya at the factory gate.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou - Jingsan Road, Jinshui District → Ruiguang Creative Factory, Zhongyuan District

subevent.name: Met up with Su Ya and started browsing the market
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen met Su Ya at the entrance of Ruiguang Creative Factory, and the two entered the handicraft market together. As they strolled, they admired the pottery and handmade craft booths, discussing the style, technique, and pricing strategies of the works.
subevent.location: Handicraft Market at Ruiguang Creative Factory, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Discuss the pottery booth plan and share works
subevent.description: During a break in browsing the market, Su Ya suggested adding an interactive pottery experience segment to the stall at the November market to attract customers. Yu Xiaowen agreed and shared the design ideas for the custom Year of the Rooster piece she had just finished. The two exchanged views on booth layout and pricing.
subevent.location: Beside the market stall at Ruiguang Creative Factory, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Resting and chatting at a café.
subevent.description: After visiting the market, Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya came to a café in the park to have drinks and continued chatting about pottery-making insights, funny life stories, and recent plans. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, and their friendship deepened further.
subevent.location: Cafe at Ruiguang Creative Factory Park, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Agreed to practice pottery throwing together next time
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya agreed at the café to go together next time to Master Zheng's 'Between the Clay' pottery studio to practice wheel throwing, and planned to bring their own works for Master Zheng to critique.
subevent.location: Cafe at Ruiguang Creative Factory Park, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Completed a custom ceramic piece of the Chinese zodiac Rooster.
description: On Sunday, October 19, Yu Xiaowen went to Su Ya's community pottery studio to give the final touches to the custom zodiac rooster pottery piece she received in September—carving feather patterns and glazing it. The two chatted while working, and Su Ya suggested she add an interactive pottery experience session to her November market booth. After the piece was put into the kiln, Xiaowen was full of anticipation for the finished result; this would be her first custom piece formally sold.

subevent.name: Going to Su Ya's community pottery studio.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen set out from her home on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and walked or took public transportation to the Su Ya Community Pottery Studio on Daxue Road in Erqi District, Zhengzhou, to complete the final finishing work on the custom-made zodiac rooster pottery.
subevent.location: From home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to the community pottery studio in Erqi District

subevent.name: Carving feather details and glazing the zodiac rooster pottery blank.
subevent.description: At Su Ya's community pottery studio, Yu Xiaowen took out a zodiac rooster biscuit she had finished making in September, carefully carved feather lines with a carving knife, then evenly applied transparent glaze, completing the final finishing process.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Erqi District - Su Ya's Community Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Talked with Su Ya and discussed the interactive segment of the market.
subevent.description: While refining her works, Yu Xiaowen chatted with her friend Su Ya, who was also there. Su Ya suggested that she add an interactive pottery experience segment at the market she would attend in November to attract more customers. Yu Xiaowen listened carefully to the suggestion and said she would consider it.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Erqi District - Su Ya's Community Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Put the work into the kiln for firing
subevent.description: After finishing trimming and glazing, under the guidance of Su Ya or Master Zheng, Yu Xiaowen carefully placed the zodiac rooster clay piece into the electric kiln in the studio, set the firing temperature and duration, and started the firing process, full of anticipation for the finished piece.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Erqi District - Su Ya's Community Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Left the pottery studio and returned home.
subevent.description: After the finished pieces were placed in the kiln, Yu Xiaowen said goodbye to Su Ya and left the community pottery studio, returning to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, ending the day's pottery activity.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - Erqi District to Jinshui District

name: Participated in departmental difficult-case discussion and spoke.
description: On the afternoon of May 13, the department organized a case discussion on the sequelae stage of cerebral infarction complicated by depressive state. Yu Xiaowen reviewed the literature in advance and, drawing on her father's rehabilitation experience, proposed combining psychological intervention with exercise therapy. This was recognized by Director Zhang Lei, who encouraged her to compile it into a case report.

subevent.name: Reviewed literature on post-cerebral infarction depression.
subevent.description: During her break time, Yu Xiaowen searched medical databases in the Zhengzhou Central Hospital library and at home for the latest literature and intervention studies on the sequelae stage of cerebral infarction complicated by depressive state, focusing on collecting evidence-based support for psychological intervention and exercise therapy, in preparation for the upcoming case discussion.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Library, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Compile my father's rehabilitation experience and write a speech outline.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen drew on her father Yu Jianguo's actual rehabilitation experience (he is recovering from a cerebral infarction), systematically organized her observations of how psychological counseling and regular exercise improved mood and function, integrated them with evidence from the literature, and wrote a speech outline highlighting the feasibility and clinical value of 'psychological intervention combined with exercise therapy'.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Participated in departmental case discussion and received recognition from the director
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 13, during a case discussion on post-cerebral infarction sequelae complicated by depressive state held in the department meeting room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen, based on literature prepared in advance and her father's experience, proposed a comprehensive recommendation of "psychological intervention combined with exercise therapy." The department director Zhang Lei affirmed the suggestion on the spot and encouraged her to write up the case as a case report for publication.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Department Meeting Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Home rehabilitation environment modification
description: On August 11, after consulting colleagues in the rehabilitation department, Yu Xiaowen made elderly-friendly modifications to the apartment she rented: installing grab bars in the bathroom, laying anti-slip floor mats, and adding an adjustable-height rehabilitation nursing bed to her father's bedroom. She adjusted the position of the bed with her father to ensure the lighting was appropriate. After the modifications, it was safer for her father to get up at night, and during the day he could also watch TV while half-reclining. His quality of life improved significantly.

subevent.name: Consulted colleagues in the rehabilitation department for advice on elderly-friendly home modifications
subevent.description: On the morning of August 11, 2025, during a break at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen went to the rehabilitation department to consult her colleague Dr. Wang about an elderly-friendly renovation plan for her home. Based on the age and physical condition of her father, Yu Jianguo, Dr. Wang explained in detail the installation height for bathroom grab bars (about 75 cm from the floor), the material requirements for anti-skid floor mats, and the functional parameters of an adjustable nursing bed, and also provided specific product recommendations.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Purchase items needed for the elderly-adaptation renovation
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 11, 2025, following the advice from the morning consultation, Yu Xiaowen first went to a building materials market near Jingsan Road in Jinshui District and bought stainless steel safety grab bars and non-slip floor mats. Then she went to a medical equipment store to compare several rehabilitation nursing beds, and finally chose one with adjustable height and side rails. After paying on the spot, she arranged for the store to deliver the nursing bed to her rented apartment that same day.
subevent.location: Building materials market and medical equipment stores in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Installing bathroom grab bars and laying non-slip floor mats
subevent.description: On the evening of August 11, 2025, after the care bed was delivered and installed, Yu Xiaowen, with the help of her father Yu Jianguo, used an electric drill to install a stainless steel handrail on the wall of the bathroom of the rented apartment at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and laid non-slip mats on the floor. She repeatedly tested the firmness of the handrail and the anti-slip effect of the mats to ensure her father could use them safely when getting up at night.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District, No. 89 Jingsan Road Apartment Bathroom

subevent.name: Installed and adjusted the rehabilitation nursing bed
subevent.description: On the morning of August 12, 2025, Yu Xiaowen and her father Yu Jianguo moved the rehabilitation nursing bed, which had been delivered the day before, into her father's bedroom and completed the assembly. The two then adjusted the bed's position together, placing it near the window but avoiding direct sunlight to ensure soft, just-right lighting. After trying it out, her father said it was much easier to sit up and lie down, and he could also lie half-reclined to watch TV during the day. His quality of life had improved significantly.
subevent.location: Father's bedroom in the apartment at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Received praise at the department monthly meeting and started the attending physician exam preparation plan
description: At the department monthly meeting on the afternoon of October 10, Director Zhang Lei singled out Yu Xiaowen for praise for the acceptance of her paper and announced that she would be included in the hospital's young talent reserve program. After the meeting, the director asked her to stay behind and said in a low voice, 'You should start preparing for the attending physician exam now; you need solid credentials in both clinical work and research.' Xiaowen nodded, and that evening she made a rough monthly plan based on the exam syllabus, officially entering the exam preparation track.

subevent.name: Attend the October department monthly meeting
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 10, 2025, Yu Xiaowen attended the monthly department meeting at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. During the meeting, Director Zhang Lei praised her specifically for the recent acceptance of her paper and announced that she would be included in the hospital's young talent reserve program. The meeting was held in the department conference room, and all medical staff of the department were present.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department Conference Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: The director had a private talk with me to remind me to prepare for the exam.
subevent.description: After the department's monthly meeting, Director Zhang Lei kept Yu Xiaowen behind alone and quietly suggested that she prepare for the attending physician examination, emphasizing that both clinical work and research require solid credentials. Yu Xiaowen listened carefully and nodded in response. The conversation took place in the corridor outside the office and lasted about five minutes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - corridor outside the department office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: In the evening, made a monthly study plan for the attending physician exam.
subevent.description: That evening, Yu Xiaowen returned home. In her study, she drafted a rough monthly review schedule based on the attending physician exam syllabus and her clinical work schedule, formally beginning exam preparation. The schedule included time allocation for each subject, marking of key chapters, and arrangements for staged mock tests.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: Received a Guardian cake at the morning meeting on Doctors' Day
description: On the morning of August 19, Doctors' Day, Director Zhang Lei had prepared small cakes for every doctor at the department's morning meeting. The cake Yu Xiaowen got had the words 'Guardian' on it. She thought of her father, her family, and the new chapter about to begin in the rehab department, and a complex but solid warmth rose in her heart.

subevent.name: Doctors' Day cake preparation.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 18, 2025, Zhang Lei, the department director of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, arranged for head nurse Wu Min to order a batch of small cakes for Doctors' Day, specifically instructing that one cake be marked with the words Guardian for the next morning's meeting. Wu Min contacted a cake shop near the hospital to complete the order, picked up the cakes, and stored them in the department refrigerator.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City, Henan Province - Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Opening of the department morning meeting.
subevent.description: At 7:50 a.m. on August 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowen arrived on time at the departmental meeting room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital for the day's morning meeting. Director Zhang Lei chaired the meeting. He first handled the daily shift handover and ward round arrangements, then announced that today was Doctors' Day and there was a special segment.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Department Meeting Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Director Zhang Lei gave a speech and distributed the cake.
subevent.description: During the morning meeting on August 19, 2025, at 8:10, Director Zhang Lei extended Doctors' Day greetings to all residents and attending physicians, thanking everyone for their hard work. Then, with the assistance of Head Nurse Wu Min, customized small cakes were distributed one by one to each doctor. Each cake had a different blessing written on it; the cake Yu Xiaowen received read 'Guardian'.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Department Meeting Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowen's reflections after receiving the "Guardian" cake
subevent.description: During the morning meeting on August 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowen received a cake with the word "Guardian" written on it and was deeply moved. Thinking of her professional mission as a doctor, the spirit of dedication her father Yu Jianguo had taught her since childhood, the support of her family as she worked independently in Zhengzhou, and the upcoming new rotation in the rehabilitation department, she felt a mixture of complex emotions and comforting warmth. Her eyes were slightly moist, but her professional conviction was strengthened.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Department Meeting Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Share the cake with colleagues after the morning meeting and take photos.
subevent.description: At 8:30 after the morning meeting on August 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowen shared cake with her department colleagues and friends Wang Fang and Liu Qiang in a corner of the conference room, taking photos of each other as keepsakes. Yu Xiaowen took a close-up of the word 'Guardian' on the cake with her phone. Wang Fang praised the cake for being exquisite, and Yu Xiaowen said she would show it to her parents.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Department Meeting Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Sharing photos of the cake with her family
subevent.description: At 9:00 a.m. on August 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowen sent the cake photo and her thoughts from the morning meeting via WeChat to her father Yu Jianguo, her mother Li Xiuying, and her older cousin Li Yaqin. She wrote, “On Doctors' Day, I received a cake from the director with the words ‘Guardian’ on it. It feels very warm, and I’ll keep working hard.” Her father quickly replied with encouragement, her mother sent a voice message expressing her delight, and her cousin also liked the post and congratulated her.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City, Henan Province - Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Teamed up with Wang Fang to register for the first aid skills competition and began preparing.
description: After the hospital released the notice on March 22, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang officially formed a team to register for the annual emergency skills competition. Between March 24 and 31, the two used lunch breaks and some time after night shifts to practice two-person CPR, endotracheal intubation coordination, and other procedures multiple times in the department's demonstration room. Wang Fang was in charge of timing and recording issues, while Yu Xiaowen corrected details against the operation standards. The two agreed to practice at least three times a week to prepare for the preliminary round in April.

subevent.name: Formed a team to sign up for the first aid skills competition.
subevent.description: After the hospital released the annual emergency skills competition notice on March 22, Yu Xiaowen and her department colleague Wang Fang discussed it during work breaks and decided to form a team to register. The two filled out the registration form in the department office of Zhengzhou Central Hospital using the hospital intranet system, officially submitted their competition information, and agreed to step up practice during their free time over the following week.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: First two-person first aid coordination practice
subevent.description: During the lunch break on March 24, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang conducted their first two-person CPR coordination practice in the department demonstration room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Wang Fang was responsible for timing and recording operation issues such as compression depth and frequency, while Yu Xiaowen performed chest compressions and ventilation according to standard procedures. The two alternated roles for practice and discussed and corrected the details of coordination and handover.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Department teaching room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Endotracheal intubation cooperation practice
subevent.description: After the night shift ended on March 26, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang practiced tracheal intubation coordination in the department's demonstration room. Yu Xiaowen performed the intubation, while Wang Fang helped expose the glottis, passed instruments, and recorded the time taken and common mistakes for each attempt. The two repeatedly refined their division of roles and corrected details against the competition scoring standards.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Department teaching room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Comprehensive simulation drill.
subevent.description: During the lunch break on March 28, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang conducted a comprehensive simulated drill in the department's demonstration room, practicing the connection between CPR and tracheal intubation. The two simulated the entire emergency rescue process. Wang Fang led the timing and recorded the time spent on each transition, while Yu Xiaowen focused on optimizing the coordination between pre-intubation preparation and compression switching timing. After practice, they verbally reviewed the problems and adjusted the plan.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Department teaching room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Targeted error-correction training
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 30, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang conducted targeted training in the department teaching room to address problems revealed in earlier practice sessions, such as unstable compression depth and mistimed ventilation. Wang Fang used a stopwatch to time each attempt precisely and record the data, while Yu Xiaowen adjusted her arm perpendicularity and compression rate according to the standard. Through repeated drills, they brought the deviations within the error tolerance allowed by the competition.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Department teaching room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Final process standardization rehearsal
subevent.description: On the evening of March 31, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang conducted the final complete pre-competition practice in the department demonstration room. The two completed the full process of CPR, endotracheal intubation, and defibrillation coordination in accordance with the competition time requirements. Wang Fang timed the entire process and checked each item against the scoring sheet, and Yu Xiaowen confirmed that all operations met the standard. After the practice, they organized their notes together, summarized the key points of their teamwork, and made final preparations for the preliminary round in early April.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Department teaching room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Took the national attending physician qualification examination.
description: On August 9, Yu Xiaowen took the national Attending Physician Qualification Examination in the Zhengzhou test area. The exam consisted of four subjects, with two sessions in the morning and two in the afternoon. She was quite confident about the neurology and rehabilitation-related questions. After leaving the exam hall, the tension from months of exam preparation was finally released. She called her parents to share her feelings and resolved that, no matter the result, she had given it her all.

subevent.name: Pre-exam preparation and departure.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 9, 2025, after getting up at her home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen checked and organized her exam supplies, including her admission ticket, ID card, black gel pen, 2B pencil, and eraser, and quickly reviewed key notes on neurology and rehabilitation medicine. At 7:30, she then drove to the designated examination venue for the Zhengzhou test area, near Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou (set as Zhengzhou No. 1 Middle School).
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - at home and en route

subevent.name: Take the morning subject exam
subevent.description: From 8:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. on August 9, 2025, Yu Xiaowen took the first and second subjects of the National Attending Physician Qualification Examination in the designated examination room at Zhengzhou No.1 Middle School examination center, covering basic knowledge and relevant professional knowledge. She was fairly confident in her answers on the neurology and rehabilitation medicine questions, remained calm and focused throughout the exam, and completed the answer sheets on time.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou No.1 High School

subevent.name: Noon break and meal
subevent.description: From 12:00 to 13:30 on August 9, 2025, Yu Xiaowen had a simple meal at a fast-food restaurant near the exam venue (such as a restaurant around the school), and used the interval to take a short rest in the car to adjust her state for the afternoon exam.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - around the exam venue

subevent.name: Attend the afternoon subject exam.
subevent.description: On August 9, 2025, from 14:00 to 17:30, Yu Xiaowen continued to take the third and fourth exams at Zhengzhou No. 1 Middle School, covering professional knowledge and professional practical ability respectively. She patiently read the questions, allocated time reasonably, and finally completed all subjects smoothly, feeling a great sense of relief as she walked out of the examination room.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou No.1 High School

subevent.name: Post-exam phone call with parents to share how it went
subevent.description: On the evening of August 9, 2025, after the exam ended, Yu Xiaowen drove home and, at her residence at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, had a WeChat video call with her parents Yu Jianguo and Li Xiuying in Luoyang. She described the exam process in detail, expressed confidence in the neurology and rehabilitation questions, and admitted that the tension from months of exam preparation had finally been released—regardless of the result, she had given it her all. Her parents encouraged and comforted her, and the call lasted about 20 minutes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - living room at home

name: Progress in father's rehabilitation assessment: he can now walk short distances independently
description: On the morning of September 14, the rehabilitation medicine therapist performed an interim assessment of her father, showing improved lower limb muscle strength and balance; he could walk independently without a cane for about 15 meters. Yu Xiaowen recorded a video on the spot and sent it to Chen Siyu in Luoyang and her cousin in Shenzhen. Her father waved at the camera, and the family's confidence in home rehabilitation greatly increased.

subevent.name: Accompany father to the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine
subevent.description: On the morning of September 14, 2025, Yu Xiaowen accompanied her father Yu Jianguo to the Rehabilitation Medicine Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, where she communicated with the rehabilitation therapist on duty (Therapist Wang) about the process and precautions for this phase assessment, to prepare for the evaluation.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Conduct assessment of lower limb muscle strength and balance ability
subevent.description: The rehabilitation therapist used professional assessment scales to carefully test the lower-limb muscle strength and balance of her father Yu Jianguo. Under the therapist's guidance and encouragement, he successfully walked about 15 meters independently without a cane. The evaluation results showed significant improvement in both lower-limb muscle strength and balance.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Recorded a video of her father walking independently
subevent.description: After her father successfully walked independently, Yu Xiaowen used her phone to record a video on the spot, capturing the process of her father walking 15 meters without a cane. Her father, Yu Jianguo, waved happily at the camera. After confirming the video was clear and complete, Yu Xiaowen saved it to her phone.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Shared the video with Chen Siyu and her cousin.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen sent the recorded video of her father's rehabilitation via WeChat to her high school classmate Chen Siyu (Luoyang) and her cousin Li Yaqin (Shenzhen), and in the message explained that her father had shown progress in today's evaluation and could now walk short distances independently. The two quickly replied with congratulations and words of encouragement.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Used pottery visualization to help my father relax and reignite his interest in pottery.
description: On the afternoon of June 18, her father Yu Jianguo was feeling down due to slow rehabilitation progress and homesickness. Yu Xiaowen remembered a pottery video she had made, and tried using the method of visualization and focused breathing from it to guide her father to breathe deeply and relax. He closed his eyes and followed along; after twenty minutes he dozed off peacefully, and the effect was very good. On June 25, pottery teacher Zheng Guodong sent a WeChat message asking if she had any unfired bisque pieces to fire together. Yu Xiaowen realized she had not touched clay for nearly half a year, and a wave of unwillingness surged in her. She walked into her study, touched the kaolin clay Su Ya had sent, and decided to take up pottery again as a way to relieve stress and add variety.

subevent.name: Recall the pottery visualization method and prepare to guide the session
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 18, at her father's home in Luoyang, Yu Xiaowen saw that her father was feeling down because of slow rehabilitation progress and homesickness. She remembered the method of visualization and focused breathing from a pottery video she had made, and decided to use it to help him relax. She first found the relevant video on her phone, recalled and organized the guided steps, preparing for the upcoming relaxation exercise.
subevent.location: Father's home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City

subevent.name: Guide father in breathing relaxation through visualization
subevent.description: At her father's home in Luoyang, Yu Xiaowen asked her father Yu Jianguo to close his eyes and follow her voice guidance, imagining the feel of clay in his hands and the rhythm of breathing, and to do focused deep-breathing relaxation. Her father cooperated earnestly; after twenty minutes he dozed off peacefully, his mood improved markedly, and the relaxation effect was significant.
subevent.location: Father's home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City

subevent.name: Father rested briefly and recovered his mood.
subevent.description: After completing the guided visualization breathing exercise, her father Yu Jianguo fell into a peaceful nap because of relaxation. Yu Xiaowen stayed quietly by his side. After confirming that her father was emotionally stable, she quietly left the room so that he could rest at ease. This relaxation helped her father relieve his low mood and rehabilitation pressure.
subevent.location: Father's home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City

subevent.name: Received a WeChat message from the pottery teacher and reflected on my current situation.
subevent.description: On June 25, at her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen received a WeChat message from her pottery teacher, Zheng Guodong, asking if she had any bisque pieces that could be fired together. The message made her realize that she had not touched clay in nearly half a year. A sense of unwillingness and nostalgia rose in her heart, and she decided to take up pottery again as a way to relieve stress and add variety to her life.
subevent.location: Home, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Touching kaolin clay and deciding to take up pottery again.
subevent.description: After receiving a WeChat message from her teacher, Yu Xiaowen went into the study, opened the kaolin clay package sent by Su Ya, and touched the fine clay with her hands, feeling a material she hadn't used in a long time. She resolved to start practicing ceramics again, making it an important part of her daily stress relief and personal interest development, and planned to contact Teacher Zheng Guodong to arrange future pottery activities.
subevent.location: Home study room, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

name: Go to the pottery studio to complete the first piece in half a year
description: On the evening of June 26, Yu Xiaowen drove to the pottery studio, spent nearly three hours shaping the rough form of a tea bowl, and before leaving that night took a photo and shared it with her best friend Su Ya, regaining a long-missed sense of focus and tranquility.

subevent.name: Drive to the pottery studio
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen left home in Jinshui District at about 7 p.m. that evening, drove her own family car along Jingsan Road and Longhai Expressway for about 20 minutes, arrived at the Artist Park on Shangcheng Road in Guancheng Hui District, parked the car, and walked into the 'Between the Clay' pottery studio.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Guancheng Hui District, Shangcheng Road Artists' Park

subevent.name: Shaping the rough form of a tea cup in the studio
subevent.description: At around 7:30 PM, Yu Xiaowen entered the back work area of the pottery studio, put on an apron, took about 300 grams of white clay, and began making a tea bowl on the potter's wheel. Because she was unfamiliar with the technique, she modified the shape of the clay body multiple times along the way. After nearly three hours of repeated throwing and trimming, she finally completed a rough tea bowl with a diameter of about 8 cm. Zheng Guodong gave brief guidance twice, helping her correct the thickness of the bottom.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Guancheng Hui District, Between the Earth Pottery Studio.

subevent.name: Leave the studio and share the creative results.
subevent.description: At around 10:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen packed up her belongings, took photos of the clay body of the tea bowl she had just finished from multiple angles with her phone, left the studio, and got into her car. She sent the photos to her best friend Su Ya via WeChat with the message 'Finally got started, my first piece in six months.' Then she started the car and drove back home along the same route, feeling a long-missed sense of focus and peace.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Artists' Park on Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, and in the car

name: Pottery creation breakthrough, small showcase, and a friendship gift.
description: On the afternoon of Saturday, August 16, after two failed attempts at throwing clay at the 'Between the Soil' studio, Yu Xiaowen played Bach's Unaccompanied Cello Suites on her third try. Amid the serene melody, she successfully threw two bowls, two cups, and two plates, with a warm, smooth glaze. Zheng Guodong praised her, 'Music and clay blend together in your hands; your technique is steady.' That evening, she shaped and fired a small ceramic plaque engraved with 'Siyu' from the leftover clay, attaching a card reading 'For our Luoyang memory,' and planned to mail it to Chen Siyu, who works in Luoyang. On the morning of Sunday, August 17, she held a small open studio session, inviting Su Ya, Zhang Jing, and Sun Yue to share the creative process, display the works, and demonstrate wheel throwing on site. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.

subevent.name: Pottery creation breakthrough
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 16, at the "Between Clay" pottery studio in Zhengzhou, after two failed attempts at throwing clay, Yu Xiaowen played Bach's "Cello Suites" on her phone during her third attempt. In the calm melody, she successfully threw two bowls, two cups, and two plates — six pieces in total — and applied a warm, glossy glaze. Pottery teacher Zheng Guodong observed and praised, "Music and clay blend in your hands; your technique is steady now." Yu Xiaowen was very happy about her breakthrough and placed the pieces in the studio to air-dry naturally.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Guancheng Hui District - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Firing a clay plaque gift engraved with a name
subevent.description: On the evening of August 16, at the pottery studio, Yu Xiaowen used leftover material from that day's creations to carefully shape and carve a small clay plaque inscribed with the characters Siyu, as a gift for her high school friend Chen Siyu. She personally fired it in the studio's electric kiln and wrote a card beside it reading For Our Luoyang Memory. After finishing, she wrapped the plaque and card, ready to mail them the next day.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Guancheng Hui District - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Held a small pottery creation showcase
subevent.description: On the morning of August 17, Yu Xiaowen held a small viewing session at the Between the Clay pottery studio, inviting friends Su Ya (classmate from pottery class), Zhang Jing (close friend), and Sun Yue (university classmate and colleague) to visit. She introduced the breakthrough process and insights from her creation the previous day, showed her newly completed works, and gave a live demonstration of simple wheel-throwing techniques. Her three friends praised her progress, and everyone chatted over tea about pottery and life. The whole session lasted about two hours in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Guancheng Hui District - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

name: Observation of rehabilitation equipment during caregiving in Luoyang sparked thoughts about career transition
description: On February 7, after work, Yu Xiaowen drove from Zhengzhou to Luoyang Central Hospital to accompany her father Yu Jianguo, who was hospitalized for rehabilitation treatment. On Saturday, February 15, she went to the rehabilitation department again to observe new intelligent rehabilitation training equipment. Moved by its precise techniques and remarkable effects, and comparing it with her repetitive work in the cardiology department, she seriously considered switching to rehabilitation medicine for the first time, and briefly recorded the career prospects and training paths in her phone memo. On February 16, after finishing the caregiving, she drove back to Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: Going to Luoyang Hospital to care for her father.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen drove from her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, to her parents' home in Xigong District, Luoyang City, planning to go to Luoyang Central Hospital to accompany her father Yu Jianguo, who was hospitalized for rehabilitation treatment.
subevent.location: On the way from Zhengzhou to Luoyang, Henan Province

subevent.name: Observe and record transformation thoughts again.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen again went to the rehabilitation department to observe how the equipment was used, and briefly noted in her phone memo the employment prospects and training paths for rehabilitation medicine, laying the groundwork for a systematic investigation later.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Luoyang City - Luoyang Central Hospital

subevent.name: Return to Zhengzhou.
subevent.description: After finishing her weekend caregiving duty, Yu Xiaowen drove from Luoyang back to her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou.
subevent.location: Henan Province – en route from Luoyang to Zhengzhou.

name: Lunar New Year's Day online greetings and bridesmaid invitation confirmation
description: On January 29, during Spring Festival, Yu Xiaowen video-called relatives and elders to pay New Year greetings, and sent blessings in her close friends' group and work group. Her friend Wang Fang sent photos of her engagement ceremony and formally invited her again to be a bridesmaid (the wedding was tentatively set for May Day), and Yu Xiaowen happily agreed. Wang Lina, Zhang Jing, and Sun Yue also sent red envelopes and greetings, sharing the lively Spring Festival celebrations from different places.

subevent.name: Send New Year greetings to relatives and elders via video
subevent.description: At her home at No. 89, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen used the WeChat video call feature on her phone to connect one by one with her parents Yu Jianguo and Li Xiuying, who were far away in Luoyang, as well as her older female cousin Li Yaqin and other elder relatives, to wish them a happy New Year and send her New Year blessings. During the calls, she asked about their health, shared her recent work and life in Zhengzhou, and expressed her best wishes for the new year.
subevent.location: Living room at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: In the besties group, she sent New Year greetings and received red envelope good wishes.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen sent New Year's greetings and emojis in her best friends' WeChat group named "Childhood Pals Circle", and proactively greeted her three best friends Wang Lina, Zhang Jing, and Sun Yue in the group. She then received New Year red envelopes and voice greetings from Wang Lina, Zhang Jing, and Sun Yue. They shared lively scenes of celebrating the New Year in their respective hometowns in the group, and Yu Xiaowen also replied with blessings and thanks.
subevent.location: Home at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Sent New Year greetings in the work group
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen sent New Year wishes and New Year greeting emojis in the department work WeChat group of Zhengzhou Central Hospital to express holiday greetings to her colleagues. Li Wei, Liu Qiang, Zhang Lei, Wu Min, and other colleagues also replied with blessings in turn.
subevent.location: Home at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Confirm the bridesmaid invitation with Wang Fang.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen's close friend and colleague Wang Fang sent her engagement ceremony photos via WeChat private chat and formally invited Yu Xiaowen again to be her bridesmaid at her wedding during the May Day holiday. Yu Xiaowen was very happy seeing the photos, immediately replied that she happily accepted the invitation, offered sincere congratulations, and asked about the wedding preparation progress. Wang Fang thanked her for her support and agreed to discuss bridesmaid-related matters together later.
subevent.location: Home at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

name: Researching the talent home-purchase subsidy policy and starting to pay attention to real estate.
description: On November 5, Yu Xiaowen was browsing the news when she saw the newly released talent housing subsidy policy in Zhengzhou and found that she was eligible. She immediately contacted her cousin Li Yaqin, who had already bought a home in Hangzhou, to ask about home-buying experience. She then downloaded the Beike Zhaofang app, set her budget at 800,000 yuan or less, and began paying attention to small apartments in Jinshui District and Zhongyuan District. She also made buying a home her three-year mid-term goal.

subevent.name: Browsing news and discovering the talent housing purchase subsidy policy
subevent.description: While browsing news on her phone in her rented apartment at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen saw the latest talent housing purchase subsidy policy issued by Zhengzhou. Reading carefully, she found that her qualifications (bachelor's degree, resident physician, working in Zhengzhou) met the application requirements, and immediately screenshotted and saved the key terms of the policy.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Jingsan Road Rental Apartment

subevent.name: Contacted my older female cousin to ask about home-buying experience.
subevent.description: After discovering that she qualified for the home-purchase subsidy policy, Yu Xiaowen immediately contacted her cousin Li Yaqin, who had already bought a home in Hangzhou, via WeChat video call. She asked in detail about the purchase process, things to note, unit layout choices, and how to take advantage of the talent policy. Li Yaqin shared her home-buying experience in Hangzhou and suggested that Yu Xiaowen first determine her budget and preferred area. The call lasted about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Jingsan Road Rental Apartment

subevent.name: Download the Beike Zhaofang app and set a home-buying budget
subevent.description: After finishing the call with her cousin, Yu Xiaowen immediately downloaded the Beike app from the phone app store, and based on her current savings, possible financial support from her parents, and monthly mortgage repayment ability, set her home-purchase budget at a total price within 800,000 yuan. She also set the filter conditions to compact units, two-bedroom with one living room or one-bedroom with one living room, with a building age of no more than 10 years.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Jingsan Road Rental Apartment

subevent.name: Browsed small-unit housing listings in Jinshui District and Zhongyuan District.
subevent.description: After setting the filter criteria in the Beike app, Yu Xiaowen started browsing small-unit listings in Jinshui District and Zhongyuan District of Zhengzhou, focusing on properties with a total price within 800,000 yuan. She saved 5 houses that looked promising, and set buying a home as a medium-term goal for the next three years. After browsing for about 1 hour, she gained a preliminary understanding of the distribution and prices of the listings.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Jingsan Road Rental Apartment

name: Participated in the multicenter study led by Li Wei; her research role shifted from independent to collaborative.
description: On September 16, Li Wei, deputy chief physician of the rehabilitation department, assigned Yu Xiaowen to assist the multicenter project “Adherence to Post-Stroke Rehabilitation Training,” responsible for collecting case data from three community health centers. It was her first exposure to a multicenter collaborative workflow, and she reflected that research had shifted from working alone to teamwork.

subevent.name: Accepted the multicenter research task assigned by Li Wei
subevent.description: On September 16, 2025, in the office of the Department of Rehabilitation at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Li Wei, an associate chief physician, had a one-on-one conversation with Yu Xiaowen and formally assigned her to assist with the multicenter research project Adherence to Post-Stroke Rehabilitation Training. Li Wei introduced the project's background, objectives, and collaboration process to Yu Xiaowen, clarifying that her responsibility was to collect case data from three community health centers. This was Yu Xiaowen's first exposure to multicenter collaboration. She listened carefully to the requirements and noted key information, inwardly feeling that research was shifting from working alone to teamwork.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City, Zhongyuan District - Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Rehabilitation Department Office.

subevent.name: Familiarize herself with the multicenter research project documents and data collection standards.
subevent.description: After accepting the task, Yu Xiaowen used the time after work that day and the next morning's rest time to carefully study the project manual, data collection forms, and informed consent template provided by Li Wei in the study of her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. She focused on learning the multi-center collaborative data submission process, unified scoring standards, and ethical requirements, marked questions to be clarified, and prepared for subsequent communication with the community health center.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province – home study

subevent.name: Read project documents after work
subevent.description: After work on September 16, 2025, Yu Xiaowen returned home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. In her study, she opened the multicenter research project manual, data collection forms, and informed consent template provided by Li Wei. subevent.name: Continued studying and organizing the list of questions in the morning.

name: Qixi blind date and the subsequent best-friend venting.
description: On August 14, Qixi Festival, to comfort her mother, who had been feeling down recently due to her father's illness, Yu Xiaowen reluctantly agreed to a blind date arranged by her mother's colleague—dinner with a 29-year-old engineer from a state-owned enterprise at Dennis Lakeview Restaurant. The conversation was limited to surface topics such as work; no spark developed because their life circles were different. After a polite goodbye, she walked alone by Ruyi Lake, then immediately vented to her best friend Wang Lina on WeChat that it was "like completing a KPI." Wang Lina defused it with humor and advised her, "If you don't want to go next time, just say so; don't make yourself miserable." This experience made Yu Xiaowen more certain about her emotional needs and more considerate of her mother's concern.

subevent.name: Mother's persuasion and the decision to attend the appointment
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen received a phone call from her mother Li Xiuying in Luoyang. Feeling down because of the recent illness of her father Yu Jianguo, her mother urged Xiaowen to go on a blind date. To comfort her mother, Xiaowen agreed to attend.
subevent.location: Home living room, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Their conversation was limited to superficial topics such as work, and due to differences in social circles, no spark developed. After the meal, they politely said goodbye.
subevent.location: Dennis Lakeview Restaurant, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.location: Ruyi Lake, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Best friend Sun Yue came over for a casual get-together; they talked about life pressures and career confusion
description: On the afternoon of March 28, Yu Xiaowen went to the market to buy ingredients and cleaned the new home to prepare for the gathering. On Saturday, March 29, Sun Yue, who had taken a compensatory day off, came to visit with a fruit basket. The two cooked together, making huimian noodles and sweet and sour pork. At lunch they shared amusing stories from the pediatric ward, confided their financial pressure and confusion about career transitions, and encouraged each other to release their anxiety.

After returning home, she thoroughly cleaned the living room and kitchen of the three-bedroom apartment, set out tableware and seasonings, and made full preparations for the gathering with her best friend Sun Yue the next day.

Around 8 a.m., she went to a fruit shop near her residence, carefully selected a fruit basket containing apples, oranges, dragon fruit, etc., attached a handwritten greeting card, and then drove to the three-bedroom apartment complex where Yu Xiaowen had newly rented in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou.

subevent.description: Around 10 a.m., Sun Yue arrived at Yu Xiaowen's newly rented apartment in Jinshui District. The two hugged warmly and toured the new home. Then they busied themselves in the kitchen together: Yu Xiaowen was in charge of kneading the dough and pulling huimian noodles, while Sun Yue helped wash vegetables and marinate the pork tenderloin. Sun Yue shared amusing stories and on-call experiences from the pediatric ward, while Yu Xiaowen talked about her recent financial pressure and confusion about career transition. The two encouraged each other; Sun Yue used her own experience to counsel Yu Xiaowen, and Yu Xiaowen responded with an optimistic attitude, effectively releasing each other's anxiety. The gathering lasted until about 2 p.m.

At the department morning meeting on April 16, Director Zhang Lei publicly praised them, specifically mentioning that Yu Xiaowen 'maintained a professional standard despite family pressure,' which greatly encouraged her. After the meeting, Wang Fang invited her to celebrate and brought up the bridesmaid role at the wedding again. Yu Xiaowen more firmly promised, 'I'll definitely be there.' On April 22, during the department team-building activity, Yu Xiaowen arrived late because of a conflict with her father's treatment time. Wang Fang specially adjusted the games so she could easily join in, and their friendship deepened through the shared experiences.

subevent.description: At the department morning meeting at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Director Zhang Lei publicly praised Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang for their outstanding performance in the emergency skills competition. She immediately made a list: fever reducer, cold granules, povidone-iodine, band-aids, elastic bandage, and her father's personal medications. After returning home, she sorted them into sealed bags, labeled the expiration dates, and gave the medicine cabinet a thorough refresh. She also put in a handwritten Family First Aid Tips card, making a healthy stockpile for the New Year.

description: Continuing from the draft completed last month and Director Zhang Lei's review comments, Yu Xiaowen focused on revising the paper from August 1 to 5: on the 1st, she revised the data descriptions in the discussion section; on the 2nd, she improved the citations and formatting; on the 3rd, she adjusted the abstract and conclusion; on the 4th, she read through and polished the full text, finally finalizing it. subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen opened the draft of her paper in her home study in Zhengzhou. subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Refining the paper's citations and reference format
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen checked all the references cited in her paper in her study, added missing recent relevant studies, and corrected the reference formats (such as author names, journal names, volume/issue/page numbers) to ensure compliance with the submission guidelines of Henan Medical Research. She also reorganized the reference list generated by the citation tool.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Revise the abstract and conclusion sections of the paper.
subevent.description: In the study at her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen adjusted the abstract and conclusion of the paper based on the revised discussion section, so that the abstract accurately reflected the core findings of the study, the conclusion remained consistent with the discussion results, and optimized keywords were added. subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

After confirming the submission was complete, she emailed the submission receipt and paper abstract to collaborator Director Zhang Lei, with a note asking for confirmation.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Teaching mother to shape clay and fire it into an everyday jewelry dish
description: On the morning of October 4, Yu Xiaowen set up a pottery clay board on the balcony of her parents' home in Xigong District, Luoyang, and taught her mother Li Xiuying hand by hand how to roll clay coils and pinch small bowls. Her mother was trying pottery for the first time; her movements were clumsy but earnest, and she eventually pinched out a small low dish with fingerprints along the rim. On the afternoon of October 5, Yu Xiaowen glazed the dish and put it in a small home electric kiln to fire. When it came out of the kiln in the evening, the glaze was warm and even. Her mother Li Xiuying was delighted by the finished piece and immediately placed her usual earrings and thimble into the dish, softly marveling that it was a gift more precious than anything bought in a store.

subevent.name: Taught her mother how to shape small dishes out of clay
subevent.description: On the morning of October 4, Yu Xiaowen set up a pottery clay board on the balcony of her parents' home in Luoyang and taught her mother, Li Xiuying, hands-on how to roll clay coils and shape small bowls. It was her mother's first time trying pottery. Her movements were clumsy but earnest, and in the end she shaped a small, low saucer with fingerprint marks along the rim. As they worked, mother and daughter chatted, and the atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: Balcony of parents' home, Xigong District, Luoyang.

subevent.name: Glazed the small plates, fired them, and unloaded them from the kiln.

Her mother, Li Xiuying, was delighted when she saw the finished piece and immediately put the earrings and thimble she often wore into the dish, softly exclaiming that it was a precious gift that nothing she could buy could match.
subevent.location: Balcony of parents' home, Xigong District, Luoyang.

name: A small incident: flat tire on the way to work
description: On the morning of July 15, 2025, while Yu Xiaowen was driving to work, her tire was punctured by a nail near the intersection of Jingsan Road and Weier Road and went flat. She pulled over and called roadside assistance. The rescuer arrived and changed the tire to the spare, which made her 45 minutes late for work. After work, she went to an auto repair shop to patch the tire, which cost 200 yuan. This little incident annoyed her for the rest of the day, but it also reminded her of driving safety.

subevent.name: Discovered a flat tire.
subevent.description: On the morning of July 15, 2025, at about 7:40, Yu Xiaowen drove her car from her home on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District to Zhengzhou Central Hospital at 1 Jianshe West Road in Zhongyuan District for work. When she was approaching the intersection of Jingsan Road and Weier Road, she suddenly felt the car vibrating abnormally, then heard a hissing sound of air leaking from a tire, and at the same time the tire pressure warning light on the dashboard came on. She realized that the tire might have been punctured, quickly turned on the turn signal and slowed down, stopped the car steadily in a safe area on the roadside, turned off the engine, and activated the hazard warning lights. After getting out to check, she found a nail stuck in the left front tire, and the tire was almost completely flat.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou: near the intersection of Jingsan Road and Weier Road.

subevent.name: Call roadside assistance
subevent.description: After Yu Xiaowen confirmed that the tire was punctured and leaking, she took out the insurance company road rescue card kept in the glove compartment from the car and called the rescue hotline. She clearly told the customer service representative her vehicle location (100 meters east of the intersection of Jingsan Road and Weier Road), vehicle model, license plate number, and the problem (left front tire punctured by a nail and leaking). The customer service representative said the rescuer would arrive within 30 minutes and advised her to turn on the hazard lights and place a triangular warning sign behind the car. Yu Xiaowen placed the warning sign as instructed, then returned to the car and locked the doors and windows to wait for rescue. While waiting, she glanced at her watch: 7:48, and estimated she would be late.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou: near the intersection of Jingsan Road and Weier Road.

subevent.name: Wait for and receive rescue
subevent.description: About 20 minutes later, a yellow service vehicle with a rescue company logo arrived at the scene. The rescue technician (male, about 40 years old) got out, first checked the tire condition, and confirmed that a roadside repair was not possible. He then used a jack to lift the left front wheel, took the spare tire out of the trunk, and deftly replaced the tire. The entire replacement process took about 15 minutes. After the replacement, the technician told Yu Xiaowen that the spare tire's maximum speed should not exceed 80 km/h, and that she should go to a repair shop to patch or replace the tire as soon as possible. He then collected the fee (included in the annual membership package, no additional charge on site). The service vehicle left. The time was 8:25.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou: near the intersection of Jingsan Road and Weier Road.

subevent.name: Continued driving to work and was late
subevent.description: After thanking the rescue workers, Yu Xiaowen restarted the car and carefully drove the vehicle with the spare tire toward the hospital. Because the spare tire had a speed limit, she could only keep the speed around 60 km/h. Combined with morning rush hour traffic, she finally arrived at the Zhengzhou Central Hospital parking lot at 8:45. She was 45 minutes late for the normal work start time of 8:00 (the hospital's resident physician regulations require arriving for shift handover at 8:00). She parked hastily, jogged into the inpatient department, and apologized to her supervising teacher, Li Wei. Because of the lateness, she missed the first half of the morning shift handover and would need to catch up on her own.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Central Hospital Inpatient Department

subevent.name: Dealt with the damaged tire after work
subevent.description: After getting off work at 4:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen drove to a familiar auto repair shop near the hospital (located on Huashan Road, Zhongyuan District). The mechanic removed the tire that had been punctured by a nail, repaired it with a hot patch, and performed dynamic balance adjustment, charging a total of 200 yuan. The mechanic said the repaired tire was safe to use and recommended checking it again at the next maintenance. Yu Xiaowen paid, replaced the spare tire with the original one, and drove home safely. This small incident cost 200 yuan and made her 45 minutes late, but fortunately no one was hurt.
subevent.location: An auto repair shop on Huashan Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou

name: Mid-Autumn Festival family moon-gazing and wish-making
description: On the evening of the Mid-Autumn Festival, October 6, Xiaowen and her parents set out mooncakes, pomegranates, and green tea on the balcony. The moon was gradually becoming full. Her father stood for a while leaning on his walking frame, looked up, and said, 'We're finally reunited this year.' Her mother made a silent wish and then broke the largest mooncake into three pieces. Xiaowen remembered the moonlight in the hospital room a year ago and deeply felt that recovery was not just about walking, but also about the family coming back together.

subevent.name: Decorated the balcony for Mid-Autumn moon viewing.
subevent.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying arranged Mid-Autumn moon-viewing items together on the balcony of their home in Luoyang: placing mooncakes, pomegranates, and green tea neatly on the tea table, and arranging the chairs and cushions in preparation for the family reunion on Mid-Autumn Festival night.
subevent.location: Home balcony, Xigong District, Luoyang City

subevent.name: Father joined in moon-viewing and reflected on family reunion.
subevent.description: In the evening while admiring the moon, my father Yu Jianguo walked to the balcony with his walking frame, stood for a while, looked up at the waxing moon, and said with deep emotion, 'We're finally reunited this year,' expressing his relief and joy that the family was together again.
subevent.location: Home balcony, Xigong District, Luoyang City

subevent.name: Mother made a wish and shared mooncakes
subevent.description: Mother Li Xiuying silently made a wish in the moonlight, then broke the largest mooncake into three pieces. She shared them with Yu Xiaowen and Yu Jianguo, and the family tasted it together, creating a warm family atmosphere.
subevent.location: Home balcony, Xigong District, Luoyang City

subevent.name: Xiaowen recalled the moonlight in the ward and realized the meaning of rehabilitation
subevent.description: While admiring the moon, Yu Xiaowen was moved by the scene and recalled the moonlight she had seen in a hospital ward a year ago, thinking of her father's journey from illness to recovery. She deeply realized that rehabilitation is not only the physical recovery of walking, but also the complete process of the family coming back together and reuniting.
subevent.location: Home balcony, Xigong District, Luoyang City

name: Car insurance renewal and installment repayment arrangements
description: At noon on December 15, after receiving the renewal reminder for Ping An auto insurance, Yu Xiaowen carefully checked the new policy: compulsory traffic insurance, third-party liability insurance of 1.5 million yuan, vehicle damage insurance and no-deductible coverage, totaling 3,870 yuan. Considering the cash flow pressure that month, she chose to pay with her China Merchants Bank credit card and set up installment repayment in 3 installments (1,290 yuan per installment), saving the electronic policy to a folder on her phone to ensure uninterrupted coverage.

subevent.name: Check the details of the new annual insurance policy
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen carefully checked the coverage types and fee details of the new annual auto insurance policy: compulsory traffic insurance, third-party liability insurance (1.5 million), vehicle damage insurance, and no-deductible coverage, totaling 3,870 yuan. She confirmed that the insurance items were the same as the previous year and the coverage was correct.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Paid car insurance by credit card.
subevent.description: Considering the current month’s cash-flow pressure, Yu Xiaowen decided to pay the 3870 yuan auto insurance premium in one lump sum using her China Merchants Bank credit card. She logged into the Ping An Auto Insurance app or China Merchants Bank mobile banking and completed the payment by selecting the credit card payment method.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Set up repayment in 3 installments
subevent.description: After the payment was successful, Yu Xiaowen set the 3,870 yuan purchase as a 3-installment repayment plan on the China Merchants Bank credit card bill page, with 1,290 yuan payable per installment, to ease the repayment pressure for that month. She confirmed that the installment handling fee and the repayment date for each installment were correct.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Save the electronic insurance policy.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen downloaded the received electronic insurance policy file to her phone and saved it into a dedicated 'Insurance - Vehicle' folder in her phone, ensuring it can be quickly found when needed in the future, completing the whole car insurance renewal process.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Paper officially published, first research cycle concluded
description: On November 1, Yu Xiaowen received a sample issue of Henan Medical Research, and her paper was officially published. She put the sample issue on her desk, took a photo, and sent it to her supervisor and family, marking the completion of her first full research cycle from case collection to revision and acceptance.

subevent.name: Signed for the sample journal issue for the paper
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen signed for the sample issue package of Henan Medical Research delivered by the courier in her office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital and confirmed it was correct.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Take a photo and share the good news of the paper's publication.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen used her phone to take photos of the sample journal cover and the paper pages, and sent them via WeChat to her advisor Li Wei and her parents Yu Jianguo and Li Xiuying, sharing the joy of the paper being officially published.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

name: Taking a solo autumn City Walk along the Jinshui River.
description: After work on September 23, 2025, Yu Xiaowen set out from Zhengzhou Central Hospital and walked along the Jinshui River trail, enjoying the autumn sunset and river view while listening to Chopin's Nocturnes. On the way, she stopped at the riverside "Ink Fragrance Bookstore" to browse pottery books, then continued walking and returned home on Jingsan Road, enjoying a complete autumn City Walk.

subevent.name: After work, she set off for Jinshui River.
subevent.description: Around 17:30 on the evening of September 23, 2025, Yu Xiaowen finished her day at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. After changing out of her white coat, she walked out of the hospital alone and headed east along Jianshe West Road to the trail entrance along the Jinshui River. She was wearing comfortable casual clothes and earphones, ready to start an autumn City Walk.
subevent.location: Jianshe West Road / Jinshui River Trail Entrance, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Walked along the Jinshui River trail and enjoyed the scenery
subevent.description: From about 17:45 to 18:30, Yu Xiaowen took a leisurely walk along the Jinshui River trail. The afterglow of the setting sun spilled onto the river, sparkling. She enjoyed the autumn scenery on both banks—leaves turning yellow, a gentle breeze—while listening to Chopin's nocturnes through earphones, immersed in a blend of classical music and nature, temporarily forgetting work stress.
subevent.location: Jinshui River riverside trail, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Stopped at a small bookstore and browsed pottery books
subevent.description: From about 18:30 to 19:00, Yu Xiaowen was drawn to a small bookstore called 'Ink Fragrance Bookstore' on the riverside during her walk, and went in to browse. She paused in front of the art bookshelf and found a book on modern ceramic techniques. Leaning against the shelf, she leafed through it carefully for about twenty minutes. She was quite interested in the hand-building techniques described in the book and enjoyed a peaceful time reading.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City, Henan Province - Small Bookstore by the Jinshui River

subevent.name: Finished the walk and returned home.
subevent.description: At around 19:15, Yu Xiaowen left the bookstore and continued walking along the Jinshui River walkway for a while, then left the riverbank from an exit near the intersection of Jinshui Road and Jingsan Road and walked back to her home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District. After arriving home, she briefly sorted out her feelings for the day, bringing this pleasant autumn City Walk to an end.
subevent.location: Home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Schedule and record a nutrition department dietary adjustment consultation.
description: On October 16, Yu Xiaowen used the hospital's internal messaging software to make an appointment with her nutrition department colleague Li Ting, and at 10 a.m. consulted her in person at the nutrition department office about dietary adjustments. In view of her mild anemia, Li Ting advised increasing intake of red meat, pork liver, and dark-colored vegetables, reducing coffee and strong tea, and recommended replacing them with fruit tea rich in vitamin C. After the consultation, Yu Xiaowen returned to her office desk and recorded the key adjustment points in detail in her personal health management notebook.

subevent.name: Schedule a consultation time with a colleague in the nutrition department
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen contacted Li Ting, a colleague in the nutrition department, through the hospital's internal messaging app. She briefly explained that a recent physical exam suggested mild anemia and asked to set up a time to discuss a dietary adjustment plan in person. Li Ting agreed to meet at 10 a.m. in the nutrition department office.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Had a consultation on dietary adjustments
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen arrived at the nutrition department office on time and described in detail to her colleague Li Ting the low hemoglobin level found in her recent physical examination. Based on clinical nutrition principles, Li Ting advised her to increase intake of red meat (100–150 grams per day), pork liver (1–2 times per week, 50 grams each time), and dark-colored vegetables (such as spinach and broccoli), while reducing beverages that inhibit iron absorption like coffee and strong tea, and recommended replacing them with fruit teas rich in vitamin C. Yu Xiaowen listened carefully and took notes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Nutrition Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Record key points of dietary adjustments
subevent.description: After the consultation, Yu Xiaowen returned to her desk in her department and organized the key dietary adjustments suggested by Li Ting, item by item, into her personal health management notebook, including recommended portions and frequencies for various food categories as well as beverage replacement options, and marked the precautions for strict implementation in her daily life later.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Had in-depth communication with parents about car maintenance costs, deepening intergenerational understanding.
description: On the evening of December 15, after paying the installment for her car insurance, Yu Xiaowen had a video call with her parents. She explained in detail the composition of car maintenance costs and emphasized the convenience the car provided during her father's rehabilitation, such as being able to take him to the hospital for physical therapy at any time. Her father said with emotion that he used to think buying a car was a waste of money, but now he could see it really helped a lot. Her mother also marveled at her daughter's thoughtfulness. The three chatted for a long time under the warm light. Her parents shifted from past opposition to full support, and the generational gap melted away through understanding.

subevent.name: Pay car insurance installment
subevent.description: At her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen used the mobile banking app to complete the monthly installment payment for her car insurance, confirmed the deduction was successful, and reviewed the bill details, laying a factual basis for later discussing car ownership costs with her parents.
subevent.location: Living room at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Video call with parents about the cost of car ownership
subevent.description: After paying for her car insurance, Yu Xiaowen had a video call via WeChat from her home in Zhengzhou with her father Yu Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying at their home in Luoyang. She explained in detail the specific breakdown of car maintenance costs (insurance, fuel, maintenance, etc.) and emphasized the convenience the car provided during her father's rehabilitation, such as being able to take him to the hospital for physical therapy at any time. After hearing this, her father said with emotion that he had previously thought buying a car was a waste of money but now realized it had been a great help; her mother also praised her daughter for being thoughtful. The three chatted for nearly an hour in a warm atmosphere. The generational gap melted away through understanding, and her parents shifted from opposition to full support.
subevent.location: Living room of home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (Yu Xiaowen's side); home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province (parents' side)

name: Sorting the wardrobe for the change of season and recycling old clothes to practice environmental protection.
description: On the afternoon of April 12, with the assistance of her mother Li Xiuying, Yu Xiaowen organized the two wardrobes at home, putting away winter clothes and taking out spring clothes. They sorted out 13 pieces of unused clothing belonging to herself and her mother, and scheduled door-to-door recycling pickup through the Baijingyu platform. Although her mother was reluctant, she was persuaded that 'recycling old clothes is environmentally friendly and helps others.' The mother and daughter reached an understanding while working together. In the end, the recycling worker came to take the old clothes, and Yu Xiaowen donated the Ant Forest energy she earned.

subevent.name: Preparing to organize the wardrobe
subevent.description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowen and her visiting mother Li Xiuying began preparing to organize the two wardrobes at home, taking out storage bins, clothes hangers, and dust bags to prepare for the seasonal clothes change.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home

subevent.name: Put away winter clothes
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen folded the winter down jackets, sweaters, and thick pants neatly and placed them into storage boxes. At the same time, she took out spring clothes such as light jackets and long-sleeved T-shirts and hung them up, while her mother helped with the arrangement.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home

subevent.name: Selecting spare clothes
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen carefully selected 13 pieces of unused clothing from her own and her mother's wardrobes, including coats, tops, and pants, sorted and piled them together, preparing for old clothes recycling.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home

subevent.name: Booked a Baijingyu door-to-door recycling pickup.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen took out her phone, opened the White Whale Fish old clothes recycling mini program, filled in her home address and a convenient door-to-door pickup time slot, and made an appointment for the recycler to come pick up the old clothes that afternoon.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home

subevent.name: Persuade mother to support recycling.
subevent.description: Her mother, Li Xiuying, was reluctant to part with some old clothes that had sentimental value. Yu Xiaowen patiently explained the environmental benefits of old-clothes recycling and how it could help people in mountain areas. Her mother finally understood and agreed to recycle all the idle clothes.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home

subevent.name: The recycling collector came to pick up clothes.
subevent.description: During the afternoon appointment window, the Baijingyu recycling collector arrived on time. Yu Xiaowen handed over 13 old garments, and the collector scanned the order QR code to confirm the recycling and took the clothes away.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home
