subevent.name: Donated Ant Forest energy.
subevent.description: After the recycling was completed, the Baijingyu platform issued Ant Forest energy to Yu Xiaowen's account. She immediately opened Ant Forest in Alipay and donated the energy to an environmental public welfare project supporting desertification prevention.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home

name: First teahouse experience with my best friend: the idea of replacing coffee with tea came to mind
description: On the evening of December 5, her close friend Sun Yue took Yu Xiaowen to a newly opened neo-Chinese teahouse in Jinshui District. The tea artist elegantly demonstrated the brewing process of oolong tea. The warm tea fragrance and sense of ritual made Yu Xiaowen, who had been tense for nearly six months, feel very relaxed. Recalling that after her physical examination in October the doctor advised reducing coffee intake, she immediately had the idea of replacing evening coffee with tea, and with Sun Yue's encouragement, decided to give it a try.

subevent.name: Agreed with Sun Yue on an evening visit to the teahouse
subevent.description: That afternoon, Yu Xiaowen made arrangements with her best friend Sun Yue via WeChat to visit the newly opened new-Chinese-style tea house in Jinshui District that evening. Sun Yue had recommended the tea house to her before, and the two agreed to meet at the subway station after work.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Metro Station

subevent.name: Go to the tea room to experience oolong tea brewing.
subevent.description: After meeting up in the evening, Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue walked together to the "Qingyun New Chinese Tea House" in Jinshui District. The tea master demonstrated the complete brewing process of Fenghuang Dancong oolong tea, from warming the cups, awakening the leaves, to decanting the tea through the fairness cup, with tea fragrance filling the air. Yu Xiaowen, who had been tense for nearly half a year due to work pressure, felt obviously relaxed in the warm tea house atmosphere. The two chatted while tasting tea, and Sun Yue shared recent funny stories from her life.
subevent.location: Qingyun New Chinese Tea Room, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Came up with the idea of replacing coffee with tea and decided to try it.
subevent.description: During a break in tea tasting, Yu Xiaowen recalled that during her physical examination in October, the doctor advised her to reduce her coffee intake. Thinking of the relaxing feeling tea had just brought her, she told Sun Yue on the spot that she wanted to try replacing her usual evening coffee with nighttime tea. Sun Yue expressed strong support and suggested she start by buying a small amount of good-quality oolong tea. Yu Xiaowen decided to begin the plan the next day and asked Sun Yue to help supervise and remind her.
subevent.location: Qingyun New Chinese Tea Room, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Attended an online course on basic rehabilitation medicine
description: To make a smooth transition to the rehabilitation department, Yu Xiaowen used her after-work time from August 11 to 25 to complete the online course Fundamentals of Rehabilitation Medicine on the Chinese University MOOC platform, totaling 16 class hours, with a focus on modules such as neurorehabilitation and exercise therapy, and she finished the after-course quizzes. She organized her course notes into the themed notes 'Rehabilitation + Technology + Humanities' to build up her knowledge reserve for the department transfer.

subevent.name: Systematic study of the neurorehabilitation module
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen used her time after work every day to focus on studying the neurorehabilitation module of the 'Fundamentals of Rehabilitation Medicine' course in her home study, including core content such as post-stroke rehabilitation and spinal cord injury rehabilitation. She studied about 1-2 class hours a day, watched instructional videos, read courseware, and completed in-class exercises, building up professional knowledge for the department transfer.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Studied an overview of post-stroke rehabilitation.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen returned to her study at home, opened her laptop, and began studying the first part of the neurorehabilitation module in the course Foundations of Rehabilitation Medicine: an overview of post-stroke rehabilitation. She watched about 40 minutes of instructional videos, learning the pathophysiological mechanisms of stroke, principles of rehabilitation assessment, and the timing of early rehabilitation intervention. She then read the accompanying PDF courseware and took notes. Finally, she completed 5 in-class multiple-choice questions with an accuracy of 80%, and marked the wrong questions for review.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Learning rehabilitation for motor dysfunction after stroke
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen continued studying the neurorehabilitation module in her study after work, focusing on rehabilitation treatment for motor dysfunction after stroke. She watched about 50 minutes of course videos, learning in detail the application of neurodevelopmental therapies such as Bobath technique, Brunnstrom staged training, and proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) in hemiplegia rehabilitation. She then went through the corresponding textbook chapters and completed a timed set of 8 practice questions on motor function recovery.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Studied rehabilitation for speech and swallowing disorders after stroke.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen stayed in her study to focus on learning rehabilitation methods for common post-stroke speech disorders (aphasia, dysarthria) and swallowing disorders. She first watched a 45-minute special lecture, then read the courseware on speech therapy, swallowing function training, and compensatory strategies. She used her phone timer to simulate swallowing training movements and took two pages of notes. Finally, she completed the after-class exercises and focused on reviewing swallowing disorder assessment scales (such as the Kubota water swallow test).
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Study the basics of spinal cord injury rehabilitation.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen began studying the spinal cord injury rehabilitation module in her study. She watched a video course on spinal cord injury classification (ASIA classification), neurological level, and functional prognosis, for about 50 minutes. She then read the sections of the rehabilitation medicine textbook on acute-phase rehabilitation of spinal cord injury and prevention of complications (such as pressure ulcers and deep vein thrombosis), and highlighted key points with a highlighter. She completed a practice set of 10 multiple-choice questions, scored 70, and carefully analyzed the questions she got wrong.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Learning rehabilitation treatment techniques for spinal cord injury
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen studied rehabilitation treatment techniques for spinal cord injury in depth in her study, including physical therapy (muscle strength training, breathing training, bladder and bowel management), occupational therapy (activities of daily living training, use of assistive devices), and psychosocial rehabilitation. She watched two instructional videos of about 30 minutes each and read the course material on wheelchair selection and mobility training. She tried to mentally simulate developing a rehabilitation plan for a patient with a complete T10 injury and wrote down the key points.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Study comprehensive case analysis in neurorehabilitation.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen studied case analyses for the neurorehabilitation module in the study. She opened the three comprehensive cases provided in the course (including stroke hemiplegia with speech impairment, spinal cord injury paraplegia, and sequelae of traumatic brain injury) and analyzed them following the steps of rehabilitation assessment, rehabilitation goal setting, rehabilitation treatment plan, and prognosis evaluation. She first wrote down her own analysis in her notebook, then compared it with the course lecture videos one by one, identified her shortcomings, and summarized them. It took about 1.5 hours.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Complete the neurorehabilitation module summary and test
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen reviewed and summarized the neurorehabilitation module in her study. She quickly went over the notes and incorrect questions from the past six days and organized the knowledge framework into a mind map. Then she took the neurorehabilitation unit test provided by the course, which contained 30 multiple-choice questions and 2 short-answer questions, with a time limit of 60 minutes. She scored 86. She noted her weak areas (such as the details of bowel management for spinal cord injury) and planned to strengthen them later through literature review.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Studying the exercise therapy module and the remaining content.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen used her evening time after work from August 19 to 24, 2025, to study the exercise therapy module and the remaining course content in several sessions. She successively learned joint range-of-motion training and basic and advanced muscle strength training, and completed the entire course module through comprehensive case analysis and knowledge summarization. During the learning process, she took notes on key points and finally organized them into complete course notes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Studying exercise therapy - joint range of motion training
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen returned to the study in her home, opened the online course platform, and studied the joint range-of-motion training section in the exercise therapy module. She watched the instructional videos, followed the narration to learn the assessment methods for joint range of motion and the techniques for passive and active range-of-motion training, and took down key notes. After completing about 1.5 class hours of study, she organized her notes for future reference.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Study exercise therapy - basics of strength training
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen returned to the study at home and continued learning the basic strength training part of the exercise therapy module. Through the course materials, she studied the muscle strength grading standards, principles of resistance training, and how to use common equipment, jotting down key points as she watched. After completing two class hours of study, she made a preliminary organization of the day's notes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Studied exercise therapy - muscle strength training progression and hands-on practice
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen returned to the study at home and learned advanced content on muscle strength training along with simple hands-on demonstrations. She watched clinical case videos, understood the principles for formulating muscle strength training plans for different diseases, and practiced drafting a training plan in her notebook. After completing one lesson of study, she reviewed the notes from the previous two days.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Study remaining course content - comprehensive case analysis
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen returned to her home study and studied the comprehensive case analysis section of the remaining course content. She watched multiple cases of exercise therapy application in clinical scenarios, thought about how to integrate what she had learned into daily medical work, and wrote analysis notes. She completed 1.5 class hours of study and organized the key points of the cases.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Study remaining course content - summary and knowledge integration
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen returned to her home study and finished the remaining content of the course, including knowledge summary and module tests. She reviewed the notes for the entire exercise therapy module, connected the key points, completed the after-class self-test questions to consolidate her understanding, and organized complete course notes for archival.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: End-of-course quiz and note organization and archiving
subevent.description: On August 25, Yu Xiaowen completed the last lesson and all after-class quizzes. She then systematically organized the notes she had taken throughout the course, put them into the "Rehabilitation + Technology + Humanities" themed notes folder, marked key knowledge points, and completed the entire online course learning task.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: Promote an art therapy questionnaire survey based on pottery feedback from the nursing home.
description: On December 21, 2025, Yu Xiaowen compiled the positive feedback from the nursing home pottery activity and created a report document. The next morning, she had an in-depth conversation with Chen Zhiqiang, director of the rehabilitation department, and gained high recognition by citing concrete examples. That afternoon, following the director's instructions, she started designing a questionnaire survey on art therapy for the department.

subevent.name: Organizing feedback materials for the pottery activity at the nursing home
subevent.description: At the resident physician duty room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen compiled the positive feedback from the pottery activities previously held at the nursing home, including specific examples of increased participation and improved mood among the elderly, and produced a concise report document to fully prepare for the in-depth discussion with the director of the rehabilitation department the next day.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - resident on-call room at Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: In-depth conversation with the director of the rehabilitation department, citing feedback from the pottery class.
subevent.description: On the morning of December 22, 2025, Yu Xiaowen brought the compiled feedback materials from the nursing home pottery activity to the office of the chief of the Rehabilitation Department at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, where she had an in-depth exchange with Director Chen Zhiqiang. She described in detail examples of increased participation and improved mood among the elderly during the nursing home pottery activity. Director Chen highly recognized this, believing that these frontline experiences could serve as an empirical basis for advancing the art therapy questionnaire survey.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – Director's Office, Department of Rehabilitation, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Initiate the design of the art therapy questionnaire survey plan
subevent.description: After the in-depth conversation with the director of the rehabilitation department, Yu Xiaowen returned to the office that afternoon. Based on Director Chen's approval and instructions, she began to draft an art therapy questionnaire survey plan for internal departmental use, initially listing the survey purpose, target population, and questionnaire dimensions (such as key indicators like elderly participation and emotional improvement), and planned to complete and submit a first draft within two days.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – Resident Physician Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Went to visit the 'Digital Future' art exhibition and organized rehabilitation art inspiration.
description: At noon on November 29, 2025, Yu Xiaowen left home and drove to the Zhengdong New District Art Museum. In the afternoon, she toured the "Digital Future" art exhibition alone. She stood for a long time before the interactive piece "Life Map", interacting with it by touching the screen, thinking about the intersection of medicine and art, and taking out her notebook to record the inspiration. In the evening, after driving home, she systematically organized the ideas in her study, considering how to incorporate digital art techniques into visual aids for rehabilitation medicine or psychological interventions for patients, laying a foundation for the subsequent practice of integrating rehabilitation and art.

subevent.name: Go to the art museum
subevent.description: At noon on November 29, 2025, Yu Xiaowen set out from home and drove her personal car to the Zhengdong New District Art Museum, using the in-car navigation system to guide the way.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - en route

subevent.name: Visited the “Digital Future” art exhibition
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 29, 2025, Yu Xiaowen visited the Digital Future art exhibition alone at the Zhengdong New District Art Museum. The exhibition included projection installations, interactive digital works, and traditional paintings. She stood for a long time before the interactive piece Life Atlas, interacting with the work via a touch screen, and reflected on the intersection of medicine and art. She then took out her notebook and recorded her inspiration and observations.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengdong New District Art Museum

subevent.name: Return home to organize inspiration
subevent.description: On the evening of November 29, 2025, Yu Xiaowen drove home and systematically organized the inspirations she had noted in her notebook during the visit, thinking about how to integrate digital art expression techniques (such as interactive projection and data visualization) into visual aids in rehabilitation medicine or psychological intervention for patients, laying the foundation for future practice integrating rehabilitation and art.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City - Home Study Room

name: Swapped shifts to return to Luoyang before the Dragon Boat Festival; the whole family made zongzi to celebrate the holiday together.
description: On May 30, 2025, Yu Xiaowen swapped shifts with a colleague at Zhengzhou Central Hospital to make sure she had the Dragon Boat Festival off, then took a high-speed train back to her parents' home in Luoyang. She went to the food market with her mother, Li Xiuying, to buy ingredients such as glutinous rice and zongzi leaves. On the morning of May 31, the mother and daughter prepared the ingredients at home while her father, Yu Jianguo, gave instructions from his wheelchair. In the morning, the whole family wrapped more than thirty zongzi together, with her father demonstrating and correcting. In the afternoon, they boiled the zongzi, and in the evening the family sat around the table to taste them. Her mother said it was as lively as in Luoyang. After dinner, they organized and packed the zongzi, and the holiday atmosphere at home was warm and peaceful.

subevent.name: Shift Change Arrangement
subevent.description: In order to be able to reunite with her parents at home on the day of the Dragon Boat Festival, Yu Xiaowen negotiated a shift swap with her colleagues at Zhengzhou Central Hospital one day in advance, moving her duty on the day of the Dragon Boat Festival to another date, ensuring that she had the whole day off on May 31.
subevent.location: Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Buy ingredients for the Dragon Boat Festival
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 30, Yu Xiaowen took the high-speed rail from Zhengzhou back to her parents' home in Luoyang. After a short rest, she went with her mother Li Xiuying to the vegetable market near Xigong District, Luoyang, and bought glutinous rice, red dates, bamboo leaves, cotton thread, and other materials needed for making zongzi, as well as some fruit and vegetables.
subevent.location: Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province - Food Market

subevent.name: Prepare ingredients for zongzi.
subevent.description: On the morning of May 31, the Dragon Boat Festival, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying began preparing ingredients in the kitchen of their home at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang: they rinsed and soaked the glutinous rice, pitted and cleaned the red dates, soaked the bamboo leaves in warm water until soft and scrubbed them clean, and cut cotton thread into pieces for later use. Her father Yu Jianguo watched from his wheelchair nearby, occasionally reminding them to pay attention to the soaking time for the rice.
subevent.location: Home Kitchen - Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

subevent.name: The whole family wraps zongzi together
subevent.description: Around ten in the morning, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying spread out bamboo leaves and set up basins on the living room coffee table to start making zongzi. Her father Yu Jianguo moved his wheelchair closer to the coffee table, pointed out flaws in their technique as he watched, and personally demonstrated how to fold the bamboo leaves and press the glutinous rice firmly. The three chatted and laughed together as they made more than thirty neatly shaped zongzi. Yu Xiaowen learned very seriously, and her father wore a pleased smile on his face.
subevent.location: Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province - home living room

subevent.name: Boiled rice dumplings and shared them for tasting
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen put the wrapped zongzi into a large pot, added water to cover them, brought it to a boil over high heat, then turned down to low heat and simmered slowly. As the steam rose, the kitchen filled with the fragrance of glutinous rice and bamboo leaves. In the evening, the zongzi were cooked and taken out of the pot. Yu Xiaowen sat at the dining table with her parents, peeling the piping hot zongzi and dipping them in white sugar. Her mother smiled and said, ‘It's as lively as in Luoyang.’ The family was immersed in the warm atmosphere of the traditional festival.
subevent.location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Tidying, cleaning, and portioning zongzi
subevent.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen and her mother cleared the dining table together. They let the leftover zongzi cool, then divided them into plastic storage bags. Some were put in the refrigerator for the near future, and the rest were frozen. They cleaned the pots, bowls, plates, and tools that had been used, wiped the kitchen counter clean, and tidied up the remaining bamboo leaves and cotton string. Her father Yu Jianguo watched TV in the living room, chatting with them occasionally. The festive atmosphere at home was warm and peaceful.
subevent.location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Attended Zhang Jing's wedding and rushed to Wang Fang's wedding banquet, breaking the ice in their friendship.
description: On the morning of October 18, Yu Xiaowen served as a bridesmaid for Zhang Jing. In her toast, she deliberately mentioned, 'Today is also the wedding day of another close friend of mine. Though I can't be in two places at once, my sincerity can cross the distance.' Zhang Jing hugged her. At 7 p.m., she rushed to Wang Fang's wedding banquet and, with both hands, presented a handmade ceramic cup engraved with their initials and a small double-happiness bowl. Wang Fang received the gifts and immediately shed tears, saying, 'You actually remembered.' Xiaowen replied softly, 'I started making them in July.' The rift between them loosened. A week later, on Saturday, October 25, Wang Fang came to the door with a cake to thank her. On the living room bookshelf, she discovered Xiaowen's neatly arranged complete works of Bach and Mozart, and delightedly talked about their college playlists. In the afternoon sunlight, Brahms's 'Lullaby' played, and the old rift gradually healed amid the notes.

subevent.name: Serve as a bridesmaid at Zhang Jing's wedding and deliver a speech.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 18, 2025, Yu Xiaowen attended the wedding of her best friend Zhang Jing as a bridesmaid. During the wedding toast, Yu Xiaowen specifically said, 'Today is also my other good friend's wedding day. Although I can't be in two places at once, my heartfelt wishes can cross the distance.' Zhang Jing was moved and hugged her upon hearing this. The wedding took place in a hotel banquet hall in Zhengzhou, and the atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: A hotel banquet hall in Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Go to Wang Fang's wedding banquet to present a ceramic gift.
subevent.description: At 7 p.m. on October 18, 2025, Yu Xiaowen rushed from Zhang Jing's wedding to Wang Fang's wedding banquet. She held out with both hands a handmade ceramic cup engraved with their initials and a small double-happiness bowl as wedding gifts. Wang Fang took the gifts and immediately said tearfully, “You actually remembered.” Yu Xiaowen replied softly, “I started making them in July.” The rift between the two caused by work loosened at that moment. The wedding banquet was held in a restaurant in Zhengzhou.
subevent.location: A restaurant in Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Wang Fang came to the door to express her gratitude and repair their friendship
subevent.description: On Saturday, October 25, 2025, Wang Fang visited Yu Xiaowen's home with a cake to thank her for the wedding gift. While looking at the living room bookshelves, Wang Fang discovered Yu Xiaowen's neatly arranged complete collections of Bach and Mozart and excitedly reminisced about their college playlists. In the afternoon sunlight, the two played Brahms's “Lullaby” together, and the old rift gradually healed through the music. They chatted happily all afternoon, and their relationship was mended.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City, Henan Province - living room of Yu Xiaowen's rented apartment

name: Morning run to welcome the New Year.
description: On the morning of December 28, Yu Xiaowen went for a 5-kilometer morning run in Dongfeng Canal Riverside Park near Jingsan Road. Under the warm winter sun, she adjusted her breathing rhythm and finished the run in 32 minutes, with a pace of 6 minutes 24 seconds per kilometer. This was her third consecutive week of morning running, building up exercise data for the end of the year and making a good start toward staying active in the new year.

subevent.name: Process of a 5-kilometer morning run.
subevent.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen reached the Dongfeng Canal Riverside Park near Jingsan Road and began a 5 km morning run along the riverside track. Under the warm winter sun, she adjusted her breathing rhythm and maintained a steady pace, completing the entire run in 32 minutes, with an average pace of 6 minutes 24 seconds per kilometer. Along the way, she experienced the quiet of the park in the early morning and felt relaxed in body and mind.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Dongfeng Canal Riverside Park

subevent.name: Organizing and recording data after the morning run.
subevent.description: After finishing her morning run, Yu Xiaowen did 5 minutes of stretching and relaxation on a park bench, then walked home. Once home, she used a mobile fitness app to log the run: distance 5 km, duration 32 minutes, pace 6 minutes 24 seconds per kilometer, and reviewed her exercise accumulation from a third consecutive week of morning runs. She felt satisfied and thought this was a good start to keeping up her exercise routine in the new year.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Annual check-up detected anemia and started managing it
description: On October 15, Yu Xiaowen completed her annual physical examination at the Health Examination Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Her hemoglobin was 105g/L, indicating mild anemia. On October 17, she consulted internist Li Wei and was preliminarily diagnosed with mild iron-deficiency anemia. He recommended increasing red meat, animal liver, spinach, and other foods in her diet, and taking iron supplements. On October 18, she went to the supermarket and pharmacy to buy pork liver, beef, spinach, red dates, and ferrous sulfate tablets. Starting October 19, she began the dietary adjustments and took iron supplements daily, while keeping records for a follow-up visit.

subevent.name: Undergo the annual physical examination.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen completed her annual health check-up at the Physical Examination Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, including routine items such as blood draws and internal medicine examination. During the check-up, she told the nurse about recent symptoms such as dizziness and fatigue, and the nurse advised her to pay special attention to the complete blood count results.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Physical Examination Center.

subevent.name: Consult the doctor for a diagnostic opinion.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen contacted a colleague through the hospital's internal communication software or registered to consult an internal medicine doctor at the hospital, sent her physical examination report, and described her symptoms. Based on the hemoglobin level and clinical symptoms, the doctor initially diagnosed mild iron-deficiency anemia and suggested she add iron-rich foods to her diet (such as red meat, animal liver, and spinach), and possibly take oral iron supplements. At the same time, the doctor recommended rechecking indicators such as ferritin to confirm the cause of iron deficiency.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou City - Internal Medicine Consulting Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Purchase blood-nourishing foods and iron supplements.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen went to a supermarket and a pharmacy near her home. Following the doctor's advice, she bought iron- and vitamin C-rich foods such as pork liver, lean beef, spinach, and red dates, and also bought oral iron supplements such as ferrous sulfate tablets, preparing to start adjusting her diet and supplementing iron.
subevent.location: A supermarket and a pharmacy on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Started dietary adjustments and taking iron supplements
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen began following the doctor's orders to implement an anemia improvement plan: adding red dates and spinach juice at breakfast, eating red meat at lunch, and having pork liver with dinner. She also started taking oral ferrous sulfate tablets once a day and made sure to have orange juice to promote iron absorption. She also recorded her diet and medication in the memo app on her phone so that she could report back at the follow-up visit.
subevent.location: Henan Province - Zhengzhou - Home (No. 89 Jingsan Road)

name: Initiated rehabilitation treatment and work adjustments after the family started living together.
description: After the parents moved into the new home, on April 1 Yu Xiaowen contacted the rehabilitation center to schedule daily physical therapy for her father Yu Jianguo. On the same day, her mother Li Xiuying began handling household care. On April 3, Yu Xiaowen requested fewer night shifts from her department and switched to buying meals in the cafeteria to save energy. On April 5, Yu Xiaowen accompanied her father to complete the first physical therapy session. These adjustments marked the family’s entry into a new rhythm of life and set the stage for subsequent interactions.

subevent.name: Contacted the rehabilitation center to schedule physical therapy for her father.
subevent.description: At her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen called a rehabilitation center in Zhengzhou, consulted about the daily physical therapy service plan, fees, and schedule, booked daily physical therapy sessions for her father Yu Jianguo starting April 2, and completed the registration and payment procedures.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home

subevent.name: Her mother, Li Xiuying, began to take charge of household care.
subevent.description: Starting April 1, mother Li Xiuying officially took on the household chores, including preparing three meals, cleaning, and buying daily necessities, so that Yu Xiaowen could focus more on work and caring for her father. The family adapted to the new division of labor.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - home

subevent.name: Father Yu Jianguo received his first daily physical therapy session
subevent.description: According to the appointment made the previous day, Yu Xiaowen accompanied her father Yu Jianguo to the rehabilitation center to complete the first full physical therapy session. The therapist developed a personalized plan based on her father's physical condition. The session lasted about one hour, and Yu Xiaowen observed and learned the precautions so she could assist later.
subevent.location: Physical Therapy Room, Rehabilitation Center, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Request to the department to reduce night shift scheduling
subevent.description: While working at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen submitted a written request during her break to Zhang Lei, the department director, explaining that her father needed nighttime care from family members during postoperative rehabilitation, and requesting that her night shifts be reduced from twice a week to once, with day shifts arranged as much as possible. Director Zhang Lei understood the situation, agreed to the adjustment, and notified the scheduling staff to implement it in subsequent shift rosters.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City, Zhongyuan District - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Adjusted lifestyle habits and started buying meals at the cafeteria
subevent.description: To save time and energy on cooking so as to better balance work and family, Yu Xiaowen changed her habit of cooking at home from April 3 onward, mainly buying meals at the hospital cafeteria or community cafeteria and stocking up on some ready-to-eat food. This change gave her an extra 1-2 hours per day to spend with her father for rehabilitation and rest.
subevent.location: Zhongyuan District / Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - hospital cafeteria and community cafeteria

name: Returned to Luoyang for the National Day holiday to attend a high school reunion and visit home
description: On October 3, to attend a high school reunion, Yu Xiaowen took the high-speed rail from Zhengzhou back to Luoyang. In the evening, at a braised noodle restaurant in the old city, she had dinner with more than ten classmates including Chen Siyu, chatting freely about how they had been. After the gathering, she returned to her parents' home to rest.

subevent.name: Return from Zhengzhou to Luoyang
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 3, Yu Xiaowen took a high-speed train from Zhengzhou East Railway Station back to Luoyang Longmen Station, planning to attend the high school reunion in the evening. She ended her National Day holiday in Zhengzhou early and specially returned to Luoyang that day.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou East Station, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Luoyang Longmen Station, Luoyang

subevent.name: Attended a dinner gathering with high school classmates
subevent.description: From 6 p.m. to 9 p.m., Yu Xiaowen attended a high school reunion organized by Chen Siyu at a hand-pulled noodle restaurant in Laocheng District, Luoyang. More than a dozen old classmates sat together, eating hand-pulled noodles, chatting about their lives, and recalling funny high school stories. Yu Xiaowen shared her work experience at Zhengzhou Central Hospital and the news of her father's recovery, and the atmosphere was warm and lively.
subevent.location: A huimian noodle restaurant in Laocheng District, Luoyang City

subevent.name: Returning to her parents' home to rest
subevent.description: Around 9:30 p.m., after the gathering ended, Yu Xiaowen took a taxi back to her parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang. After arriving home, she briefly chatted with her parents about the gathering, then washed up and went to bed.
subevent.location: No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City (parents' home)

name: Organize first-aid key points and plan a departmental sharing session
description: After the assessment, she organized the key points of emergency care based on the latest guidelines, planning to share them at the next departmental study session to help improve the team's emergency skills, reflecting her pursuit of professional reliability as a young doctor.

subevent.name: Consult the latest first aid guidelines
subevent.description: After the assessment, Yu Xiaowen logged into the hospital intranet and medical databases, searched and downloaded the 2025 updated emergency guidelines commonly used in the department, such as cardiopulmonary resuscitation and anaphylactic shock, and highlighted the updates different from the old versions to prepare for later organizing key points.
subevent.location: Doctor's office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital.

subevent.name: Compile the first-aid essentials document.
subevent.description: In the on-duty rest room, Yu Xiaowen opened her laptop, compared the latest guideline content she had obtained with the department's existing emergency response plans, reorganized it according to the logical framework of "recognize-call for help-rescue-transport," and wrote a concise first-aid key points checklist, including key drug dosages, operational steps, and precautions. She saved it in both printed and electronic versions.
subevent.location: Doctor's duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Consulted the supervising doctor about the sharing arrangement.
subevent.description: Before work the next day, after the department morning meeting, Yu Xiaowen found her supervising teacher Li Wei and told him that she had compiled a set of key first-aid points and hoped to share it for 15 minutes at the next department study session. Li Wei agreed and suggested she add some typical cases recently encountered in the department. He also told her that next Wednesday afternoon's study session was already scheduled and would need to be moved to two weeks later, and suggested that she first find the teaching secretary to confirm the specific date.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department corridor at Central Hospital

subevent.name: Confirm the sharing date with the teaching secretary.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen contacted the department teaching secretary via the hospital's internal communication software, confirmed that there was an opening for the department's professional study session on Wednesday afternoon, October 8, 2025, two weeks later, and then requested to use that time for sharing key emergency care points. The teaching secretary said it could be arranged and reminded her to send the PPT to the department group three days in advance. Yu Xiaowen marked the sharing time on her calendar.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Central Hospital

subevent.name: Make a PPT for sharing
subevent.description: During the National Day holiday, Yu Xiaowen worked in the study at her home in Zhengzhou and turned materials such as first aid key points, flowcharts, medication dosage tables, and department resuscitation cases into a 15-page PPT courseware, and added an interactive Q&A section. After finishing, she sent it to teaching secretary Wang Hui for review, made fine adjustments based on the feedback, and finalized it.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Organizing materials and designing a PPT outline
subevent.description: On the first day of the National Day holiday, Yu Xiaowen, in the study at her home in Zhengzhou, categorized the materials she had previously organized, such as first-aid key points documents and past emergency rescue cases from the department, and designed the overall structure outline for a 15-page PPT, including sections such as cover, table of contents, first-aid procedures, drug dosages, case analysis, and interactive Q&A, clarifying the theme and key content of each page.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Create the text and table content for the PPT
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen, in the study of her home in Zhengzhou, began making a PPT according to the outline. She converted the key steps from the first-aid key points document into concise text, created a medication dosage table, inserted it into the corresponding pages, and adjusted basic formatting such as fonts and colors.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Add flowcharts and case examples.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen used PPT drawing tools to create an emergency flow chart, presenting the department's past rescue cases in a timeline or storyboard format, and annotated key points of the cases to improve the PPT content and make the courseware more intuitive and easy to understand.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Design an interactive Q&A segment and complete the first draft.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen added an interactive Q&A session at the end of the PPT, designed 3-5 first aid-related questions and answers, and set up animation effects. She also checked the overall coherence and consistency of the PPT and completed the first draft.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Send the PPT to the teaching secretary for review.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen sent the completed 15-page PPT courseware to the hospital teaching secretary, Wang Hui, by email, with a brief explanation asking her to review it and provide suggestions.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Fine-tune the PPT based on feedback
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen received review feedback from Wang Hui, the teaching secretary, and made revisions on several formatting and content details pointed out by Teacher Wang, such as adjusting the font size, supplementing the missing drug dosage, and re-typesetting, before finalizing the manuscript.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: Wednesday badminton showdown: the regular match with Lin Wei
description: On the evening of December 3, Yu Xiaowen had her regular Wednesday badminton match with Lin Wei at Yuyue Badminton Hall in Jinshui District. They battled for two full hours, and Yu Xiaowen's backhand drive had improved. Lin Wei joked, "It's the end of the year, and your skills have improved too." After playing, they drank hot soy milk at a stall outside the hall, talked about the pottery exhibition and New Year plans, and agreed to play two more matches before the end of the year.

subevent.name: Played a badminton match against Lin Wei
subevent.description: That evening, Yu Xiaowen and Lin Wei played a badminton match at Yuyue Badminton Hall, battling intensely for two hours. Yu Xiaowen had made obvious progress in her backhand drive technique, and Lin Wei smiled and praised her, saying, "The year is ending, and your skills have improved too."
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - Yuyue Badminton Hall

subevent.name: After playing ball, drank soy milk and chatted.
subevent.description: After the match, Yu Xiaowen and Lin Wei drank hot soy milk at a small stall outside the badminton hall, chatting about the upcoming pottery exhibition and their respective New Year plans.
subevent.location: Stall outside Yuyue Badminton Hall, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City

name: Resumed pottery creation at Zheng Guodong's invitation.
description: On November 15, Teacher Zheng Guodong invited Yu Xiaowen to participate in the annual works exhibition Between the Clay and suggested she could create a series. Inspired by the zodiac commemorative coin from the beginning of the year, Xiaowen decided to start making zodiac-patterned ceramic plates based on her parents' zodiac signs, the Rabbit and the Dog. That afternoon she returned to the studio to knead and shape the clay, and made a plan to create three times a week, officially starting work on the exhibition pieces.

subevent.name: Invitation and discussion on creative direction
subevent.description: At Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen received a phone call from Mr. Zheng Guodong inviting her to participate in the annual exhibition Between Clay, and he suggested that she create a series of works. In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen went to Zheng Guodong's studio in the Artist Park on Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, where they discussed the creative direction in person. Inspired by the zodiac commemorative coin from the beginning of the year, she decided to start creating zodiac-pattern ceramic plates based on her parents' zodiac signs (Rabbit and Dog).
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Nitu Zhijian Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Formulated a creative plan.
subevent.description: After discussing with Teacher Zheng Guodong at the Nitu Zhijian Pottery Studio, Yu Xiaowen developed a creation plan of three times a week (Monday, Wednesday, and Friday) and decided to first make zodiac pottery plates of the rabbit and the dog. She recorded the plan in the notes app on her phone, getting ready for the subsequent formal production.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Nitu Zhijian Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Knead the clay, shape it, and start making the first piece.
subevent.description: As planned, Yu Xiaowen began hands-on work at the Nitu Zhijian Pottery Studio. She took out the clay and prepared it by kneading, patting, and removing air bubbles. Then she used wheel throwing and hand-building techniques to shape the clay into the initial form of her first zodiac ceramic plate—the rabbit as the theme. Teacher Zheng Guodong guided her from the side, helping her adjust her technique to ensure the piece's basic form was stable. The whole process took about two hours. After finishing, she placed the semi-finished piece in a cool place to dry naturally.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Nitu Zhijian Pottery Studio

name: National Day family celebration of Father's independent walking
description: On October 1, National Day, her father was already able to walk steadily at home. The whole family ordered sweet and sour pork, braised noodles, and several home-style dishes at a restaurant near the community. Xiaowen raised her tea cup and made a toast with tea instead of wine. Her father said with emotion, 'This is the best meal of the year.' Her mother quietly wiped away tears. Confidence in recovery and family warmth were interwoven.

subevent.name: Family discusses celebration plans.
subevent.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying saw that her father Yu Jianguo was already walking steadily in the living room, so they decided to celebrate at a nearby restaurant at noon on National Day. After her father agreed, her mother called the restaurant to reserve a table and mentioned the dishes she wanted to order, such as sweet and sour pork tenderloin and stewed noodles.
subevent.location: At home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

subevent.name: The whole family walked to the restaurant.
subevent.description: Around noon, Yu Xiaowen, her father Yu Jianguo, and her mother Li Xiuying set out from home and walked slowly to a restaurant near the community. Her father walked slowly because he was still recovering, but he was in good condition, and her mother and Xiaowen accompanied and encouraged him along the way.
subevent.location: Inside the residential compound, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Celebrating by ordering food and dining at a restaurant
subevent.description: After arriving at the restaurant, Yu Xiaowen and her mother ordered sweet and sour pork tenderloin, braised noodles, and several home-style dishes that her father liked. During the meal, the three chatted at the table. Her father sighed about how difficult rehabilitation was, and the family encouraged each other, creating a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - restaurant near the neighborhood

subevent.name: Toasting in celebration and sharing heartfelt words with father.
subevent.description: As the meal was drawing to a close, Yu Xiaowen raised her teacup as a toast to her father in place of wine. Her father, Yu Jianguo, said with emotion, "This is the best meal of the year." Her mother, Li Xiuying, quietly wiped away tears. The three of them then continued chatting for a while.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - restaurant near the neighborhood

subevent.name: The whole family returned home
subevent.description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowen paid the bill, and the three of them walked back home. Her father said he was a bit tired but in good spirits. Her mother and Xiaowen helped him rest on the sofa, cleaned up the dining table, and shared the joy of his recovery.
subevent.location: At home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: At the department's year-end dinner, was named Annual Rising Star in Research and expressed thanks.
description: On the evening of December 27, at the department year-end dinner, Yu Xiaowen was named "Research New Star of the Year" for her published paper and research performance. In her speech, she sincerely thanked mentor Li Wei, colleagues Liu Qiang and Wu Min, friend Wang Fang, and Director Zhang Lei for their support along the way, marking her research role as having moved from independent work to recognition in multicenter collaboration.

subevent.name: Preparing the award acceptance speech.
subevent.description: During her lunch break in her office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen drew on her published paper and research experience to write in advance and practice the award-acceptance thank-you speech she might need at the department's year-end dinner that evening, highlighting the help of her supervising teacher Li Wei, colleagues Liu Qiang and Wu Min, her friend Wang Fang, and Director Zhang Lei.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Heading to the restaurant for the gathering
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen walked or drove to a booked Chinese restaurant near the hospital for the department's year-end dinner. On the way, she confirmed the meeting time with her friend Wang Fang via WeChat, feeling excited.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - on the way from the hospital to the restaurant.

subevent.name: Department year-end dinner in progress
subevent.description: All department members at Zhengzhou Central Hospital gathered in a private room at a nearby Chinese restaurant. Yu Xiaowen sat at the same table as her supervising physician Li Wei, colleagues Liu Qiang, Wang Fang, Wu Min, and Director Zhang Lei. They ate and chatted, reviewing the past year's work in a harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Chinese restaurant near the hospital

subevent.name: Director Zhang Lei announced the winner of the Annual Research Rising Star Award
subevent.description: During the dinner, Director Zhang Lei stood up and announced the results of the department's annual Research Rising Star selection, which was awarded to Yu Xiaowen. He praised Yu Xiaowen's outstanding performance in paper publication and clinical research, and invited her to the stage to receive the award and give a speech.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Chinese restaurant near the hospital

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowen's award acceptance speech.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen went on stage to receive the honorary certificate. In her speech on behalf of the recipients, she sincerely thanked her supervising teacher Li Wei for his careful guidance in research, her colleague Liu Qiang for his collaboration in data analysis, Wu Min for her assistance in patient management, her friend Wang Fang for her emotional support, and Director Zhang Lei for his overall leadership, saying she would take this as motivation to continue working hard.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Chinese restaurant near the hospital

subevent.name: Returned home after the meal gathering.
subevent.description: As the dinner gathering was drawing to a close, Yu Xiaowen said goodbye to her colleagues and drove alone back to her home on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District. Before going to bed, she photographed the award certificate and sent it to the family group to share the joy, and made a brief video call with her parents to report.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Started preparing for the attending physician qualification exam.
description: On the evening of December 28, while on night shift at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen received an encouraging phone call from her father Yu Jianguo and decided to make preparation for the attending physician qualification exam a key annual goal. That night, in the duty room, she made a daily early-morning study plan, planning to start reviewing core subjects such as internal medicine and neurology one hour earlier each day from January 2026. The next morning (December 29), after finishing her night shift, she returned home, searched online for the exam syllabus, bought reference books, and organized old textbooks, officially beginning her exam preparation.

subevent.name: Talked to her father on the phone and received encouragement.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 28, 2025, while on the night shift at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen received a phone call from her father Yu Jianguo in Luoyang. In the call, her father expressed concern about her career development, encouraged her to actively prepare for the Attending Physician Qualification Examination, and shared his experience of preparing for the Teacher Qualification Certificate exam all those years ago. Yu Xiaowen was deeply encouraged and decided to list preparing for the Attending Physician Qualification Examination as a key annual goal.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital - Duty Room

subevent.name: Made a daily early-morning review plan.
subevent.description: In the duty room, Yu Xiaowen used her spare time to make an exam preparation plan in her phone's memo app. She decided that from January 2026, she would get up one hour earlier every morning (changing the original 7:00 to 6:00) to review core subjects such as internal medicine, neurology, and diagnostics. She divided the review subjects into weekly modules, set alarm reminders, and planned to complete a systematic review of internal medicine and neurology in the first three months.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital - Duty Room

subevent.name: Organizing review materials and buying reference books
subevent.description: After finishing the night shift on the morning of December 29, Yu Xiaowen returned home, searched online for the official syllabus of the attending physician qualification exam, and compared various versions of review materials. She ordered two reference books via JD.com: Key Points for Internal Medicine Attending Physician Exam and Neurology Review Notes. She also organized the textbooks and courseware she had used during college, sorted them by subject, and put them in the desk drawer, making material preparations for the upcoming systematic exam review.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District - home study room.

name: Weekend afternoon: reading on the balcony and journal time.
description: On Saturday afternoon, December 19, Yu Xiaowen sat on the balcony of her rented apartment. She first read and annotated a chapter of The Birth of the Clinic, then flipped through Pottery: From Beginner to Advanced to relax, and finally wrote in her diary about cherishing such peaceful moments.

subevent.name: Reading The Birth of the Clinic
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen sat on a soft cushion on the balcony, opened 'The Birth of the Clinic,' which had been set aside for a long time, and immersed herself in Foucault's deconstruction of medical history. As she read, she made pencil notes on the pages, and it took her about an hour to finish one of the chapters.
subevent.location: Balcony of the apartment at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Reading Pottery: From Beginner to Advanced
subevent.description: After finishing the medical book, Yu Xiaowen switched to a leisure book, *Pottery: From Beginner to Advanced*, and relaxed by browsing the sections on hand-building techniques and glaze color combinations, imagining new shapes she could try at her next pottery class.
subevent.location: Balcony of the apartment at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Wrote a diary entry recording insights.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen took out her diary and wrote down today's mood on the balcony table: 'The moment when the fragrance of tea, the pages of a book, and the resonance of strings are in harmony is a gift life has given me.' She also briefly reviewed her reading experience and interest in pottery, expressing her appreciation for quiet moments.
subevent.location: Balcony of the apartment at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: French dessert experience class: unexpectedly discovering the joy of baking.
description: On May 24, her colleague Wang Fang dragged Yu Xiaowen to a French dessert experience class at a baking studio. Yu Xiaowen was not interested at first, but gradually became engaged while kneading dough and mixing fillings, and finally succeeded in making croissants and madeleines, experiencing the joy of handcrafted baking. After class, she brought the finished pastries home and planned to take them to her parents the next day, filled with unexpected joy.

subevent.name: Decided to attend the baking class upon invitation
subevent.description: On the morning of May 24, Yu Xiaowen was resting at her home on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, when her colleague and close friend Wang Fang suddenly visited or called, strongly inviting her to join a French pastry experience class at a baking studio that afternoon. Yu Xiaowen was not interested in baking at first, but couldn't resist Wang Fang's enthusiastic persuasion and finally agreed to go together.
subevent.location: Yu Xiaowen's apartment, Zhengzhou, Henan, China

subevent.name: Heading to the baking classroom
subevent.description: At about 1 p.m. on May 24, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang set off from Yu Xiaowen's residence, walking or driving to a baking studio near Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou. On the way they chatted; Wang Fang shared her interesting past experiences learning baking, and Yu Xiaowen gradually relaxed.
subevent.location: On the way to the baking studio, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Making French desserts in a hands-on class
subevent.description: On May 24 from 2 p.m. to 5 p.m., Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang attended a French pastry experience class in the baking classroom. Under the teacher's guidance, Yu Xiaowen learned to knead dough and prepare fillings. She was a bit clumsy and unaccustomed at first, but gradually became absorbed in the process, and finally succeeded in making croissants and madeleines. When the pastries came out of the oven, she felt a great sense of accomplishment and packed up her homemade desserts to take away.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Baking Studio

subevent.name: Return to residence and organize the results
subevent.description: Around 6 p.m. on May 24, after the trial class ended, Yu Xiaowen said goodbye to Wang Fang and returned alone to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, carrying the croissants and madeleines she had made herself. She carefully placed the desserts, took a photo as a keepsake, and felt unexpectedly delighted, planning to bring them back to Luoyang the next day for her parents to taste.
subevent.location: Yu Xiaowen's apartment, Zhengzhou, Henan, China

name: Attend a multidisciplinary consultation to discuss the stroke rehabilitation plan.
description: On October 16, Yu Xiaowen participated in multidisciplinary collaboration on the rehabilitation plan for a complex stroke patient. In the morning, she reviewed the medical records and electrical stimulation literature in her office and organized the key points of the neuromuscular electrical stimulation plan. In the afternoon, she attended a consultation with experts from multiple departments in the neurology department conference room, proposed neuromuscular electrical stimulation suggestions, and they were adopted. In the evening, she sorted out the consultation notes, recorded the opinions of each department and the comprehensive rehabilitation pathway, and deepened her understanding of the team-based rehabilitation model.

subevent.name: Preparing materials before the consultation
subevent.description: On the morning of October 16, Yu Xiaowen, in the residents' office of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, reviewed the medical records, imaging reports, and rehabilitation assessment records of the complex stroke patient, reviewed the recent literature on functional electrical stimulation she had studied, and organized the key points of a neuromuscular electrical stimulation plan that might be raised at the meeting.
subevent.location: Resident Physician Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Attended a multidisciplinary stroke rehabilitation consultation.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 16, Yu Xiaowen went to the neurology department meeting room on time as notified and participated in a multidisciplinary consultation together with the chief neurologist, a rehabilitation therapist, and a dietitian. At the meeting, each department analyzed the patient's condition in turn. Based on her prepared knowledge of functional electrical stimulation, Yu Xiaowen proposed adding neuromuscular electrical stimulation to the routine motor training and explained the clinical basis. The suggestion was recognized by the experts present and incorporated into the final rehabilitation plan.
subevent.location: Department of Neurology Conference Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Post-consultation follow-up and review
subevent.description: On the evening of October 16, after the consultation ended, Yu Xiaowen returned to her office, organized the consultation discussion into structured notes, recorded the opinions of each department and the final comprehensive rehabilitation pathway, and wrote down in her personal work log the takeaways and reflections from this multidisciplinary collaboration, deepening her understanding of the team-based rehabilitation model.
subevent.location: Resident Physician Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Volunteer service activity to honor the elderly, guiding seniors in experiencing pottery.
description: On the afternoon of September 14, Yu Xiaowen brought simple clay and tools to the nursing home in Jinshui District and led several elderly residents in trying to shape clay bowls. Their cheerful and focused responses deeply moved her, and the idea of using pottery for rehabilitation intervention became more concrete in her mind, laying the groundwork for a future application to study art therapy.

subevent.name: Go to the Jinshui District Nursing Home
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen drove to the nursing home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, carrying prepared clay and tools, and confirmed the activity arrangements by phone with the nursing home staff on the way.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - On the way from Jinshui District to the nursing home

subevent.name: Led the elderly in a pottery clay-sculpting activity.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen set up the pottery experience area in the nursing home activity room, patiently demonstrated clay kneading and shaping techniques, and encouraged several elderly residents to try making clay bowls. She assisted and corrected each of them one by one. The elderly residents appeared focused and happy, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.

participant.name: Elderly residents of the nursing home

subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District Nursing Home

subevent.name: Cleanup and exchange after the event
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen helped the nursing home staff clean up clay debris and wash tools, and properly placed the finished clay bowls made by the elderly. Then she chatted briefly with a few of the elderly residents, listening to their feelings and feedback. The elderly residents thanked her and expressed their happiness.

participant.name: Elderly residents of the nursing home

subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District Nursing Home

subevent.name: Returned home and recorded her thoughts and takeaways.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen drove home, sorted through the activity photos, and in her personal journal recorded in detail the elderly people’s positive reactions during the pottery session. Deeply moved, she organized her thoughts on using pottery for rehabilitation intervention, laying the groundwork for applying to an art therapy research project in the future.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home in Jinshui District

name: Guided father through rehabilitation training and helped mother adapt to the community
description: On March 21, Yu Xiaowen bought non-slip mats and handrails online, and on March 23 she installed them and completed the rehabilitation corner in the living room. Starting March 23, she urged her father to do home rehabilitation exercises every day after work, and on weekends she took her mother to get familiar with the food market, community health service center, and parks around the neighborhood, helping her parents gradually adapt to their new life in Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: Purchased rehabilitation assistive supplies online.
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen ordered non-slip mats and grab bars via Taobao on her phone to prepare supplies for her father's upcoming home rehabilitation training. She deliberately chose rubber mats with good anti-slip performance and grab bars with reliable load-bearing capacity, and chose expedited delivery to ensure they arrived as soon as possible.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - Home

subevent.name: Receive the package and install the rehabilitation corner equipment.
subevent.description: After receiving the non-slip mats and handrails she bought online, Yu Xiaowen used her lunch break to organize an area in the living room, laid the non-slip mats, installed the handrails, and completed the setup of the living room rehabilitation corner. She carefully checked the sturdiness of the installation and explained to her father, Yu Jianguo, the purpose and precautions of the rehabilitation corner.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - Home

subevent.name: Supervise father in doing home rehabilitation exercises every day.
subevent.description: Every evening after getting home from work, Yu Xiaowen first accompanies her father Yu Jianguo in the rehab corner of the living room for about 20 minutes of rehabilitation exercises, patiently guiding each movement to ensure it is done correctly, and recording her father's progress and discomfort. On weekends, the training time is adjusted to the morning or afternoon to ensure daily practice without interruption. She chats with her father while training to help him maintain a positive attitude.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - Home

subevent.name: Take my mother to get familiar with the vegetable market and the community health service center on the weekend
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, Yu Xiaowen took her mother Li Xiuying on foot to the vegetable market around the community, introducing her to the stall locations, shopping tips, and pricing characteristics. Then the two went to the nearby community health service center, letting her mother understand the registration process, department layout, and family doctor contracted services. Along the way, Yu Xiaowen also recommended several affordable breakfast shops nearby.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - area around Jingsan Road.

subevent.name: On the weekend, take mother to get familiar with the community park and the surroundings
subevent.description: On Sunday afternoon, Yu Xiaowen accompanied her mother Li Xiuying for a walk in the neighborhood park near the residential community. She showed her the fitness area, pavilions, and walking routes in the park, and taught her mother how to use the outdoor fitness equipment. After the walk, the two strolled along the street, pointing out daily service spots such as the bus stop, pharmacy, and bank, helping her mother gradually build a map of activities in the new community.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Jinshui District - Jingsan Road Street Park

name: Collaborating with Zhou Haoran to prepare a rehabilitation case-based paper.
description: From November 25 to 27, after video calls and discussions with Zhou Haoran, Yu Xiaowen decided to compile recent rehabilitation cases and submit them to the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine. Then, on the 26th, Yu Xiaowen screened and organized 14 typical cases; on the evening of the 27th, she drafted a writing plan for the first draft of the paper and confirmed the division of labor and schedule with Zhou Haoran.

subevent.name: Video call with Zhou Haoran to discuss the direction of the paper
subevent.description: On the evening of November 25, 2025, Yu Xiaowen had a video call via WeChat with her college classmate Zhou Haoran in Beijing from her home in Zhengzhou. Based on the data from their published paper and recent clinical experience, they discussed in depth the next research direction. They ultimately decided to compile rehabilitation cases successfully treated over the past six months, write a paper, and submit it to the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine, agreeing to complete the first draft by New Year's Day 2026. The call lasted about an hour, with clear division of labor: Yu Xiaowen was responsible for organizing case data and writing the first draft, while Zhou Haoran was responsible for guiding the paper's structure and reviewing it.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Organize recent rehabilitation case materials.
subevent.description: During the day on November 26, 2025, Yu Xiaowen used breaks during her shift and time after work, at her office in Zhengzhou Central Hospital and at home, to retrieve successful rehabilitation cases she had participated in treating over the past six months from the hospital case system, according to the classification criteria agreed upon with Zhou Haoran. She screened out 14 typical cases, extracted key indicators (such as admission/discharge functional scores, rehabilitation duration, treatment plans, etc.), and organized them into an Excel spreadsheet to prepare for writing the paper.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Formulate a writing plan for the first draft of the paper.
subevent.description: On the evening of November 27, 2025, at home, Yu Xiaowen formulated a detailed writing plan for the first draft of the paper based on the framework discussed with Zhou Haoran and the compiled case materials. She divided the draft into four parts: introduction, methods, results, and discussion, and assigned completion deadlines for each part (complete the main body of the first draft in the first week of December, and complete revisions before mid-December). Meanwhile, she shared the plan with Zhou Haoran via WeChat to confirm the division of work and schedule.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: Daily rehabilitation plan optimization practice
description: On November 10, 2025, Yu Xiaowen reviewed her exercise anatomy notes from the ACE Health Coach course before the morning ward rounds, then accompanied her supervising attending physician, Dr. Li Wei, on the department's morning rounds to learn about the recovery of Uncle Wang, a patient with post-stroke sequelae. After the rounds, applying what she had learned, she addressed the patient's insufficient weight-bearing on the affected side during weight shifting by adding resistance band training and adjusting the training plan, guiding the patient through the new movements on the spot. That afternoon, she observed the patient's training again, communicated with the rehabilitation therapist and confirmed that the patient's weight-shifting stability had improved, and summarized the case experience in her personal notes.

subevent.name: Preparation and review before morning rounds
subevent.description: Before the morning ward round on November 10, 2025, Yu Xiaowen was organizing medical records in the doctors' office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, reviewing notes from the exercise anatomy chapter of the ACE Health Coach course, focusing on key points of rehabilitation training for stroke sequelae, preparing for the ward round and treatment plan adjustments.
subevent.location: Doctor's office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital.

subevent.name: Attend the department's morning ward rounds
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen joined the department's routine morning rounds with her supervising attending physician Li Wei. In the neurology ward, she conducted a detailed assessment of a patient with post-stroke sequelae (Uncle Wang) for muscle strength, balance function, and occupational therapy progress, listened to the rehabilitation therapist's feedback, and recorded the day's rehabilitation priorities.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Neurology Ward, Central Hospital

subevent.name: Adjust the patient's weight-shift training plan.
subevent.description: After the morning ward round, Yu Xiaowen used the sports anatomy knowledge from the ACE course to address Uncle Wang's problem of insufficient weight bearing on the affected lower limb during weight shifting. She added elastic band resistance training (ankle dorsiflexion and eversion exercises) to the original plan, adjusted the angle and frequency of seated weight-shifting, and guided the patient through two new sets of exercises on the spot.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Central Hospital Rehabilitation Treatment Room

subevent.name: Observing patient training feedback and summary records
subevent.description: That afternoon she went to the rehabilitation therapy room again and observed Uncle Wang completing the training under the new plan under the guidance of the rehabilitation therapist. The patient said the movements were moderately difficult and his weight-shifting stability had improved. Yu Xiaowen communicated with the therapist to confirm that the patient had shown obvious progress that day, and recorded the case experience in her personal work notes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Central Hospital Rehabilitation Treatment Room

name: Anemia follow-up showed improvement; incorporated into nutrition education for patients.
description: At the end of November, a follow-up check showed hemoglobin had risen to 120g/L, and the anemia was corrected. After that, Yu Xiaowen incorporated her own experience into nutritional education for patients in the rehabilitation department, reminding stroke patients to pay attention to dietary iron supplementation and balanced nutrition. Her self health management and professional practice formed a virtuous cycle.

subevent.name: Hospital follow-up to recheck anemia indicators.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen went to the Laboratory Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital for a routine blood test follow-up. The results showed that hemoglobin had risen to 120 g/L, and the anemia had been corrected. She received the lab report and consulted the doctor to confirm that the anemia had improved.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Department of Laboratory Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Conducted patient nutrition education in the rehabilitation department.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen took advantage of the opportunity to provide nutrition education to patients in the rehabilitation department, combining her own experience of correcting anemia, to explain to stroke patients the importance of dietary iron supplementation and balanced nutrition. She emphasized pairing iron-rich foods with vitamin C and reminded them to avoid dietary misconceptions that affect iron absorption. During the education session, she interacted with patients and answered questions.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Rehabilitation Department Education Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Barely completed the online statistics course and mastered basic statistical methods.
description: Continuing the online statistics course that was postponed in March due to family matters, from April 1 Yu Xiaowen used fragmented time such as her father's afternoon naps and her night shifts to catch up, and finally passed the completion assessment on April 20, mastering basic methods such as the t-test and chi-square test, laying a preliminary foundation for subsequent research data analysis.

subevent.name: Learning basic statistics content.
subevent.description: From April 2 to April 9, Yu Xiaowen used fragmented time, such as her father's afternoon naps and night shifts, to study the basic statistics module of an online statistics course, either at home or in the hospital duty room. The module covered data description, probability distributions, and the principles of hypothesis testing. She consolidated the basics by watching instructional videos and completing after-class exercises, laying the groundwork for later studying inferential statistics.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home and hospital duty room

subevent.name: Learning descriptive statistics
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen, at her home in Zhengzhou, used the fragmented time after her father's afternoon nap to open an online statistics course and study the data description section in the basic statistics module. She watched instructional videos to learn concepts such as mean, median, and standard deviation, and recorded key formulas and points in her notebook. After the lesson, she completed 5 accompanying multiple-choice exercises to consolidate her understanding of central tendency and dispersion.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Studied the basics of probability distributions
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen was in the duty room at Zhengzhou Central Hospital and used the gaps in her night shift to study the probability distribution module of basic statistics.
