She watched instructional videos on binomial and normal distributions and, after finishing the shift's medical records, took a quiz on her mobile app. She focused on memorizing the characteristics of the normal distribution and the standard score formula, and briefly shared her progress with her colleague Wang Fang.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - On-call Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Studying the principles of hypothesis testing
subevent.description: During her weekend break at home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen systematically studied the principles of hypothesis testing in basic statistics. She watched videos explaining concepts such as the null hypothesis, alternative hypothesis, significance level, and p-value, and followed the course to practice the steps of manually calculating a one-sample t-test. She summarized the principles into a mind map and saved it to her phone notes for later review.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - living room at home

subevent.name: Complete the comprehensive practice after class
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen used her pre-bedtime time at night to complete the comprehensive after-class exercises for the Basic Statistics module. She answered 15 mixed multiple-choice questions covering three sub-topics—data description, probability distributions, and hypothesis testing—then analyzed the incorrect questions one by one and consulted the course handouts to deepen her understanding. After finishing, she sent herself screenshots of the wrong questions and planned to review them again the next day.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Review basic statistics content.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen was in the duty room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, using her lunch break to quickly review the core knowledge points of the basic statistics module. She looked through her previous notes and mind maps, focusing on reviewing the steps of hypothesis testing and common mistakes. She planned to ensure full mastery before the next stage began, so she re-did a t-test practice problem to confirm her understanding.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - On-call Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Learning t-test and chi-square test methods
subevent.description: From April 11 to April 19, building on the earlier foundation, Yu Xiaowen focused on learning inferential statistical methods including the t-test (one-sample, independent-sample, paired-sample) and the chi-square test. Through case analysis and data analysis exercises on the course platform, she gradually mastered their practical application in medical research, organized personal study notes, and prepared for the final assessment.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home and hospital duty room

subevent.name: Study the one-sample t-test.
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen learned the theoretical principles of the one-sample t-test and the SPSS operation steps through an online course platform. She practiced independently using the medical case data provided in the course (such as the effect of a drug on blood pressure) and took study notes, focusing on understanding the applicable conditions of this test in medical research.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Learning the independent samples t-test
subevent.description: On her day off, Yu Xiaowen, at her home in Zhengzhou, studied the statistical principles and application scenarios of the independent samples t-test through course videos, used SPSS software to complete data analysis exercises for two independent groups (e.g., treatment group and control group), and compiled common misuse cases to deepen her understanding of the method's applicability.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Learning the paired-sample t-test
subevent.description: While resting in the duty room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen used the mobile course platform to study the formula and cases of the paired samples t-test, conducted simulated analyses using real clinical before-and-after data (such as changes in patient indicators before and after treatment), and drew flowcharts by hand to aid memory.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Hospital duty room

subevent.name: Learn the chi-square test
subevent.description: At home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen focused on learning the theoretical knowledge and SPSS operation of the chi-square test, including the fourfold table chi-square and R×C table chi-square. She practiced using the categorical variable data analysis tasks provided by the course platform, such as a study on the association between disease and smoking, and completed the after-class quiz.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Comprehensive practice and organizing notes
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen comprehensively reviewed the methods of t-tests and chi-square tests, independently completed the comprehensive case analysis questions on the course platform (including the selection of multiple testing methods and interpretation of results), and systematically organized her personal study notes, marking common errors and key points, to prepare for the final assessment.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Take the final assessment for the online statistics course
subevent.description: On April 20, Yu Xiaowen logged into the course platform within the specified time and took the final assessment for the online statistics course. The assessment covered basic statistics, the t-test, the chi-square test, and other knowledge points. Through exam questions and case analysis, she successfully passed the assessment, received the course completion certificate, and mastered basic statistical methods.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Organized study notes and review summaries
subevent.description: On April 21, after the assessment, Yu Xiaowen systematically organized the electronic notes and practice records from the course, summarized the key steps, applicable conditions, and medical cases for the t-test and chi-square test, and formed a personal knowledge base, laying an initial foundation for future research data analysis.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Introductory community pottery class
description: On the evening of January 2, 2025, Yu Xiaowen signed up for and attended her first pottery class at the "Between Clay" pottery studio in Zhengzhou. She then continued classes on January 4, 9, and 11, systematically learning basic techniques such as kneading clay, hand-building, and coiling. After class, she practiced independently and exchanged messages online with her classmate Su Ya. In the end, she completed a piece on her own and got to know the teacher Zheng Guodong and her classmate Su Ya.

subevent.name: Sign up for the community pottery class.
subevent.description: On the evening of January 2, 2025, Yu Xiaowen went to the Between the Clay Pottery Studio, formally signed up for the introductory course, paid the tuition, and received the basic tools and materials. At the studio she met Su Ya, who had also enrolled for the same session; after a brief exchange, they agreed to talk more during class.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - "Between the Clay" Pottery Studio

subevent.name: First pottery class (kneading clay and basic hand-building).
subevent.description: On the night she signed up, Yu Xiaowen attended the first foundational course. Teacher Zheng Guodong started with clay-kneading techniques, explaining the properties of clay and basic hand-building skills. Under his guidance, Yu Xiaowen tried making a small bowl. During the process, she exchanged practice insights with Su Ya. After class, she left the semi-finished piece in the studio for later refinement.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - "Between the Clay" Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Second pottery class (advanced hand building techniques)
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen attended the second class on Saturday morning. Teacher Zheng Guodong demonstrated and guided advanced hand-building techniques, such as closing the cup rim and finishing the surface of the vessel. Yu Xiaowen practiced making a small teacup. During the break, she exchanged problems she had encountered with Su Ya, and they encouraged each other.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - "Between the Clay" Pottery Studio

subevent.name: After-class self-practice and exchange
subevent.description: At home, Yu Xiaowen used her spare time to review clay wedging and hand-shaping techniques, and filmed her own practice videos. She exchanged pottery learning insights with Su Ya on WeChat, shared their practice photos, gave feedback on each other's work, and agreed to communicate and prepare in advance before the next class.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Third pottery class (coil building technique)
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen attended the third class on Thursday evening. Teacher Zheng Guodong taught the coil-building technique, from rolling out clay coils to forming shapes by coiling. Yu Xiaowen tried making a small vase and, under the teacher's guidance, adjusted her force and speed, finally completing a rough shape. Su Ya was also practicing nearby, and the two helped each other with coil building during the break.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - "Between the Clay" Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Fourth pottery class (independent completion of a work and course summary)
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen attended the fourth and final session of the introductory pottery course on Saturday morning. She independently completed a ceramic cup, from kneading and shaping the clay to finishing it. Instructor Zheng Guodong gave detailed feedback and encouraged her to advance to the next level. After class, Yu Xiaowen exchanged contact information with Su Ya, and they agreed to attend advanced courses at the same studio together later.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - "Between the Clay" Pottery Studio

name: Birthday family party and long annual reflection: complete friendship, self-reconstruction
description: On the afternoon of December 29, her mother Li Xiuying, together with close friends Zhang Jing, Sun Yue, Wang Fang, Lin Wei, and pottery partner Su Ya, secretly arranged a family party and prepared longevity noodles. In the evening, Yu Xiaowen came home and was pleasantly surprised to see the decorations. Sun Yue played Mozart's "Serenade," and music flowed in the candlelight. Wang Fang gave her pottery tools; Zhang Jing gave her a deluxe zodiac commemorative coin collection album; Sun Yue gave her a medical English dictionary; Lin Wei gave her a badminton racket pendant; Su Ya and Zheng Guodong jointly gave her a custom pottery throwing knife. Yu Xiaowen was moved to tears and hugged every friend, and during this time she received an online blessing from high school classmate Liu Yang. Late at night, she wrote nearly 200 characters of year-end reflections in her diary, looking back on how clay, the paper, her father standing up, her mother's small dish, Bach's melody, and candlelight together defined the year. She realized that "in the spinning of the pottery wheel, I felt a peace akin to eternity," summarized the changes in finances, family, and career, and finally accepted herself, learning to guard her own flame.

subevent.name: Mother and her girlfriends secretly arranged a birthday party
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 29, 2025, Yu Xiaowen's mother Li Xiuying arrived in Zhengzhou early from Luoyang and secretly decorated for the birthday party with close friends Zhang Jing, Sun Yue, Wang Fang, Lin Wei, and Su Ya at Yu Xiaowen's home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. Li Xiuying personally cooked Yu Xiaowen's favorite hulatang and longevity noodles in the kitchen. Zhang Jing decorated the living room with ribbons and balloons. Sun Yue set up the equipment to play Mozart's Serenade. Wang Fang placed the hand-wrapped pottery tool gift box on the coffee table. Lin Wei and Su Ya neatly arranged the custom pottery trimming knife jointly given by Zheng Guodong along with the other gifts. The whole arrangement took about two hours, and everyone spoke softly to avoid revealing the surprise in advance.
subevent.location: Home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: Birthday party in progress: candlelight, music, and gifts
subevent.description: In the evening of December 29, 2025, Yu Xiaowen returned home after work and was moved by the surprise party prepared by her mother and close friends. Sun Yue played Mozart's "Serenade" (Eine kleine Nachtmusik), candles lit up, and Li Xiuying brought out longevity noodles. In the warm atmosphere, Wang Fang gave her a set of professional pottery tools, Zhang Jing gave her a deluxe zodiac commemorative coin album, Sun Yue gave her a medical English dictionary, Lin Wei gave her a badminton racket charm, and the custom throwing tool co-given by Su Ya and pottery teacher Zheng Guodong was handed over by Su Ya. Yu Xiaowen was moved to tears and hugged each friend and her mother in turn, thanking them for their thoughtfulness. The party lasted about two hours. Everyone chatted while eating noodles, and the atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
subevent.location: Home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: Received an online greeting from high school classmate Liu Yang.
subevent.description: During the birthday party on December 29, 2025, Yu Xiaowen received a birthday greeting message sent via WeChat from her high school classmate Liu Yang. Liu Yang works in Shenzhen and could not attend, but specially recorded a blessing video and attached an e-card, reminiscing about their time studying together in high school. Yu Xiaowen replied with thanks during a break in the party and briefly exchanged updates with Liu Yang.
subevent.location: Home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou.

subevent.name: Wrote a diary entry of nearly 200 words with annual reflections.
subevent.description: Late on the night of December 29, 2025, after the party ended, Yu Xiaowen sat alone at her desk, opened her diary, and wrote nearly 200 words of year-end reflections. She looked back on the bits and pieces of the past year related to clay, her thesis, her father standing up, her mother's small dishes, Bach's melodies, and candlelight, and realized, “In the rotation of wheel-throwing, I touched a calm resembling eternity.” She summed up that financially, she had achieved steady growth through fund investment; in family relationships, her father had recovered and her mother often came to accompany her; professionally, she had passed an important assessment. In the end, she accepted herself and resolved to guard the fire in her heart. The diary was written in the study at home and took about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Study at home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

name: Preparing for the attending physician exam: friction and reconciliation after her mother rearranged the mistake cards, and fragmented study time broken up by night shifts.
description: Since August, her mother had been paying attention to Xiaowen's schedule and nagging her about staying up late and getting up late. On the evening of September 8, Yu Xiaowen discovered that all the mistake cards arranged in review order on the left side of her desk had been moved to the right side and rearranged by date, leaving her unable to find the nervous system summary card. Frustrated, she confided her feelings to Zhang Jing. At breakfast on September 9, her mother handed her a handwritten note: “Mom was afraid you couldn't find the old ones, so I copied a new set for you. See if it's right.” Xiaowen then realized that her mother had not only sorted the blurry cards but also recopied them word by word, and her nose suddenly stung with emotion. During a break in the night shift on September 12, she forced herself to look through the mistake collection despite exhaustion, but after only a few pages she was interrupted by the call bell, and she deeply felt the difficulty of preparing for the exam.

subevent.name: Confided in her best friend after discovering the cards had been organized.
subevent.description: In the study of her home in Luoyang, Yu Xiaowen found that her mother had moved all the mistake cards, which had been arranged in review order on the left side of the desk, to the right side and rearranged them by date. Unable to find the nervous system summary card, she became irritated and vented her dissatisfaction and helplessness to her best friend Zhang Jing via WeChat.
subevent.location: Luoyang City, Henan Province - home study room

subevent.name: Mother handed over a handwritten note, a warm reconciliation.
subevent.description: At breakfast on September 9, her mother Li Xiuying handed Yu Xiaowen a handwritten note that read: "I was afraid you couldn't find the old one, so I copied it again for you. See if it's right." Yu Xiaowen then realized her mother had not only sorted out the blurry flashcard of wrong answers but also recopied it word by word. Her nose tingled instantly, and the mother and daughter reconciled warmly.
subevent.location: Luoyang City, Henan Province - Home Dining Room

subevent.name: Fragmented study during the night shift was interrupted
subevent.description: Late at night on September 12, Yu Xiaowen was on night shift at the inpatient department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. During a break at work, fighting fatigue, she opened her mistake notebook to review, but after only a few pages she was interrupted by the ward call bell and had to stop studying to attend to a patient, deeply feeling how difficult preparing for the exam was.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Inpatient Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: “Between the Clay” Annual Works Exhibition: Ceramic Therapy and Friendship Gifts
description: From December 13 to 15, Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya jointly held the annual exhibition "Between the Clay," with the section theme "Time Heals." The exhibition displayed bowls, cups, and plates created over the year, four ceramic plates with zodiac commemorative coin patterns, and clay slabs pressed with the texture of her father's grip ball. Pottery teacher Zheng Guodong commented, "Your works have gained emotion this year, and next year they will have stories." The customer who had custom-ordered the zodiac Rooster plates in September came as promised, was satisfied with the four finished pieces, placed an order, and introduced friends. Colleague Wang Fang bought a small cup as a belated bridesmaid gift. Friends including Zhang Jing, Sun Yue, and Lin Wei came to show support. Through this healing pottery creation, sales and friendship came together.

subevent.name: Exhibition setup preparation.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya arranged the exhibition area at the 'Between Clay' pottery studio, displaying the bowls, cups, and plates created over the year, four ceramic plates with zodiac commemorative coin patterns, and ceramic panels with the texture of Father's grip ball according to the theme 'Time Heals', and set up exhibition labels and lighting. Pottery teacher Zheng Guodong came to provide technical guidance and helped adjust the placement of the exhibits.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Exhibition Day One: Opening and Reception
subevent.description: The annual works exhibition "Between the Clay" officially opened. Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya greeted visitors in the exhibition area. The customer who had customized a zodiac rooster ceramic plate in September came as promised and was very satisfied with the four finished pieces, placing an order on the spot and recommending friends to come. After browsing the works, Zheng Guodong commented, "Your works have emotion this year; next year they will have stories." Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya introduced their creative concepts to the customer and the teacher.

participant.name: Customer (the one who ordered the custom zodiac rooster ceramic plate)

subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

subevent.name: The day after the exhibition: friends came to show support.
subevent.description: On the second day of the exhibition, friends such as colleague Wang Fang, childhood friend Zhang Jing, college classmate and best friend Sun Yue, and badminton partner Lin Wei came to visit one after another. Wang Fang took a liking to a small cup and bought it as a belated bridesmaid gift. Zhang Jing, Sun Yue, and Lin Wei exchanged creative insights with Yu Xiaowen and took photos. Some friends picked out other small ceramic pieces on the spot to show their support.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Exhibition closing and sales summary.
subevent.description: On the last day of the exhibition, Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya received a small number of new visitors. Teacher Zheng Guodong came again, reviewed the exhibition with the two, and gave suggestions for future creation. Near closing time, Yu Xiaowen recorded the proceeds from some sold works and thanked her friends for their support. The exhibition area began preliminary tidying up, preparing for the formal dismantling the next day.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Exhibition teardown and wrap-up
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya carried out the dismantling of the exhibition at the “Between the Clay” pottery studio. They carefully packed the unsold works and transported them back to their respective homes, then cleaned the display tables and boards. Teacher Zheng Guodong helped handle the exhibition labels and lighting equipment. The three briefly discussed how to store the unsold works. Yu Xiaowen said she would give some of the works to the friends who had come to support her as keepsakes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio

description: On Thanksgiving Day, November 27, Yu Xiaowen sent gratitude messages to instructor Li Wei, Director Zhang Lei, her parents, and her older brother, thanking them for their support in her career and life. In the evening, she also called Wang Fang to thank her for their companionship and mutual encouragement. This small ritual made her cherish the relationships around her even more.

subevent.description: On Thanksgiving Day, November 27, 2025, Yu Xiaowen, at her home in Zhengzhou, used her phone to compose and send a Thanksgiving message to her mentor Li Wei, thanking him for the careful guidance and support he had provided in clinical skills and career development since she began practicing medicine.

subevent.name: Send a gratitude message to Director Zhang Lei
subevent.description: On Thanksgiving Day, November 27, 2025, Yu Xiaowen sent a gratitude message via WeChat from her home in Zhengzhou to Zhang Lei, the department director, thanking him for his management of the department and his recognition and encouragement of her work.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Send parents a message of gratitude
subevent.description: On Thanksgiving Day, November 27, 2025, Yu Xiaowen, at her home in Zhengzhou, sent a gratitude message to her father Yu Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying via the family WeChat group, thanking her parents for their years of upbringing and their care and support in her daily life.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Send a thank-you message to her brother
subevent.description: On Thanksgiving Day, November 27, 2025, Yu Xiaowen sent a private gratitude message to her older brother Yu Xiaofeng via WeChat from her home in Zhengzhou, thanking him for his advice and companionship in life and work all along.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Called Wang Fang to express gratitude.
subevent.description: On the evening of Thanksgiving Day, November 27, 2025, Yu Xiaowen had a phone call with her colleague and good friend Wang Fang from her home in Zhengzhou, thanking each other for their companionship and mutual encouragement at work and sharing reflections on Thanksgiving.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Under the guidance of the supervising teacher, independently completed the first rehabilitation assessment report.
description: On the afternoon of September 9, Yu Xiaowen used breaks at work to review muscle strength grading, range of motion measurement, and balance and activities of daily living assessment scales, preparing to independently complete her first rehabilitation assessment. On September 10, under the guidance of her supervising teacher Li Wei, she assessed Zhao Zhiqiang, a stroke patient with hemiplegia, for muscle strength, range of motion, balance function, and activities of daily living. She then wrote a complete rehabilitation assessment report. Teacher Li reviewed it, gave his approval, and suggested revisions, and Xiaowen finalized it after making the changes.

subevent.name: Studied rehabilitation assessment knowledge in advance.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of September 9, Yu Xiaowen used a break at work to consult the department's rehabilitation assessment guidelines and textbooks, reviewing muscle strength grading, joint range-of-motion measurement methods, and assessment scales for balance function and activities of daily living (such as the Barthel Index and the Fugl-Meyer Scale), in preparation for independently completing her first rehabilitation assessment the next day.
subevent.location: Office of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou City

subevent.name: Prepare evaluation tools and equipment
subevent.description: At 8:00 a.m. on September 10, Yu Xiaowen arrived early at the rehabilitation treatment room and checked the required assessment tools: goniometer, dynamometer, handgrip dynamometer, balance board, stopwatch, and various assessment forms. After confirming the tools were in good condition, she moved them to the bedside of Zhao Zhiqiang, a hemiplegic patient after stroke, and prepared to begin the assessment.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Rehabilitation Treatment Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Perform muscle strength and joint range-of-motion assessment
subevent.description: On the morning of September 10, from 9:00 to 10:30, under the observation of her supervising teacher Li Wei, Yu Xiaowen assessed patient Zhao Zhiqiang (hemiplegia after stroke, left limb impairment) for muscle strength (using the Lovett grading method) and joint range of motion (measured with a universal goniometer). She successively assessed the active and passive range of motion of the shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, and ankle joints on the patient's normal right side and hemiplegic left side, and recorded muscle strength. Li Wei recorded and observed the standardization of the procedure.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Rehabilitation Treatment Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Assess balance function and activities of daily living
subevent.description: On the morning of September 10, from 10:30 to 11:30, Yu Xiaowen continued to assess patient Zhao Zhiqiang's balance function (using the Berg Balance Scale, including items such as sit-to-stand, turning, and standing with eyes closed) and activities of daily living (using the Barthel Index, asking the patient about self-care in eating, dressing, toileting, bathing, etc.). During the assessment, Li Wei reminded her to pay attention to the patient's fatigue level and allow timely rest. In the afternoon, from 14:00 to 15:00, Yu Xiaowen organized all the assessment data and calculated the scores on each scale.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Rehabilitation Treatment Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Write the rehabilitation assessment report
subevent.description: On the afternoon of September 10, from 15:00 to 17:00, Yu Xiaowen wrote her first complete rehabilitation assessment report in the doctors' office based on the assessment data and records from the morning. The report included the patient's basic information, medical history summary, various assessment results (muscle strength, joint range of motion, balance function, activities of daily living), analysis of existing problems, and preliminary rehabilitation recommendations. She followed the hospital's medical record writing standards, used medical terminology, and signed it by hand.
subevent.location: Office of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou City

subevent.name: Receive the supervising teacher's comments and revisions
subevent.description: From 17:00 to 17:30 on the afternoon of September 10, Yu Xiaowen submitted the rehabilitation assessment report she had written to her supervising teacher Li Wei for review. Teacher Li affirmed the overall structure and data accuracy of the report, while pointing out several detailed issues: the unit annotations for joint range of motion data should be unified, the description of activities of daily living should be more specific, and the recommendations section should incorporate the patient's personal goals. Yu Xiaowen revised and improved the report on the spot based on the feedback, and finally submitted the final version. Li Wei signed to confirm the report.
subevent.location: Office of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou City

name: Developing an evening tea-drinking habit: a new ritual for self-soothing.

subevent.name: Bought a white porcelain tea set online
subevent.description: At her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen searched on Taobao via her phone and placed an order for a simple white porcelain tea set (including teapot and teacups) for brewing tea in the evening. She chose Jin Junmei and ripe pu-erh as the accompanying teas, paid, and waited for delivery.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: First time brewing tea and starting an evening tea-drinking habit
subevent.description: On the evening of December 6, Yu Xiaowen used the newly arrived white porcelain tea set in the living room of her home in Zhengzhou to brew a pot of Jin Junmei black tea. While sipping tea, she read a medical journal and recorded in her diary the start of this new habit, deciding to replace evening coffee with tea. The warm tea made her feel relaxed, officially beginning a new ritual of evening tea as a way to soothe herself.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - living room at home

subevent.name: Sustained habit of drinking tea during work breaks
subevent.description: From December 7 to the end of the year, Yu Xiaowen would brew herself a pot of Jin Junmei or ripe pu-erh tea after night shifts or during breaks in day shifts, either at home or in the rest room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Her tea time was often accompanied by reading medical journals, writing in her diary, or video chatting with her best friend Sun Yue. This habit gradually became a fixed ritual for soothing her nerves, and it also gave her and Sun Yue more common topics; the two often exchanged tea-tasting insights over video calls.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – home or hospital rest room.

subevent.name: Brewed Jin Jun Mei at home after the night shift
subevent.description: After finishing her night shift, Yu Xiaowen returned to her home in Jinshui District at around 10 p.m. She took out Jin Jun Mei tea from the tea canister and brewed it with hot water at 80°C. Sipping the hot tea, she sat at her desk, flipped through the Chinese Medical Journal that she had not finished reading that day, and used a fountain pen to record the typical cases and reflections from the night shift in her diary. The whole process took about one hour, after which she washed up and rested.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: In the hospital lounge, brewing ripe pu-erh tea and video-calling Sun Yue
subevent.description: At 3 p.m. during a break in her day shift, Yu Xiaowen went to the department lounge at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, boiled water with an electric kettle, and brewed a pot of Yunnan ripe Pu'er tea. She took out her phone and made a video call via WeChat to her friend Sun Yue. The two chatted while drinking tea; Sun Yue had also brewed tea. They exchanged notes on the types of tea they had been drinking recently and their thoughts. Yu Xiaowen also shared a research abstract about the antioxidant effects of tea polyphenols that she had read in a medical journal. The video call lasted about 40 minutes before she returned to work.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - hospital lounge

subevent.name: Brewing Jin Jun Mei tea and writing a diary in the hospital lounge
subevent.description: During her lunch break, Yu Xiaowen entered the hospital break room, took out a Jin Junmei tea bag and a thermos cup she carried with her, and brewed it with hot water. She sat alone at a small table by the window, opened her diary, and wrote down her thoughts on recent work and her duty schedule for the holiday. Accompanied by the aroma of tea, she also put together a review plan for the following week. After about 40 minutes, she packed away her tea things and notebook and returned to the ward to continue working.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - hospital lounge

name: Enjoy an all-Beethoven symphony concert
description: Yu Xiaowen had always wanted to experience a symphony live. On the evening of November 22, 2025 (Saturday), she went alone to the Concert Hall of Henan Art Center in Zhengzhou to enjoy a Beethoven symphony concert. The concert was performed by the Zhengzhou Philharmonic Orchestra, with repertoire including the Coriolan Overture and Symphony No. 3 (Eroica). In the stirring Eroica Symphony, she released work pressure. After the performance, she drove home, ending a pleasant evening.

subevent.name: Enjoy an all-Beethoven symphony concert
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen entered the concert hall of the Henan Art Center at 7:30 p.m., found her seat, and sat down. The concert was performed by the Zhengzhou Philharmonic Orchestra, with repertoire including the Coriolan Overture, Symphony No. 3 (Eroica), and others. Yu Xiaowen listened with full attention, releasing her work pressure in the stirring Eroica Symphony, and applauded for a long time after the performance ended.
subevent.location: Henan Art Center Concert Hall, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Returned home after the event ended
subevent.description: The concert ended around 10 p.m. Yu Xiaowen left the concert hall with the crowd, went to the underground parking lot to pick up her car, and drove home along the same route. She arrived home around 10:30, washed up briefly, and rested.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jianshe West Road to Jingsan Road, Jinshui District

name: Video call with mother to plan New Year family activities
description: On the evening of December 23, Yu Xiaowen had an hour-long video call with her mother Li Xiuying. Her mother showed her the Laba garlic she had pickled and freshly made dumplings in front of the camera, while Yu Xiaowen shared reflections from her annual summary. The two seriously discussed whether to return to Luoyang for New Year's Day, the schedule for her father's next follow-up visit, and the menu for the Spring Festival family dinner. Her mother told her not to overwork herself, and Yu Xiaowen promised to go home for two days before the end of the month.

subevent.name: Video call with mother - opening.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen made a WeChat video call to her mother Li Xiuying from her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. Li Xiuying answered at her home in Xigong District, Luoyang, and showed the camera the Laba garlic she had pickled and the freshly made dumplings. Yu Xiaowen shared reflections from her annual summary, and the mother and daughter asked about each other's recent lives.
subevent.location: Home living room, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Discussed arrangements for family activities for the New Year.
subevent.description: During the video call, Yu Xiaowen and her mother focused on discussing three family matters: first, whether to go back to Luoyang for New Year's Day; they preliminarily agreed that Yu Xiaowen would go home at the end of the month for two days. Second, the specific time schedule for her father Yu Jianguo's next follow-up appointment. Third, the menu for the Spring Festival family dinner; her mother mentioned wanting to prepare dishes her daughter loves, such as spicy soup and braised noodles. Yu Xiaowen carefully recorded the discussion results.
subevent.location: Home living room, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Call wrap-up and commitment
subevent.description: As the video call was ending, her mother told Yu Xiaowen not to work too hard and to take care of her health. Yu Xiaowen promised to return to Luoyang by the end of the month to stay for two days to visit her parents, and she confirmed again the date of her father’s follow-up visit and the preliminary plan for the Spring Festival family dinner menu. After saying goodbye, Yu Xiaowen hung up.
subevent.location: Home living room, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Purchase personal critical illness insurance.
description: On November 13, Yu Xiaowen consulted financial advisor Wang Mingyuan about critical illness insurance, then compared products at home. On November 18, she bought a critical illness insurance policy online with coverage of 500,000 yuan and an annual premium of about 4,800 yuan (paid in 12 installments, first month 400 yuan). The next day, she saved the policy and told her parents, emphasizing that as a doctor she takes health risks seriously.

subevent.name: Consulted a financial advisor about critical illness insurance.
subevent.description: From her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen contacted financial advisor Wang Mingyuan via WeChat to ask about the necessity of purchasing personal critical illness insurance, the choice of sum insured, and the premium budget. Based on her income and professional characteristics (doctors have strong health-risk awareness), Wang Mingyuan recommended a critical illness insurance product on the market with a coverage of 500,000 yuan and an annual premium of about 4,800 yuan, and suggested that she compare other similar products before making a decision.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Research critical illness insurance products online by comparing them
subevent.description: At home in Zhengzhou, after work, Yu Xiaowen used an insurance brokerage platform and a banking app to compare the coverage, deductibles, claims processes, and customer reviews of three mainstream personal critical illness insurance products on the market, with special attention to the coverage of rehabilitation treatment costs. Combining her medical knowledge as a doctor, she selected the two products closest to the one recommended by Wang Mingyuan for detailed comparison.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Finalized the insurance plan and purchased insurance online.
subevent.description: On November 18, Yu Xiaowen finally decided to take the advice of financial adviser Wang Mingyuan and chose a critical illness insurance product with a coverage of 500,000 yuan and an annual premium of about 4,800 yuan. At her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, she completed the online application process through the insurance company's official app, filled in her personal health disclosure, chose to pay in 12 installments, and successfully paid the first month's premium of 400 yuan. After applying, she immediately received an email with the electronic policy, confirming that the insurance would take effect at midnight the next day.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Saving the insurance policy and notifying family
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen downloaded the electronic insurance policy to her phone and computer as a backup, and sent screenshots of the key terms to the family WeChat group. She told her parents in Luoyang that she had purchased critical illness insurance, emphasizing that as a doctor she should pay more attention to health risk protection, and reminding her family to pay attention to health management. Her mother, Li Xiuying, replied and reminded her to note the payment date.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Family surprise dinner: birthday rehearsal

When she arrived, she found close friends such as Sun Yue and Lin Wei all there, and realized it was an early celebration for her December birthday. She was deeply moved. During the meal, everyone talked freely about life and dreams, and the warmth of family and friendship flowed.

subevent.name: Zhang Jing reserved a Hunan restaurant and notified her friends
subevent.description: According to the plan, Zhang Jing booked a private room for the evening of September 30 at a Hunan restaurant in Zhengzhou, and privately notified friends such as Sun Yue and Lin Wei via WeChat of the time and location of the dinner gathering, urging everyone to keep it confidential and emphasizing that this was a birthday surprise for Yu Xiaowen. Sun Yue and Lin Wei both readily agreed to attend and said they would arrive on time.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhang Jing's home (online notice)

subevent.name: Zhang Jing invited Yu Xiaowen under the guise of an ordinary dinner
subevent.description: After work on the afternoon of September 30, Zhang Jing asked Yu Xiaowen to meet at 7 p.m. at a Hunan restaurant in Zhengzhou, using the excuse, “We haven't eaten together in a long time—let's try the newly opened Hunan restaurant tonight.” Yu Xiaowen had no suspicions and happily agreed, driving to the meeting place after work.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Yu Xiaowen's home (invitation)

subevent.name: The surprise dinner was underway, and Yu Xiaowen was deeply moved.
subevent.description: At 7 p.m. that evening, Yu Xiaowen arrived at the private room of the Hunan restaurant and found her mother Li Xiuying, Zhang Jing, Sun Yue, Lin Wei, and others already waiting. Only then did she realize it was a surprise dinner held early for her December birthday. Yu Xiaowen was moved to tears and hugged everyone to thank them. During the meal, they chatted freely about their life updates and career aspirations and shared funny stories. The warm atmosphere of family and friendship filled the entire evening. The dinner lasted about two hours, and after taking a group photo together, everyone went their separate ways.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - private room at a Hunan restaurant

name: Sprint preparation for the attending physician exam
description: Continuing with the sprint plan after last month's mock exam, July became the final month of preparation. Yu Xiaowen used fragmented time during daily commutes, lunch breaks, and before bed, combining flashcard memorization and a question-bank app to focus on weak subjects such as the cardiovascular system and neurology. On weekends, she took mock papers and organized wrong answers. Her mother Li Xiuying sometimes helped test her with flashcards, silently supporting her.

subevent.name: Fragmented exam preparation on workdays of the first week
subevent.description: From July 14 to 18 (Monday to Friday), Yu Xiaowen used fragmented time during commuting, lunch breaks, and before bed to focus on weak subjects such as the cardiovascular system and neurology, using flashcards and a question-practice app.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - at home and during commute.

subevent.name: Fragmented exam prep on Monday
subevent.description: On Monday, July 14, Yu Xiaowen listened to audio about the cardiovascular system in the car during her commute (about 10 minutes of driving); during the lunch break, she completed 30 practice questions on the cardiovascular system chapter using a question-practice app in the department on-call room; before bed at home, she reviewed 20 flashcards of core neurology concepts using the card memorization method. The total study time for the day was about 1 hour.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - at home and during commute.

subevent.name: Tuesday fragmented test prep

Before bed, she organized her mistake notebook and reviewed key concepts in neurology, accumulating about 1 hour of study time throughout the day.

During this period, her mother Li Xiuying helped quiz her with knowledge cards at home and provided support.

subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - at home and during commute.

subevent.description: On Saturday morning (July 26), Yu Xiaowen began her second round of mock exam self-testing at her desk at home. Strictly following the exam timing requirements, she completed a comprehensive medical mock exam paper in two consecutive hours. During that time, she avoided interruptions, stayed focused, and answered independently. After finishing the paper, she immediately scored it against the answer key and marked all incorrect and uncertain questions with a red pen. In the afternoon, she recorded the wrong questions in her dedicated mistake notebook, noted the related knowledge points and common traps, and prepared for the next day's in-depth review.

In the afternoon, her mother Li Xiuying came to Yu Xiaowen's home and, following the method agreed upon in advance, took the medical knowledge flashcards Yu Xiaowen had prepared and randomly drew cards to ask about related concepts and key points. Yu Xiaowen answered them one by one. Her mother put a check mark next to cards answered correctly and put the incorrect ones back to be drawn again, repeating this until everything was mastered. Throughout the process, Yu Xiaowen actively identified and filled gaps in her knowledge, deepening her memory.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Sprint exam preparation during the workdays of the third week.

subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - at home and during commute.

subevent.name: On Monday, focus on reviewing error-prone internal medicine questions.
subevent.description: On Monday, July 28, Yu Xiaowen used work breaks, lunch breaks, commute time, and time at home after work to conduct intensive review and strengthen her memory of the internal medicine knowledge points prone to error compiled earlier and the internal medicine mistakes in the mock exam papers. She flipped through her notebook in the hospital rest room, listened to audio of knowledge points she had recorded during her commute, and in the evening sorted through and wrote out key content from memory at home.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Yu Xiaowen's home and Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: On Tuesday, focus on reviewing surgical questions that are commonly answered incorrectly.

subevent.name: On Wednesday, work intensively on the incorrect questions from the mock papers.

On her commute she quietly recited the knowledge points related to the wrong questions, during lunch break she reworked them in the break room, and in the evening she did a timed full practice test at home to check the results.

She used her commute time to quickly flip through the condensed notes she had compiled, listened to classical music during her lunch break to relax, reviewed high-frequency exam point flashcards at home after work, and spent 15 minutes meditating to relax, ensuring she would face the exam in the best state. In the evening, she prepared her exam materials in advance and went to bed early to recharge.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Yu Xiaowen's home and Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Won an air fryer in a lucky draw at the dinner gathering
description: On the evening of December 27, during the lucky draw at the department's year-end dinner, Yu Xiaowen unexpectedly won second prize—a branded air fryer. Colleagues joked, "Next year we'll get to eat your healthy fried chicken." She happily planned to use the air fryer to make low-fat dishes for her father. This little surprise ended a tense year on a light note.

subevent.name: After work, prepare to head to the dinner gathering place
subevent.description: At 6:30 p.m. on December 27, after finishing the day's ward work and shift handover, Yu Xiaowen changed out of her white coat in the locker room, touched up her makeup, and packed her bag. She walked with her colleague Wang Fang to the restaurant at Zhongyuan Wanda Plaza, about 1.5 kilometers away. On the way, they chatted about interesting stories from their respective rotating departments.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - on the way from Zhengzhou Central Hospital to Zhongyuan Wanda Plaza.

subevent.name: Department year-end dinner and raffle.
subevent.description: From 7:00 to 9:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen had a dinner gathering with more than 20 colleagues from her department (including Director Zhang Lei, Teacher Li Wei, Liu Qiang, Head Nurse Wu Min, etc.) at a Chinese restaurant in Zhongyuan Wanda Plaza. After dinner, a lucky draw was held with a third prize, a second prize, and a first prize. In the second round of the draw, Yu Xiaowen won the second prize, an air fryer from a certain brand. She went up to the stage in surprise to receive the prize, and her colleagues joked, "Next year we can eat your healthy fried chicken." The atmosphere was lively.
subevent.location: A Chinese restaurant at Wanda Plaza, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Joyful conversation after winning the prize and going home
subevent.description: After the lucky draw, Yu Xiaowen continued chatting with her seat neighbors Wang Fang and Head Nurse Wu Min. She happily showed off the air fryer packaging and said she planned to use the air fryer to make low-fat fried chicken and French fries for her father in Luoyang, so that he could eat more healthily. The dinner ended at 9:30 pm. She walked back to her residence with Wang Fang, chatting and laughing along the way while carrying the prize.
subevent.location: Roadside between Zhongyuan Wanda Plaza, Zhengzhou, and home in Jinshui District

subevent.name: Shared the joy of winning a prize with her father via video call
subevent.description: At 10 pm, Yu Xiaowen returned to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, placed the air fryer on the living room table, and then made a WeChat video call on her phone to her father Yu Jianguo in Luoyang. She described the dinner party lucky draw in detail, showed the prize, and discussed with her father how to use the air fryer to make healthy dishes with less oil. They agreed that she would show off her cooking skills when she went home for the Spring Festival. The call lasted about 20 minutes, and her father was happy for her.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City.

name: Father's independent walking encourages exam preparation; family reconciliation welcomes the New Year.
description: During the family dinner on the evening of December 30, her father took the initiative to say to Yu Xiaowen, 'Go take the attending physician exam next year. Dad can walk on his own now; you should live for yourself.' Her mother wiped away tears nearby. Her older brother Yu Xiaofeng said over video, 'You've worked hard this year, little sister. Next year I'll come back more often.' Her father's recovery progress in walking independently became a turning point that softened family relations, completing the reconciliation of intergenerational conflict, and the whole family welcomed the new year with a relaxed mood.

subevent.name: Return from Zhengzhou to Luoyang
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen used her annual leave and compensatory rest. On the morning of December 30, 2025, she drove her private car from her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and after about a 2-hour drive, arrived in the afternoon at her parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, to attend the family dinner that evening.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Xigong District - parents' home

subevent.name: Mother prepared the family dinner.
subevent.description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying prepared a hearty dinner together in the kitchen at her parents' home. Her mother specially made the spicy soup and braised noodles that Yu Xiaowen loves. The mother and daughter chatted while cooking, and her mother felt gratified at her father's rehabilitation progress.
subevent.location: Kitchen of parents' home, Xigong District, Luoyang

subevent.name: Rehabilitation demonstration and encouragement during family dinner
subevent.description: The whole family sat around the dining table in the parents' home. After the meal, Father Yu Jianguo stood up on his own, walked a few steps independently to show his rehabilitation progress, and then said to Yu Xiaowen: “Next year you should take the attending physician exam. Dad can walk on his own now; you should live for yourself.” Mother Li Xiuying was moved to tears at the side. Brother Yu Xiaofeng joined the meal via video call and said in the video: “Little sis, you've worked hard this year. Next year I'll come back more often.” The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Dining room at parents' home, Xigong District, Luoyang City

subevent.name: Family chat and welcoming the New Year.
subevent.description: After dinner, the whole family moved to the living room at the parents' home to continue chatting. Father Yu Jianguo sat on the sofa and talked about work with elder brother Yu Xiaofeng via video call, while mother Li Xiuying and Yu Xiaowen discussed plans for the New Year's Day holiday. The whole family welcomed the upcoming new year in a relaxed and cheerful mood, and the estrangement that had built up between generations over the years was resolved because of their father's recovery.
subevent.location: Luoyang City - Xigong District, living room of parents' home

name: Departmental emergency first aid knowledge sharing
description: From October 21 to 22, Yu Xiaowen prepared for and carried out an emergency care knowledge sharing session for the department's professional study. On the evening of the 21st, she first organized the 2025 CPR updated guidelines and stroke case notes in the apartment study. On the morning of the 22nd, she made the PPT handouts at the hospital, and in the afternoon she shared the key points of the new CPR and stroke recognition in the department conference room with more than ten medical staff, including the head nurse, supervising teachers, and colleagues. She gave live demonstrations and answered questions. After the session, she collected feedback. Her clear and logical presentation was praised, and it consolidated her own knowledge system.

subevent.name: Organizing first aid knowledge points and clinical cases
subevent.description: In the study room of her rented apartment in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen used her spare time to systematically review the key changes in the 2025 updated cardiopulmonary resuscitation guidelines, selected typical stroke cases from the departmental cases she had handled in the past, and organized the first-aid points corresponding to the cases into notes, preparing content for the next day's department sharing session.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Creating a sharing PPT and lecture handouts
subevent.description: That morning, Yu Xiaowen used a computer in the department doctors' office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital to turn the first-aid knowledge points and cases she had sorted out the day before into a concise, clear PPT presentation and a one-page handout, highlighting the updated CPR process and the FAST stroke recognition mnemonic. She also did a trial presentation to make sure it was smooth.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Departmental study: First aid knowledge sharing
subevent.description: During the afternoon departmental professional study session, Yu Xiaowen gave a presentation in the department meeting room to more than ten medical staff present, including supervising teacher Li Wei, head nurse Wu Min, and colleague Wang Fang. She first explained the updated 2025 cardiopulmonary resuscitation guidelines (such as compression depth and ventilation ratio adjustments), then elaborated on the key points of early stroke recognition (FAST principle) based on the stroke cases she had compiled, and demonstrated the new CPR steps on site. During the sharing session, colleagues actively asked questions, and Yu Xiaowen answered them one by one, making for a good interactive atmosphere.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department Conference Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Collect feedback and organize the sharing summary
subevent.description: After the sharing session, Yu Xiaowen briefly talked with Wang Fang, Wu Min, and others in the department break area. Wu Min praised her for clear logic and practical cases, and Wang Fang said she had gained a deeper understanding of stroke identification. Based on everyone's feedback, Yu Xiaowen noted key improvement points in her notebook, filed away the sharing materials, and sent the electronic version of the handout to the department WeChat group for future reference.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Department rest area, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Received the handmade cotton quilt and hometown snacks sent by her mother.
description: On the evening of December 18, Yu Xiaowen picked up a package from her mother, sent from Luoyang, at the community parcel locker on her way home from work. Inside were a hand-sewn quilt and a large bag of hometown snacks such as hulatang seasoning and sweet-and-sour pork seasoning. She spread out the new quilt that night, and the bedroom immediately felt full of the smell of sunshine and home. She took a photo and sent it to her mother, and the two video-chatted until late at night. Her mother told her to keep warm and take care of herself. Yu Xiaowen felt that her solo life was wrapped in deep family love.

subevent.name: Pick up a package after work.

subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - community parcel locker

subevent.name: Opened the package and checked the items
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen returned home, opened the package, and found a hand-sewn cotton quilt from her mother and a large pack of hulatang seasoning, sweet and sour pork seasoning, and other hometown snacks. Her heart was filled with warmth.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Home

subevent.name: Spread out the cotton quilt and take a photo to share.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen spread the new quilt on the bed, and the bedroom instantly felt full of sunshine and the warmth of home. She picked up her phone, took a photo of the neatly spread quilt, and sent it via WeChat to her mother, who was far away in Luoyang.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Home

subevent.name: Video chat with mother
subevent.description: After receiving the photos, her mother Li Xiuying soon called her over video. The mother and daughter talked on the video call for nearly two hours. Her mother reminded Yu Xiaowen to keep warm and take care of herself, while Yu Xiaowen shared updates on her work and life. The video call lasted late into the night, and Yu Xiaowen felt that even her solitary life was wrapped in strong family affection.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - Home

name: Invite Wang Fang to supervise exam preparation and confirm the supervision relationship at a reconciliation dinner
description: On the evening of November 12, 2025, Yu Xiaowen sent a screenshot of her exam preparation plan to her colleague Wang Fang on WeChat and invited her to be her accountability partner. Wang Fang responded with a joke about the previous wedding preparations and happily accepted. On the evening of November 14, Wang Fang invited Yu Xiaowen to dinner at a Sichuan restaurant and apologized during the meal for getting angry last month; the two hugged and reconciled. Wang Fang solemnly promised to seriously oversee the exam preparation and said, ‘I want to be involved in all your big events.’ Friendship repair and exam support merged into one.

subevent.name: Invite Wang Fang via WeChat to supervise exam preparation
subevent.description: On the evening of November 12, 2025, Yu Xiaowen, at home, used WeChat on her phone to send a screenshot of her exam preparation plan to her colleague Wang Fang, who also works at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. She sincerely invited Wang Fang to be her study accountability partner, hoping they could keep each other on track. Wang Fang replied quickly, joking about how Yu Xiaowen had supervised her wedding preparations last time: “Last time you supervised my wedding; this time it’s my turn to supervise you.” She happily accepted the invitation.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Reconciled with Wang Fang over dinner at a Sichuan restaurant and confirmed the supervision arrangement.
subevent.description: On the evening of November 14, 2025, Wang Fang took the initiative to invite Yu Xiaowen to dinner at a Sichuan restaurant in Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou. During the meal, Wang Fang candidly said that she had let go of the anger incident from the previous month and apologized face to face. The two hugged warmly and completely reconciled. Afterward, Wang Fang solemnly promised to seriously supervise Yu Xiaowen's exam preparation plan and said affectionately, “I want to be involved in all your major events.” Friendship repair and exam preparation support came together as one.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Sichuan restaurant

name: Complete remarks by the young physician representative at the 65th anniversary celebration of the hospital
description: On November 1, at the department's morning meeting, Director Zhang Lei informed Yu Xiaowen that she had been selected as the young physician representative for the hospital's 65th anniversary celebration and needed to prepare a speech. She then drafted it in her home study and discussed revisions with her mentor, Li Wei, finalizing it late on November 6. On November 7, she attended the rehearsal and adjusted the pacing of her speech. On November 8, the day of the celebration, she took the stage in the academic lecture hall, shared her emotional journey through her father's rehabilitation and her career transition, and thanked the hospital for its care. The audience broke into thunderous applause, and her mother, Li Xiuying, wept silently. Afterwards, she took a commemorative photo with her mother and shared the joy with her father via video call. On November 9, she posted her reflections as a WeChat Moments update and received likes and comments from colleagues and friends.

subevent.name: Received the task of giving a speech as the young physician representative.
subevent.description: At the department morning meeting, department director Zhang Lei officially informed Yu Xiaowen that, due to her outstanding performance in balancing family and career over the past year, she had been selected by the hospital as the young physician representative for the 65th anniversary celebration, and she needed to prepare a speech of about 5 minutes. Yu Xiaowen felt surprised and a sense of responsibility, and immediately accepted the task.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Writing the initial draft of the speech
subevent.description: In her spare time, Yu Xiaowen wrote the first draft of a celebration speech in her home study during her evening break. Centering on her father Yu Jianguo's recovery experience and her own mental journey through career transition, she incorporated gratitude for the hospital's care, aiming to be authentic and moving while reflecting the spirit of a young physician.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Revise and finalize the speech
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen sent the draft to her supervising teacher Li Wei via WeChat for feedback. Li Wei suggested strengthening the expression of medical humanistic care. After discussion, Yu Xiaowen revised the draft twice and finally finalized and printed it late that night, preparing for tomorrow's rehearsal.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Attending the celebration rehearsal
subevent.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowen joined the other hospital celebration performers in a full rehearsal at the hospital conference center. She simulated her speech on stage, tested the sound and lighting, and reviewed the program flow with the host. After the rehearsal, she made final adjustments to her speaking pace and posture, and expressed anticipation to her mother.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Conference Center

subevent.name: Formal speech at the hospital's 65th anniversary celebration.
subevent.description: At 9 a.m., the hospital's 65th anniversary celebration was grandly held in the academic lecture hall. Yu Xiaowen spoke on stage as a representative of young physicians. With sincere emotion, she shared her father's journey from illness to recovery, and how this experience motivated her to move forward firmly in her career, thanking the hospital for its humanistic care. After the speech, the audience burst into thunderous applause. Her mother, Li Xiuying, sitting in the audience, quietly wiped away tears.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – Academic Lecture Hall, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Taking a photo with mother as a souvenir and sharing the joy
subevent.description: After the celebration ended, Yu Xiaowen found her mother Li Xiuying at the entrance of the lecture hall. Her mother hugged her tightly and praised her speech. The two asked a colleague to take a group photo in front of the celebration backdrop. Yu Xiaowen then sent the photo to the family group chat and made a video call to her father Yu Jianguo to share the moment.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Record reflections on social media
subevent.description: On her rotating day off, Yu Xiaowen spent the afternoon at home editing a post for WeChat Moments, sharing photos from her speech and personal reflections, and thanking the hospital for the opportunity and her parents for their company. Several colleagues and friends (Zhang Jing, Sun Yue, etc.) liked and commented, and she replied to each one, feeling happy.

name: Try meditation stress-relief exercises.
description: On August 22, 2025, after reading Better, Yu Xiaowen decided to try meditation to relieve stress. That evening, she downloaded the Tide app and did her first 10-minute mindfulness meditation. After that, she practiced meditating every night before bed. During this period, she also applied meditation techniques in the pottery studio, significantly improving the success rate of her works. After practicing for more than a week, she summarized the effects on the 31st, feeling that she fell asleep faster and had more energy, and decided to maintain this habit in the long term.

subevent.name: Read Better and decided to try meditation.
subevent.description: On August 22, 2025, during the day, Yu Xiaowen read Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance in the study at her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, and after being inspired by it, she decided to try meditation to relieve stress. She planned to do 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation every night before bed to release the pressure from work and family.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City - Home Study Room

subevent.name: Downloaded the Tide app and did a mindfulness meditation for the first time.

She adjusted her breathing, focused on the present moment, and successfully completed her first meditation session.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Jinshui District - Home Bedroom

subevent.name: Six consecutive days of nightly meditation practice before bed.
subevent.description: From August 23 to 28, 2025 (except the 25th), Yu Xiaowen used the Tide app for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation in her bedroom every night before going to sleep. The continuous practice made her feel that she fell asleep faster and was full of energy the next day.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Jinshui District - Home Bedroom

subevent.name: Applying meditation techniques at the pottery studio
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 25, 2025, while doing wheel-throwing at the Between the Clay pottery studio in Guancheng Hui District, Yu Xiaowen actively used mindfulness meditation techniques, focusing on the clay in her hands and the spinning wheel. She found that the success rate of her pieces improved significantly and the shapes were more even, and she shared this insight with her pottery teacher Zheng Guodong.

subevent.name: Continued meditation practice on the evening of the 25th.
subevent.description: Even though she already applied meditation during pottery in the daytime, Yu Xiaowen still insisted on completing a 10-minute guided meditation on the Tide app before bed on the evening of the 25th, to maintain the habit and further consolidate the stress-relief effect.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Jinshui District - Home Bedroom

subevent.name: Continue meditation practice for the next two days

subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Jinshui District - Home Bedroom
