She decided to maintain meditation as a long-term habit and recorded her insights in her diary.
subevent.location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou - Home

name: A small gathering of college classmates; Zhou Haoran suggested the intersection of rehabilitation and technology, which led to follow-up research.
description: On Sunday, October 26, Sun Yue took the lead in organizing a small gathering at a teahouse to celebrate Xiaowen's successful department transfer, and Zhao Ming joined via video link. During the gathering, Zhou Haoran earnestly suggested combining the rehabilitation department with technology, such as using wearable devices to monitor training. Xiaowen was quite interested. After returning home, she immediately searched online for relevant information, bookmarked research-related public accounts, and sent Zhou Haoran a message to thank him and say she would seriously consider it.

subevent.name: Heading to the teahouse for the appointment.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 26, Yu Xiaowen set out from her home and walked or drove to Qingyun Teahouse near Jingsan Road in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. On the way, she received the seating information sent by Sun Yue and arrived at the teahouse at the agreed time. Sun Yue and Zhou Haoran were already seated, and Zhao Ming joined the conversation via mobile video call.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District - Qingyun Teahouse

subevent.name: Teahouse gathering and making suggestions
subevent.description: Four people (Zhao Ming via video) drank tea and chatted in the teahouse. Sun Yue first congratulated Yu Xiaowen on successfully transferring to the rehabilitation department, and Zhao Ming shared his experiences in Shenzhen. Then Zhou Haoran put down his teacup and seriously suggested that Yu Xiaowen combine rehabilitation with technology in a cross-disciplinary way, for example by developing wearable devices to monitor patients' training data, and encouraged her to pay attention to this direction. Everyone then had a brief discussion on this topic.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District - Qingyun Teahouse

subevent.name: After returning home, did an initial search of information.
subevent.description: After the small gathering, Yu Xiaowen returned home, opened her laptop, and searched the medical databases and the internet for keywords such as 'wearable devices, rehabilitation training, sensors.' She read a few introductory papers and bookmarked three promising research WeChat official accounts. She also sent a message to Zhou Haoran on WeChat, thanking him for his suggestion and saying she would seriously consider it.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District - home study room.

name: Buy a full-body massage chair for parents.
description: On November 23, 2025, at her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen researched and compared multiple massage chairs. After choosing one, she used her year-end bonus and part of her savings to buy a full-body massage chair online on November 25, and immediately notified her parents.

subevent.name: Research and select a massage chair.
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen researched and compared the specifications, user reviews, and prices of multiple full-body massage chairs through e-commerce platforms and forums. She finally chose a cost-effective one and planned to buy it for her parents using her year-end bonus and some savings.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Place order and pay to buy a massage chair
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen used her phone to place an order on an e-commerce platform for the selected full-body massage chair. She paid with her year-end bonus and part of her savings, spending nearly 10,000 yuan in total. After placing the order, she received an order confirmation, with delivery expected on November 30.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

subevent.name: Called her parents to tell them about buying a massage chair
subevent.description: After placing the order, Yu Xiaowen immediately contacted her parents Yu Jianguo and Li Xiuying in Luoyang via a WeChat video call, told them she had bought a full-body massage chair online with her year-end bonus, and reminded them to keep an eye out for the delivery. Her parents felt pleasantly surprised and gratified.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Home

name: Free clinic in Micun Town, Xinmi
description: From October 10 to 12, Yu Xiaowen joined the medical team organized by the hospital to provide free clinics in Mizhen Town, Xinmi City. After work on October 10, she and her colleague Wang Fang sorted out equipment and materials in the office. On the morning of the 11th, they took a car to Mizhen Town; in the afternoon, they held a free clinic at the health center; in the evening, they checked into the guesthouse and chatted with Wang Fang late into the night. On the morning of the 12th, they continued the free clinic; in the afternoon, they returned to Zhengzhou. That evening, she sorted out medical records at home and wrote up her reflections. This experience made her feel the medical needs at the grassroots level and also deepened her friendship with Wang Fang.

subevent.name: Preparation for the free clinic
subevent.description: After work on October 10, Yu Xiaowen, together with her colleague Wang Fang, organized the medical equipment (blood pressure monitors, stethoscopes), promotional materials (stroke prevention handbook), common medicines, and personal supplies needed for the free clinic in the office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The two checked the list, confirmed the meeting time and place for the next day, and contacted the transport team to confirm the departure time.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Office

subevent.name: Taking the medical team vehicle to Micun Town
subevent.description: At 7 a.m. on October 11, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang met at the hospital gate and took the medical team bus arranged by the hospital, departing with other colleagues (including supervising teacher Li Wei, head nurse Wu Min, etc.) for Micun Town, Xinmi City. On the bus, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang briefly discussed the free clinic procedures. About an hour later, they arrived at Micun Town Health Center and began setting up the free clinic site.
subevent.location: Xinmi City - Micun Town Health Center

subevent.name: First-day afternoon free clinic event
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 11, from 13:00 to 17:00, Yu Xiaowen was at the temporary free clinic set up by Micun Town Health Center, mainly responsible for measuring villagers' blood pressure, recording health data, and providing diet and exercise advice to those with abnormal blood pressure. At the same time, she patiently answered villagers' questions about stroke prevention and distributed brochures. During the period, she worked well with Wang Fang, serving about 30 villagers in total.
subevent.location: Xinmi City - Micun Township Health Center free clinic site

subevent.name: Checked into the guesthouse and chatted with colleagues at night.
subevent.description: After dinner on the evening of October 11, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang checked into a standard room at the Micun Town Government Guesthouse. After washing up, the two lay on the beds chatting, sharing their feelings from the day's free clinic, funny stories from work, and their respective plans for the future. Yu Xiaowen talked about the lack of grassroots medical resources, while Wang Fang encouraged her to stay true to her original intention. The two chatted until nearly midnight before falling asleep, deepening their friendship.
subevent.location: Xinmi City – Micun Town Government Guesthouse

subevent.name: Free clinic event on the following morning
subevent.description: From 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. on October 12, Yu Xiaowen continued to work at the free clinic site at Micun Town Health Center. She provided health guidance for the villagers who came for consultation, focusing on the early recognition of stroke (the Stroke 120 mnemonic) and preventive measures. Thanks to the experience she had accumulated the previous day, she communicated more smoothly with the villagers. She also saw a patient with hypertension, recorded the patient's condition in detail, and advised the patient to go to a higher-level hospital for further examination.
subevent.location: Xinmi City - Micun Township Health Center free clinic site

subevent.name: Return to Zhengzhou.
subevent.description: At 1 pm on October 12, after the free clinic ended, Yu Xiaowen and the medical team sorted out remaining supplies and cleaned up the site. Then they took the same bus back to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. On the way, Yu Xiaowen dozed off in the car and exchanged insights about the free clinic with Wang Fang. They arrived at the hospital at about 2:30 pm, and Yu Xiaowen went home to rest.
subevent.location: Xinmi City to Zhengzhou City – medical team bus / Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Compiling free clinic records and reflections
subevent.description: On the evening of October 12 after dinner, Yu Xiaowen opened her computer in the study of her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, to organize the medical records from this free clinic (villagers' blood pressure data, consultation suggestions), and wrote a brief reflection on the clinic, recording the needs of primary-level healthcare and her own growth insights. She then sent the records to her department mentor Li Wei as material for the activity summary.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District, home study

name: Had an extended conversation with the director of the rehabilitation department and launched a questionnaire survey on art therapy.
description: On December 22, Yu Xiaowen had a long exchange with the director of the rehabilitation department. The director strongly agreed with her interest in introducing pottery into rehabilitation and suggested first conducting an internal questionnaire survey on stroke patients' acceptance of pottery intervention during rehabilitation, as preliminary preparation for applying for the Youth Fund. Xiaowen was deeply encouraged. From December 23 to 25, with the remote assistance of her college classmate Zhou Haoran, she drafted the questionnaire items, formally launching the interdisciplinary research on rehabilitation and art.

subevent.name: Long conversation with the rehabilitation department director
subevent.description: On December 22, 2025, Yu Xiaowen had an hour-long discussion with Wang Jianguo, director of the Rehabilitation Department, in his office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. She reported in detail her interest and initial ideas for introducing pottery art into stroke patient rehabilitation. Director Wang highly recognized the innovation and clinical value of this direction and proposed first conducting an internal questionnaire survey on "acceptance of pottery intervention among stroke patients in the rehabilitation period" as preliminary preparation for applying for the youth fund. Deeply encouraged, Yu Xiaowen carefully recorded the director's guidance and suggested next steps.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital.

subevent.name: Discussed the questionnaire framework remotely with Zhou Haoran.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 23, 2025, Yu Xiaowen, in the study of her home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, contacted her college classmate Zhou Haoran, who works at the National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases in Beijing, via a WeChat video call, and invited him to help design the questionnaire. Zhou Haoran, drawing on his medical research experience, suggested using a Likert 5-point scale and helped Yu Xiaowen determine the questionnaire's dimensional structure (including interest awareness, feasibility perception, barrier factors, and support needs) and initial item directions. The two discussed for about one hour and clarified the division of subsequent writing tasks.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Collaboratively writing questionnaire items
subevent.description: On December 24, 2025, Yu Xiaowen, in the study of her home in Zhengzhou, collaborated online with Zhou Haoran using Tencent Docs, writing questionnaire entries one by one according to the framework set the previous day. Zhou Haoran was responsible for literature support and ensuring the scientific rigor of the entries, while Yu Xiaowen adjusted the wording to make it more accessible based on her clinical experience. After about four hours of collaboration, the two completed a draft containing 20 entries.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Review, revise, and finalize the questionnaire draft
subevent.description: On the morning of December 25, 2025, Yu Xiaowen had another video call with Zhou Haoran to review the draft questionnaire completed the day before item by item. The two adjusted some unclear wording, merged duplicate items, and added two open-ended questions about willingness to participate. This resulted in a formal draft questionnaire containing 22 items. Yu Xiaowen saved the document and prepared to submit it to Director Wang.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: After badminton, Xu Tao shared insights on rehabilitation + AI, boosting career confidence.
description: On November 20, 2025, after work, Yu Xiaowen played badminton with Xu Tao and Wang Fang. Afterward, Xu Tao shared the latest on the Shenzhen 'rehabilitation + AI' startup scene, mentioning wearable devices and intelligent training systems, and said rehabilitation doctors would be in high demand in the future. Xiaowen recalled Zhou Haoran's advice from last month and immediately noted 'rehabilitation + AI, keep following up' in her phone memo. After returning home, she organized the notes into her career development digital notebook, added cases and reflections, and reviewed Zhou Haoran's advice. Feeling that the two pieces of information corroborated each other, she became more confident in building a career in rehabilitation technology, then sent a WeChat message to thank Xu Tao.

subevent.name: Went to the badminton hall after work.
subevent.description: At 18:45 on the evening of November 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowen walked about 10 minutes from Zhengzhou Central Hospital after work to the badminton hall near Gongren Road. Along the way, she stayed in touch with Xu Tao and Wang Fang in a WeChat group to confirm each person's departure status. At 18:55, the three arrived at the entrance almost simultaneously and went in together to change and get ready.
subevent.location: Badminton Hall on Gongren Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Played badminton doubles
subevent.description: From 19:00 to 20:30 on November 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowen, Xu Tao, and Wang Fang played doubles badminton at the badminton hall (rotating partners among the three). Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang teamed up against Xu Tao and another player (an impromptu match). They played three full games, and Yu Xiaowen performed well, making several successful saves. During the exercise, the three chatted and laughed in a relaxed atmosphere. After it ended at 20:30, they rested at the side of the court and rehydrated.
subevent.location: Badminton Hall on Gongren Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Exchange after the ball game: Xu Tao shares updates on rehabilitation + AI.
subevent.description: From 20:30 to 21:00 on November 20, 2025, after playing badminton, the three of them sat on a bench in the rest area of the venue and chatted. Xu Tao shared recent 'rehabilitation + AI' entrepreneurship trends in Shenzhen, mentioned commercial cases of wearable devices used for rehabilitation monitoring and intelligent training systems, and pointed out that 'rehabilitation doctors will be in high demand in the future, because AI implementation in clinical practice requires medical professional oversight.' Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang listened carefully. Yu Xiaowen was reminded that her college classmate Zhou Haoran had also suggested a technology-cross-disciplinary direction last month. Feeling encouraged, she immediately took out her phone and wrote down 'rehabilitation + AI, keep following' in her memo, noting the date. After the conversation, the three left the venue together and went home at 21:10.
subevent.location: Rest area, Gongren Road Badminton Hall, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: After returning home, organize records and strengthen career confidence.
subevent.description: At 21:30 on November 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowen returned to her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District. She organized the notes from her phone memo into her career development e-notebook, added the specific case Xu Tao had mentioned and her own thoughts at the time, and wrote down: “Rehabilitation + AI is a cross-disciplinary field worth cultivating in depth; it can be combined with my clinical background as a long-term direction.” Meanwhile, she reviewed Zhou Haoran's suggestions from last month and felt that the two pieces of information corroborated each other, further strengthening her confidence in steadily accumulating experience in rehabilitation technology. After finishing the organization at 22:00, she sent a WeChat message thanking Xu Tao for sharing and agreed to continue the conversation next time they played ball.
subevent.location: Home study room, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

name: Took a stress-relief yoga class with Wang Fang
description: Starting from November 10, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang arranged to attend a stress-relief yoga class at a yoga studio near the hospital every Tuesday evening. The class included breathing meditation and gentle stretching to help relieve work pressure and exam-preparation anxiety. After class, the two exchanged relaxation techniques and applied meditation practice to adjusting their mindset before routine ward rounds, continuing until the end of the month.

subevent.name: Discuss and book a stress-relief yoga class.
subevent.description: After work on November 10, Yu Xiaowen and her colleague Wang Fang walked together to the ‘Tranquil Mind Yoga Studio’ near Zhengzhou Central Hospital and asked the receptionist about the course schedule. After learning in detail about the stress-relief yoga course’s content (including breathing meditation and gentle stretching), schedule (Tuesday evenings), and cost, they decided to sign up and paid the full month’s course fee on the spot. They also bought yoga mats and comfortable practice clothes, and agreed to attend the class on time every Tuesday evening starting the following week.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jingxin Yoga Studio

subevent.name: First stress-relief yoga class
subevent.description: At 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 11, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang arrived at the "Serenity Yoga Studio" as scheduled for their first stress-relief yoga class. Under the guidance of a professional yoga instructor, they did 40 minutes of breathing meditation and gentle stretching exercises to ease work stress and exam preparation tension. After class, the two exchanged relaxation tips in the rest area, shared their feelings during meditation, and agreed to apply the meditative breathing technique to their mindset adjustment before daily ward rounds.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jingxin Yoga Studio

subevent.name: Second stress-relief yoga class
subevent.description: At 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 18, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang went to the 'Jingxin Yoga Studio' again for their second stress-relief yoga class. The class focused on shoulder-and-neck relaxation and deep breathing training. Under the teacher's guidance, the two gradually entered a relaxed state. After class, they exchanged their experiences from the past week of trying to use meditation to adjust their mindset before ward rounds, and found that their moods were more stable and their concentration at work had improved.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jingxin Yoga Studio

subevent.name: Third stress-relief yoga class and post-class summary.
subevent.description: At 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 25, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang attended the last stress-relief yoga class of the month. The class included a complete breathing meditation sequence and full-body stretching. After it ended, the teacher led a brief group sharing session. The two talked privately after class, reviewed what they had gained from three weeks of practice, decided to keep breathing meditation as a long-term habit, and agreed to continue encouraging each other to do five-minute breathing exercises during lunch breaks on workdays before the end of the month to consolidate the stress-relief effect.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jingxin Yoga Studio

name: Register for the ACE Health Coach certification and integrate rehabilitation training.
description: Starting November 3, following the health check-up warning from the previous month, Yu Xiaowen formally registered for the ACE Health Coach certification course and used spare moments to study exercise anatomy. That week, she applied knowledge such as weight-shift training and resistance band exercises to her father's home rehabilitation, guiding him personally, and her father made obvious progress. She wrote in her diary: 'Rehabilitation and exercise science go hand in hand—for myself, and for future patients.' This integrated effort continued until mid-November.

subevent.name: Register online for the ACE Health Coach certification course
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen returned to the study of her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. She opened her laptop, logged into the ACE official website, carefully browsed the details of the health coach certification course, confirmed the course fee and exam requirements, then completed the online registration and paid the tuition. After successful registration, she immediately downloaded the course syllabus, e-textbooks, and study guide, and also set up a course platform account and joined the student community.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Use fragmented time to study exercise anatomy.
subevent.description: After work every day, during night-shift breaks, and on weekends, Yu Xiaowen studied Chapter 1 of the ACE course, 'Fundamentals of Exercise Anatomy,' in her home study or the hospital break room, using a mobile app or paper notes. She focused on mastering the skeletal muscle system, types of joint movements, center of gravity transfer, and the principles of resistance training. She recorded key learning points daily and marked knowledge points related to clinical rehabilitation in a small notebook.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study/hospital lounge

subevent.name: Discussing the home rehabilitation plan with her father
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen contacted her father Yu Jianguo, who lives in Xigong District, Luoyang, via WeChat video call, told him she was taking a health coaching course, and asked about his recent physical condition and rehabilitation needs. After discussing, they decided that starting November 7, she would guide him every evening via video through home rehabilitation exercises, focusing on improving balance and muscle strength.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: First time guiding her father via video for weight-shifting training
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen opened a video call in her home study and guided her father, Yu Jianguo, who was far away in Luoyang, through weight-shift training. She first had her father stand with his feet shoulder-width apart, then slowly shift his weight to his left foot for 10 seconds, then to his right foot, repeating 10 sets. During this, she watched her father's posture through the screen and corrected his movements, noted that his initial completion rate was about 60%, encouraged him, and assigned practice tasks for the next day.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Conducted the second video session to guide her father in resistance band training.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen drew simple diagrams of how to use the resistance band and sent them to her father via WeChat in advance. During the evening video call, she guided her father in securing the band to a table leg and performing resistance movements such as seated rows and standing push-pulls, 12 reps per set for a total of 3 sets. She carefully evaluated the standard of his movements. After he completed the exercises, she pointed out that his scapula was not stable enough and demonstrated how to adjust. After the training, her father reported mild soreness in his thighs and back, so Yu Xiaowen advised him to stretch appropriately and rest.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Third video session guiding father through comprehensive rehabilitation training
subevent.description: Drawing on the previous two sessions of experience, Yu Xiaowen combined weight-shifting exercises and resistance band training into a 15-minute comprehensive training program. She led her father through the four phases via video: warm-up, weight shifting, resistance training, and relaxation stretching. Her father's movements were noticeably more coordinated; his weight-shifting improved from 60% to 80%, and his resistance band movements were much more standard. In the video, Yu Xiaowen praised her father and shared insights from her study of exercise anatomy, encouraging him to keep it up.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Fourth video call to guide father in consolidating training results
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen again guided her father through rehabilitation training over video, adding assisted single-leg standing exercises this time. Her father's completion of weight shifting had reached 90%, and his elastic band resistance strength had improved significantly. Yu Xiaowen recorded the new training data and guided her father through the full set of exercises continuously. After the training, her father said his body felt much lighter and he had more strength when walking. Yu Xiaowen encouraged her father to practice the core exercises on his own every day.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

subevent.name: Writing a learning and practice diary
subevent.description: After finishing her night shift, Yu Xiaowen sat in her home study and opened her diary to record the complete experience of enrolling in the ACE Health Coach course and guiding her father's rehabilitation. She wrote: 'Rehabilitation medicine and exercise science are tied together—for myself, and for future patients.' She summarized her father's progress, what she had learned, and her next plan to integrate the course into her clinical work, and decided to continue the integrated rehabilitation training until the course ended.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study room

name: Learn underglaze painting and incising techniques to enhance pottery skills
description: From September 6 to 7, Yu Xiaowen attended a pottery master class organized by teacher Zheng Guodong at the Between Clay Pottery Studio in Guancheng District, Zhengzhou, taught by Jingdezhen ceramic artist Chen Zhiming. She learned the theory and practice of underglaze painting, designed a draft of a zodiac rooster pattern, and learned carving techniques to finely carve a vase body, finally perfecting the work and applying glaze. The course improved her pottery skills and she created a vase with a zodiac rooster pattern.

subevent.name: Master class opening and underglaze painting theory.
subevent.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowen went to the 'Between the Clay' pottery studio in Guancheng District, Zhengzhou, to attend a pottery master class organized by teacher Zheng Guodong. Zheng Guodong introduced the Jingdezhen ceramic artist Chen Zhiming. Chen Zhiming explained the history of underglaze painting, the principles of pigment mixing, and brush techniques, and gave live demonstrations of traditional techniques such as blue-and-white water-dividing and multicolored outlining. Yu Xiaowen listened carefully and took notes, then received a ceramic blank and basic tools to prepare for the afternoon practice.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Guancheng District - Between Clay Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Underglaze painting practice and design drafts
subevent.description: From 2 p.m. to 5 p.m., Yu Xiaowen practiced underglaze painting under the guidance of Chen Zhiming and Zheng Guodong. She first practiced line drawing and filling techniques on the bisque to familiarize herself with how the glaze behaved on different clay bodies. Then she began drafting a design around the theme of the Year of the Rooster, drawing a composition of a rooster holding its head high and crowing, and trying to combine blue-and-white with underglaze red to highlight the layering of the feathers. After multiple revisions, the main pattern on the front of the vase was finalized as the zodiac rooster motif. When the draft was completed, she received the approval of both teachers.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Guancheng District - Between Clay Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Learning carving techniques and carving a vase.
subevent.description: From 9 a.m. to 12 p.m., under the guidance of Chen Zhiming, Yu Xiaowen systematically learned the carving technique, including the selection of carving knife types, the use of knife strokes (such as line drawing, gouging, and depth control), and the different effects on wet and dried clay bodies. She chose the vase body on which she had drawn the draft the previous day and used a carving knife to carve finely along the outline, highlighting the comb, feathers, and tail feather textures of the rooster. During the process, Teacher Zheng Guodong helped adjust local details. After the carving was complete, she refined the overall lines to enhance the three-dimensionality of the pattern.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Guancheng District - Between Clay Pottery Studio

subevent.name: Polishing the work and summarizing the course.
subevent.description: From 1 p.m. to 4 p.m., Yu Xiaowen did the final touches on top of the carved lines, removing excess clay crumbs and supplementing some underglaze painted colors. Then Chen Zhiming guided her in applying transparent glaze to the piece and explained follow-up considerations such as firing temperature and heating curve. Before the class ended, Zheng Guodong organized a peer review of the works. Yu Xiaowen presented a vase with a zodiac rooster pattern and received praise from the teacher and classmates. She packed the greenware properly and planned to have it glaze-fired after the studio's unified bisque firing.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Guancheng District - Between Clay Pottery Studio

name: Resume the morning jog habit and check in for morning runs three times a week
description: Starting November 1, after her anemia improved in a physical examination, Yu Xiaowen resumed her morning running plan. Every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 6:30 a.m., she jogged for 30 minutes along the Jinshui River, using a sports watch to record her heart rate and pace as part of health monitoring. After three consecutive weeks, she felt noticeably more energetic and incorporated the post-run stretching into her father's home rehabilitation training, achieving mutually reinforcing health management.

subevent.name: Preparation before morning run
subevent.description: Before starting her morning running plan, Yu Xiaowen checked the condition of her old running shoes and selected new running shoes, planned a running route from her home in Jinshui District to the banks of the Jinshui River, and looked up precautions for morning running after her anemia improved, to ensure a safe start to the morning running plan.
subevent.location: At home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and by the Jinshui River.

subevent.name: Checked the condition of running shoes and chose a new pair.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen took out her old running shoes from the shoe cabinet at home, carefully checked the sole wear and the condition of the uppers, and found that they needed to be replaced. She then drove her family car to a sports brand store in Jinshui District, tried on and selected a pair of cushioned running shoes suitable for jogging, and returned home after purchasing them.
subevent.location: Home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and sports brand stores

subevent.name: Plan a running route from home to the Jinshui River.
subevent.description: At home, Yu Xiaowen used a mobile map app to plan a morning running route. Starting from her home at No. 89 Jingsan Road in Jinshui District, she ran west along Jinshui Road to the greenway along the Jinshui River, about 3 kilometers in total. She avoided congested sections, marked drinking water points and restrooms along the way, and saved the route screenshot to her phone album.
subevent.location: Living room at home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City

subevent.name: Check precautions for morning running after anemia improvement
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen used her laptop at home to log into medical literature databases and sports medicine websites to look up precautions for resuming exercise after anemia improves, including target heart rate range, recommended exercise duration, and warning signs such as dizziness and fatigue. She noted the key points in her notebook to ensure a safe start to her morning running.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District, home study

subevent.name: Week 1 morning run execution
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday of the first week of November, Yu Xiaowen got up and went to the banks of the Jinshui River for a 30-minute jog. She used her sports watch to record her heart rate and pace, maintained aerobic intensity, and did simple stretches after running.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui Riverbank

subevent.name: Second week morning run execution
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday of the second week of November, Yu Xiaowen continued her morning running plan. She has gradually adapted to the exercise rhythm, with a steady pace and improved stamina.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui Riverbank

subevent.name: Week 3 morning run
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday of the third week of November, Yu Xiaowen went for her planned morning run. After three consecutive weeks, she felt her energy had noticeably improved and her mental state after running was better.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui Riverbank

subevent.name: Fourth week morning run execution.
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays of the fourth week of November, Yu Xiaowen continued her morning running plan. Morning running had become a habit; she easily completed each 30-minute session and felt a greater sense of accomplishment from teaching her father the stretching methods.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui Riverbank

name: Prepared and completed the department's professional study sharing, which received high praise.
description: To prepare for the department's monthly professional learning sharing session, Yu Xiaowen wrote a speech about her reflections on the book "Better" at home on November 11, practiced and polished it on the 12th, and officially shared it at the department meeting on the 14th, with the theme 'How doctors can protect themselves while protecting others.' The sharing received the comment from Director Zhang Lei as 'the warmest professional learning sharing of the year,' and colleagues responded enthusiastically. After the meeting, Li Wei privately praised her growth.

subevent.name: Writing a book-sharing presentation script
subevent.description: In her home study in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen wrote a sharing speech titled "How doctors can protect themselves while caring for others," based on the book The Doctor's Progress, combining her father Yu Jianguo's rehabilitation experience and her own journey from confusion to determination as a doctor. She carefully sorted out the book's core viewpoints, excerpted key passages, and incorporated the care of medical staff during her father's hospitalization and her own reflections during her professional burnout period into the speech, producing a roughly 2,000-word draft that ensured the content had both theoretical depth and personal warmth.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Trial lecture practice and polishing.
subevent.description: At home in her study, Yu Xiaowen practiced giving the presentation in front of the mirror, repeatedly adjusting her speaking pace, pauses, and emotional expression. She focused on polishing the transition between her father’s rehabilitation story and the advice on preventing job burnout, and asked her best friend Sun Yue to listen in via a WeChat video call and give feedback. Based on the suggestions, she revised the wording of one technical term in the script, making the content more accessible and moving.
subevent.location: Home study, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Departmental professional study sharing
subevent.description: At the monthly professional learning session held in the departmental conference room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen gave a book-sharing talk titled "The Doctor's Refinement" to all the department colleagues, with the theme "How doctors can protect themselves while protecting others." She combined her father Yu Jianguo's rehabilitation experience with her own reflections on transitioning into medicine, and spoke vividly and sincerely from three perspectives: identifying professional burnout, methods of self-care, and balancing the doctor-patient relationship. After the sharing, Director Zhang Lei commented on the spot, "This is the warmest professional sharing this year," and the colleagues applauded with enthusiasm. After the meeting, her mentor Dr. Li Wei said privately to Yu Xiaowen, "You have changed a lot. Last year you were still asking me whether you should transfer to another department, and now you can teach others how to balance."
subevent.location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province - Zhengzhou Central Hospital - Department Meeting Room

name: Confessed to Wang Fang about the wedding date conflict and financial difficulties; the relationship developed a rift, but she still insisted on preparing a gift.
description: On August 20, Yu Xiaowen learned that Zhang Jing's wedding was also set for October 2, which seriously clashed with Wang Fang's wedding. After three days of inner struggle, on the evening of August 23 she invited Wang Fang to a coffee shop and confessed: besides the difficulty of coordinating time, a bigger obstacle was financial pressure—a decent bridesmaid dress and a red envelope would cost at least 1,000 yuan, which was truly hard for her to afford given how carefully she was budgeting. Wang Fang was silent for a long time, then said with reddened eyes, “Why didn't you tell me earlier?” The two fell into an awkward silence, and a rift appeared in their relationship like never before. Although the conflict remained unresolved, Yu Xiaowen still went to the studio that evening, fired the cup she had thrown in July as a priority, and carved Wang Fang's initials 'WF' on it. At the same time, she began using new clay to make a pair of small bowls engraved with double-happiness patterns as wedding gifts. This series of preparations continued until the end of the month.

subevent.name: Learned that Zhang Jing's wedding and Wang Fang's wedding fall on the same day.
subevent.description: On August 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowen received a wedding invitation from Zhang Jing by phone or WeChat and was surprised to find that Zhang Jing's wedding was set for October 2, exactly the same day as Wang Fang's wedding. This news left her shocked and anxious, as she realized she would face a conflict over attending the two weddings.
subevent.location: Yu Xiaowen's home, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

subevent.name: Inner struggle under financial pressure and candid communication.
subevent.description: On August 20, Yu Xiaowen calculated the bridesmaid expenses at her home in Jinshui District. Because her savings were tight, she decided to be honest with Wang Fang and drafted the wording and alternative plans. On August 23, in the break room at Central Hospital, she explained the difficulty to Wang Fang via WeChat voice message. Wang Fang said she understood, and Yu Xiaowen felt relieved.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - Yu Xiaowen's home and workplace

subevent.name: Financial pressure calculation and the decision to come clean.
subevent.description: At her home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen sat alone at her desk, took out her phone and a calculator, and carefully calculated that the bridesmaid dress cost and cash gift for Wang Fang's wedding would be at least 1,000 yuan. She logged into her bank app to check her savings balance and found that her savings were tight, which immediately made her feel anxious and guilty. She paced back and forth in the room, repeatedly thinking about how to be honest with Wang Fang. In the end, she decided to stop hiding it and prepared her wording in advance. She planned to explain her financial difficulties and time conflicts to Wang Fang, and to suggest alternatives—such as helping with the preparations but being unable to serve as an official bridesmaid—to reduce pressure on both sides. She recorded the key points of her thoughts in her phone's memo.
subevent.location: At home in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

subevent.name: Confess the truth to Wang Fang
subevent.description: In the department lounge of the inpatient building at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen contacted Wang Fang via a WeChat voice call during her lunch break. She started with work topics, then tactfully expressed her difficulty: with limited savings, spending around 1,000 yuan would be a strain, and she might also be on duty on the wedding day, so she worried she could not properly fulfill her bridesmaid duties. She apologized sincerely to Wang Fang and proactively offered remedies: she would help decorate the venue in advance or take on other tasks that did not require large expenses, and promised that even if she could not be a bridesmaid, she would still send her sincere blessings in other ways. Wang Fang said she understood during the call. The two communicated smoothly, and Yu Xiaowen felt relieved. After the call ended, she let out a long breath, her inner pressure eased.
subevent.location: Inpatient Department Lounge, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Meet with Wang Fang and confess the scheduling conflict and financial difficulties.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 23, Yu Xiaowen arranged to meet Wang Fang at a café in Zhengzhou and confessed that she could not manage the time conflict between the two weddings, and more importantly, she could hardly afford the bridesmaid dress and the red envelope gift. After hearing this, Wang Fang was silent for a long time, and with red-rimmed eyes said, 'Why didn't you tell me earlier?' The two fell into an awkward silence, and a rift appeared in their relationship.
subevent.location: A café in Zhengzhou, Henan Province

subevent.name: Fire a ceramic cup with carved characters as a gift.
subevent.description: After the confession ended, Yu Xiaowen went that evening to Master Zheng's "Between Clay" pottery studio to fire the bisque cup that had been thrown on the wheel in July, and personally engraved Wang Fang's initials "WF" on the cup body. When finished, she put the cup into the kiln to be fired, planning it as a wedding gift.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - "Between the Clay" Ceramics Studio

subevent.name: Making a small bowl with a double happiness pattern.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen went to the pottery studio. Starting from August 24, she continued from the rough bisque she had completed the previous day, and successively finished the steps of shaping the bowl body, fine trimming and sanding, carving double-happiness patterns, trimming and drying the bisque. On August 31, she completed the bisque ware of two small bowls and placed them in the firing area to await glazing and kiln firing.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - "Between the Clay" Ceramics Studio

subevent.name: Continue shaping the bowl body.
subevent.description: After work at about 18:30, Yu Xiaowen went to the pottery studio again. She checked the moisture level of the previous day's rough pieces, then covered the bowl rims with wet sponges to prevent them from drying too quickly. She then continued to thicken the bases and walls of the bowls with clay and used a scraper to trim the rims so that the two bowls matched in height and diameter. The work lasted until after 9 p.m., and the bowl bodies were basically formed, with wet cloths placed on the surfaces to keep them moist.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - "Between the Clay" Ceramics Studio

subevent.name: Fine trimming and sanding
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen continued her trimming work. She dipped a fine-pore sponge in water and gently polished the inside and outside walls of the bowls to remove knife marks and small uneven spots, then turned the bowl blanks upside down on the turntable to trim the ring feet. Using a small carving knife, she cleaned up the excess clay strips on the bottoms of the bowls so that the feet would sit flat. Finally, she swept away debris with a soft brush; the surfaces of both bowl bodies were now smooth and refined. The work ended at 9:30 p.m.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - "Between the Clay" Ceramics Studio

subevent.name: Carving a double-happiness pattern.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen came to the studio. Master Zheng Guodong had already prepared reference drawings of the double happiness pattern for her. Yu Xiaowen first lightly sketched a symmetrical double happiness outline on the outside wall of the bowl with a pencil, then carved shallowly along the lines with a pointed graver, and deepened them with a beveled knife. Master Zheng Guodong guided her on the force and angle of the carving tool to ensure smooth and symmetrical lines. By 10 p.m., the carved pattern on one bowl was basically completed.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - "Between the Clay" Ceramics Studio

subevent.name: Refining the carved pattern details.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen continued her carving work and completed the double happiness pattern on the second bowl. She repeated the steps of sketching in pencil, shallow carving, and deepening, while paying attention to the symmetry of the patterns on the two bowls. Then she used a fine brush to clean the clay debris out of the carved grooves, and gently wiped the surface with a damp sponge to make the edges of the pattern clean and crisp. By 9:30 p.m., the carving on both bowls was fully completed.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - "Between the Clay" Ceramics Studio

subevent.name: Bisque trimming and inspection
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen carefully inspected the bisque. She found a tiny crack on the rim of one bowl, filled it with slip, and scraped it smooth. Meanwhile, she gently sanded the carved pattern area with fine sandpaper to make the design clearer. Finally, she placed the two bowls on a shelf in the ventilated area of the studio to dry naturally and recorded the drying progress. The work ended after about 2 hours.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - "Between the Clay" Ceramics Studio

subevent.name: Bisque drying and final touches
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen went to the studio to check on the drying. She used a hygrometer to measure the moisture content of the clay bodies and confirmed that they were ready for final finishing. She gently wiped the edges of the bowl feet with a damp cloth to remove excess slip, and used a sponge to refine the curvature of the rims again. She then placed the two bowls on a shelf near the electric kiln to continue drying, preparing for uniform glazing later. She left at 9 p.m.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - "Between the Clay" Ceramics Studio

subevent.name: Finished making the bisque.
subevent.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen came to the studio one last time to do the finishing work on the greenware. She carefully inspected every detail of the two small bowls, confirming that the double happiness pattern was clear and free of defects, the bowl bodies had no cracks, and the ring feet were smooth. She used a soft-bristled brush to thoroughly brush off surface dust, then placed the two bowls securely in the studio's firing area, labeled them, and left them to be glazed and kiln-fired together with the previously fired cups. At this point, the greenware of the two small bowls with the double happiness pattern was completely finished.
subevent.location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City - "Between the Clay" Ceramics Studio

name: Inspect three-bedroom apartments for parents moving to Zhengzhou and settle into the new home
description: From March 6 to March 9, Yu Xiaowen, accompanied by agents Liu Ming and Wang Li, inspected several three-bedroom apartments near Jingsan Road and Huayuan Road in Jinshui District. On the evening of March 9, she calculated her monthly income and expenses at home and made a savings plan. On March 12, she met with landlord Song Yumei to discuss ending the lease early. Aunt Song voluntarily returned the full deposit and waived part of the rent, moving her as she said goodbye to her old residence at 89 Jingsan Road. On March 15, Yu Xiaowen selected a property in Jinshui District and signed a formal lease contract, paying the deposit and first month's rent. On March 22, her parents Yu Jianguo and Li Xiuying arrived in Zhengzhou from Luoyang and moved into the new home in Jinshui District, where the family began living together.

subevent.name: Visit properties in person and calculate the budget.
subevent.description: On March 6, accompanied by real estate agent Liu Ming, Yu Xiaowen visited a community near Jingsan Road in Jinshui District to inspect two three-bedroom apartments; on March 8, accompanied by agent Wang Li, she inspected two three-bedroom apartments in a community near Huayuan Road, comparing the surrounding facilities and rents; on the evening of March 9, she calculated her monthly income and expenses at home, listed the difference between the old and new rent, crossed out non-essential expenditures, and made a strict money-saving plan.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District / Home / Agency

subevent.name: Field visit to residential communities near Jingsan Road
subevent.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowen went to the residential area near Jingsan Road in Jinshui District as scheduled, accompanied by real estate agent Liu Ming to view apartments. They looked at two three-bedroom units in succession, one on the 5th floor (80 square meters, monthly rent 2,800 yuan), the other on the 12th floor (95 square meters, monthly rent 3,200 yuan). Yu Xiaowen carefully checked the lighting, ventilation, and water/electricity facilities, asked about property management fees and parking, photographed the floor plans and interiors with her phone, and recorded the pros and cons.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Jinshui District - a community on Jingsan Road

subevent.name: Field survey of residential neighborhoods near Huayuan Road
subevent.description: At 2 p.m., accompanied by another agent, Wang Li, Yu Xiaowen went to view apartments in two residential communities near Huayuan Road in Jinshui District. First, she inspected a three-bedroom apartment (100 square meters, monthly rent 3,500 yuan), then viewed another one (88 square meters, monthly rent 3,000 yuan). Yu Xiaowen discussed the room for rent negotiation with the agent and compared the surrounding amenities (supermarkets, bus stops, pharmacies, etc.). Finally, she took the property flyers home to compare and analyze.
subevent.location: A residential community on Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Calculate the budget and make a savings plan.
subevent.description: At 8 pm, Yu Xiaowen sat at her desk in her bedroom at home, took out her ledger and calculator, and began to calculate her personal monthly income and expenses. She listed fixed income (monthly salary after tax about 9,000 yuan) and fixed expenses (current rent 1,800 yuan, utilities 300 yuan, dining 1,500 yuan, transportation 500 yuan, communication 100 yuan, monthly fund investment 2,000 yuan). She found that if the new rent were 3,500 yuan, she would spend 1,700 yuan more each month. She crossed out items in her notebook such as "book budget 200 yuan," "entertainment activities 300 yuan," and "non-essential clothing 500 yuan," and made a strict savings plan: keep weekly dining within 1,000 yuan, stop buying non-essential consumer goods, and set a monthly savings target of no less than 3,000 yuan.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - Jinshui District - home bedroom

subevent.name: Notify the landlord, Aunt Song, of early lease termination.
subevent.description: On March 12, Yu Xiaowen met with her landlord Song Yumei at her old residence at 89 Jingsan Road to discuss ending the lease early. Upon learning that Xiaowen wanted to rent a place in Zhengzhou to bring her parents over, Aunt Song expressed understanding and voluntarily offered to return the full deposit, not charging for the extra few days of rent, which deeply moved Xiaowen. After seeing Aunt Song off, she finished the hulatang that Aunt Song had brought, and said goodbye to 89 Jingsan Road, where she had lived for nearly six years.
subevent.location: Home, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

subevent.name: Signed a lease for a three-bedroom apartment in Jinshui District.
subevent.description: On March 15, Yu Xiaowen signed a formal lease agreement with the landlord for a three-bedroom property in Jinshui District that she had previously liked, paid the deposit and first month's rent. She carefully inspected the house facilities, confirmed the water, electricity, and gas conditions, and got the keys. The new home is located in a convenient area of Jinshui District, surrounded by a vegetable market and a park, suitable for her parents to live in.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - in the new rental apartment in Jinshui District

subevent.name: Parents move into new home in Zhengzhou
subevent.description: On March 22, Yu Xiaowen's parents, Yu Jianguo and Li Xiuying, traveled by bus from Luoyang to Zhengzhou and, with Yu Xiaowen's assistance, moved into a newly rented three-bedroom apartment in Jinshui District. Yu Xiaowen had cleaned the house in advance and bought necessary daily necessities. After her parents settled in, the family sat around the dining table in their new home and ate a meal, bringing an end to their hectic traveling life and starting a new life in Zhengzhou.
subevent.location: New residence, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou.

name: Implement dietary adjustments and iron supplementation
description: Starting October 20, Yu Xiaowen began implementing a dietary adjustment and iron supplement plan: breakfast changed to beef hulatang with boiled eggs; lunch added iron-rich foods such as pork liver and spinach; and she took iron supplements daily. After adapting and adjusting during the initial phase, she entered a stable execution phase, sticking to the daily diet plan and taking medication on time, occasionally changing the variety of dishes to maintain nutritional balance. Finally, on December 19, she conducted a phase summary, felt her energy had improved significantly, and planned to continue the good eating habits.

subevent.name: Dietary adjustment and initiation phase of iron supplementation
subevent.description: Since October 20, Yu Xiaowen has been following a new diet plan. For breakfast, at home or in the hospital cafeteria, she has beef hulatang soup with boiled eggs. For lunch, she pays attention to a balanced meat and vegetable mix, adding iron-rich foods such as pork liver and spinach, and takes iron supplements after dinner every day. She is gradually adapting to the new routine, observing her body's reactions, and recording her daily diet and energy changes.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – my home and the Zhengzhou Central Hospital cafeteria

subevent.name: Start the first-day diet plan and take iron supplements
subevent.description: On October 20, Yu Xiaowen followed the new plan: for breakfast, she made beef spicy soup in her home kitchen and paired it with a boiled egg; for lunch, at the Zhengzhou Central Hospital cafeteria, she deliberately chose stir-fried pork liver with spinach, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and mixed-grain rice, ensuring a balanced meat-and-vegetable combination rich in iron; after dinner, in her living room, she took her first iron supplement and used her phone memo app to record the day's diet and initial feelings, officially starting the dietary adjustment and iron supplementation plan.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou City - own home kitchen and the cafeteria of Zhengzhou Central Hospital.

subevent.name: Weekly Diet and Body Response Log
subevent.description: On the evening of October 27 after dinner, Yu Xiaowen sat at her desk at home and reviewed her diet implementation over the past week (October 20 to 26). She flipped through daily records and summarized changes in energy: she found that her morning energy had improved, afternoon drowsiness had decreased, no obvious gastrointestinal discomfort occurred, and she tolerated the iron supplement well. She wrote a stage summary in her diary and planned to keep the current menu for the next week, paying attention to increasing fruit intake to promote iron absorption.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home study

subevent.name: Two-week mid-term assessment and dietary fine-tuning.
subevent.description: During her lunch break on November 3, Yu Xiaowen used the memo app on her phone in the hospital rest area to conduct a two-week diet evaluation: comparing with the records from two weeks ago, she found that her energy levels were noticeably more stable and the color of her nails was healthier. Based on how she felt, she decided to change the pork liver in her lunch from daily to every other day, and to add more soy products and mushrooms to diversify her nutritional sources. That day she still followed the new plan for breakfast and lunch and took her iron supplement, and reminded herself to repurchase the iron supplement at the pharmacy on the weekend.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Rest Area of Zhengzhou Central Hospital

subevent.name: Final summary and follow-up plan formulation
subevent.description: After dinner on November 17, Yu Xiaowen did an end-of-stage summary on the sofa in her living room. She sorted through her nearly one-month food diary and found that her overall energy level had improved by about 30%, with no anemia-related symptoms. She decided to continue the current diet plan but adjusted the iron supplement to once every other day to observe whether the effect could be maintained, and planned to recheck her blood routine at next month's physical examination. She saved the summary document and shared it with her best friend Zhang Jing (informal communication), and also marked it in her phone calendar to remind herself to follow up.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - living room at home

subevent.name: Stable implementation phase of dietary adjustments and iron supplementation
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowen has fully adapted to her new diet routine. She continues to have beef pepper soup with a boiled egg for breakfast every day, includes iron-rich foods in her lunch, and takes her iron supplement on time. She feels that her energy has improved significantly and has kept up good execution habits. During this period, she had no obvious discomfort, and she occasionally adjusted the variety of dishes to maintain balanced nutrition.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou – my home and the Zhengzhou Central Hospital cafeteria

subevent.name: Try adjusting the variety of dishes
subevent.description: While having lunch at the cafeteria of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen deliberately tried a new combination of iron-rich dishes, including stir-fried pig blood and cold dressed black fungus, to add more variety to her diet. She noted the taste and texture as well as how her body felt, and she continued to take her iron supplement on time without any discomfort.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - Zhengzhou Central Hospital Cafeteria

subevent.name: Phase completion and personal summary.
subevent.description: At her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen summarized the dietary adjustments for this phase. Reviewing a month of persistence and physical changes, she felt a significant boost in energy and an improvement in her complexion. She recorded her progress in her diary and planned to continue these good eating habits to provide a stronger physical foundation for obtaining the attending physician qualification.
subevent.location: Zhengzhou - home
